Job.CustomJobTypeName: Loss Control Consultant, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
At Alexander & Schmidt, a Senior Loss Control Consultant performs inspections and prepares in-depth reports for insurance underwriting purposes. Insurance companies use the reports to properly insure a commercial building, or business operations, for a new policy or renewal of a current policy.

Required Skills

  • A Minimum 10 years' experience with a major carrier or working as an independent contractor providing loss control services.
  • Extensive understanding of commercial property and casualty lines.
    • Property assessments will potentially include the necessity to determine adequacy of sprinkler systems based on occupancy, commodities and racking systems.
    • Inland Marine coverages will include builders risk, contractor's equipment, motor truck cargo, WLL and MOLL and other specialty coverage's.
    • Commercial General Liability will include Premises, Operations, Products and Completed Operations.
    • Workers Compensation assessments for regulatory compliance and workplace safety.
    • Loss analysis involving identification of trends, root cause and appropriate corrective action.
    • Specialty fields such as Environmental and Professional Liability
  • Risk Improvement services including training, consulting, hazard analysis and regulatory assessments will also be conducted.
  • Solid communication skills—including exceptional writing ability, organizational skills, and computer skills
  • Excellent Time management skills
  • Professional certifications CSP, OHST, ALCM and/or ARM are preferred, but not required.
  • Uploading completed reports, photos and diagrams through a special website or complete reports on web based systems
  • Travel within a reasonable territory, 50 mile radius

This work will be challenging and covers everything from contractors to real estate to retail to warehouse and distribution to manufacturing.

High-quality, accurate loss control surveys guide the underwriter in the selection of profitable business, and assist the insured in controlling losses through the demonstrated value of the loss control services provided.

Job.JobTitle: Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Southwest Region
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist

Southwest Region

Lead With Expertise. Deliver Impact That Matters. Grow With a Company That Invests in You.

At Liberty Mutual, we show up for people in their toughest moments, and we show up for our employees with the same commitment. We areseeking a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist for our Southwest Region who brings deep technical expertise, sharp critical thinking, and a passion for doing whats right.

If youre energized by the challenge of managing highexposure, complex, and catastrophic injury claims, and you want to work in an environment where professionalism, integrity, and empathy guide everything we do, this is the role for you.

What Makes This Role Special:

You Own the Complex Work

Youll be the point person on severe and catastrophic auto and homeowners casualty claims, navigating litigation, partnering with counsel, and driving strategy.

Your Expertise Is Valued

Your judgment plays a key role in shaping outcomes. Youll influence decisions on some of our most significant claims, backed by leaders who respect your experience.

Flexibility Meets Purpose

This role is remote or hybrid depending on location, with only a modest two days a month expectation if you live near a hub.

Youll Keep Growing

From advanced technical training to mentorship opportunities, were dedicated to helping you expand your impact.

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an activeFL or TX AllLines Adjuster License(CEs current) may qualify for a$2,500 signon bonus.

What Youll Do:

  • Manage the investigation, evaluation, and resolution of complex auto and homeowners casualty claims.
  • Assess coverage, liability, and damages; recommend settlement strategies and escalate appropriately for authority review.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Collaborate closely with trial counsel; attend mediations, arbitrations, trials, hearings, and conferences.
  • Prepare detailed litigation and trial reports for local management and Home Office.
  • Communicate effectively with policyholders, witnesses, attorneys, and claimants to gather information and provide guidance.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports.
  • Maintain accurate reserves, recommending increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Safeguard financial and confidential information across all claim files.
  • Oversee billing practices of outside and inhouse counsel to ensure compliance and cost efficiency.
  • May assist as a resource to the team, stepping in for the Claims Team Manager when needed or mentoring colleagues; or representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • Participate in special projects at the direction of leadership.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fastpaced, highstakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills
  • California and Arizona Casualty claims handling

Where You Can Work:

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote. Candidates located in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Pacific/Mountain Time Zones.

Ideal candidate will be located in Scottsdale, AZ.

  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and at least 5-7 years of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

Job.JobTitle: Business Insurance Underwriting Professional Development Program (BI UPDP) Internship
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $25.00 to $26.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Ten-week summer internship in business insurance underwriting at Travelers, running early June to mid-August in Hartford, Connecticut. Interns complete training modules, project work, and gain exposure to commercial insurance underwriting with potential pathway to full-time Professional Development Program.

Good fit if you are pursuing a Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, risk management, or related field, with working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. 

Salary Range

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in October. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Director Sourcing Strategy Management and Governance
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sourcing and Supplier Management (S&SM) team drives enterprise-wide sourcing strategy, supplier governance, and supplier risk management across Travelers' technology and operations supplier portfolio. This multi-disciplinary team manages Travelers' global sourcing and supplier relationships, and is accountable for implementing strategic sourcing models that optimize supplier relationships and deliver measurable business outcomes.

This Senior Director leads S&SM's Sourcing Risk & Operations function, managing a team responsible for supplier risk reviews, business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) planning, offshore development center (ODC) management, site audits, and various other supplier operations and governance functions. The Risk & Operations team is shifting from a reactive, process-facilitation model to a proactive, portfolio-based approach to supplier risk management - this role is accountable for leading that transition and for building the frameworks, cadence, and team capability needed to deliver a holistic, enterprise view and approach to risk management for these suppliers.

Additionally, this role will play a key role in expanding Sourcing and Supplier Management's strategic partnership role with Tech & Ops platform and product partners, enhancing governance frameworks and relationship management protocols. Additionally, the role encompasses developing and maintaining executive briefing materials that provide leadership visibility into strategic vendor partnerships and performance outcomes.

This senior director role is also a key member of the extended S&SM leadership team, which is responsible for developing and executing Tech & Ops sourcing strategies that align supplier selection, relationship management, and strategic sourcing models with enterprise objectives. The position partners closely with Line of Business Technology & Operations leadership and cross-functional stakeholders - including SLT/ELT, Procurement, Legal, and Workforce Management. Leveraging Travelers' scale and strategic positioning, this role partners with technology and business leaders on managed services models, sourcing strategies, and supplier selection aligned to workforce planning initiatives.

This position manages a team.

What Will You Do?

  • Supplier Risk Program Leadership & Proactive Risk Monitoring: Own end-to-end supplier risk management for the Tech&Ops strategic supplier portfolio - including risk reviews, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring. Lead the team's transition from reactive, case-by-case process facilitation to proactive, portfolio-based oversight that gives S&SM and Tech & Ops leadership a holistic, enterprise view of supplier risk exposure. Drive continuous improvement to how the work is completed, emphasizing value-add activities and approaches while reducing reactive, manual work wherever possible.
  • Portfolio Design and Management: Develop a portfolio-based approach to Tech&Ops strategic supplier population, including a framework for determining which suppliers are in-scope, how suppliers align to portfolios, what level of governance/operational support are required for each supplier, and how to align portfolios to team members. Lead the growth of the team's role in ongoing supplier governance - identifying opportunities to add value, deepen the team's knowledge of the supplier's footprint, and partner to help business stakeholders drive the most value from each supplier relationship. Leverage S&SM's mature professional services sourcing (GSO) program to drive the development of a strategic, substantive approach to Tech&Ops non-GSO strategic providers.
  • Executive Briefings: Lead the development, maintenance and continued improvement of briefing materials for senior executives within Tech&Ops, in partnership with stakeholders across the organization, ranging from the supplier's executive sponsor to leaders responsible for day-to-day operations with the supplier, to procurement, finance and legal. Ensure materials are comprehensive, provide a holistic view of the total supplier footprint, and include timely, actionable information; additionally, prepare distilled talking points as required to summarize key aspects of each supplier relationship to support senior executive meetings.
  • BC/DR and Incident Management: Manage business continuity and disaster recovery planning and readiness across S&SM's strategic suppliers, including partnering with BC/DR stakeholders to plan and facilitate annual tabletop testing, drafting/disseminating communications to strategic suppliers in connection with incident management/DR events, and identify opportunities to improve BC/DR preparedness.
  • ODC Management, Site Audits & Other Operational Controls: Oversee oversight of Travelers' offshore development center footprint, evaluating site changes - capacity shifts, technology updates, operational control changes - for risk and operational impact, and directing site audits toward the areas of greatest control exposure. Own SOC review outcomes for strategic professional services partners, assessing findings for substantive risk and driving suppliers to remediate gaps rather than simply tracking review completion.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and manage the Sourcing Risk & Operations team, setting direction, priorities, and performance expectations. Build team capability - through coaching, role clarity, and tooling - to support the shift to portfolio-based risk management.

Collaborative Environment, Transformational Projects, and a Growing Team!

  • Experience supporting transformational change. Able to adjust plans, priorities and strategies in response to changing circumstances.
  • Insurance technology experience preferred.
  • Understanding of value creation and business capability models.
  • Strong knowledge of the insurance industry.

  • Experience with cloud AI services AWS Bedrock including AgentCore (optional: Azure Foundry/Agent 365, or GCP/Gemini AI), with awareness of multi-cloud and SaaS AI and agentic capabilities
  • Working knowledge of responsible AI principles, AI ethics, and compliance considerations relevant to production AI deployments
  • Awareness of AI governance frameworks and risk management practices, with ability to apply established standards within defined guardrails

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT

  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Manager responsible for enterprise-wide sourcing and supplier strategies, governance, and performance management across Travelers' global supplier relationships. Executes work order processes, manages supplier portfolios, and serves as key point of contact for business stakeholders on sourcing strategy execution and supplier performance.

Good fit if you have experience managing supplier relationships, sourcing strategies, and work order processes in a complex, multi-line organization.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$106,600.00 - $175,900.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Member of the Sourcing and Supplier Management team within Tech & Ops Finance responsible for enterprise-wide sourcing and supplier strategies, governance, performance management, risk and operational processes for Travelers' global sourcing and supplier relationships.

As a Manager, Sourcing Strategy, Management and Governance, you will play a critical role in executing work order processes across assigned business lines and area-specific strategic sourcing strategies, including sourcing model design, supplier selection, and alignment of suppliers to business needs across our professional services and outsourcing partner portfolio. You will serve as a key point of contact on execution of sourcing strategy, workforce demand, and supplier performance across assigned lines, partnering closely with business stakeholders to track activity, resolve issues, and identify opportunities to improve how the team operates. This position does not manage others.

What Will You Do?

  • Work Order/Vendor Management and Sourcing Strategy: Manage a defined set of supplier work orders or portfolio activities across multiple assigned lines, including intake, modifications, closures, data-driven analysis, and process and tool optimization. Serve as a proactive sourcing advisor to LOB stakeholders, providing counsel on sourcing model selection, supplier performance, and workforce demand planning. Apply enterprise sourcing models and rate card structures to work being requested, advising stakeholders on right model, right supplier, right rate.
  • Onboarding and Team Support: Oversee resource onboarding and monitor engaged resources for quality, progress, and team dynamics. Own resource onboarding end-to-end, including understanding the skills required for the work being engaged, validating skill requirements with LOB stakeholders, and driving Technical Assessments. Cultivate ongoing, trusted relationships with the owners of the work, including engagement managers and LOB stakeholders, staying close enough to the business to anticipate needs, flag risks early, and bring forward solutions before issues escalate. Partner with Circle Leads on resource and team alignment needs.
  • Proactivity and Risk Management: Monitor assigned vendor performance data and flag early indicators of risk or control gaps, addressing delivery issues as they arise and escalating when appropriate. Analyze work order data, supplier capability changes, and sourcing market conditions to identify business continuity risks, surface insights, and deliver proactive recommendations to leadership. Maintain deep understanding of assigned business lines to anticipate workforce needs, monitor internal demands, and inform sourcing strategy.
  • Internal and External Stakeholder Engagement: Build and sustain trusted relationships with business stakeholders, finance partners, and assigned supplier contacts to surface risks, resolve delivery concerns and budget variances, and support governance interactions, performance discussions, and sourcing process coordination. Provide data and updates supporting ELT visibility for assigned lines on execution of sourcing strategy, workforce demand, and supplier performance.
  • Work Transition and Migration: Own the operational execution of work transitions when sourcing decisions result in a change of supplier, sourcing model, or workforce composition. This includes coordinating the migration of work from internal resources to external suppliers, managing supplier transitions, supporting onboarding of new supplier teams, and ensuring continuity of delivery throughout the transition period. Partner closely with LOB stakeholders, DFRs, and the S&SM Strategy team to sequence and execute transitions in alignment with enterprise sourcing strategy and workforce plans.
  • Process Optimization: Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities, including AI-enabled workflow enhancements. Optimize like work across assigned lines, standardizing repeatable processes, eliminating redundancy, and driving consistency across the Sourcing Delivery and Execution team. Champion the use of Travelers' AI tooling to streamline reporting, automate recurring workflows, and improve the quality and speed of work.
  • Rate Card Adherence: Ensure compliance with established enterprise sourcing models and rate card structures. Partner with the S&SM Strategy team to validate that work being requested aligns to the appropriate rate card, role designation, and sourcing model, and assist stakeholders in understanding and adhering to rate card guidelines.
  • Track and report on sourcing footprint, role utilization, team composition, and premium role usage across assigned lines.
  • Manage sourcing activity across multiple assigned lines or areas. Bring cross-line perspective to sourcing decisions, identify patterns and efficiencies across the portfolio, and ensure consistent application of enterprise sourcing strategy regardless of line-specific variation.
  • Monitor work order alignment to budget; proactively flag variances and partner with DFRs to resolve.
  • Contribute to the preparation of Business Review materials and Monthly Operating Review (MOR) data for assigned lines, supporting leadership visibility into supplier performance, workforce trends, and sourcing activity across the portfolio.
  • Partner cross-functionally with LOB stakeholders, DFRs, and Procurement to support sourcing and contracting activity, ensure alignment on budget and resource plans, and facilitate resolution of issues that span organizational boundaries.
  • Engage with and learn Travelers' AI tooling, applying these capabilities to improve the speed and quality of recurring work such as reporting, data analysis, and workflow management.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience required.   
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in sourcing, workforce strategy, supplier management, or a related field.
  • Experience with Fieldglass, ACS, and workforce planning tools strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting or managing work transitions, supplier migrations, or sourcing model changes preferred.
  • Familiarity with rate card structures, role modernization concepts, and supplier performance principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior LOB or technology leaders.
  • Experience identifying and implementing process improvements or automation opportunities.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered tools and large language models (e.g., Claude); demonstrated ability or willingness to integrate AI capabilities into day-to-day work processes preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, including Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong working knowledge of sourcing models: managed services, staff augmentation, GSO, POD/catalog models, and rate card structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, ambiguous situations and drive to resolution with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate sourcing data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for business partners.
  • Process improvement and automation orientation, with experience identifying and implementing operational efficiencies.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior LOB leaders and building trusted advisor relationships.
  • Demonstrated initiative in identifying and adopting tools, technology, and process improvements that increase team efficiency and output quality, including AI-enabled solutions.
  • Demonstrated proficiency or willingness to actively develop proficiency with AI-powered tools, including large language models such as Claude; ability to apply these tools to sourcing workflows, reporting, and operational tasks to improve efficiency and output quality.
  • Ability to operate effectively through change and ambiguity, adapting approaches as the function evolves.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and in a team environment.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple workstreams, and deadlines simultaneously in a fast-moving environment.

What is a Must Have?

  • Three years of experience Supplier Management, Finance, Audit, Procurement, or a related field.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. About this job

Assurant seeks a People Partner in Irving, Texas to provide HR support to managers and employees, focusing on employee experience and data-driven decisions. The role includes coaching on performance issues, hiring assistance, employee engagement, and termination support for a designated business unit.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree, 2+ years HR experience including coaching, knowledge of employment law, and 1+ year supporting 250+ employees.

Full job description

Overview of Position

We are growing in Irving, Texas! Assurant is seeking a People Partner who will provide Human Resource support to managers and employees in designated segments in one of Assurant Lines of businesses (LOB) focusing on the employee experience, enabling business outcomes, and using data to help make solid business decisions.

In partnership with the People Business Partner, you will provide comprehensive and consistent coaching to employees and managers on performance and conduct/behavioral related challenges. This will include answering questions and listening to concerns about the workplace and jobs. The Partner will also work with the Business Partner to assist the LOB in identifying people and talent needs in the organization through the application of talent program and processes.

This role espouses the vision of the People Organization by:

  • Putting people first

  • Helping our employees realize their potential

  • Empowering our employees to do their best work

  • Embedding Diversity Equity and Inclusion in all that we do

  • Living The Assurant Commitments in all that we do

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Focus on the employee experience, provide proactive and reactive coaching and consultative human resources advice and services to all employees of Assurant in their designated business unit from intake to resolution.

  • Coaching and advice are centered around and leverages the core learnings of Success in Leading Employees (i.e., StAR/StAR-AR, GROW) as they counsel on Performance Development and Performance Improvement situations.

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with Managers and with the People Business Partners for their client group.

  • Provide hiring & staffing assistance such as interviewing, assessing and selection to managers as needed. Including effective compensation management and development of job descriptions for needed positions.

  • Partner with managers in client group in their efforts around Employee Engagement that could include action planning, team meetings and follow-up to ensure closure on plans.

  • Provide performance coaching and advice which may include participation in meetings with employees and managers.

  • Provide advice on policy interpretation with the focus on advising managers to always use their judgment and discretion. The Partner will leverage the Success in Leading Employees information in their interactions with managers and promote the use of this information to the Managers.

  • Provide education and training to managers as needed in areas such as FMLA, Union Avoidance, Wage and Hour, Accommodations etc. Collaboratively makes decisions about training needed by consulting with managers, Legal and/or People Business Partner.

  • Performs consultation responsibilities to assist managers & leaders in the termination process whether a reduction in force or a voluntary or involuntary termination including participating in any termination meeting with employees.

  • Facilitates the end-to-end process of the reduction in force in consultation with the People Business Partner and Business leadership. This will include the assessment of talent, notification to impacted associates and continued support to those employees after notification.

  • Performs more routine inquiries, research or investigation into issues raised by employees, managers, or other sources.

  • Participates in additional projects as identified by the People Organization leadership.

  • Utilize multiple tools (Workday, Peakon, ERIN, etc.) to mine data for their client groups and use the analytics to drive performance in the organization.

  • Recommend updates and suggestions to the content in the Knowledge Base and in the analytics that will improve the content available to them and to the managers.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with members of the People Experience Center team to expedite and ensure that employee and manager concerns or requests which have been escalated are responded to in a timely, consistent, and accurate manner as well as documented appropriately.


What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in a related area

  • A minimum of 2 years of experience in a Human Resource professional role.

  • Experience must include coaching and advising all levels of employees in areas such as performance, organizational change, employee engagement, working relationships.

  • Knowledge of employment law at the federal and state level (FMLA, ADA, FLSA, Title VII, EEO and other applicable employment related laws)

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Extensive analytical and problem-solving skills desired.

  • Certification as PHR, SPHR or SHRM CP or SCP preferred.

  • Experience in handling employee related investigations and writing report summaries.

  • Minimum of 1 year HR support for a workforce of a minimum of 250 employees.


Pay Range

$74,600.00 - $124,700.00

About this job

Negotiates purchase of complex equipment and strategic services, processes purchase orders, and coaches junior buyers. Focuses on cost reduction, lead-time improvement, and product quality while managing supplier relationships and driving procurement process improvements.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree in business or finance, 5 years of buying and procurement experience, and knowledge of RFP processes and purchasing contract terms.

Full job description

The Senior Buyer negotiates the purchase of complex equipment and strategic services within authorized limits, processes purchase requisitions and purchase orders using system software, looks for optimization, cost reduction, improved lead-times and product quality. The Senior Buyer coaches and mentors any Associate Buyer and Buyer. The Senior Buyer must have advanced knowledge of purchasing contract terms, RFP process, bid analysis and must be able to lead complex customer-focused special projects.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Purchase goods and services by utilizing the Procurement operation processes and technology across Assurant enterprise to meet the needs of the customers.
  • Review purchase requisitions for completeness and accuracy.
  • Develop, implement and follow established Procurement policies, procedures and organization structure.
  • Manage suppliers, internal costs, quality and delivery performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement on end-to-end aspects of the procurement process.
  • Maintain and promote sound relationships with suppliers and the business community.
  • Maintain positive relationships and communication with internal customers.
  • Demonstrate understanding of market trends and conditions for product changes.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business or Finance
  • 5 years buying and procurement related experience
  • Ability to positively adjust to changing daily demands and work volumes required.
  • Effective verbal and written skills with mid to upper-level management required.
  • Above-average telephone and interpersonal skills required.
  • Above-average judgment, initiative, problem solving, collaboration and teamwork skills required.
  • Ability to conduct Request for Proposal (RFP) projects.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel.
  • Knowledge of purchasing terms, concepts, processes and procedures.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • CPM certification

Company Details

Gemini Transportation Underwriters is a leading provider of excess liability insurance for companies in the transportation industry. We offer excess liability coverage for all types of vehicles and excess liability and railroad protection for freight and passenger railroads and public transit systems.

As part of W. R. Berkley Corporation, one of the nation's premiere commercial lines property casualty insurance providers, we combine the resources of a Fortune 500 company with the underwriting expertise and personalized service of a specialty carrier.

We are pleased to underwrite and issue policies on behalf of Gemini Insurance Company*, also a W.R. Berkley member company, which carries an A. M. Best Financial Strength Rating of A+ (Superior) and a Financial Size Category of XV.

Company URL: https://www.geminiunderwriters.com/

The company is an equal opportunity employee

Responsibilities

The Claims Specialist handles high-exposure transportation claims (trucking, public transit, rail) throughout the United States.

Key Functions/Duties of Position: Describe the overall job responsibilities (including any decision-making authority) for this position.

  • Determine whether Gemini has a present or potential future defense obligation or indemnity obligation on assigned claims and position claims accordingly.
  • Handle assigned claims for which Gemini has a present or potential future defense obligation or indemnity obligation
    • Actively monitor and evaluate handling of such claims by insureds within self-insured retentions or underlying carriers and gather all information, documentation and advice necessary to evaluate and manage the exposure to the insured and Gemini.
    • Participate in the defense of such claims with insureds or underlying carriers to the extent necessary to protect the interests of the insured and Gemini or assume control of the defense as may be required by policy language, law or circumstances.
    • Retain, lead and supervise monitoring counsel or defense counsel in representing the interests of the insured or Gemini or both.
    • Establish expense and loss reserves up to designated authority levels and recommend reserving above such levels to Claims Unit Manager, Senior Vice President of Claims and President of Gemini as needed.
    • Review, evaluate and, if necessary, respond in a reasonable and timely fashion to demands seeking payment of an insured's total applicable limits of liability, time-limited demands, offers of judgment, demands that Gemini settle a claim within its limits of liability and similar types of demands or offers.
    • Retain, lead and direct coverage counsel in providing advice and guidance to Gemini as needed.
    • Represent Gemini at settlement conferences, mediations and any court room or trial appearances as may be required.
    • Ensure that claims are being handled (by the insured, an underlying carrier or by Gemini) in a manner such that the insured and counsel retained to defend the insured are prepared and ready try a case to verdict if a reasonable negotiated resolution cannot be achieved.
    • Negotiation the settlement of claims on behalf of Gemini up to designated authority levels and request authority above such levels to Claims Unit Manager, Senior Vice President of Claims and President of Gemini as necessary.
  • Report on a regular basis to the Claims Unit Manager, Senior Vice President of Claims, Vice President of Underwriting, and President of Gemini due to nature of claims being handled.
  • Additional responsibilities and opportunities assigned based on need, performance and demonstrated development potential.

Qualifications

Education Requirement

  • Bachelor's Degree required
  • Juris doctor with litigation experience preferred.

Qualifications: Include necessary skills/experience and core competencies required

  • Minimum of six (6) years handling or litigating commercial auto liability claims with an insurance company or law firm required. Experience handling trucking claims, in particular, preferred.
  • Experience handling claims involving public transit systems (busses, subways, etc.) and railroads preferred.
  • Experience handling claims on behalf of umbrella or excess carriers preferred.
  • Must have excellent investigative and analytical abilities.
  • Must have excellent written and oral communications skills.
  • Creativity and problem-solving abilities are essential.
  • Ability to assess priorities and manage deadlines effectively.
  • Must have sufficient knowledge and confidence to lead, instruct, question and challenge, in a reasonable and appropriate fashion, counsel retained to represent insureds or Gemini or both.
  • Up to 20% travel.

Additional Company Details

Only solicited resumes/candidate profiles that are submitted by a Berkley Preferred Agency Partner that have been requested by Berkley Internal Recruiting to engage in a particular search will be subject to the payment of Agency fees as defined in the formal agency agreement. Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles are not subject to payment of the agency fees.

The company offers a competitive compensation plan which for this role include:
o Base Salary Range: $85,000-$130,000 DOE
o Eligible to participate in annual discretionary bonus.
o Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit-Sharing plans.

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

About this job

Field Property Claims Adjuster for Farmers Insurance in Eugene/Corvallis area. Visit policyholders' homes to assess property damage, determine liability, and negotiate settlements using claims software and company vehicle.

Good fit if you have customer service experience, valid driver's license, can climb ladders and work in confined spaces, and live in greater Eugene area

Full job description

We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Here, growth isn't just a goal – it's a way of life for both the organization and every individual on our team. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Remote ( #LI-Remote ) - This is a field role requiring travel to and from policy holder homes.

Location Requirement: Candidates must live in the greater Eugene, Oregon area and be residents of the state of Oregon to be eligible for consideration.


The starting wage for this position is $27.67/hr. or higher. Additional compensation may be offered based on relevant experience and transferable skills.

If you are looking for the following in your next career...

  • Paid training through the award-winning and industry-leading University of Farmers.
  • Flexibility and independence to work outside the confines of a desk job.
  • Total Rewards Benefits Package: 401K and a competitive starting salary.
  • Rapid growth potential and management opportunities for success-oriented people through education, mentorship programs, and inspirational leadership at a company you can be proud of.

… Then Farmers Insurance is the place for you!

A Day in the Life of a Field Property Claims Adjuster

  • Conduct both virtual and on-site investigations by visiting policyholders' residences to assess propertydamage, determine liability, evaluate the extent of loss, and negotiate fair settlements.
  • Use claims handling software, a company car, and a laptop to determine claims-related damage and write estimates in a paperless environment.
  • Evaluate and report on potential subrogation opportunities.
  • Reports incidents involving theft, fraud, or arson to appropriate state and industry agencies.
  • Perform duties independently, with work directly impacting management outcomes.
  • Acts as a company representative in public interactions, maintaining a professional demeanor consistentwith management standards.
  • Engages regularly with a variety of stakeholders, including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses,contractors, law enforcement, fraud and arson investigators, attorneys, medical professionals, and otherrelevant parties.
  • Use strong customer service skills to negotiate with policyholders to settle the claim.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.
  • Promotes safety at all times and complies with safety/ergonomicstandards as outlined in relevant company published manuals.

Employees assigned to the Catastrophe team will be required to travel away from their residence for a specified period of time, usually consisting of 23 days.

  • Although this is not a CAT-specific role, hires will be expected to commit to 1–3 CAT deployments per year.

If You Have the Following:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Excellent Customer service experience, preferably in a retail environment
  • Construction or Insurance experience is highly desirable and preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills – both oral and written.
  • Computer Literate: MS Word, Excel, Outlook.
  • Proficiency with smartphones and applications.
  • Eagerness to learn about insurance policies and property damage from the inside out to identify how coverage applies to a particular loss.
  • Outgoing personality that would enjoy interacting with a wide variety of people including policyholders, claimants, agents, witnesses, and fraud investigators.
  • Valid driver's license and Bondable. Final candidates will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle Record background check as this position may include a company vehicle.

... then this could be a great career opportunity for you!

Final candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated level of this role.

Candidates Must be Willing and Able to:

  • Climb Ladders to inspect roofs, and be comfortable working on rooftops, multiple times per day,
  • Work in small, confined spaces that have been damaged; such as attics and crawlspaces.
  • Achieve a minimum passing score on all claims training exams.

Physical Actions and Environment

  • Bending, Kneeling, Pulling, Pushing, Sorting, Carrying up to 50 lbs., Climbing, Reaching, Standing, Walking, Seeing
  • Speaking (English), Reading (English), Writing (English), & Key Entering

Required job duties are performed in the field and an in-home office environment. Exposure to some or all of the following environments when in the field: Uncontrolled outside environmental conditions, Excessive noise levels, Chemicals Chemical/Biological conditions, Moving mechanical parts, Areas considered dangerous, Conditions which could affect the respiratory system or skin such as fumes, odors, dust, mists, gases, oils, smoke, soot, or poor ventilation.

About this job

Full job description

The CareIQ Intake Specialist provides administrative customer service assistance to claimants, providers, and claims management by receiving and entering new ancillary healthcare referrals. Utilizing proprietary systems and knowledge from training, a CareIQ Intake Specialist will provide excellent telephonic and written customer service to both inbound and outbound customers. A CareIQ Intake Specialist operates with a high focus on accuracy and urgency to ensure that service orders are received quickly in alignment with the claimant and customer needs.

This is a remote position and for continuity of business, candidate must live and work in the Central or Eastern Time Zone.

The schedule for this position is Monday - Friday, 1:00 PM-9:30 PM EST.

A wired connection to your modem from a broadband internet network with a minimum bandwidth of at least 3 Mbps is required for this position

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Provides quality and friendly telephonic customer service in an inbound and outbound high-volume call-center environment
  • Completes accurate data entry and review
  • Able to learn and operate corporate proprietary systems
  • Enters assigned electronic (email/fax/data feed) orders into coordination system
  • Ensures all case stakeholders are updated regularly
  • Transcribes correspondence/reports from dictation
  • Uses problem solving and critical thinking skills to ensure that daily scheduling challenges do not cause delays in securing appointments
  • Meets departmental production and quality performance expectations
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Ability to work on several concurrent tasks and prioritize workload to meet designated deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office and Proprietary Systems
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to maintain a professional and courteous demeanor that sets tone for complex telephonic conversations
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • High School diploma
  • Prior work experience in a detail-oriented customer service environment

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $15.61 - $23.82 per hour

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

ABOUT CORVEL:

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers' compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 3500 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off.

CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

Job Summary

At Farmers, data powers better decisions. As a Sr. Associate Decision Scientist, you'll help transform complex business questions into actionable analytical solutions that shape strategy across our Direct & Strategic Partnerships organization.

In this role, you'll leverage advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and data visualization to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and influence critical business decisions. Working closely with business leaders and cross-functional partners, you'll apply tools such as Python, SQL, Excel, and Power BI to analyze large datasets, develop predictive models, and deliver recommendations that drive growth, improve customer outcomes, and optimize business performance.

Success in this role requires a blend of technical expertise, intellectual curiosity, and business acumen. The ideal candidate thrives in solving ambiguous problems, translating data into compelling stories, and turning analytical insights into measurable business impact.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Apply moderately advanced statistical, mathematical, and analytical techniques to solve medium-to-large-scale business problems impacting current and future business strategies.
  • Build descriptive and explanatory models or leverage outputs from predictive and machine learning models developed by others.
  • Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and business opportunities.
  • Utilize data visualization tools and advanced analytical methods, including: Distribution analysis, Correlation analysis, Outlier detection, Multivariate analysis, Time-series analysis, Machine learning techniques.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), test hypotheses, and validate findings with business stakeholders.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to understand business objectives and develop data-driven solutions.
  • Collect, integrate, and transform data from multiple sources into cohesive datasets for analysis.
  • Evaluate data quality and apply data governance and hygiene practices to ensure reliability and accuracy.
  • Perform quality-control checks, document processes, and collaborate with peers on data validation efforts.
  • Work closely with IT, Data Engineering, Data Science, and other technical teams to optimize data pipelines and resolve data quality issues.
  • Support the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of predictive models within business workflows.
  • Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for business leaders.
  • Utilize effective storytelling and visualization techniques to make analytical findings accessible and impactful.
  • Stay current on emerging data science methodologies, technologies, and industry best practices.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing.
  • Provide informal coaching or mentorship to less experienced team members as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

First Year Success Factors

Within the first 12 months, a successful candidate can expect to have achieved the following:

  • Establish strong partnerships with business leaders and become a trusted advisor for data-driven decision-making across Direct & Strategic Partnerships.
  • Deliver actionable insights through advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and predictive techniques that solve complex business challenges and influence strategic outcomes.
  • Lead high-impact analytical projects from problem definition through implementation, driving measurable improvements in growth, customer experience, operational performance, and profitability.
  • Develop, validate, and deploy analytical models that identify key business drivers, improve forecasting capabilities, and support informed decision-making.
  • Leverage Python, SQL, Power BI, and other analytical tools to transform complex datasets into scalable analytical solutions and executive-ready insights.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations that influence leadership decisions and advance business objectives.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

Candidates would ideally reflect the following professional qualifications and experiences:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Three or more years of experience applying advanced analytics, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, or quantitative problem-solving to support business decision-making. Experience in insurance, financial services, or other data-driven industries is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex or ambiguous business questions into analytical approaches, actionable insights, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong technical proficiency with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, and other analytical tools used for data exploration, statistical analysis, modeling, and visualization.
  • Experience developing, validating, and deploying analytical models, including forecasting, segmentation, driver analysis, optimization, predictive modeling, and performance measurement.
  • Solid foundation in statistical methods and analytical techniques, including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, experimental design, forecasting, and trend analysis.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, translating data into clear recommendations that influence business strategy and decision-making.

About this job

Software Engineering Manager leading Allstate's Legal Technology ecosystem, with 80% hands-on development in Java, Python, and cloud-native architectures. Role includes designing AI-powered legal solutions, managing integrations across enterprise systems, and mentoring an engineering team.

Good fit if you have 7+ years software engineering experience with Java and Python, deep cloud platform expertise, and comfort balancing hands-on coding with team leadership.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly technical Software Engineering Manager to lead the engineering vision, development, integration, and support of our Legal Technology ecosystem.

This role is ideal for a hands-on engineering leader who enjoys building software, solving complex integration challenges, and applying Generative AI to transform legal operations. Unlike traditional management positions, approximately 80% of this role is dedicated to software development, solution architecture, production support, and technical leadership, with the remaining 20% focused on coaching engineers, resource planning, and stakeholder management.

The Managing Engineer will oversee critical legal technology platforms, including vendor-provided legal applications, enterprise integration and orchestration services, and emerging AI-powered legal solutions. This individual will be responsible for designing scalable cloud-native architectures, integrating legal products across the enterprise, and delivering innovative solutions using Agentic AI and Generative Intelligence platforms.

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with strong product ownership, operational excellence, and a passion for modern AI technologies. They are equally comfortable debugging production issues, designing APIs, reviewing architecture, mentoring engineers, and collaborating with Legal, Compliance, Security, and Technology stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, development, integration, and support of Legal Technology products and platforms.
  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native applications, APIs, integrations, and event-driven services supporting Legal and Regulatory business capabilities.
  • Actively contribute to software development through hands-on coding, code reviews, architectural design, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Integrate and orchestrate vendor-provided legal applications with enterprise systems, ensuring scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
  • Drive technical decisions related to cloud platforms, application modernization, data management, integration patterns, and AI services.
  • Own product reliability, security, performance, and operational excellence, including incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner closely with product managers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver business outcomes.
  • Design and implement AI-powered solutions using Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and intelligent automation technologies to enhance legal operations and knowledge management.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance stakeholders to identify opportunities to leverage AI responsibly while maintaining governance, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead experimentation, innovation, and adoption of emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and legal technology solutions.
  • Own the reliability, supportability, security, scalability, and performance of Legal Technology products in production.
  • Manage vendor relationships, product upgrades, integration initiatives, and platform lifecycle activities.
  • Define operational KPIs, service-level objectives, and engineering metrics to ensure platform health and business value realization.
  • Lead, coach, and mentor team of engineers while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning
  • Influence stakeholders and engineering teams to adopt modern engineering and AI best practices.

Functional Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures.
  • Proficiency in Python for automation, and platform engineering.
  • Experience designing and supporting highly available production systems with accountability for reliability, security, and performance.
  • Strong experience with enterprise integrations, API management, workflow orchestration, SaaS platforms, and messaging technologies such as Kafka.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, container platforms such as Kubernetes, and cloud-native data services.
  • Strong expertise with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered solutions using Azure OpenAI, LLMs, RAG, vector databases, or related technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration platforms.
  • Experience with AI-driven search, knowledge management, or information retrieval solutions is a plus.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating directly with business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Legal Technology, Compliance, Risk Management, Regulatory Technology (RegTech), or similar domains.
  • Experience with legal research, document intelligence, contract lifecycle management, eDiscovery, or knowledge management solutions.
  • Experience managing relationships with technology vendors and SaaS providers.
  • Experience leading cloud modernization, integration, or AI transformation initiatives.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.

Experience

  • 7 or more years of experience (Preferred)

  • This job has supervisory duties

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Represented, Moderate (EST/CST) Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster Moderate, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair and timely injury settlements with all parties involved.


***The ideal candidate will be able to handle a high-volume of pending cases and have experience with not only third-party casualty adjusting, but also first-party collision and third-party property damage claims.***


Candidates for this role must reside in the Eastern or Central Time Zones.


Claims experience in Ohio or Connecticut highly preferred


Qualifications

  • Prior represented third-party casualty claim handling experience is required
  • 2-5 years of moderate Bodily Injury claim handling experience is preferred
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Proficient knowledge of insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination and state regulations.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite a plus


Youll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.*


**Candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.


This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.


Allstate Benefits

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit https://www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Skills

Business Communications, Critical Thinking, Fraud Investigations, Information Collection, Time Management

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 56,000.00 - 92,000.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$40,200.00 - $66,200.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Auto Express, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage personal insurance claims involving various types of automobiles and property damage. This role involves frequent customer interactions through telephone and written communications. This program is typically 8-12 months and upon successful completion of this program, you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Assess coverage to determine compensability.
  • Investigate by gathering information from policyholders and claimants to verify the facts of loss.
  • Assess coverage and bring claim to resolution with accurate payment in a timely manner.
  • Communicate and apprise all parties regarding claim status.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management systems.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.
