Job.JobTitle: Sr Analyst, Energy & Infrastructure - Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Company

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) andis responsible forpowering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies,LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises.Weoffer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future.#LMI #LI-LMI

The Position

The Energy & Infrastructure (E&I) team,part of the $22 billion Global Alternative Markets portfolio, is seeking a Senior Analystas the mandate executes on its next phase of growth. The strategy invests holistically across the infrastructure landscape including opportunities in:

(i) traditional energy

(ii) digital infrastructure

(iii) diversified infrastructure

(iv) renewables

(v) energy transition

(vi) services and software into the infrastructure ecosystem

E&I's mandate is to deliver compelling, risk-adjusted returns featuring strong downside protection and asymmetric upside. The team leverages subject matter expertise, ability to underwrite complexity, speed to execute, and a peer-oriented go-to-market strategy to establish E&I as a differentiated capital partner of choice. This hire will be an integral member of the E&I team with significant ownership of the investment process across thematic research, underwriting, deal execution and ongoing portfolio management. The individual hired will be centrally involved in the execution of direct/co-investment transactions as well as primary fund commitments and relationship management.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute as an integral member of the E&I Equity team to invest in opportunities across the infrastructure landscape.
  • Manage investment diligence from start to finish, performing comprehensive analysis and developing recommendations on directs investments, co-investments and fund commitments.
  • Effectively screen opportunities, identifying and succinctly communicating the most relevant investment highlights and key risk considerations.
  • Lead the creation of investment committee materials (complete with financial projections) and support in presenting the teams investment recommendations to internal investment committees.
  • Assist in the evaluation, structuring, and negotiation of economic and legal terms.
  • Actively monitor existing investments, maintain external relationships with partners, and provide detailed updates to team members as needed.
  • Contribute to regular engagement with external stakeholders and market participants to support the E&I teams origination goals and enhance market presence.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with additional LMI teams including Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Risk Management to execute transactions and manage the portfolio.
Qualifications
  • 2+ years of relevant work experience in energy and infrastructure investment banking, consulting or investing.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze and evaluate transaction risks, value-creation opportunities and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable understanding investment recommendations, and addressing questions from, an investment committee.
  • Detail-oriented, accurate, and capable of producing consistent work product.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; comfortable with consensus decision-making and working in a collaborative, team-based environment.
  • Self-motivated and creative with the ability to work independently; flexibility to take on additional responsibilities depending on the needs of the business.
  • Proven ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external investment professionals and executives.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and time-sensitive deliverables with a high degree of quality and accuracy.
  • Strong interest in energy and infrastructure with a passion for investing.
  • Minimum of a Bachelors degree required
  • Demonstrates strong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation while maintaining sound judgment and compliance with governance standards.

Job Description: Senior Tax Associate

About the Team

The North America Tax team supports tax reporting, planning, and compliance across the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda. The team partners with Finance, Legal, HR, Underwriting, Operations, and external advisors to ensure accurate reporting and strong governance. The Senior Tax Associate plays a key role in delivering timely and reliable tax outcomes.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

This role strengthens AXIS' global tax function by supporting accurate tax reporting, maintaining compliance across multiple jurisdictions, and improving processes that support financial integrity. The Senior Tax Associate helps ensure AXIS meets regulatory requirements while supporting business decisions with clear and reliable tax insights.

What will you be doing in this role?

  • Supporting day‑to‑day tax activities for the U.S., Canada, and Bermuda

  • Assisting with quarterly GAAP and STAT tax provisions under ASC 740 and SSAP 101

  • Partnering with international tax teams to align global provisions with U.S. GAAP

  • Helping consolidate global tax calculations for management reporting

  • Supporting internal and external reporting, including Board materials and annual tax footnotes

  • Coordinating compliance activities across U.S., Canadian, and Bermuda tax regimes

  • Supporting withholding tax documentation, including residency certificates and FATCA

  • Performing tax research to interpret authoritative guidance

  • Responding to audits and notices across multiple jurisdictions

  • Maintaining accurate process documentation and contributing to internal training

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About you:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What we're looking for from you:

  • Possess a CPA or Tax LLM

  • Bring at least three years of tax experience in public accounting or a multinational company with extensive experience with ASC 740, account reconciliation, tax compliance and return-to-provision analysis

  • Demonstrate strong technical tax knowledge across U.S. federal, state, and indirect taxes

  • Demonstrate familiarity with BEAT, Pillar II and other international tax concepts

  • Apply knowledge of SOX 404 requirements

  • Use advanced Microsoft Office skills

  • Communicate clearly and build strong relationships across teams

  • Manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment

  • Show strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail

Role factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Be in the office 3 days per week

  • Travel within the U.S. and internationally as needed

What we offer:

You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $90,000 to $110,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance.

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is exempt for FLSA purposes.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

Venues for this role typical cover Southwest & Central Georgia including but not limited to Macon, Columbus, and Warner Robbins.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Good fit if you have six to eight years of commercial lines underwriting experience, CPCU designation, and can travel to meet with agents and brokers regularly.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.

About this job

Senior Counsel role handling workers compensation litigation for Travelers Insurance in Jacksonville. Manage high-exposure cases independently, mentor junior attorneys, and serve as trusted advisor to insured clients from case inception through trial and appeal.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience, proven jury trial success, and active law license in required state.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards. 

Salary Range

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Are you curious by nature? Do you enjoy managing relationships and employing your critical thinking skills? Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP).
Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Within your assigned business unit, each intern will be given a designated coach and be expected to:
  • Complete core assignments and training modules geared toward insurance and underwriting principles.
  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Atlanta, GA

About this job

12-week paid internship at Fortune 500 Assurant in Atlanta, rotating through Ethics & Compliance teams. Includes hands-on projects in regulatory compliance, risk management, and a capstone focused on AI applications in compliance.

Good fit if you pursue a degree in business, law, compliance, data analytics, or related field, with strong analytical skills and interest in AI and technology.

Full job description

The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


The Ethics & Compliance Intern will gain hands-on experience across multiple compliance disciplines while supporting strategic initiatives that advance Assurant's culture of integrity and responsible innovation. Through a rotational program, the intern will work with a number of Ethics & Compliance teams, contributing to projects involving regulatory compliance, ethics and investigations, policy governance, risk management, and emerging technologies.


A key component of the internship will be a capstone project focused on the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) within Ethics & Compliance. The intern will research, evaluate, and recommend innovative approaches that enhance compliance effectiveness, operational efficiency, and employee engagement.

This internship is designed for candidates who are curious, analytical, and interested in the intersection of compliance, ethics, technology, and business operations.

What You Will Do


Rotational Experience:

The intern will rotate through multiple Ethics & Compliance teams, which may include:

  • Business Unit Compliance
  • Ethics and investigations
  • Compliance communications and training
  • Risk assessment and monitoring
  • Enterprise policy management
  • Compliance operations and reporting

Potential Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist with research related to regulatory requirements, industry trends, and emerging risks.
  • Support the development, review, and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures, and governance documents.
  • Analyze data and prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and executive summaries.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve compliance processes and operational efficiencies, including from the AI lens.
  • Participate in compliance risk assessments, monitoring activities, and program evaluations.
  • Assist in developing employee communications, training materials, and awareness campaigns.
  • Collaborate with team members across multiple business functions and compliance disciplines.
  • Present findings and recommendations to Ethics & Compliance leadership.

AI & Compliance Capstone Project:

As part of the internship experience, the intern will:

  • Explore how AI and emerging technologies can enhance Ethics & Compliance programs.
  • Assess opportunities to improve compliance processes through automation, analytics, and responsible AI practices.
  • Conduct stakeholder interviews and research leading practices across industries.
  • Develop recommendations for practical AI use cases within Ethics & Compliance.
  • Deliver a final presentation summarizing findings, recommendations, and potential business impact.

Qualifications


Required

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Business, Risk Management, Compliance, Law, Public Policy, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or related field

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skill risk management, governance, or regulatory affairs.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and responsible innovation.
  • Experience with data analysis, research projects, or process improvement initiatives.
  • ·Demonstrated leadership through academic, volunteer, or extracurricular activities.

What You Will Gain

  • Exposure to multiple areas of a global Ethics & Compliance program.
  • Experience working alongside compliance and business leaders.
  • Understanding of compliance governance, regulatory requirements, and ethical business practices.
  • Real-world experience evaluating AI applications in a corporate environment.
  • Professional development opportunities, mentoring, and networking across the organization.
  • Experience presenting recommendations to senior leaders.

Hybrid Opportunity: Atlanta Office

Paid Internship: $20 -22/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/7/2027

Note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World
Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we'll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What's the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America's Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world's leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

AI and Biometric Usage
Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant's privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

Job.JobDescription:
This job is responsible for working with the Supervisors and assisting in training and developing the team, monitoring production performance, ensuring production and quality controls are met while adhering to the work instructions for the area of responsibility.


This role is based at our Irving, TX location with a schedule of Monday - Friday from 11:30 am to 8:00 pm

What will be my duties and responsibilities be in this job?

• Participate in daily stand-up meetings with the Supervisor.

• Work with the Supervisor to reallocate resources, including employees, supplies, equipment, and products, as needed to meet customer and operational goals.

• Collaborate with other departments to ensure proper workflow and timely resolution of operational issues.

• Serve as a point of contact for employees and assist with escalations during the shift.

• Identify process improvement opportunities and submit recommendations to the Supervisor and Engineering teams.

• Assist the Supervisor with implementing operational changes and adjustments on the warehouse floor.

• Perform on-the-job training, refresher training, and workstation assessments.

• Monitor inventory levels and aging inventory within the area of responsibility.

• Monitor daily KPIs, SLAs, productivity, and quality metrics, and proactively support corrective actions when performance falls below target.

• Compile and analyze operational data and complete daily reports.

• Communicate effectively with employees, supervisors, managers, and cross-functional teams.

• Maintain proficiency and certification in the operational area being supported.

• Promote and maintain a safe work environment by ensuring associates follow all safety procedures and immediately escalating safety concerns.

• Lead by example and maintain a hands-on presence in the operation, supporting associates and assisting with operational activities when necessary to meet business objectives.

• Train, coach, and mentor associates while reinforcing productivity, quality, safety, and attendance expectations.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

• 1+ years of experience leading, training, coaching, or directing employees in a manufacturing, logistics, warehouse, or operations environment.

• High level of computer proficiency, including the ability to navigate multiple systems, analyze data, and utilize reporting tools effectively.

• Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed productivity, quality, and operational performance expectations while serving as a role model for associates.

• Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple operational priorities.

• Ability to communicate effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently while also collaborating with Supervisors and cross-functional teams.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

• Forklift certification or ability to obtain certification.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Power BI.

• Experience analyzing operational data and generating reports to support business decisions.

• Experience using Oracle, Power BI, SQL, warehouse management systems, or similar reporting and operational platforms.

• Experience training, coaching, and developing associates in a warehouse or operational environment.

• Strong continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify and recommend process improvements.

11/07/2026

About this job

Summer internship in risk control with Erie Insurance's Future Focus program, running May-August 2027 in Erie, Pennsylvania. Includes mentorship, shadowing risk control consultants, research and data analysis projects, and networking with senior leaders.

Good fit if you are a college sophomore, junior, or senior pursuing a four-year degree, have a 3.0 GPA or higher, and can work onsite in Erie, Pennsylvania.

At Erie Insurance, we believe in professional and personal development. With our Future Focus Internship Program, both are provided in abundance. Not only do we offer the opportunity to gain professional experience in a challenging and competitive setting, but we welcome you as part of the ERIE family. We ensure that our interns receive the best internship experience possible, which includes multiple educational, developmental, professional, social and networking opportunities. The esteem ERIE holds in its Future Focus Internship Program is evident at every level of the organization, defined even further by multiple opportunities for socializing with high level leaders, up to and including our President and CEO. Are you ready for the internship experience of a lifetime? Look no further.

2027 Future Focus Internship Program Start Dates: Monday, May 17th and Monday, May 24th, 2027

2027 Future Focus Internship Program End Date: Friday, August 6th, 2027

Opportunity to join our Future Focus Internship Program as a Risk Control Intern

Erie Insurance is committed to helping you learn and grow with a challenging internship position that will offer you relevant and real-world business experience. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Customer Service Representative, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: York, PA
  • Education: High school diploma or GED

About this job

Assistant Account Manager providing day-to-day support to the Commercial Lines team at a major managing general agency. Responsibilities include quoting and rating policies, maintaining client records in Epic, issuing certificates of insurance, and supporting account managers with client service.

Good fit if you have commercial lines retail insurance agency experience and a PA Property & Casualty license or can obtain one within three months.

Full job description

Who We Are

For over 70 years, Glatfelter Insurance Group has believed in doing the right thing for our clients, agents, communities and associates. This founding principle has enabled Glatfelter to grow from the kitchen-table, one-man-operation as it began, to one of the largest managing general agencies in the U.S. with nearly 500 associates across the country, a distribution network of over 4,500 independent brokers and more than 30,000 clients. It is what drives us to innovate—the desire to deliver the best for our clients. Founded as The Glatfelter Agency, which is still in operation, the program basis of Glatfelter Insurance Group, Volunteer Firemen's Insurance Services (VFIS), was founded in 1969. Throughout the years, Glatfelter has expanded to include specialized program business inclusive of public entities, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and religious organizations. Glatfelter provides their insureds with comprehensive insurance solutions including property, casualty, life insurance, and more. In 2018, Glatfelter joined American International Group (AIG) and is now part of the AIG family.

About the Position

The Glatfelter Agency (TGA), a division of Glatfelter Insurance Group, is seeking an experienced Commercial Lines Assistant Account Manager to join our growing team. This individual will provide support for the Commercial Lines team in the day-to-day servicing of our commercial clients.

This position is required to be onsite at our Leader Heights, York, PA office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Account Managers and Account Executives to provide quality service to our clients.
  • Utilize carrier websites to quote, rate, bind, and various other functions.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation within agency management system (Epic).
  • Issue Certificates of Insurance & Prepare Auto ID Cards.
  • Accurately enter prospect and client data in applications.
  • Process mid-year client change requests.
  • Review all carrier issued documents for accuracy.
  • Provide audit support.
  • Compiling materials for client renewal presentations, including preparation of the agency proposal document.
  • Perform administrative functions such as phone reception, scanning and processing mail as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with company procedures and workflows.
  • Other duties as required or assigned.

What We're Looking For

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Some college coursework or a college degree preferred.
  • Commercial Lines retail insurance agency experience preferred.
  • Valid PA Property & Casualty license or must attain within three (3) months.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Outlook & Excel).
  • Prior experience with Applied Epic or comparable agency management system preferred, but not required.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively both orally and in writing with internal and external customers including but not limited to underwriters, clients, marketing representative, and service team members.
  • Must be capable of working independently under team concept with general supervision.
  • Should possess the ability to plan & prioritize, be detail oriented and able to handle multiple tasks.
  • Must possess problem solving capabilities.
  • Must possess strong customer service skills.
  • Should have the ability to adapt to changing and improving technologies, and able to function within various on-line company rating sites.
  • Must possess a genuine willingness to learn, be intuitive, resourceful and coachable.

Why Choose Glatfelter?

Glatfelter is honored to have been named a Best Place to Work in PA since 2005. We are proud to offer a range of employee benefits and resources that help you protect what matters most - your health care, savings, financial protection and wellbeing. In addition to 17 paid holidays, (which includes a personal holiday and mental health and wellness day) we provide a variety of leaves for personal, health, family, and volunteer needs.

We believe in fostering our associates' development and offer a range of learning opportunities for associates to hone their professional skills to position themselves for the next steps of their careers. We have a tuition reimbursement program for eligible associates to enhance their education, skills, and knowledge in areas that relate to their current position or future positions to which they may transfer or progress.

Equal Opportunity Employer

It has been and will continue to be the policy of Glatfelter Insurance Group to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories. At Glatfelter, we believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to our future and our mission – creating a foundation for a creative workplace that leads to innovation, growth, and profitability.

Glatfelter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with physical or mental disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to complete any part of the application or hiring process, please contact Human Resources. Reasonable accommodations will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

  • Routinely represents the Advanced Technical Security Systems section on project teams. Assists with the design and/or configurations of integrated technical security systems.
  • Participates in and assists senior staff with conducting on-going risk analysis and physical security audits at all ERIE facilities and corporate functional areas to identify points of vulnerability. Documents and evaluates all points of vulnerability and recommends risk avoidance and reduction strategies.

Analyzes, troubleshoots, repairs, and restores equipment/systems to full operation and recommends revisions when necessary for effectiveness. Ensures completion of required quality tasks, reviews, documentation and compliance with problem management and best practices. Full job description

The Senior Process Engineer is responsible for driving operational excellence across a high-volume, highly automated manufacturing facility. This role provides technical leadership for manufacturing processes, equipment optimization, new product introductions, and large-scale continuous improvement initiatives to achieve world-class safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.


The Senior Process Engineer leads cross-functional projects from concept through implementation, develops standardized manufacturing processes, and serves as a technical mentor to Process Engineers and Operations teams. This position partners closely with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Automation, Supply Chain, and customers to improve manufacturing capability while supporting production performance and business objectives.


This is an onsite role in our Mt. Juliet TN facility with a schedule of Monday - Friday, 8AM – 5PM.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?


Manufacturing Process Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and engineering support for all production operations.
  • Develop, optimize, and standardize manufacturing processes to improve safety, quality, productivity, and cost.
  • Design and maintain manufacturing work instructions, process documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  • Establish best practices that improve process consistency and manufacturing reliability.
  • Support new product introductions, equipment launches, and production transfers.

Project Management

  • Lead complex, cross-functional capital and operational improvement projects.
  • Develop project timelines, budgets, resource plans, launch curves, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Create project dashboards and tracking systems to ensure milestones, deliverables, and financial targets are achieved.
  • Coordinate activities between Engineering, Operations, Quality, Automation, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and external suppliers.
  • Present project status and business results to plant leadership.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and Value Stream Mapping initiatives throughout the facility.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manufacturing cost, improve throughput, eliminate waste, and increase equipment utilization.
  • Utilize data analytics to identify process bottlenecks and prioritize improvement opportunities.

Root Cause Analysis & Problem Solving

  • Lead structured problem-solving activities utilizing:
    • DMAIC
    • 8D
    • 5 Why
    • Fishbone Analysis
    • FMEA
  • Investigate manufacturing failures, field returns, and customer complaints.
  • Validate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to eliminate recurring issues.
  • Support production during critical downtime events and major quality issues.

Data Analysis

  • Analyze manufacturing KPIs including:
    • Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
    • First Pass Yield (FPY)
    • Throughput
    • Cycle Time
    • Scrap
    • Rework
    • Labor Efficiency
    • Cost per Unit
    • Capacity Utilization
  • Utilize statistical analysis and manufacturing data to drive operational decisions.
  • Develop reports and dashboards using Excel, Power BI, or similar analytical tools.

Position Summary

Exercises independent discretion or judgment in handling all types of property claims. Also assists or acts on behalf of the claims supervisor when required.

  • This is a remote, work from home position in Illinois
  • The selected candidate will ideally live in Madison, St Clair, Monroe, Jersey, Macoupin County and/or surrounding areas.

  • Completes industry-related training programs and continues to attend training programs to remain informed on policy changes, interpretation or new legislation.
  • Assists in training of new claims adjusters.
  • Participates on Catastrophe Team when required.

About this job

Supply Chain Manager overseeing material flow, inventory control, and cost reduction in a reverse logistics depot in Irving, Texas. Leads inventory control teams, manages KPIs, and coordinates work across multiple shifts to ensure production runs smoothly.

Good fit if you have 7+ years logistics/distribution experience, 5+ years leadership managing supervisors, and 2+ years inventory management experience.

Full job description

The Supply Chain Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products necessary for production and operational success within the depots. In addition to managing the entire lifecycle of materials, from procurement to distribution, ensuring that production processes run smoothly, maintains optimal inventory levels to prevent shortages or excess, which can disrupt production or tie up capital unnecessarily, and implement strategies to reduce costs while maintaining quality and supply continuity. This is accomplished through the development of lean processes and procedures that meet internal and external customer requirements and the effective leadership of Inventory Control resources through clear and precise communications of responsibilities and goals.

This is an onsite role in our Irving, TX facility. Multiple shifts and positions are available.

This job posting is part of our ongoing efforts to build a strong talent network for current and future opportunities. We invite you to apply, and qualified candidates will be contacted as roles become available.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Effective operation by working with the supervisors to complete customer priorities based on demand schedules, assigning tasks/projects as needed, coordinating the flow of work, oversee completion of work, monitor key performance metrics (KPI), managing labor efficiency across the area of responsibility, mentor/coach leaders and manage headcount
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff for the department
  • Establish, track, and analyze departmental reports/measurements and present findings as appropriate
  • Work with senior management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment and innovation to achieve them
  • Identify process improvements for the department along with the design of KPIs and coordinate new model introductions
  • Create and utilize reports to accurately represent product flow and task completion rates and percentages
  • Develop and utilize reporting to ensure SLAs are achieved
  • Manage cycle counts and inventory control processes to ensure inventory accuracy maintained
  • Liaison between teams, shifts, and departments, and partners with vendor/customer/client representatives while fostering true partner relationships that allow us to manage change and growth within the individual business
  • Monitor inventory of stock and ensure adequate levels are maintained
  • Provides technical and operational support during the business development process and new customer acquisition
  • Maintain a clean, organized and safe work environment for personnel to work in while ensuring all safety and environmental regulations are followed
  • Develop and establish document controls to ensure accuracy of inventory
  • Hires, develops, evaluates, and (when necessary) disciplines and discharges subordinates' personnel or makes authoritative recommendations in such matters
  • Develops function-specific orientation and training programs for area personnel
  • Establishes standards for effective job performance and evaluates subordinates according to such standards

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in any business or related discipline
  • Minimum seven (7) years' experience required in a logistics/distribution, fast paced, high volume manufacturing environment with at least five (5) years of data interpretation/analysis and logistics experience and 2 of inventory management experience
  • Minimum of five (5) years leadership experience with at least five (5) years' experience managing supervisory personnel

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • APICS CPIM designation
  • Working knowledge and understanding of MRP/ERP systems, WIP & Planning, Preferred knowledge with Oracle
  • Experience with Microsoft Great Plains
  • Highly skilled inventory control leader with extensive strategic and tactical experience, results-oriented, high energy, high urgency, and embraces effective change
  • High level of customer interaction; frequent interruptions and re-prioritization of projects based upon customer needs, working under deadlines, creative thinking, working on multiple projects simultaneously, and ability making decisions based on various levels of information
  • Working knowledge of Visio
  • Ability to interact and understand IT issues related to business processes and systems changes
  • Knowledge of inventory and warehousing processing procedures
  • Experience in, manufacturing, automation, electronics, systems integration, life cycle modeling, new product introduction, process development and deployment, leveraging Lean/6 Sigma tools, project and resource planning, and systems implementation

Virtual mentorship program for college sophomores to learn about actuarial consulting careers at Aon from February to April 2027. Selected participants can be fast-tracked to interview for Summer 2028 internship positions in Health, Wealth, Risk, or Reinsurance.

Full job description

Job Description

Early Careers: Sophomore Actuarial Career Discovery Program

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What is the Sophomore Actuarial Career Discovery Program?

College Sophomores have the unique opportunity to connect with an advisor working in the actuarial field at Aon to learn more about a consulting career from one of our solutions team from either Health, Wealth, Risk, or Reinsurance and practice real-world scenarios during the discovery program.

How this opportunity is different

This mentorship opportunity gives students considering a career in actuarial science to connect with professionals and peers throughout this virtual program. This program is designed for sophomores and used as a direct pipeline to our Summer 2028 Actuarial Intern opportunities!

At the end of the program, selected mentees will have the opportunity to be fast-tracked to a final round interview for consideration for our intern program. While the mentor program is virtual, candidates would select location preferences that are aligned with their interests for Summer 2028 internship opportunities.

- Application Deadline: November 2026

- Review Process: November - December 2026

- Program Acceptance: December 2026 - January 2027

We're looking for collaborators, critical thinkers, problem solvers, excellent teammates, effective communicators, relationship builders and future leaders.

Education: Preferred Majors in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related. All majors welcome to apply.

Applicants for this event should be current sophomores, graduating between December 2028 - June 2029, with a GPA of 3.0 and above

Job.JobTitle: Lead Cloud Platform Engineer - AWS Control Tower & Service Enablement
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Technology / Insurtech, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76724

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking a highly motivated Lead Cloud Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Engineering team, with a primary focus on AWS Control Tower, enterprise landing zone engineering, and the secure enablement of AWS services. This is an enterprise cloud platform engineering role, not an application development or application-focused DevOps position. The engineer will build, govern, automate, and operate the shared AWS foundation used by multiple application teams, including landing zones, account provisioning, platform controls, and approved cloud and AI services, including Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

The successful candidate will possess hands-on ownership experience with a shared enterprise AWS platform, deep practical AWS Control Tower knowledge and implementation experience, a demonstrated ability to take AWS services from evaluation through production enablement, and working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Strong software development and automation skills applied to reusable platform capabilities, experience with AI and machine learning technologies, and excellent written and verbal communication skills are essential. This position does not include direct people management responsibilities but requires strong technical influence and collaboration across stakeholders.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the design, implementation, automation, and ongoing operation of AWS Control Tower and enterprise landing zones, including multi-account structures, organizational units, account provisioning and enrollment, baseline configurations, landing zone upgrades, and drift remediation.
  • Implement and maintain AWS Control Tower controls and account governance in partnership with security teams, integrating AWS Organizations, service control policies (SCPs), IAM Identity Center, AWS Config, and centralized logging.
  • Drive end-to-end AWS service enablement: assess use cases and dependencies, coordinate architecture and security reviews, define approved configurations and access patterns, build reusable Infrastructure as Code, validate controls, and deliver production-ready services with documented support ownership.
  • Develop and maintain cloud automation using Python and Infrastructure as Code to standardize account provisioning, landing zone configurations, service deployment, and ongoing platform lifecycle management.
  • Build and enhance GitLab CI/CD pipelines for shared platform infrastructure, account baselines, and reusable AWS service enablement patterns.
  • Evaluate, enable, and support AI and machine learning capabilities, with particular emphasis on enabling Amazon Bedrock AgentCore as a governed enterprise platform capability. Develop shared deployment patterns, access controls, observability, and support boundaries for Runtime, Gateway, Identity, Memory, and Observability in partnership with AI, application, architecture, and security teams. The focus is enabling application teams to build and operate agents, not primarily developing application-specific agents.
  • Partner with architects, developers, security teams, and operations teams to deliver shared cloud platform capabilities and approved service patterns that application teams can consume.
  • Implement cloud best practices related to security, scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in the shared AWS platform, including account provisioning, governance controls, identity integrations, and service enablement; collaborate with application teams to distinguish platform issues from application-owned issues.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across cloud engineering processes and tooling.

Technical Skills

Cloud & Platform

  • AWS / AWS Control Tower
  • Landing Zone
  • AWS Organizations, organizational units, SCPs, IAM Identity Center, AWS Config, & AWS CloudTrail
  • EC2
  • S3
  • VPC
  • IAM
  • Lambda
  • API Gateway
  • EKS
  • ECS/Fargate
  • RDS
  • CloudWatch
  • Splunk
  • SNOW

Development & Automation

  • Python
  • GitLab
  • CI/CD Pipelines
  • AWS CDK
  • CloudFormation
  • REST APIs
  • Reusable service enablement modules, account baseline automation, & automated configuration validation

AI & Machine Learning

  • Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: Runtime, Gateway, Identity, Memory, and Observability
  • SageMaker
  • Generative AI
  • Prompt Engineering
  • AI/ML Workflows
  • Agent-Based Solutions

Enterprise Tools

  • ServiceNow
  • Jira
  • Confluence

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related roles, including demonstrated hands-on ownership and engineering of a shared, enterprise-wide AWS platform supporting multiple accounts and application teams. Experience must include platform-level configuration, governance, automation, lifecycle management, and operational support. Experience limited to developing, deploying, or supporting applications within an existing AWS environment does not meet this requirement.
  • Deep hands-on experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting AWS Control Tower in an enterprise multi-account environment; practical experience with landing zone lifecycle management, Account Factory, account enrollment, organizational units, controls, and drift remediation is required.
  • Demonstrated experience enabling AWS services for enterprise use, including technical evaluation, architecture and security review, automated deployment patterns, testing, documentation, and operational readiness—not solely deploying services for individual applications.
  • Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, including the purpose and integration considerations of Runtime, Gateway, Identity, Memory, and Observability, and an understanding of platform responsibilities versus application-owned agent logic.
  • Strong Python development and automation skills.
  • Experience building and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with AI and Machine Learning technologies and platforms.
  • Strong understanding of AWS architecture, cloud networking, security, and multi-account governance, including AWS Organizations, SCPs, IAM Identity Center, least-privilege access, AWS Config, and AWS CloudTrail.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Hands-on experience implementing or piloting Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, including secure tool/API connectivity, identity integration, deployment automation, and agent monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, or Generative AI technologies.
  • Experience designing and supporting enterprise cloud platforms, including AWS Control Tower adoption, landing zone migrations or upgrades, and automated account customization.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, or Dynatrace.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 products and collaboration platforms.
  • AWS certifications such as: AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, or AWS Machine Learning Specialty

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through 2/1/27, subject to close earlier.

About this job

Financial Planning & Analysis Specialist supporting Lincoln Financial Distributors in budget analysis, forecasting, and financial reporting. The role involves preparing analyses for business leaders, developing financial models, and supporting strategic planning across multiple business lines.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree or 4 years work experience, at least 1 year FP&A experience, strong Excel skills, and proficiency with AI tools and PowerPoint.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76749

The Role at a Glance

This Financial Planning & Analysis Specialist will perform and deliver on routine assignments and projects while leveraging and applying knowledge of FP&A principles to support Lincoln Financial Distributors (LFD). The individual will prepare, analyze, forecast, and report on financial information that helps business leaders make informed decisions regarding budgets, expenses, headcount planning, and business investments. This role partners with leaders across multiple business lines to provide financial insights, evaluate business performance, identify trends and variances, and support strategic and operational planning initiatives. The position also contributes to annual budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and ad hoc analyses that support business growth and profitability.

What you'll be doing

  • Prepare, analyze, and report on financial results and key business metrics for assigned LFD business areas.
  • Support the annual budget, forecast, and long-range planning processes, including expense, revenue, and headcount planning.
  • Perform budget-to-actual, forecast-to-actual, and variance analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Partner with business leaders to provide financial guidance and decision support related to operational initiatives, strategic investments, and resource planning.
  • Develop financial models and analyses to evaluate business opportunities, including new products, pricing strategies, sales growth initiatives, and workforce planning scenarios.
  • Collect, compile, and evaluate financial information to develop and deliver both standard and ad hoc financial analyses.
  • Assist in the preparation and maintenance of financial forecasts, management reporting, and executive presentations.
  • Support monthly and quarterly close activities, including reconciliations and financial performance reviews.
  • Communicate financial insights, trends, and emerging issues to management and recommend actions where appropriate.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Senior Managing Litigation Attorney is to oversee a team of attorneys ranging from entry level to seasoned senior litigation management attorneys. This position is responsible for overseeing and reviewing work performed by attorneys to ensure compliance with defense counsel guidelines. The role works to improve processes, as well as assists with budget planning, financial measures and results. The Senior Managing Attorney will identify and lead initiatives to improve the team's efficiency and ensures effective communication between the legal and business teams. This role acts as both a Litigation Attorney with a reduced case count and manages a staff of Litigation attorneys. The position works autonomously and under the general supervision of the Litigation Management's department Director.

This is a hybrid position, offering the flexibility to work from both home and the office. Candidates must be able to work from one of our California branch offices in San Diego, Pasadena, or Rancho Cordova.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Directs the operations of law office personnel providing litigation and legal services.

  • Oversees the law office activities to ensure efficient operations of In-House Counsel.

  • Determines the intake and assignment of cases to ensure distribution based on each attorney's level of expertise and associated location (region or county).

  • Ensures the firm is achieving its client satisfaction goals by evaluating productivity and quality of service.

  • Identifies, makes recommendations for work process improvements and follows through to implement remediations.

  • Works with leadership to ensure the department meets financial and ROI goals, identifies trends, prepares reports, and implements modifications as needed.

  • Mentors less experienced attorneys and ensures the team continues to expand their job-related knowledge, skills and abilities.

  • Regularly reviews cases and provides feedback on legal strategies, compliance with deadlines, timeliness on response, and maximizing the department's core goals.

Provides litigation services and is responsible for all aspects of assigned Workers' Compensation matters.

  • Handles a reduced caseload of litigated files and ensures files are fully worked and moved to resolution.

  • Litigates workers' compensation cases in California before all state and federal courts, administrative boards, and other court proceedings.

  • Represents ICW Group, its related entities and insureds before administrative boards, state and federal courts, Court of Appeal, and the California Supreme Court.

  • Analyzes complex legal and factual issues; conducts extensive, well-reasoned legal research, as necessary; independently develops and presents defense strategies on behalf of ICW Group.

  • Provides strategic legal advice, recommendation, and implementation of clear, cost-effective, and efficient plans of action.

  • Assists in analyzing, reviewing, and distributing information on new legislation, regulations, and court decisions.

Provides oversight of a team of Litigation Management professionals.

  • Oversees the entire employee lifecycle from identifying, training, coaching and retaining talent.

  • Supervises and evaluates, mentors, motivates, and develops attorneys to strengthen the legal team.

  • Communicates clear performance expectations for the assigned team as well as providing support and guidance for achieving the department's metric, billable hours and expectations.

  • Communicates and enforces team values including mission statement of In-House Counsel (IHC) and ICW.

  • Establishes and maintains the overall work cadence and, in partnership with Department leadership, ensures performance and outcomes strive for excellence in delivery and customer experience.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises employees within the Litigation Management team and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. These responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing team members to further their skills and knowledge; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations/goals; forecasting staffing needs and planning for peak times and absences; enforcing department policies and procedures.

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required. Juris Doctorate from an accredited law school required.

  • Minimum 10 years' workers' compensation legal experience handling complex cases along with a minimum of 2 years' experience managing associate through senior litigation attorneys.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Licensed and in good standing with the State Bar of California with no history of public or private reprisals.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Good computer skills with MS Office (including MS Excel with the ability to create financial/performance reports).

  • Proficient in the use of applications/programs to create automated reports, templates, systems and data retrieval of high quality and reliability.

  • Deep understanding of workers' compensation administrative rules, laws, statutes, legal principles and practices.

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal/written).

  • Skilled at logical thinking to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

  • Consistently maintains professional and appropriate demeanor, works harmoniously with others and responds positively to feedback.

  • Demonstrated experience in working independently under minimal supervision, maintaining a strong work ethic, and exercising initiative.

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in an office, home, and court environment and requires frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, scanner, and other standard office equipment. The position requires traveling to various court locations and works at one of the offices of In-House Counsel on a weekly basis.
