HOW TO GET STARTED

Click APPLY NOW to complete our simple preliminary profile. Be sure to include your preferred contact information as one of our Qualification Specialists will connect with you promptly.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Quick facts

  • Pay: $136,100 to $224,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Blue Bell, PA
  • Experience: 7+ years
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Senior Counsel position handling insurance defense litigation for Travelers Insurance in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania. Responsible for managing higher exposure and complex cases independently, mentoring junior attorneys, and serving as trusted advisor to insured clients.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience, proven jury trial success, and active bar license in required state(s).

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Commercial Lines Underwriter, Underwriting, Surety Underwriter
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$92,200.00 - $152,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Bond & Specialty Insurance provides management and professional liability insurance, as well as surety bonds to businesses and non-profit organizations of all sizes. As an underwriter, you will have a dynamic role that blends evaluating and analyzing financial and business risk, building relationships, and selling and negotiating with clients, agents, and brokers.

This role is part of the Commercial Surety team which provides surety bonds for individuals and businesses of all sizes both domestically and internationally. In the role, the Commercial Surety team member works in a fast-paced environment with a local and national team to build client, agent, and broker relationships, evaluate and price risk through financial and contractual underwriting, and offer surety product line solutions to our agents and customers.

The Account Executive (AE) will build and maintain relationships with agents and brokers to provide insurance or surety solutions to customers. An AE will analyze and evaluate risk to achieve business goals within an assigned book of business. As an AE, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to assess risk and sell our products will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Execute business unit underwriting strategies across your book of business to achieve profit and growth objectives.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Develop and execute individual agency sales plans that align with the team's sales plans to drive success.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Three to five years of applicable underwriting experience.
  • Working knowledge of products, the regulatory environment, and local market conditions.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to underwrite, market products, identify financial challenges, and analyze available information to make decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate with agents and brokers.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of underwriting, product knowledge, financial analysis, or risk assessment experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.

Position Summary

This position is responsible to monitor, assess and work with management to mitigate the organization's overall compliance risk exposures and changes to those exposures on an ongoing basis to provide assurance of compliance with applicable regulations and internal policies.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conducts risk assessments to evaluate and analyze ERIE's operations to determine potential liabilities or risks due to non-compliance. Partners with first line of defense management and other risk assurance teams to proactively identify, assess, report, recommend and monitor mitigation, and recommend prioritization of compliance and ethics risk exposures in the context of philosophy statements, appetite statements, and tolerances.
  • Works to establish, implement and monitor processes necessary to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Performs tests of compliance and evaluates controls related to compliance risk exposures.
  • Collaborates with and provides guidance to business areas on the development of risk-specific mitigation plans.
  • With minimal guidance, prepares recommendations and leads initiatives to enhance the Compliance Program which could include consistent identification, assessment, mitigation, reporting, and monitoring of risks related to business processes, people, and technology.
  • Develops, maintains, and enhances compliance tools to conduct and monitor risk assessments.
  • Assists in the development and preparation of reports, metrics and communications to various corporate stakeholders including business process leaders, senior leaders, executive leaders, and the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors to convey the outcomes of compliance related risk assessments.
  • Supports requests from internal partners for compliance risk assessments information and total cost of risk.
  • With minimal guidance, prepares recommendations and leads highly complex initiatives for the Compliance program that seeks to improve compliance risk management effectiveness through coordination, collaboration, and automation that are aligned with other risk assurance functions.
  • Works with members of Compliance to identify state requirements, NAIC market regulation standards and industry findings related to regulatory compliance risks.
  • Serves as an expert resource and works with others in Compliance to serve as the primary advisor for compliance risk management matters of the highest complexity.
  • Maintains a thorough understanding of ERIE's business practices and operations.


This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the incumbent. Employees are required to follow any other job-related instruction and to perform any other duties as requested by their supervisor, or as become clear.

Job.JobTitle: Summer 2027 Intern: Assurant Claims Operations Intern
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Atlanta, GA
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

12-week summer internship in residential property claims operations at a Fortune 500 company. Interns work on real business assignments, complete a structured project, and gain exposure to claims processing, quality, compliance, and customer service.

Good fit if you are enrolled in a bachelor's degree program graduating between December 2027 and August 2028, proficient in Microsoft Office, and available May 17 through August 7, 2027.

Full job description

The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


Job Purpose

The Claims Operations Intern will gain hands-on experience within residential property claims while learning how different teams contribute to the customer experience and claim lifecycle. Working alongside experienced Claims professionals, the intern will assist with operational activities, participate in cross-functional learning opportunities, and explore areas such as claim processing, quality, compliance, transformation, subrogation, training, and customer service.


In addition to day-to-day business assignments, the intern will complete a summer project focused on a meaningful Claims opportunity or business challenge. The intern will gather information, analyze findings, develop recommendations, and present the project's results to Claims team members and leaders.


This position is designed for a student interested in insurance, business operations, risk management, customer experience, or a related field.



What You Will Do

  • Learn how residential property claims are reviewed, documented, processed, and resolved.
  • Support operational activities involving claim documentation, reporting, workflow management, quality review, and process improvement.
  • Work with Claims professionals across different business areas to understand their responsibilities and contributions to the claim lifecycle.
  • Assist with research, data gathering, analysis, and documentation supporting current business priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve a Claims process, workflow, technology, training approach, or customer experience.
  • Complete a structured summer project with clear objectives, milestones, and measurable deliverables.
  • Present project findings, insights, and recommendations to Claims colleagues and leaders.
  • Participate in team meetings, professional-development activities, mentorship, and the enterprise internship learning program.

What You Will Learn

  • How Claims Operations supports customers and the broader business.
  • How quality, compliance, customer service, technology, and operational processes influence claim outcomes.
  • How different Claims teams collaborate to address business needs and improve the customer experience.
  • How to research a business problem, analyze information, and develop practical recommendations.
  • How to communicate findings and present ideas to business partners and leaders.
  • How to work effectively in a professional, cross-functional environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • You are enrolled in a bachelor's degree program and will have at least one semester remaining following the summer internship.
  • You have an expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028.
  • You are available to participate in the full internship program from May 17, 2027 through August 7, 2027.
  • You are proficient with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • You possess effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • You demonstrate strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • You can manage multiple assignments and meet established deadlines.
  • You can work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
  • You can handle customer and company information with discretion and confidentiality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Pursuing a bachelor's degree in business administration, insurance, risk management, finance, communications, operations, or a related field.
  • Interest in claims, insurance operations, customer experience, or process improvement.
  • Previous customer service, administrative, office, or internship experience.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Comfort working in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, procedures, and business needs.
  • Customer-focused mindset with an interest in helping others.
  • Experience using Excel to organize, review, or analyze information.

What Makes You a Good Fit

  • Organized and detail-oriented.
  • Curious and eager to learn.
  • Customer-focused and empathetic.
  • Dependable and accountable.
  • Comfortable asking questions and receiving feedback.
  • Proactive in identifying problems and proposing solutions.
  • Able to balance accuracy with productivity.
  • Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively.

Internship Experience

As a Claims Processing Operations Intern, you will receive:

  • A structured onboarding experience.
  • An assigned manager and opportunities for mentorship.
  • Hands-on assignments that support real business needs.
  • Exposure to experienced Claims and Operations professionals.
  • Professional-development and networking opportunities.
  • Ongoing coaching and performance feedback.
  • A meaningful internship project with an opportunity to present your work.

Remote Opportunity

Paid Internship: $20-22/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/6/2027

Note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.


If no application deadline is provided, this role may be a pipeline requisition, and we'll continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis, or there is no requirement for this information in the location where the role is posted.

Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience, and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Helping People Thrive in a Connected World
Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we'll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at jobs.assurant.com.

What's the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America's Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture The Assurant Way.

Company Overview
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world's leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.

Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant's privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

At Berkley Technology Services, we believe AI-assisted ways of working are becoming a foundational part of how excellent engineering work gets done - much like the way digital communication tools did a generation ago. The AI Automation Architect designs, builds, and maintains the automation and AI-enabled capabilities that make Berkley's Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) function faster, more consistent, and more audit-ready. The role turns manual, repetitive compliance work — evidence collection, control testing support, exception handling, and reporting — into governed, automated workflows, freeing IT Compliance and operating-unit personnel to focus on judgment, risk decisions, and control ownership.

Working within IT GRC and in close partnership with Information Security, Internal Audit, and the operating units, the engineer builds automations on the enterprise GRC platform (ServiceNow GRC/IRM and Archer), integrates control and evidence data across systems, and applies AI responsibly to accelerate compliance activities. Consistent with BTS's “security-first” and “use AI to work smarter” principles, this position acts as a force multiplier for the compliance team rather than a replacement for it — accountability, oversight, and risk acceptance remain with people.

  • Automation & AI Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain GRC automations and AI-enabled solutions that streamline compliance processes, ensuring each solution complies with security, privacy, and governance requirements.
  • Control Evidence & Testing Support: Automate the collection, validation, and packaging of control evidence for SOX, NYDFS Part 500, and internal control assessments — reducing manual gathering and improving completeness and consistency.
  • Exception & Workflow Automation: Build and improve exception intake, routing, reporting, and dashboards within ServiceNow GRC/IRM and Archer; support the migration of GRC processes onto the strategic platform.
  • Integration & Data: Integrate control, risk, and evidence data across GRC, ITSM, identity, and security tooling via APIs and connectors to create reliable, reusable data pipelines and reporting.
  • Applied AI: Apply AI responsibly to draft first-pass control narratives, summarize findings, map controls to frameworks (NIST CSF 2.0, NYDFS Part 500), and accelerate analysis — with human review retained for all decisions.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain clear process and technical documentation for every automation, including run books, data lineage, and control mappings, so solutions remain auditable and supportable over time.
  • Security First: Implement a security-first practice, embedding least-privilege access, logging, and change-control into every automation; ensure AI and automation use aligns with the company AI Policy and GRC governance.
  • Business Partnership: Partner with IT Compliance analysts, Internal Audit, InfoSec, and OU compliance personnel to identify high-value automation opportunities, gather requirements, and drive adoption of delivered capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on automation building. Demonstrated experience turning manual, fragmented processes into engineered, automated workflows — with concrete examples of automations built and shipped, not just advised on.
  • Programming and scripting. Proficiency in Python and comfort building and consuming APIs / REST integrations to move and connect data across systems.
  • Workflow and integration tooling. Practical experience with workflow-automation and orchestration tools, plus building reusable pipelines and integrations that others can consume.
  • Applied AI judgment. Working experience with applied AI — agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM-assisted workflows — and sound judgment on when AI adds value versus when deterministic automation is the better choice.

The Enterprise Architect partners with business and technology leaders to translate organizational strategy into enterprise capabilities, target-state architectures, transition roadmaps, and informed technology investment decisions. The role provides enterprise-wide direction for application and technology portfolios, including modernization, rationalization, lifecycle management, technical debt reduction, and responsible adoption of AI and emerging technologies.

Serving as a trusted advisor, the Enterprise Architect evaluates business value, cost, risk, architecture, data readiness, security, resilience, and organizational impact to recommend whether capabilities and technologies should be enhanced, consolidated, modernized, replaced, or retired. The role leads through influence, enables cross-domain decisions, and helps teams balance enterprise standards and reuse with the needs of individual operating companies.

Business and Technical Strategy

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to understand strategic priorities, customer and employee needs, operating constraints, and growth opportunities.
  • Translate business strategy into enterprise capabilities, target architectures, transition roadmaps, and sequenced investment choices.
  • Frame recommendations, business cases, and solutions in terms of business value, cost, risk, speed, resilience, and organizational impact, not technical views alone.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, rationalize platforms, improve reuse, and strengthen enterprise leverage while respecting individual company needs.
  • Maintain contact with vendors, industry peers, and professional associations to keep informed of existing and emerging industry trends, standards, and technologies.

Architecture Direction and Portfolio Guidance

  • Develop and maintain architecture principles, standards, guidelines, business capability models, and roadmaps that support enterprise priorities.
  • Provide architecture guidance across initiatives and portfolios, identifying dependencies, redundancies, technical debt, and opportunities for reuse.
  • Influence portfolio planning and technology lifecycle decisions through research, data-driven rationale, market trends, target architectures, and roadmaps.

Solution Guidance and Governance

  • Advise product, application, data, infrastructure, security, and engineering teams on solution direction and key design decisions.
  • Lead or participate in architecture reviews with a pragmatic focus on business value, risk, standards alignment, technical debt, interoperability, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
  • Create clear, decision-enabling architecture artifacts appropriate to their audience and the decisions being made.
  • Escalate material risks and exceptions while helping teams identify viable paths forward.

AI and Emerging Technology

  • Partner with business and technology leaders to shape the enterprise approach to AI, including generative and agentic AI, by connecting use cases to business outcomes, data readiness, architecture, security, legal, compliance, and responsible use requirements.
  • Guide teams in selecting fit-for-purpose AI patterns, platforms, models, tooling, and integration approaches, including build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Assess AI and emerging technology opportunities through experiments and proofs-of-concept with clear hypotheses, guardrails, adoption considerations, and success metrics.

Influence, Leadership, and Change

About this job

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer on the Enterprise Intelligence Factory team to play a foundational role in building the enterprise Semantic Ontology & Dimension Factory Platform. This platform enables AIready analytics by combining semantic ontologies, knowledge graphs, agentic AI, and data engineering to automatically generate businessready star schemas from heterogeneous enterprise data sources.

In this role, you will design and implement agentdriven pipelines that leverage RDF/OWL ontologies, SPARQL, and Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform semantic alignment, dimension mining, and AIassisted data modelling at scale. You will work at the intersection of AI, semantics, and modern data platforms, helping establish engineering patterns and best practices for the team.

This is a handson, senior individual-contributor role, ideal for engineers who enjoy building core platform capabilities rather than isolated experiments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, andmaintainagentic AI pipelines(usingGoogle ADK or similar frameworks) to automate semantic mapping, dimension mining, andontologydrivenreasoning.
  • Createand evolveenterprise ontologiesinRDF/OWL, including upper ontologies and domain extensions aligned to CIM (where applicable), to enable reusable enterprise semantics.
  • EngineerLLMpoweredservicesfor schema understanding, semantic alignment, ontology enrichment, andAIassistedmetadata generation, with a focus on accuracy, traceability, and scale.
  • ImplementSPARQL querying and reasoning layersover knowledge graphs to drive downstream transformations and ensure consistent interpretation of business concepts.
  • Architectand deliverPythonbasedmicroservicesand batch pipelines that integrate semantic reasoning with moderndataengineeringworkflows.
  • Buildandoptimizedimension and fact generation pipelinesonMicrosoft Fabric(Lakehouse, Spark, SQL, orchestration) to producebusinessreadystar schemas from heterogeneous sources.
  • Defineand enforceengineering standards, design patterns, and reusable components for semantic andAIdrivendata platforms (quality, observability, security, and performance).
  • Partnerwith data architects, domain SMEs, and governance teams tovalidatesemantic definitions, manage change, and ensure platform scalability and adoption.
  • Conductcode reviews, mentor engineers, and influence technical decisions across the platform to raise engineering quality and delivery velocity.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, withstrongproficiencyin Pythonand GenAI.

  • Handsonexperience buildingLLMbasedsystemsusing commercial oropensourcemodels.
  • Solidunderstanding ofsemantic technologies: RDF, OWL, ontologies, knowledge graphs, andSPARQL.
  • Experiencedesigning or working withagentic AI frameworks(e.g., Google ADK,LangChainagents, or similar).
  • Strongbackground indata engineering concepts(ETL/ELT, star schemas,metadatadrivenpipelines).
  • Experiencebuilding and operating systems oncloud platforms, preferablyMicrosoft Azure / Microsoft Fabric.
  • Strongproblemsolvingskills and ability to work in ambiguous, greenfield platform initiatives.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experiencewithenterprise data models(e.g., CIM or canonical models).
  • Familiaritywithsemantic alignment, ontology mapping, or datacataloguingtools.
  • ExposuretoMLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, and AI observability.
  • Knowledgeofdistributed systems, CI/CD pipelines, andcontainerisation.
  • ExperiencebuildingAIassistedanalytics or semantic layersfor BI or NLQ use cases.

The hiring manager has flexibility to hire across several levels of seniority. The level will be determined by the selected applicant's skills and competencies.

  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Director-level P&C reserving role at Allstate responsible for loss and expense reserve estimation across Auto Injury and Business Insurance. Reports to senior leadership with regular presentations to CFO, CAO, and CEO, plus engagement with external auditors and state regulators.

Good fit if you have FCAS, 12+ years of P&C reserving experience, expertise in actuarial methodologies, and proven leadership of actuarial teams.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Why This Role

This is a signature seat within the enterprise P&C actuarial organization a role designed for a senior reserving leader who wants direct line-of-sight to the top of the house. You will own the estimation of loss and expense reserves across Auto Injury and Business Insurance, and you'll do it with a rare combination of technical depth, executive influence, and enterprise reach.

You'll have opportunities to regularly present to senior and executive level leadership up to and including the CEO, along with coordinating with and supporting the external appointed actuary, auditors, and state departments of insurance. In short: your work will be seen, challenged, and acted upon at the highest levels of the company.

As a Director, you won't just deliver results you'll shape culture, sharpen the craft, and set the standard for how modern reserving is done. We value in-person, connected experiences with your team and Allstaters across the enterprise, which will require travel within your local area or to one of our offices on a regular basis.

What You'll Do

  • Own the reserve estimate. Develop, execute, and continuously improve highly complex actuarial reserving methodologies across multiple lines of business, ensuring data quality, methodology appropriateness, and documentation standards are best-in-class.

  • Influence the enterprise. Present at Loss Reserve Committee meetings and translate complex actuarial results into clear, decision-ready insights for the CFO, Chief Accounting Officer, and CEO, as well as business unit presidents and finance leadership.

  • Benchmark and modernize. Continuously benchmark reserving techniques against industry practice and bring forward the next generation of methods from stochastic models to machine learning and AI-enabled reserving.

  • Engage external stakeholders. Serve as a primary point of contact for auditors, the external appointed actuary, and state departments of insurance; represent the company with credibility and command.

  • Lead reserving in dynamic environments. Review and challenge complex loss reserving techniques across multiple lines and provide expert consultation on the most difficult reserving questions.

  • Build the team. Own end-to-end talent management for an expanded team succession planning, compensation, development, bench strength, and organizational design and coach the next generation of reserving leaders.

  • Set strategy. Connect Allstate's vision and enterprise strategies to department initiatives; develop and lead multi-year plans that drive measurable corporate business results.

  • Ensure control and compliance. Develop and adhere to internal and external compliance requirements, including GAAP, Statutory, and evolving regulatory expectations around model governance and AI.

Executive Exposure & Impact

This role sits close to the decision-making core of the company.

Your voice will shape how the company communicates reserve adequacy to the Board, the Street, and regulators.

What You'll Bring

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor's degree (preferred); equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

  • Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) or equivalent actuarial designation(required).

  • 12+ years of progressive P&C actuarial experience, with meaningful depth in reserving.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Deep expertise in loss reserving methodologies (chain-ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Cape Cod, stochastic reserving, individual claim-level models) and advanced actuarial/statistical techniques.

  • Strong knowledge of insurance reserving frameworks, ERM, capital, and regulatory requirements (GAAP, Statutory).

  • Ability to quickly master and apply a broad range of analytical tools, data sources, and software applications.z

AI & Advanced Analytics Proficiency

  • Working proficiency with AI, machine learning, and generative AI as applied to reserving and broader actuarial work including automated assumption selection and LLM-assisted documentation, analysis, and communication.

  • Familiarity with AI governance and model risk management frameworks (e.g.,CAS AI guidance) and the ability to responsibly deploy AI in a regulated environment.

  • Comfort using AI/GenAI tools (e.g., Copilot, Python/R ML libraries) to accelerate model development, benchmarking, exhibits, and executive-ready reporting.

Executive Communication & Influence

  • Exceptional communication skills able to craft and deliver clear, compelling, executive-ready messages, and to translate highly technical concepts for CFO/CAO/CEO-level audiences.

  • Proven ability to influence upward, downward, and laterally; builds alignment and drives outcomes without relying on positional authority.

  • Coaches others on the proper use of technical and analytical language and serves as a subject-matter expert to internal partners.

Leadership & Management

  • Proven leadership experience, including developing people leaders and building high-performing actuarial teams.

  • Leads with empathy and clarity through organizational changes; builds trust and sustains engagement in an evolving company environment.

Project & Program Management

  • Advanced program management capability, with a track record of independently leading multiple high-complexity, cross-functional initiatives on time and on quality.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role has direct supervisory responsibility for a team of actuarial leaders and analysts across Auto Injury and Business Insurance.

Skills

Business Strategies, Data Analytics, Performance Management (PM), Strategic Leadership, Strategy Development

Compensation

Compensation
Compensation offered for this role is 190,000.00 - 250,000.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Design and build scalable enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric for Allstate's Data & Analytics Technology team. Work on AI-driven solutions for analytics, reporting, and advanced data products, collaborating with engineers, architects, and data scientists.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join Allstate's Data & Analytics Technology team and help build the next generation of enterprise AI and data platforms on Microsoft Fabric.

We are seeking an experienced AI Cloud Platform Engineer to help design, build, and operate scalable, resilient, and high-performance data platforms that power enterprise analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and advanced data products. This role is responsible for developing and optimizing a Unified Data Analytics Platform using cloud-native Microsoft Fabric technologies.

As an AI Cloud Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and implementing intelligent, automated, and agentic AI-driven solutions that enhance the security, governance, reliability, and operational excellence of the enterprise data platform. You will work closely with analytics engineers, data architects, data scientists, and product teams to deliver innovative capabilities that enable trusted, self-service, and enterprise-scale data consumption.

You'll have the opportunity to influence platform strategy, and deliver solutions that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participates in iteration planning to ensure the team shares a common understanding of backlog stories, features, and technical chores.
  • Helps execute the product strategy with customer needs and outcomes as priorities.
  • Works with team members to design scalable systems, applications, and data solutions.
  • Participates in daily site, cross-site, and product team standups.
  • Uses Agentic AI-assisted development capabilities, including GitHub Copilot and similar coding assistants, to accelerate code generation, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while following enterprise governance standards.
  • Contributes to retrospectives by gathering feedback and identifying actionable improvements for the team and product.
  • Supports software products and platforms in production and user environments.
  • Shares knowledge and contributes to the continuous development of the teams collective expertise.
  • Applies paired programming, test-driven development (TDD), and modern software engineering practices to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Establishes and maintains Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and practices.
  • Collaborates on designing and implementing AI-enabled applications, automation workflows, and intelligent developer experiences where appropriate.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and supporting enterprise-scale data platforms and pipelines.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL , and modern data engineering practices.
  • Strong hands-on experience with GitHub, Key vault, and REST API (integration 7 automation).
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure platform, or comparable cloud analytics platforms.
    Experience with Terraform/Jenkins, or comparable CI/CD.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, source control, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated testing practices.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered engineering tools and Agentic AI-assisted software development practices.
  • Strong understanding of distributed computing, performance tuning, scalability, fault tolerance, and data reliability.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise data products within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Knowledge of data governance and data quality frameworks.
  • Cloud or data engineering certifications in Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or related technologies.

Experience

  • 3 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Job.JobTitle: Director Business Insights Delivery & Analytics Product Owner
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Data Engineer, Technology / Insurtech, Insurance Product Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $136,100 to $224,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Director role leading Business Insights Delivery and Analytics Product Owner for Travelers Insurance's Claim Business Intelligence team in Hartford. Accountable for strategy, roadmap, and portfolio of data and insights products, working with claim leaders and data partners to drive adoption and business outcomes.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree or five years of business intelligence experience, strong technical knowledge of analytics platforms, and excellent communication skills across management levels.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Claim Business Intelligence & Analytics (CBIA) is looking for a strategic Business Insights Delivery practitioner and team leader to set the vision, roadmap and backlog for a portfolio of claim data and insights products. You will work with Claim leaders, data engineering, architecture, and enterprise data and governance partners to shape what gets built, drive adoption and confirm that what we deliver changes outcomes.
In this role, you will serve as the Product Owner for a team of engineers and analysts in an Agile insights delivery environment-with the opportunity to define and steward a suite of analytic products that impact the Claim business. You will also help define how the team builds, bringing AI-native practices into product discovery, delivery and the full analytic development lifecycle.
At Travelers, we're focused on expanding the application of data and analytics beyond managing risk, helping businesses increase their productivity and efficiency and enabling great experiences for our customers and agents. The Business Insights Delivery team aims to enable the business by building solutions that turn data in to insights with well-designed data assets and effective, compelling dashboards and visualizations. As the Director, Business Insights Delivery, you will lead the strategic direction to ensure technical capabilities fit long-term business partner roadmaps. You will build highly complex data stories and present to management to enable sound decision making. You will leverage your negotiation skills to come to optimal solutions with business partners that align capabilities within the portfolio to business value. You will coordinate with internal and external partners to avoid redundancies in delivery to ensure efficient execution of business value. This position may direct a team of data and analytic professionals.

What Will You Do?

  • Accountable for the planning, objectives, and milestones for long-term strategy, including dependency mapping, business partnerships, and timelines across supported portfolio(s).
  • Focus on what pieces of value need to be delivered to achieve business partner and internal goals and objectives.
  • Lead the intake of business demand and assess value to ensure alignment to long-term roadmaps.
  • Work with business partners to design insights portfolio that addresses goals and objectives.
  • Partner with leaders across lines of business to assess and adopt new Decision Analytics and Insights capabilities.
  • Drive adoption of insights delivery solution among business partners, including reporting, guided analytics, self-service, embedded, augmented, and data as a service capability.
  • Work to ensure team structure and skills are sufficient to deliver and maintain value over time. Balances dependencies with internal and external organizations to ensure value delivery plan can be met.
  • Provide use cases for tool assessment.
  • Coach and aid in the skill development of the team, including team leaders.
  • Align solution design to enterprise data management, security, and governance controls.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to interact with all levels of management.
  • Ability to quickly gain an understanding of Travelers' business strategy and plan objectives to align with enterprise goals.
  • Strong technical understanding of all delivery methods and platforms and their use and purpose.
  • Ability to set data and information delivery strategies.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree or five years equivalent experience with business intelligence tools, techniques, manipulation, or related.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.

Sr. Construction Liability Claim Representative managing moderate to high complexity injury and property damage claims at Travelers Insurance in Diamond Bar, California. Role includes investigation, coverage evaluation, litigation support, and mentoring junior claim representatives.

Good fit if you have 2+ years bodily injury or property damage liability claim experience, 2 years litigation experience, and an active adjuster license.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$87,800.00 - $144,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

This role is eligible for a sign-on bonus of up to $20,000.

As a Technical Specialist, Specialty Liability, you will be responsible for managing and investigating moderate complexity injury and/or property damage claims including customer contact, determining coverage, evaluating liability, assessing damages, establishing timely reserves, and issue timely and accurate payments within appropriate authority and oversight. In this technical role, you will leverage your expertise in claims management, investigative techniques, coverage evaluation, and settlement negotiation to ensure timely and fair resolution. You will foster positive, professional relationships with customers and stakeholders on claims that may involve significant litigation or span extended periods. You will provide guidance and mentorship to Claim Reps and Associate Claim Reps, sharing knowledge and best practices to support their development.

What Will You Do?

  • Independently manage an active caseload of injury and/or property damage claims and litigation from first notice of loss through resolution within level of authority. Typically, handles personal and/or business insurance high complexity liability claims which may include coverage disputes and contractual indemnity issues.
  • Gather and thoroughly investigate information by contacting all relevant parties to determine coverage, evaluate liability exposure, assess bodily injury and/or property damage, and establish appropriate reserves in accordance with policy terms and management guidance.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, opposing counsel, third-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Leverage resolution strategies and coordinate internal and external resources to conduct comprehensive claim investigations and evaluations.
  • Actively negotiate with multiple constituents (e.g., claimants, attorneys, contractors, representatives) and convey claim settlements within authority and issue payments timely and accurately.
  • Assist in coordinating with Counsel to support litigation management strategies.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Identify areas in which we can improve or enhance current best practices and offer creative solutions.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • May require travel, including overnight stays, to attend mediations, trials, arbitration, etc.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Three years of liability, bodily injury or comparable claim experience.
  • Two years of litigation claim experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where required by state law.
  • Experience with claims management systems, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to comprehend, synthesize, and clearly articulate complex information to multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze complex situations, exercise sound judgement, and make effective decisions independently.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers; ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage a high-volume workload and prioritize effectively.
  • Proven conflict resolution and negotiation skills; ability to handle complex or disputed claims, negotiate settlements, and manage litigation.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Thorough understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations, fair claims practices, and legal requirements applicable to claim handling.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret, apply, and clearly articulate complex policy language, endorsements, exclusions to assess coverage and claim eligibility.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Two years of bodily injury liability, property damage liability, or comparable claim related experience.

When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

Job Description:

Location: Hybrid (Dallas In-Office and Remote)


Join a Team That Drives Positive Claim Outcomes

Are you passionate about helping customers, experienced in writing auto damage estimates, and driven to deliver exceptional results? We are seeking an Auto Damage Appraiser who excels in customer service, organization, and communication while handling auto property damage claims in a fast-paced environment.

This hybrid position offers the flexibility of working remotely 2 days per week and in the office 3 days per week while providing opportunities to collaborate with a high-performing claims team dedicated to positive claim outcomes.

Position Summary

The Auto Damage Appraiser is responsible for the prompt, accurate, and efficient evaluation and settlement of repairable automobile property damage claims. This role requires a customer-focused professional who can effectively balance claim communication, documentation, negotiations, and administrative responsibilities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and organizational excellence.

The ideal candidate is highly organized and committed to providing an outstanding customer experience through proactive communication and timely claim resolution.

What You'll Do

  • Analyze vehicle damage photographs, repair supplements, and supporting documentation to develop accurate repair estimates
  • Determine whether vehicles are repairable or qualify as total losses
  • Verify that vehicle damages are consistent with reported loss facts
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with repair facilities
  • Issue payments within established authority limits
  • Coordinate rentals, repairs, and claim resolution activities
  • Partner with policyholders, claimants, repair facilities, vendors, and internal business partners to drive positive claim outcomes
  • Build trust and confidence with customers through professionalism and responsiveness
  • Maintain accurate, detailed, and timely claim documentation
  • Maintain compliance with company guidelines, regulatory requirements, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all claim activities are completed timely and accurately

What Makes You Successful

Required Skills

  • Exceptional customer service and relationship-building skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities
  • Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage a high-volume workload
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to make independent decisions and exercise sound judgment
  • Effective negotiation skills
  • Proficiency with claims management systems and CCC One
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative hybrid work environment
  • Knowledge of vehicle construction, repair methods, and damage analysis

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate or bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in auto damage appraisal, insurance claims, collision repair, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience handling moderate to severe vehicle damage claims and total loss evaluations preferred.
  • Knowledge of state claim handling regulations preferred.

Licensing Requirements

  • Texas Adjuster License preferred.
  • Ability to obtain Texas Adjuster License within 90 Days required

Hallmark Financial Services is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Summit provides independent insurance agents and their clients with market-leading workers' comp insurance and elite customer service. We're growing and currently serve more than 7,000 independent agents and 31,000 policyholders across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic.

Our strength comes from a single-minded focus on workers' comp and a commitment to long-term customer relationships. Summit is who you turn to when you need a specialist who not only knows workers' comp but also gets to know your business and your priorities.

Our field team members are located in every state in which we operate.

Summit is a member of the Great American Insurance Group where our highest goal is for all employees to feel included, respected, and empowered to perform at their best.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Summit's superregional growth continues. We currently serve 17 states. And in 2026, our expansion will include Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, and Washington D.C., with Missouri and additional states to follow.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

  • This position is a field role within the Charlotte, NC or Greensboro, NC territory.
  • Develops strategic marketing plans, considering agency strengths, competitors, and market conditions.
  • Identifies and secures profitable new business opportunities in target markets and develops and implements strategic plans, resulting in a specified increase in market share.
  • Cultivates and maintains strong relationships with key agencies by providing tailored insurance solutions that meet their specific needs, leading to an increase in agency retention and satisfaction. Educates agencies on product features, market placement, and effective selling techniques.
  • Drives revenue growth by achieving or exceeding sales targets. May develop and execute cross-selling and up-selling strategies
  • Conducts market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats, informing strategic decision-making.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

#LI-Remote

Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

Experience: Generally, a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic business development, marketing, or a related role. Completion of or continuing progress toward certifications including Associate in Underwriting (AU), Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU), Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC), Program in General Insurance (INS) or Associate of Risk Management (ARM).

Scope of Job/Qualifications: Strong understanding of agency dynamics, marketing, underwriting, and risk management. Demonstrates excellent communication skills and ability to build relationships. Proficiency in interpreting competitive data and industry trends. Ensures compliance with insurance laws and regulations, applying underwriting rules, guidelines, and rating manual standards. Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform decisions. Demonstrated decision-making ability and customer-centric mindset. Position requires frequent day and overnight travel (60% - 80% of time) to visit agents and brokers.

SCI Summit Consulting, LLC

$100,000.00 -$155,000.00

Full-time and eligible part-time employees also enjoy Paid Time Off and paid holidays, a 401(k) plan with company match, an employee stock purchase plan, and commuter benefits.

About this job

Associate Attorney handling moderately complex civil litigation and workers' compensation matters for Liberty Mutual Insurance. Primarily remote role in California, managing cases from inception through resolution with support from senior counsel.

Good fit if you have a California bar license, knowledge of insurance law, and can manage civil litigation cases under supervision.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of California except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Californiaand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

About this job

Manages a team of Client Service Managers at Liberty Mutual's Chicago office, overseeing service delivery to customers and brokers. Responsibilities include team recruitment, training, and development, account management, and cross-functional collaboration with underwriting, claims, and field operations.

Good fit if you have 7+ years in commercial insurance with leadership experience and advanced knowledge of P&C insurance, risk management, and applicable regulations.

Full job description


Description

Manages a group of Client Service Managers (CSM) to deliver consistent and high-quality service to customers and brokers. Assists in recruiting, training, and developing team members. Responsible for developing annual objectives that support assigned account success, as well as accountable for team performance and development. Contributes to the development, implementation, and execution of the business plan and strategies. Resolves service-related issues with internal partners. Responsible for managing external relationships (clients, agents/brokers, industry associations, etc.) and issue resolution. Manage assigned accounts, handling servicing aspects of relationships.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriting Manager, Major Accounts Casualty
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Senior Underwriting Manager leads a team of Loss Sensitive Primary Casualty Underwriters serving retail-market customers. This role is accountable for the teams underwriting performance, talent management, portfolio results, and execution of the business strategy. The manager oversees the attraction, development, compensation, performance management, and engagement of team members while promoting disciplined, data-driven underwriting across a complex loss sensitive casualty portfolio.

The role requires strong technical expertise in primary casualty, loss sensitive structures, and retail distribution, along with the ability to build trusted relationships with retail brokers, agents, clients, internal partners, and other market stakeholders. The Senior Underwriting Manager may contribute to business planning, portfolio strategy, product development, and market-facing initiatives for the assigned business area.

  • Lead and develop a team of Loss Sensitive Primary Casualty Underwriters serving retail-market customers, with accountability for talent attraction, engagement, compensation, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Drive underwriting excellence across the portfolio by reinforcing disciplined risk selection, pricing adequacy, exposure analysis, terms and conditions, and compliance with underwriting authority.
  • Communicate and execute underwriting strategy, including risk appetite, target industries, portfolio priorities, broker engagement, profitability objectives, and risk-adjusted growth.
  • Own the performance of all or part of the retail loss sensitive casualty portfolio, including profitability, rate adequacy, retention, new business, premium, exposure quality, and portfolio concentration.
  • Provide senior technical guidance on complex primary casualty risks and loss sensitive structures, including large deductibles, retrospective programs, collateral requirements, collateral alternatives, and significant loss experience.
  • Serve as a point of escalation for challenging underwriting decisions, exceptions to guidelines, large loss sensitive opportunities, distressed risks, and unusual program structures.
Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 10 years progressive underwriting experience or equivalent expected, including a minimum of 2 years of proven underwriting management experience, preferred
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate high impact underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required
  • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills
