About this job

Director role leading the Quantitative Capital Insights team at Liberty Mutual Insurance in Boston. Responsible for developing risk-based capital analysis and economic capital modeling to support capital deployment, pricing, portfolio optimization, and strategic planning decisions across the enterprise.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in actuarial, capital modeling, or enterprise risk management in P&C insurance, with people management experience and an advanced degree or FCAS/ACAS credential.

Full job description


Description

Job Summary

Leads the Quantitative Capital Insights team in making risk-based capital a practical enabler of some of Liberty Mutual`s most consequential business decisions-capital deployment, pricing, portfolio optimization, risk financing, and strategic planning-by producing insight the enterprise can act on, and nurturing the relationships needed to turn that insight into decisions.

Builds a deep understanding of the risk profile of each business unit, and of LMG in the aggregate, to guide capital deployment and trade-off decisions in pursuit of TBV growth, subject to an appropriate level of volatility.

Pushes the team to become a thought leader-with the appropriate matrixed partners-in developing alternative views of capital and risk, such as less-deep-in-the-tail views of income volatility, that leverage existing tools and extend the team`s common-language approach to other important decisions.

Unites previously separate teams into one that`s stronger than the sum of its parts, providing the direction, prioritization, alignment, and discipline to execute.

Thinks broadly about where capital insight creates the most value and serves as a key advisor to senior management on capital adequacy, capital allocation, and strategic capital decisions-including regulatory and rating agency matters.

Job Responsibilities

1) Sets the strategic direction for the enterprise Economic Capital Model, ensuring it remains fit for purpose as the business evolves-reflecting current risk profile across underwriting, reserve, market, credit, catastrophe, and operational risk, informed by each business unit`s view of risk and market context.

2) Directs production of economic capital results and decision-support analytics-capital adequacy metrics, RORAC for quarterly performance reviews and planning, target capital alignment, and forward-looking capital assessments-distilled into insight that`s decision-ready for ORSA, rating agency engagements, regulatory filings, and Board discussions.

3) Navigates a matrixed partnership model across US Retail Markets, Global Risk Solutions, and Liberty Mutual Investments, tailoring engagement to each business unit`s needs-supporting business-owned decisions (pricing, portfolio optimization) with capital modeling expertise, and driving enterprise-owned decisions (target capital, deployment) through close BU relationships.

4) Provides decision-support for capital deployment, risk financing, and M&A, partnering with Actuarial, Enterprise Risk Management, Treasury, Portfolio Management, and business unit leadership to embed capital insight in allocation decisions, reinsurance optimization, and long-range planning.

5) Advises senior executives on capital positioning and scenario outcomes, distilling complex quantitative modeling into the clear, actionable insight that enables disciplined, value-creating decisions; produces clear recommendations that support executive leadership decisions and inform the Board of Directors.

6) Establishes a common language for capital (concepts, metrics, outputs) across the organization-demystifying the model at the appropriate level to build trust, support informed decision-making, and prepare materials for leadership and governance forums.

7) Extends that common language into new territory as a thought leader on alternative views of capital and risk-such as less-deep-in-the-tail views of income volatility-in partnership with matrixed partners across USRM, GRS, and LMI, leveraging existing tools and frameworks.

8) Contributes to and advances the model governance framework, ensuring rigorous validation, transparent documentation, and compliance with model risk management standards through a shared governance model with BU and enterprise stakeholders.

9) Partners with ERM on enterprise-wide stress testing and scenario analysis, translating the capital implications of emerging risks, macroeconomic shifts, and strategic initiatives into actionable recommendations on capital levers and aggregate risk profile.

10) Unites previously separate teams into one that`s stronger than the sum of its parts. Recognizes that combining multiple strong teams is a unique leadership challenge, and provides the direction, prioritization, alignment, and discipline to execute-cultivating a culture of intellectual rigor, continuous learning, and constructive challenge that attracts and retains top-tier talent.

11) Drives continuous, pragmatic improvement of modeling infrastructure, data quality, automation, and process efficiency, incorporating industry best practices and evolving regulatory standards to keep the capability proportionate to the decisions it supports.

Qualifications

A BS or BA degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline required, advanced degree (Master`s or Ph.D.) strongly preferred. FCAS/ACAS or equivalent actuarial credential strongly preferred.

Experience:

Typically, 10 plus years of progressive experience in actuarial, capital modeling, or enterprise risk management within P&C insurance or reinsurance, including people management experience; experience integrating previously separate teams is a plus.

Executive & Technical Competencies:

1) Skilled at distilling complex quantitative work into insight that drives decisions, and at building the relationships across Enterprise and BU stakeholders needed to turn that insight into action.

2) Broad, strategic thinker who looks beyond the model to identify where capital insight creates the most value and prioritizes the team`s work accordingly.

3) Forward-looking, with a track record of developing new quantitative lenses or metrics-leveraging existing tools rather than building anew-that extend beyond their original use case and become part of how business partners think about a decision.

4) Proven ability to lead a team formed by combining multiple previously separate groups, giving the combined team the direction, prioritization, alignment, and discipline to execute that make it stronger than the sum of its parts.

5) Deep expertise in economic capital modeling methodologies, including underwriting, reserve, market, credit, and catastrophe risk quantification at an enterprise scale.

6) Comprehensive command of ORSA frameworks, rating agency capital models (AM Best, S&P, Moody`s), and NAIC regulatory capital standards.

7) Strong understanding of how capital model outputs connect to business decisions-including pricing (TCRs), capital allocation, NII allocation, RORAC, portfolio optimization, and reinsurance strategy.

8) Demonstrated ability to build trust and drive outcomes across a matrixed environment-business unit actuarial teams, finance, ERM, and enterprise leadership-through influence and collaboration, while maintaining enterprise framework consistency.

9) Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to advise senior executives and make complex capital concepts accessible to non-specialist audiences.

10) Advanced proficiency with capital/actuarial modeling platforms (Igloo experience preferred) and analytical tools including Excel; Python/R/SQL capabilities valued.

11) Strong organizational and prioritization skills; ability to manage multiple concurrent modeling and reporting cycles across enterprise and BU stakeholders.

12) Strong attention to detail and commitment to model governance and controls within a shared governance model.

13) Significant experience gained within the insurance or reinsurance industry.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Underwriter, Underwriting, Insurance Account Executive
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$87,800.00 - $144,800.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

Select Accounts provides a broad array of competitive products and coverages that offer agents and insureds value and flexibility. Select Accounts' core product, the Business Owner's Policy (BOP), provides property and liability coverage for small businesses of all types, from Main Street retailers to small manufacturers and property owners. The Account Executive (AE), Select will partner with agents to provide property, general liability, commercial auto, workers' compensation, and/or umbrella coverage for new business based on customers' needs. As an AE, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to assess risk and sell our products in a high-volume, fast paced environment will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that this posting will remain open until November 23, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business in a high-volume, fast paced environment. Balance individual account underwriting within an assigned portfolio of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate property and casualty accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Ensure underwriting quality and profitability through application of the appropriate level of underwriting analysis based on risk complexity to accept, decline, modify, or rate and quote accounts.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Partner with Sales Executives to identify and write new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Collaborate effectively with underwriting leadership, as appropriate.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Three to five years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in commercial lines.
  • Knowledge of commercial lines products.

About this job

Outside Auto Appraiser for Travelers Insurance in Braintree, Massachusetts. Inspect damaged vehicles, estimate repair costs, determine total loss values, and settle claims. Work remotely with field visits to body shops and customer locations.

Good fit if you have a valid Massachusetts Auto Appraiser license and one year of auto physical damage appraisal or claim-related experience.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. $65,400.00 - $108,000.00

Target Openings

2

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.
To be considered for this role, you must hold a valid Auto Appraiser license issued by the Auto Damage Appraising License Board as required by the state of Massachusetts.

To be considered for this role, you must hold a valid Auto Appraiser license issued by the Auto Damage Appraising License Board as required by the state of Massachusetts.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

About this job

AVP, Legal Counsel advising on enterprise contracts including SaaS, outsourcing, and licensing agreements. Lead contract negotiations for deals worth tens to hundreds of millions annually while shaping contracting strategy and governance across the organization.

Good fit if you have 8+ years of commercial contract law experience, J.D. from ABA-accredited school, active bar membership, and expertise in contract negotiation and risk assessment.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina); Hartford, CT (Connecticut)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76631

The Role at a Glance

As the AVP, Legal Counsel, Enterprise Contracts, you will serve as a key strategic legal advisor supporting Lincoln's buy-side contracting and related activities. You will partner with business clients and cross functional stakeholders to structure, negotiate, and execute a broad range of commercial transactions, including software-as-a-service agreements, outsourcing agreements, professional services agreements, licensing agreements, supply agreements, equipment leases, and event agreements.

In this role, you will have a leadership role in negotiating transactions representing tens or hundreds of millions of dollars in annual spend, balancing business objectives with legal, financial, operational, and reputational risk considerations. You will provide practical, business focused legal counsel that enables informed decision making while safeguarding the organization's interests.

Additionally, you will play an important role in shaping Lincoln's contracting strategy and governance framework by driving best practices, enhancing contracting processes, improving operational efficiency, and fostering a culture of effective risk management and strong business partnership across the enterprise. Through your leadership, collaboration, and subject matter expertise, you will help advance strategic initiatives and deliver meaningful business impact.

What you'll be doing

  • Provide subject matter expertise on a broad range of commercial transactions, including software-as-a-service agreements, outsourcing agreements, professional services agreements, licensing agreements, supply agreements, equipment leases, and event agreements.
  • Serve as a trusted legal advisor to business leaders and key stakeholders, delivering practical, risk-based guidance aligned with business objectives.
  • Act as a key contributor in cross functional team environments, partnering with business units to identify, assess, and mitigate legal, financial, operational, and reputational risks.
  • Collaborate with peers and leadership across business units and corporate functions to champion contracting excellence, drive change management initiatives, and implement process improvements.
  • Create, refine, and drive adoption of enterprise contracting standards, playbooks, and best practices to improve consistency, efficiency, and risk management outcomes.
  • Develop and define appropriate objectives and performance standards related to quality, compliance, operational effectiveness, and productivity within assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Provide legal counsel and thought leadership to internal stakeholders on complex and highly visible projects and initiatives.
  • Foster an inclusive and collaborative environment by encouraging dialogue, welcoming diverse perspectives, and supporting sound decision making across teams.
  • Continuously monitor emerging legal and industry developments affecting commercial contracting and vendor management, assessing potential impacts and recommending proactive strategies.

What we're looking for

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of legal experience with significant focus on commercial contracts directly aligned with the responsibilities of this role.
  • J.D. from an American Bar Association accredited law school and active membership in at least one state Bar in good standing.
  • Advanced knowledge and expertise across all facets of contract law, including contract formation, negotiation, interpretation, enforcement, and dispute mitigation.
  • Solid command of privacy, information security and artificial intelligence considerations as they relate to contracts.
  • Experience negotiating a wide variety of contracts, including software-as-a-service agreements, outsourcing agreements, licensing agreements, professional services agreements, and supply agreements.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to balance legal risk considerations with organizational goals and operational needs.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal concepts into clear, actionable business guidance.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, lead complex initiatives, and influence decision making at senior levels of the organization.

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through December, 31, 2026, subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

What's it like to work here?

At Lincoln Financial, we love what we do. We make meaningful contributions each and every day to empower our customers to take charge of their lives. Working alongside dedicated and talented colleagues, we build fulfilling careers and stronger communities through a company that values our unique perspectives, insights and contributions and invests in programs that empower each of us to take charge of our own future.

What's in it for you:

  • Clearly defined career tracks and job levels, along with associated behaviors for each of Lincoln's core values and leadership attributes

  • Leadership development and virtual training opportunities

  • PTO/parental leave

  • Competitive 401K and employee benefits

  • Free financial counseling, health coaching and employee assistance program

  • Tuition assistance program

  • Work arrangements that work for you

  • Effective productivity/technology tools and training

The pay range for this position is $171,375 - $274,200 with anticipated pay for new hires between the minimum and midpoint of the range and could vary above and below the listed range as permitted by applicable law. Pay is based on non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to work experience, education, location, licensure requirements, proficiency and qualifications required for the role. The base pay is just one component of Lincoln's total rewards package for employees. In addition, the role may be eligible for the Annual Incentive Program, which is discretionary and based on the performance of the company, business unit and individual. Other rewards may include long-term incentives, sales incentives and Lincoln's standard benefits package.

About The Company

Lincoln Financial (NYSE: LNC) helps people to confidently plan for their version of a successful future. We focus on identifying a clear path to financial security, with products including annuities, life insurance, group protection, and retirement plan services.

With our 120-year track record of expertise and integrity, millions of customers trust our solutions and service to help put their goals in reach.

Lincoln Financial Distributors, a broker-dealer, is the wholesale distribution organization of Lincoln Financial. Lincoln Financial affiliates, their distributors, and their respective employees, representatives and/or insurance agents do not provide tax, accounting or legal advice.

Lincoln is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Follow us on Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. For the latest company news, visit our newsroom.

Be Aware of Fraudulent Recruiting Activities

If you are interested in a career at Lincoln, we encourage you to review our current openings and apply on our website. Lincoln values the privacy and security of every applicant and urges all applicants to diligently protect their sensitive personal information from scams targeting job seekers. These scams can take many forms including fake employment applications, bogus interviews and falsified offer letters.

Lincoln will not ask applicants to provide their social security numbers, date of birth, bank account information or other sensitive information in job applications. Additionally, our recruiters do not communicate with applicants through free e-mail accounts (Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or conduct interviews utilizing video chat rooms. We will never ask applicants to provide payment during the hiring process or extend an offer without conducting a phone, live video or in-person interview. Please contact Lincoln's fraud team at fraudhotline@lfg.com if you encounter a recruiter or see a job opportunity that seems suspicious.

The Role at a Glance

We are excited to bring on a Bilingual Customer Service Representative to support the Retirement Plan Services business. This role is open in the Fort Wayne, IN office with the ability to work remotely following 8 weeks of onsite training.

Background Details
The Retirement team will provide you with several weeks of paid training, coaching and development to perform in this fast-paced environment. Training will be led by one of our dedicated trainers in a classroom setting (onsite), along with a cohort of peers and managers, and will provide you with foundational knowledge to assist you in excelling in a career with Lincoln Financial.

As a Bilingual Customer Service Representative, you will serve as the primary point of contact for individuals who have questions or concerns regarding their retirement plan. You will serve as a subject matter expert and educate them about the retirement plan using excellent customer service and problem-solving skills to create a positive experience. This opportunity will provide insight into the world of retirement plan operations while gaining new skills through a defined career pathing and development program.

What you'll be doing

    • Must adhere to scheduled breaks/lunches as you are required to follow these closely.
    • Will work overtime as needed during peak volumes.

    • Further promotion opportunities exist within the Call Center.

    • Must have full written and verbal proficiency in both English and Spanish

  • Ability to be adaptable/flexible as business needs change.

Must-have capabilities:

  • Post training, working from home (or remotely) requires a designated workspace that is to be kept in a safe, healthy, professional and secure manner.
  • To work from home, you must have internet bandwidth of 12 Mbps (Megabits per second). Preferred bandwidth is 25 Mbps to perform at full capacity.
  • To check internet speed, go to ‘Google' and type in ‘Speed Test' and simply select ‘Run Speed Test'. This will run for roughly 30 seconds. Once complete you will receive a display showing your internet bandwidth.
  • Other work from home requirements:

    • Required to be available and on camera as if I were in a company office (i.e. eliminating distractions, actively working, logged into applicable company systems, and available by telephone/email during all times that I am scheduled to be working).

    • Work from home should not be used for purposes of childcare, other dependent care, or any other unapproved activities during scheduled hours.

Nice-to have Experience (Preferred):

  • Associates degree/post-secondary education
  • 2+ years of previous service industry and/or financial services experience.

  • Proven experience using professional-level written and verbal Spanish and English communication skills to assist customers, build relationships, resolve inquiries, and deliver exceptional service.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to multi-task while maintaining strict attention to details to adhere to policies, procedures and guidelines.
  • Solid relationship management skills customers, management, peers and colleagues.

At Lincoln Financial, we love what we do. We make meaningful contributions each and every day to empower our customers to take charge of their lives. Working alongside dedicated and talented colleagues, we build fulfilling careers and stronger communities through a company that values our unique perspectives, insights and contributions and invests in programs that empower each of us to take charge of our own future.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$117,600.00 - $194,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) provides management and professional liability, cyber, crime insurance, and surety bonds to or on behalf of businesses of all sizes. The BSI Claim Counsel team conducts thorough investigation, analysis, evaluation, and disposition of claims and claim litigation to achieve superior customer service and to optimize claim results. Travelers' Construction Services Team includes legal, accounting, and engineering professionals to handle claims on construction-related and other surety bonds, mitigate exposures on construction surety accounts, and provide a wide range of business support and legal services to advance our mission to serve as trusted advisors to our underwriting partners. As a valued member of our team, in addition to claim, you also will provide legal advice to our underwriting colleagues and non-attorney claim colleagues, and participate in BSI claim strategic initiatives.

What Will You Do?

  • Follow operational policies to analyze, investigate, and resolve BSI claims of varying levels of severity with moderate supervision from claims management.
  • Prepare and present reports for management that accurately reflect loss development, potential/actual financial exposure, reserve adjustments, coverage issues, and claim and recovery strategies.
  • Retain, monitor, and manage outside counsel actively utilizing litigation management plans and budgets.
  • Communicate with underwriting on significant claim exposures.
  • Continue to develop the ability to identify all recovery opportunities and coordinate recovery efforts with the Recovery Management Unit and Claim management.
  • Travel to and attend mediations, settlement conferences, claim conferences, field office visits, trials and depositions.
  • Provide legal review and advice to underwriters on bond obligations and project contract documents. Review, draft and/or modify bond forms, contract documents and other agreements including, indemnity, takeover, completion, subcontractor ratification, financing and collateral.
  • Engage in account workout risk mitigation analysis, advise on mitigation strategies, and assist in execution of such strategies.
  • Monitor account bankruptcy proceedings and document post-bankruptcy indemnity. Draft and file proofs of claim and advise as to potential recovery. Retain outside counsel where appropriate to protect or enforce surety rights.
  • Negotiate the resolution of bonded obligations on defaulted contracts, and terms of agreements including indemnity agreements, letters of credit, set aside letters from lenders, intercreditor agreements and subordination agreements.
  • Determine whether bond exposure has expired, including for the purpose of releasing collateral, by reviewing bond terms, applicable law, and court dockets (when applicable).
  • Monitor marketplace conditions, conduct research, and draft reference materials to inform claim and underwriting colleagues on law impacting Travelers' underwriting and claim decisions.
  • Review documents pertaining to mergers, equity sales and asset sales to determine the legal status and ownership of indemnitors undergoing a change of control. Draft and negotiate appropriate agreements to document indemnity changes related to such transactions.
  • Support underwriting marketing efforts, including participation in broker and account visits and risk mitigation seminars and authoring customer-focused white papers and articles.
  • Obtain and maintain required adjusters' licenses.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Five or more years of relevant legal or claim handling work experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively work through conflict and resolve issues with a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and negotiate terms and conditions within designated authority limit.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate coverage determinations.
  • Time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities with an attention to detail, data and analytics.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective and collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Juris Doctorate Degree.
  • Properly licensed, registered or authorized, and in good standing, to practice law in the jurisdiction in which you will be working.
  • Two years of relevant legal experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

Job.JobTitle: Regional Risk Engineering Manager - Energy, US & Latin America
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Loss Control Consultant, Risk Management / Loss Control
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Experience: 10+ years

About this job

Regional leadership role managing Risk Engineering across US and Latin America for Liberty Specialty Markets, focused on Energy and Construction. Oversees team strategy implementation, client service delivery, and represents Liberty with brokers, clients, and industry stakeholders.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in energy industries and 10+ years in insurance, with team management experience and ability to work across multiple business functions.

Full job description


Description

Provides regional leadership and management responsibility for Risk Engineering across the US and Latin America, with a primary focus on Energy and Construction occupancies and additional support for assigned lines of business. The role manages team resources and priorities while implementing global strategy, standards, procedures, technical guidance, and efficient workflows in a consistent and practical manner. The job holder serves as a key integration point across Risk Engineering, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, Finance, Product Line Management, and regional and global leadership to support underwriting, pricing, claims, portfolio, referral, and survey strategy decisions. Externally, the role represents Liberty with brokers, clients, broker Risk Engineering leaders, and industry stakeholders by developing bespoke client service plans, articulating Libertys technical value proposition, supporting business development, and strengthening market visibility through client engagement, conferences, technical presentations, industry papers, and thought leadership.

Background

Liberty Specialty Markets (LSM) offers specialty and commercial insurance and reinsurance products across key UK, European, Latin American, US, and other international locations.

At Liberty Specialty Markets we create an environment where careers can flourish a place for people to learn, grow, develop, and celebrate success. We recognize and encourage the values of diversity, inclusion and collaboration, working together to share our unique perspectives, make better decisions, deliver innovative solutions, and pursue our goals.

Job Responsibilities

  • Leads and supports the development and delivery of bespoke client service plans through client engagement, business development, survey strategy, and coordinated service delivery.
  • Represents Liberty Risk Engineering with brokers, clients, and industry stakeholders, articulating Libertys technical value proposition, showcasing risk engineering capabilities, and supporting new and renewal business opportunities.
  • Leads engagement with regional Heads of Broker Risk Engineering to strengthen relationships, cooperation, market visibility, and thought leadership.
  • Represents Liberty at conferences, panel discussions, technical presentations, industry papers, and other market forums to promote Liberty Risk Engineering expertise and value.
  • Maintains current knowledge of assigned business lines, process technology, loss prevention, construction, and market trends, and recommends how external developments should inform services, policies, processes, and client-facing solutions.
  • Provides regional leadership for the US and Latin America Risk Engineering team across assigned lines of business, primarily onshore energy and construction, with additional support for casualty, commercial property, and marine lines.
  • Manages team resources, priorities, technical and operational escalation, budget, headcount planning, hiring priorities, and staffing coordination with regional and global leadership.
  • Contributes to global Risk Engineering strategy, standards, procedures, technical instructions, guidelines, policies, and processes, and leads regional implementation in a consistent and practical manner.
  • Establishes efficient workflows, processes, tools, and advisory services that support business priorities, maintain high technical standards, and align with global and regional expectations.
  • Serves as a key integration point across Risk Engineering, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, Finance, Product Line Management, and regional and global leadership to support underwriting, pricing, claims, portfolio, and referral decisions.
  • Oversees survey and inspection strategy for the regional team, including desk-based risk appraisals, on-site surveys, marketing survey reports, monitoring of risk appraisals, follow-up on key recommendations, and maintenance of current risk engineering information on file.
Qualifications

Preparation, Training and Experience

Bachelor of Science degree in a technical discipline, such as Chemical, Process, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent.

At least 10 years of experience in relevant energy industries, including oil, gas, petrochemical, chemical, power generation, renewables, or heavy industries, with a background in operations, maintenance, process safety, loss prevention, or construction.

At least 10 years of experience within the insurance sector in relevant lines of business.

Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of professionals.

Demonstrated ability to partner across Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, and Finance functions on portfolio-level risk management, including Nat Cat exposure and pricing input.

Strong communication and listening skills to develop and maintain relationships with external stakeholders, including clients and brokers, and internal stakeholders, including underwriters, risk engineers, claims, actuarial, and finance partners.

Demonstrated ability in advanced-level risk evaluation, analysis, and strong marketing skills to participate in new/renewal business development.

Ability to converse in and understand Spanish and/or Portuguese is beneficial, particularly for engagement across Latin America, but is not a mandatory requirement.

Demonstrated ability to effectively use required software applications, such as Microsoft Office Suite; position requires regular travel.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Fair Chance Notices

  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia

Travelers Data Engineering team constructs pipelines that contextualize and provide easy access to data by the entire enterprise. As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in growing and transforming our analytics landscape. In addition to your strong analytical mind, you will bring your inquisitive attitude and ability to translate stories found in data by leveraging a variety of data programming techniques. You will leverage your ability to design, build and deploy data solutions that capture, explore, transform, and utilize data to support Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and business intelligence/insights.

What Will You Do?

  • Build and operationalize complex data solutions, correct problems, apply transformations, and recommending data cleansing/quality solutions.
  • Design complex data solutions
  • Perform analysis of complex sources to determine value and use and recommend data to include in analytical processes.
  • Incorporate core data management competencies including data governance, data security and data quality.
  • Collaborate within and across teams to support delivery and educate end users on complex data products/analytic environment.
  • Perform data and system analysis, assessment and resolution for complex defects and incidents and correct as appropriate.
  • Test data movement, transformation code, and data components.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree in STEM related field or equivalent.
  • Eight years of related experience.
  • Expertise designing and building scalable, self-healing, cloud-native distributed compute data pipelines using AWS native services and/or Databricks as the primary compute and orchestration platform, loading into enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Hands-on experience building analytics pipelines using transformation frameworks such as dbt within framework-based, cloud-native pipeline architectures.
  • Expertise designing and deploying production-grade, multi-agent AI applications using agent orchestration frameworks and runtimes such as AWS AgentCore or Databricks AgentBricks.
  • Experience integrating structured and unstructured data sources through tool-calling patterns, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP), to surface actionable insights at scale.
  • Strong foundational knowledge of large language model APIs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, vector databases, and embedding strategies, with the ability to apply these within multi-agent architectures to enable context-aware, data-grounded AI applications.
  • Highly proficient use of tools, techniques, and manipulation including Cloud platforms, programming languages, and a full understanding of modern software engineering practices.
  • The ability to deliver work at a steady, predictable pace to achieve commitments, deliver complete solutions but release them in small batches, and identify and negotiate important tradeoffs.
  • Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including understanding technical concepts necessary and industry trends, and possess in-depth knowledge of immediate systems worked on and some knowledge of adjacent systems.
  • Strong problem solver who ensures systems are built with longevity and creates innovate ways to resolve issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work collaborate well with team members and business partners.
  • Ability to lead team members and help create a safe environment for others to learn and grow as engineers. and a proven track record of self-motivation in identifying opportunities and tracking team efforts.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 4 additional years of data engineering experience.

If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. $94,400.00 - $155,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers Insurance is seeking a highly motivated and knowledgeable Associate Claim Counsel to join our Bond & Specialty Insurance team. Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) provides management and professional liability, cyber, crime insurance, and surety bonds to or on behalf of businesses and/or nonprofits of all sizes. The BSI Claim Counsel team conducts thorough investigation, analysis, evaluation, and disposition of claims and claim litigation to achieve superior customer service and to optimize claim results. Travelers' Private/Non-Profit Team provides executive and organizational management liability coverage to privately held companies and non-profit entities of all types and sizes as well as certain governmental public entities. As an Associate Claim Counsel, you will effectively manage all assigned BSI claims, typically of lower severity and complexity within our organization, and with close supervision from management. You will manage outside counsel relationships, negotiate settlements, and ensure stakeholders are supported throughout the claims process. In addition to comprehensive claim and risk management, you also will provide legal advice and/or insight to our underwriting colleagues and non-attorney claim colleagues and participate in BSI claim strategic initiatives.
This particular position will afford the successful candidate an exciting opportunity to shape a unique position within BSI Claim, focused on Employment Practices Liability matters. This position will have a national footprint and will handle a wide variety of claims from throughout the field regions. This Associate Claim Counsel will handle new claims, but may also manage existing claims due to the absence or departure of a claim professional.
Travelers offers a hybrid work location model that is designed to support flexibility.
This job does not manage others.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that this posting will remain open until November 23, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Analyze, investigate, and resolve Bond & Specialty Claims of lower severity and complexity with close supervision, following operational policies.
  • With close management supervision, retain, monitor, and manage outside counsel (and other vendors, as applicable) by actively utilizing incident response and/or litigation management plans and budgets, and negotiate settlements when appropriate to ensure effective legal and/or claim outcomes, involving litigation matters of lower severity and complexity.
  • Prepare management reports on loss development, financial exposure, and resolution strategies with a high degree of guidance from management.
  • Develop and coordinate recovery efforts with the Recovery Management Unit to optimize loss mitigation opportunities, as needed.
  • Attend mediations, settlement conferences, trials, depositions to support claim resolution, and may attend other internal/external business meetings with supervision as needed.
  • With significant supervision, provide a variety of legal and business support to underwriting colleagues which varies by business unit and may include negotiating indemnity documentation, drafting product forms and endorsements, reviewing contracts and bond forms, all involving matters of lower complexity, and supporting marketing and/or risk management efforts through broker visits and seminars.
  • Ensure stakeholders/customers feel 'secure, respected, and cared for' throughout the duration of the claims process.
  • Ensure compliance with BSI Claims processes, procedures, and best practices.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of claim activities, decisions, and communications, adhering to record-keeping standards and confidentiality protocols.
  • To perform the essential functions of this job, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance Adjuster License(s) is required to comply with state and Travelers' requirements. Generally, license(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the job and must obtain ongoing continuing education credits as mandated. Additionally, the maintenance of an active legal license in the state of your principal office location and remaining current with all Continuing Legal Education (CLE) is required to perform this role.
  • Management Liability
  • Prepare timely and thorough coverage evaluations and correspondence to Insureds.
  • Maintain and note claim files pursuant to company best practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • One to five years of relevant legal or claim handling work experience.
  • Ability to effectively work through conflict and resolve issues with a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and negotiate terms and conditions within designated authority limit.
  • Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate coverage determinations.
  • Solid time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities with an attention to detail, data and analytics.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective and collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Juris Doctor Degree.
  • Properly licensed, registered or authorized, and in good standing, to practice law in the jurisdiction in which you will be working.
  • Valid driver's license or access to alternative means of transportation to travel to mediations, conferences, field offices, trials, and/or depositions.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking a Technical Agile Product Owner to join the Access, Identity, Profile & Preferences (AIPP) team within the Cybersecurity Value Stream. This team owns the external identity experience for Travelers' customers and agents - spanning registration, identity proofing, authentication, MFA, and profile and preferences management across Travelers' digital platforms.

In this role, you will serve as the voice of the end-user and key technical stakeholders, guiding a focused product team to deliver secure, modern, and user-friendly identity capabilities. You will focus on achieving defined outcomes while empowering the team to determine how the work gets done. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, this this role.

What Will You Do?

  • Partner with Circle Leads, platform engineers, and cybersecurity stakeholders to elicit, refine, and prioritize requirements for external identity capabilities - spanning customer and agent registration flows, identity proofing integrations, authentication protocols, MFA enrollment and recovery, and profile/preferences APIs.
  • Decompose business and security requirements into well-defined user stories, epics, and technical acceptance criteria; ensure engineering teams understand functional intent, security constraints, and how each capability integrates within the broader AIPP identity architecture and Okta tenant configuration.
  • Serve as the technical interface between business partners, cybersecurity, and engineering - translating identity platform decisions, API design trade-offs, and security control choices into clear, audience-appropriate communications for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Own and maintain a prioritized, groomed backlog with sufficient technical depth for continuous delivery; define and enforce acceptance criteria covering security posture, usability standards, regulatory compliance, and integration correctness across identity flows.
  • Develop and manage delivery roadmaps across the external identity ecosystem - including Okta-based authentication and SSO flows, adaptive MFA policies, FIDO2/WebAuthn adoption, identity proofing service integrations, and customer/agent profile service APIs.
  • Align team objectives to the Cybersecurity Value Stream vision; translate program-level goals into sprint-level priorities and communicate delivery progress, technical risk, and architectural trade-offs to Circle Leads and key stakeholders.
  • Define and track platform KPIs and OKRs for external identity capabilities - including registration funnel completion rates, MFA enrollment and adoption rates, authentication success/failure ratios, identity proofing pass rates, and API error rates - using data to drive backlog prioritization.
  • Lead and support business readiness activities for AIPP platform releases - including stakeholder communications, change impact assessments, runbooks, cutover planning, and post-launch monitoring criteria.
  • Provide continuous in-sprint feedback on work-in-progress; clarify ambiguous requirements, validate technical designs against security and compliance standards, and proactively surface risks tied to external identity dependencies, third-party integrations (e.g., Okta, identity proofing vendors), and platform SLA constraints.
  • Establish and evangelize consistent delivery patterns, API standards, and ways of working across AIPP teams within the Cybersecurity Value Stream to ensure scalability and reduce integration debt.
  • Foster a technically grounded, inclusive, and collaborative team culture that promotes engineering ownership, security-first thinking, and continuous improvement across identity platform delivery.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Product management experience specifically within the Identity and Access Management (IAM) space - including hands-on ownership of identity platforms, authentication flows, MFA, SSO, or customer registration capabilities. This is a key requirement for this role.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Two or more years of experience in Agile product management, preferably in a technical, platform, or cybersecurity-adjacent domain.
  • Understanding of external identity concepts including customer and agent registration, identity proofing, authentication protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML), MFA patterns, and user profile and preferences management.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust security principles as they apply to external identity and access control.
  • Exposure to or experience with Okta or similar identity platform tooling.
  • Ability to understand and engage with AIPP architecture - including how authentication, session management, and profile services connect - without needing to write the code.
  • Agile Mindset: Embody Agile core values of openness, courage, respect, focus, and commitment; apply Agile principles and practices to achieve team success.
  • Product Mindset: Define a clear product value proposition aligned with the Cybersecurity Value Stream's objectives, serving as the north star for the team.
  • Technical Fluency: Ability to engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, API integrations, and security controls, and to ask the right questions to surface risk and drive good decisions.
  • Influence: Ability to drive alignment across engineering, security, and business stakeholders without relying on traditional hierarchy.
  • Communication: Skill in translating technical complexity into clear, audience-appropriate language for both leadership and delivery teams.
  • Continuous Improvement: Demonstrated commitment to learning, sharing knowledge, and evolving team practices over time.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of work experience in related field.

If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

Senior Product Owner for Guidewire ClaimCenter at an insurance carrier with 50+ years in business. Bridges business stakeholders and development teams to drive product vision, roadmap strategy, and delivery of claims solutions.

Full job description

Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The Senior Product Owner plays a pivotal role in driving the successful development and delivery of innovative products that meet the needs of our customers and aligns with the company's strategic goals. This role acts as the bridge between business stakeholders, development teams and end-users, ensuring clear communication and effective prioritization of features and enhancements throughout the product lifecycle.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Defines and communicates product vision, overall strategy and growth opportunities to business and IT stakeholders, with minimal guidance from leadership and other Product team members.

  • Drives the continuous refinement of the product vision, roadmap, and strategy to drive optimum business value.

  • Works closely with business stakeholders across the organization to convert product ideas into a prioritized backlog according to business value or return on investment (ROI).

  • Participates in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, iteration reviews, and retrospectives to ensure continuous improvement and iterative development.

  • Facilitates Product Grooming Backlog sessions to align priority & strategy for better cross functional collaboration.

  • Remains accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product, evaluating progress and performance at each iteration and deciding whether the team can move on to the next steps.

  • Works closely with Technical Product Managers and Scrum master to ensure the successful execution of the product roadmap.

  • Anticipates product's future needs by maintaining user personas and journey maps.

  • Creates annual and quarterly plans to align product groups to roadmap deliverables.

  • Independently manages and proactively identifies direction updates related to product areas.

  • Owns and drives user-centric product outcomes collaboratively with business and IT leadership.

  • Researches and analyzes market trends and user needs to develop and shape the roadmap for the product.

  • Collaborates with other Product Owners, Product Managers and shares best practices across teams to ensure alignment and consistency in ways of working within a value stream.

Domain Expertise Required

  • 3+ Guidewire ClaimCenter implementations — techno-functional ownership across FNOL, claim handling, exposures, reserves, financials, payments, recoveries, and reporting.

  • Deep understanding of P&C claims operations — adjudication, authority structures, coverage interpretation, compliance, and claims lifecycle.

  • Experience with ClaimCenter data model, workflows, business rules, integrations, and configuration concepts.

  • Experience with integrations across policy administration, billing, document management, payment vendors, and regulatory agencies.

  • Data migration, conversion, validation, and reconciliation experience on GW platforms.

  • Guidewire ACE Certified Business Analyst (ClaimCenter — Palisades or newer).

  • Experience with Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP) and SaaS delivery models.

  • Experience implementing Commercial Lines, Workers' Compensation, or Specialty claims solutions.

  • Experience in other Guidewire Products such as ContactManager and Cloud Data Access/Platform, along with integrating these with Guidewire ClaimCenter. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has no supervisory responsibility.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university is required with a major or emphasis in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

  • Minimum of 10 years' related experience inclusive of leading technical teams, collecting business needs, and translating requirements to a technical audience.

  • Experience in the insurance industry highly desired.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role, with a track record of successfully launching and managing products or platforms.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Certified Product Owner (CPO) required, SAFe preferred.

Guidewire ACE Certified Business Analyst (ClaimCenter — Palisades or newer).

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Knowledge of Agile processes and principles. Understanding of the Insurance industry. Ability to map value stream across business lines. Possess technical expertise and understanding of product development practices. Ability to balance technical constraints and a differentiated product that meets the needs of the marketplace. Knowledge of mobile and web platform design conventions and technology limitations and opportunities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, experience working with cross-functional teams, and presenting to leadership. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Visio, Excel, Project, and PowerPoint. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Advanced analytical, qualitative, quantitative, and problem-solving skills. Ability to apply critical thinking and analytical skills to recommend creative solutions to business and technical challenges. Strong attention to detail. Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Senior Production Specialist to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Lexington Underwriting

The Workers' Compensation Product Manager is a pivotal role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency, and effectiveness of our Enterprise Claims workers' compensation product. This role requires a deep understanding of product knowledge, operational processes, workers' compensation regulations, and the ability to provide business requirements to development. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to enhance our product offerings, streamline workflows, and drive product development.

This is a remote-first role with requirements for occasional travel and on-site office attendance as business needs dictate.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct comprehensive analyses of product, including feature performance, utilization trends, and user feedback; identify areas for improvement and recommend actionable solutions to enhance product functionality and user experience
  • Data Analysis: Utilize techniques to extract meaningful insights and identify patterns to inform product development and optimization efforts
  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay abreast of evolving workers' compensation regulations, regulatory compliance rules and regulations, and industry standards impacting workers' compensation claim management practices
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with product management, software development, quality assurance, and customer support teams to obtain requirements, prioritize enhancements, and facilitate the successful implementation of product improvements; act as a subject matter expert and provide guidance on technical and functional aspects of the Enterprise Claim workers' compensation product
  • Quality Assurance: Participate in quality assurance activities to validate product enhancements, ensure accuracy and consistency in claim management, and verify compliance with predefined specifications and requirements; conduct thorough testing and troubleshooting to identify and resolve any issues or discrepancies
  • Documentation and Training: Assist the documentation and training team to develop comprehensive documentation, training materials, and user guides to support internal teams and external stakeholders in understanding and effectively utilizing the workers' compensation claim product; provide training sessions and demonstrations as needed to ensure proper product adoption and utilization
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and efficiency gains within the claim management product lifecycle; drive initiatives to streamline workflows, reduce manual interventions, and improve overall product performance

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Strong understanding of claim management processes, reporting, and regulatory compliance
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets, identify trends, and draw actionable insights
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies, agile principles, and experience working in cross-functional teams
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills as well as verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across diverse teams
  • Experience with creating and leading presentations and/or conducting training with various levels of users
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy, thoroughness, and continuous improvement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
  • Aptitude for learning systems and technical processes
  • Adept at thriving in a fast-paced environment with firm deadlines with demonstrated ability to manage details and timelines for multiple simultaneous complex projects
  • Demonstrated ability to provide product requirements and drive innovation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field
  • Advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., SCLA, ARM) preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare industry roles with a focus on Workers Compensation claim management
  • Proven leadership experience, especially in matrix or cross-functional settings, is highly desirable
