The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. Health Risk Strategist (RN) | Stop Loss | Population Health | Case Management | Remote/Hybrid

Responsibilities

The Health Risk Strategist (HRS) reports to the AVP, Clinical Health Risk Management and serves as a strategic resource supporting Berkley's Health Risk Management initiatives. The HRS partners with clients and internal stakeholders to identify health risks, evaluate cost containment opportunities, and implement population health and clinical management strategies that improve outcomes and optimize healthcare spend.

A key responsibility of this role is to work collaboratively with the Clinical Consultant, Cost Containment RNs to ensure identified risks lead to clinical interventions, referral activity, member engagement, and measurable outcomes. By strengthening the connection between risk identification, clinical solutions, and member engagement, the HRS helps clients better understand the value of health risk management programs while improving overall program effectiveness.

The HRS also supports innovation through the evaluation and adoption of technology-enabled solutions, including AI and analytical tools, such as Copilot, to improve efficiency, standardize analyses, enhance reporting capabilities, and reduce manual preparation efforts.

This position can either be fully remote (if not within commutable distance to the office) or based in one of our offices:

  • Hamilton Square, NJ
  • Marlborough, MA

Our offices offer a hybrid work schedule with 4 days in the office; and 1 day remote where it makes sense to do so.

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
  • Internal mobility opportunities
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
  • Opportunity to impact change
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

We'll count on you to:

  • Conduct health risk assessments, population health reviews, and claims analysis.

  • Identify emerging trends, high-cost claim drivers, and intervention opportunities.

  • Analyze clinical, claims, pharmacy, and utilization data to develop actionable recommendations that improve health outcomes and reduce healthcare costs.

  • Partner with Clinical Consultant, Cost Containment RNs to connect identified risks to interventions and referrals.

  • Participate in reviews of complex and high-cost claims to identify opportunities for care management, cost containment, and vendor engagement.

  • Monitor referral activity, engagement, outcomes, and program effectiveness.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, captive programs, brokers, TPAs, vendors, and internal business partners regarding population health, clinical risk management, and cost containment opportunities.

  • Present recommendations, program results, and health risk insights to internal and external stakeholders in a clear and meaningful manner.

  • Foster strong relationships that promote collaboration, improve engagement, and support successful implementation of health risk management programs.

  • Measure and report program performance and outcomes.

  • Evaluate and pilot innovative technologies including Copilot.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for workflow automation, process improvement, and enhanced data analysis.

  • Support organizational innovation initiatives and contribute to the development of scalable, technology-driven health risk management practices.

  • Support client implementations, strategic initiatives, and special projects.

Qualifications

What you need to have:

  • Degree in Nursing with active, unrestricted nursing license in state of residence.
  • Experience in Stop Loss, Managed Care, Population Health, Case Management, and healthcare cost containment.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience collaborating across clinical, claims, and client-facing teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and analytics tools.
  • Knowledge and experience using AMS Suite of products including Profiler preferred but not required.
  • Ability to travel 10-20%.

Investigate and manage workers' compensation claims for an online insurance provider, including verifying coverage, calculating reserves, coordinating medical treatment, and negotiating settlements. Requires 3-5 years of claims experience and a bachelor's degree or equivalent.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of workers' compensation claims experience and strong communication and organizational skills.

BerkleyNet is an innovative workers compensation insurance provider that does all of our business online. Our Goal? To make doing business “Ridiculously Fast. Amazingly Easy.”

Responsibilities

  • Investigate workers' compensation claims by interviewing injured workers, witnesses, and policyholders to verify coverage and determine compensability and benefits due

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in the Troy, AL area that is able to service the Dothan, AL area and the Montgomery, AL area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

This is a part-time role, working 30 hours per week.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluates patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney's visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker's injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

      KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

      • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
      • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
      • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
      • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
      • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
      • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

      EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

      • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
      • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
      • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
      • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
      • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

        PAY RANGE:

        CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

        For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

        Pay Range: $63,739 - $95,264

        A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

        In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

        ABOUT CORVEL – Medical Case Managers:

        CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers' compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

        A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off. In addition, Medical Case Managers are eligible for bonus and will be provided state-of-the-art technological devices to ensure ready access to CorVel's proprietary Case Management application, enabling staff to retrieve documents on the go and log activities as they occur.

        CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you

  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

Job.JobTitle: Field Auto Claims Adjuster - Seattle, WA - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

Put your analytical skills and claims expertise to work as an Auto Field Adjuster with National General, an Allstate Company. In this role, youll evaluate first- and third-party material damage claims, develop comprehensive damage estimates, and guide claims toward appropriate resolution. Youll apply your knowledge of regulatory requirements, fair claims practices, policy coverage, and estimating fundamentals while building trusted relationships with internal and external customers. From negotiating settlements to documenting claim activity and making payments within your authority, youll take meaningful ownership of the claims process and help deliver thoughtful, well-supported outcomes.

National General is seeking an Auto Claims Estimator to join our Claims team.


Where Youll Work: This is a field-based position supporting customers throughout Seattle, Bellevue, and surrounding areas in Washington. Candidates must live within reasonable proximity to the assigned territory and be comfortable with regular local travel to support customers and complete in-person claim inspections.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Strong experience handling 1st- and 3rd-party auto material damage/collision claims of varying severity.
  • Advanced experience conducting field vehicle inspections and preparing comprehensive damage estimates and supplements.
  • Proficiency with CCC ONE or similar auto estimating software.
  • Strong knowledge of collision repair procedures, parts, labor operations, total losses, and estimating fundamentals.
  • Proven ability to negotiate repair costs and settlements with repair facilities while maintaining accurate claim documentation.
  • Knowledge of auto policy coverage, regulatory compliance, and fair claims practices.
  • Ability to effectively manage a blend of field and virtual claims while delivering a strong customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on 1st and 3rd party material damage losses of all severities


Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.


As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Product Security Engineering designs, builds, and operates enterprise security controls as software products that integrate directly into cloud platforms, the software development lifecycle, and core enterprise services. The organization applies modern software and cloud engineering practices to deliver scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly security capabilities that enable secure-by-default behaviors across the enterprise.

The Managing Engineer, Data Security Engineering leads a team responsible for designing, building, and operating capabilities across DLP Policy, Data Intelligence, and Data Access. This role combines people leadership, technical direction, and delivery ownership, ensuring the team delivers automated, scalable, and measurable solutions that protect sensitive data while enabling appropriate business use.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing team accountable for engineering data security products and controls.

  • Set technical direction and drive execution across architecture, design, implementation, deployment, and production support.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through code and, solution design, key technical decisions, and critical implementation work.

  • Guide the engineering of capabilities across DLP Policy, Data Intelligence, or Data Access, including policy automation, data discovery and classification, and access controls.

  • Develop and advance policy-as-code workflows, reusable control patterns, detection logic, platform integrations, and automated testing and deployment.

  • Automate control lifecycle activities, including validation, configuration drift detection, reporting, alert enrichment, and operational health checks.

  • Own the reliability, effectiveness, adoption, and continuous improvement of the teams products and controls.

  • Translate complex data security requirements into scalable technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

Essential Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software, data, or security engineering experience, including ownership of production systems and technical products.

  • 2+ years of experience leading engineers while remaining actively engaged in technical design, code reviews, and complex engineering work.

  • Deep technical knowledge of data protection, including DLP, data discovery and classification, information protection, data access controls, and data governance.

  • Comprehensive understanding of cloud, SaaS, CASB, and enterprise data protection architectures.

  • Strong scripting and automation proficiency using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Terraform, YAML, JSON, or comparable technologies.

  • Proven ability to build version-controlled security solutions using policy as code, automated delivery pipelines, APIs, and reusable components.

  • Demonstrated success transforming manual, console-based administration into scalable, automated operating models.

Desirable Skills

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Purview and other enterprise platforms supporting DLP, data discovery and classification, information protection, or data access governance.

  • Knowledge of integrating data security capabilities with identity, cloud, SIEM, SOAR, workflow, and enterprise data platforms through APIs and event-driven architectures.

  • Proven ability to influence technical decisions and drive adoption of secure patterns and engineering standards across product areas.

  • Demonstrated success mentoring senior engineers and developing emerging technical leaders.

  • Understanding of security and operational measures, such as control adoption, detection quality, reliability, and risk reduction, used to evaluate engineering outcomes and guide priorities.


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This role has supervisory responsibilities and serves as thefirst levelmanager for a team of engineers.

Responsible for creating or auditing a comprehensive estimate of damages for 1st and 3rd party material damage claims in either the auto or specialty lines leading to the proper disposition. National General is seeking a Field Auto Appraiser to join our Claims team.   • Strong understanding of auto repair processes, vehicle construction, and damage evaluation.

  • Ability to effectively negotiate with repair facilities, vendors, and customers.

  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and travel within the assigned territory.

Key Responsibilities

Possesses strong estimating fundamentals in order to create or audit estimates of damages on 1st and 3rd party material damage losses of all severities

Possesses a deep understanding of the content of all policy types written by the company

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files across multiple lines

Evaluates settlement alternatives by reviewing regulatory compliance and fair claims practices; makes decisions on best option

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers across multiple lines

About this job

Senior Business Developer for workers' comp insurance company serving independent agents across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic. Role involves developing strategic marketing plans, identifying new business opportunities, and maintaining agency relationships, with remote work in Missouri and frequent travel to visit agents.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in business development or marketing, hold or are pursuing insurance certifications, and can travel 60-80% of the time.

Full job description

Summit provides independent insurance agents and their clients with market-leading workers' comp insurance and elite customer service. We're growing and currently serve more than 7,000 independent agents and 31,000 policyholders across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic.

Our strength comes from a single-minded focus on workers' comp and a commitment to long-term customer relationships. Summit is who you turn to when you need a specialist who not only knows workers' comp but also gets to know your business and your priorities.

Our field team members are located in every state in which we operate.

Summit is a member of the Great American Insurance Group where our highest goal is for all employees to feel included, respected, and empowered to perform at their best.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Summit's superregional growth continues. We currently serve 17 states. And in 2026, our expansion will include Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, and Washington D.C., with Missouri and additional states to follow.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

  • The person in this role will work remotely in Missouri.
  • Develops strategic marketing plans, considering agency strengths, competitors, and market conditions.
  • Identifies and secures profitable new business opportunities in target markets and develops and implements strategic plans, resulting in a specified increase in market share.
  • Cultivates and maintains strong relationships with key agencies by providing tailored insurance solutions that meet their specific needs, leading to an increase in agency retention and satisfaction. Educates agencies on product features, market placement, and effective selling techniques.
  • Drives revenue growth by achieving or exceeding sales targets. May develop and execute cross-selling and up-selling strategies
  • Conducts market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats, informing strategic decision-making.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

#LI-Remote

Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

Experience: Generally, a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic business development, marketing, or a related role. Completion of or continuing progress toward certifications including Associate in Underwriting (AU), Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU), Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC), Program in General Insurance (INS) or Associate of Risk Management (ARM).

Scope of Job/Qualifications: Strong understanding of agency dynamics, marketing, underwriting, and risk management. Demonstrates excellent communication skills and ability to build relationships. Proficiency in interpreting competitive data and industry trends. Ensures compliance with insurance laws and regulations, applying underwriting rules, guidelines, and rating manual standards. Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform decisions. Demonstrated decision-making ability and customer-centric mindset. Position requires frequent day and overnight travel (60% - 80% of time) to visit agents and brokers.

SCI Summit Consulting, LLC

$80,000.00 -$155,000.00

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role has IN OFFICE requirements. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

Part-time sales internship at Comparion Insurance Agency for students graduating December 2027 through Summer 2028. You will develop sales skills through cold calling, sales events, CRM tools, and sourcing strategies across multiple office locations.

Full job description


Description

In-Person Part-Time Academic Year Sales Internship

Were you born to close deals? Do you love networking and connecting with people? Do you possess an unwavering drive to succeed? Are you a student graduating between December 2027 - Summer 2028?


If you checked any or all of these boxes, its time to put your people skills to work at Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company as a Sales intern.

Office Location: Openings across the following Comparion office locations:

  • Glastonbury, CT
  • Trumbull, CT
  • Middlebury, CT
  • Reno, NV
  • Elko, NV
  • Chandler, AZ
  • Gilbert, AZ
  • Cottonwood Heights, UT

Details

This internship is more than just about learning the ropes. The Sales Internship at Comparion Insurance Agency involves immersing yourself in a fast-paced and supportive environment where youre encouraged to sharpen your selling skills.


As a Sales Intern, you will join a network of over 400 Liberty Mutual interns and participate in educational and social programs that contribute to your professional development. We offer a robust intern onboarding program that brings summer interns together to build connections in their first week!


Youll grow sales through cold calling, observe and assist with sales events, develop sourcing strategies, and utilize CRM tools and systems to support marketing campaigns. You may even be asked to implement a social media strategy for sales reps.


Best of all, at the close of the internship, you may have the opportunity to explore a future career in sales at Comparion Insurance Agency.

Qualifications

What youve got

  • You're an undergraduate or associate degree student in your junior or senior year, currently pursuing a degree. Candidates majoring in Sales are preferred.
  • You hold a competitive cumulative GPA. Additional requirements might apply.
  • Youre organized, know how to manage your time, and know how to get results.
  • You know how to build rapport with prospective and existing customers.
  • You possess excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • You have prior experience in sales or client service environment.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Nurse Case Manager, Medical & Managed Care (Workers Comp)
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Oswego, OR
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years

About this job

Registered nurse managing medical and disability insurance claims for injured employees. Role involves clinical case management, coordinating care with medical professionals and employers, and facilitating return-to-work outcomes.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of clinical nursing experience, an active RN license, and strong communication and negotiation skills.

Full job description


Description

If you're a registered nurse looking for a new opportunity to work in a fast-paced, professional environment where your talent contributes to our competitive edge, Liberty Mutual Insurance has the opportunity for you. Under general technical direction, responsible for medically managing assigned caseload and by applying clinical expertise ensure individuals receive appropriate healthcare in order to return to work and normal activity in a timely and cost-effective manner. Caseload may include catastrophic/complex medical/disability cases, lost time, and/or medical only claims. Also act as a clinical resource for field claim partners.

Candidates must have a stable and reliable high-speed internet connection capable of supporting business applications, virtual meetings, and voice communications with minimal disruptions. A satellite connection is not supported.

Candidates who reside within 50 miles of the Lake Oswego, OR, Las Vegas, Nevada or Chandler, AZ office locations will be expected to commute to the office in accordance with Liberty Mutual's hybrid work guidelines and business needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Follows Liberty Mutual's established standards and protocols to effectively manage assigned caseload of medical/disability cases and by applying clinical expertise assist to achieve optimal outcome and to facilitate claim resolution and disposition.
  • Effectively communicates with injured employees, medical professionals, field claims staff, attorneys, and others to obtain information, and to negotiate medical treatment and return to work plans using critical thinking skills, clinical expertise and other resources as needed to achieve an optimal case outcome.
  • Utilizes the Nursing Process (assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention and evaluation) to facilitate medical management to attain maximum medical improvement and return-to-work (RTW) per state jurisdictional requirements.
  • Appropriately utilizes internal and external resources and referrals i.e., Utilization Review, Peer Review, Field Claims Specialists, Regional Medical Director Consults, and Vocational Rehabilitation to achieve best possible case outcome.
  • Follows general technical direction from nurse manager, senior medical and disability case manager and/or CCMU staff to resolve highly complex medical and/or RTW issues and/or successfully manage catastrophic injuries.
  • Documents all RN activities accurately, concisely and on a timely basis. This includes documenting the medical and disability case management strategies for claim resolution, based on clinical expertise. Adheres to confidentiality policy.
  • Appropriately applies clinical expertise to claims and delivers services in an efficient and effective manner.

About this job

Technical Consultant providing loss prevention consulting services to small commercial customers in Los Angeles. Conducts on-site evaluations, develops service plans, and mentors less experienced consultants in a specialized technical area.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree, at least 5 years of loss prevention consulting experience, and can travel regularly.

Full job description


Description

Provides moderately complex consultative services to an assigned group of customers within a loss prevention specialty area or territory. Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer source of risk, losses and costs. Provides risk assessment services and information to track progress and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Serves as a trainer/mentor to less experienced consultants in their specialty area at the discretion of their manager. Enhances the Company`s leadership position in the safety field through developing key relationships.

  • Provides an array of expert consultative services to an assigned group of customers within a specialized technical area or territory. Experience in Farm & Ranch is preferred.
  • Conducts on-site evaluations, evaluates data, and creates/implements service plans to control customer's source of risk, loss and/or costs.
  • Provides expert technical support to other loss prevention employees by advising them about resources available, legislation and applicable regulations, technology, industry trends and effective methods to reduce risk, improve customer satisfaction and demonstrate the value of doing business with Liberty Mutual. Monitors and evaluates the technical quality of loss prevention services provided by less experienced consultants.
  • At the discretion of their manager, provides coaching, mentoring and training to enhance their development and effectiveness.
  • Collaborates with management in developing policies, procedures, service tools, technical resources, techniques and new products in order to support and enhance the delivery of loss prevention consulting services.
  • Participates in actively acquiring and retaining profitable business.
  • Identifies new business opportunities for LP services and may design and execute programs that improve results and increase the number and quality of services customers choose to buy.
  • Enhances Liberty Mutual` s leadership position in the safety field and increases brand awareness by developing a network of contacts.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors degree with coursework in math, engineering or related areas (or equivalent) and at least 5 years of directly related consulting experience in loss prevention or progressive safety/heath field.
  • Candidates are typically working towards (or obtained) an advanced degree and/or professional certification in one or more of the following areas: CSP, ARM, CRM, CPCU, CIH, or CPE.
  • Advanced knowledge, skills and experience in a specialized field, service planning and delivery, risk assessment, risk analysis, solutions management and progress measurement.
  • Fully effective interpersonal, writing and other communication skills required to develop and maintain relationships with customers, peers, and industry contacts.
  • Demonstrated ability to retrieve and enter information using various proprietary software applications and create/modify documents and complex spreadsheets using Microsoft Office suite.
  • Position requires regular travel.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriting Manager, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions
Job.JobDescription:
Description

With ride-hailing, on-demand delivery, and autonomous vehicles, options for transporting people and goods have never been so plentiful or presented so many emerging risks. Drawing on Libertys vast commercial and personal lines expertise, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions (LMMS) represents an underwriting model that brings a full range of tailored solutions and nuanced pricing approaches to the sharing economy and new mobility marketplace. This dedicated practice combines creative commercial underwriting with actuarial, product development, client, and claims teams to deliver a robust insurance experience. Join our expanding underwriting team to foster change and innovation and partner with brokers and sharing economy and new mobility businesses to help this segment grow and thrive.

As an LMMS Underwriting Manager, you will manage a team of underwriting professionals responsible for renewing and pursuing opportunities to achieve a balanced, profitable, and quality book while protecting company assets. In some cases, the accounts worked may be among the largest risk transfer opportunities or renewals in the company, with complex risk sharing structures and evolving coverage language.Responsibilities include risk assessment, coverage and pricing analysis, broker/partner communication and management, and industry thought leadership. This role requires strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills in order to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will develop and maintain effective business relationships with internal and external partners. You will apply an advanced level of expertise and judgment to evaluate scenarios, data, and recommendations prepared by underwriters, actuaries, and or cross-functional partners and provide guidance for risk selection and acceptance, coverage, and price for casualty business in select sharing economy and new mobility sectors.

Responsibilities:

  • Leadership: Responsible for the retention, acquisition, and development of senior level underwriting talent. Formally manage, guide, mentor, and coach underwriters in both technical and professional skills. Foster an environment conducive to innovation, continuous improvement and product development.
  • Risk Selection: Responsible for developing and implementing a strategy to better evaluate risk quality and further underwriters skillset in qualifying, selecting and assessing sharing economy and new mobility risks. In addition to managing staff, may also be responsible for underwriting complex accounts.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Establish and maintain high level of relationship management with key Agents and Brokers. Develop underwriters technical, negotiation, communication and general deal making skills.
  • Portfolio Management: Evaluate portfolio performance based on profitability metrics, evolving risk scenarios, outcome and volatility ranges, reinsurance, opportunity metrics, and industry trends. Define UW team execution strategy and oversee execution of continuously improving portfolio in alignment with team objectives. Be the lead custodial of capital for your team.
  • Quality Audit and Account Review: Collaborates with the LMMS SUO and the OOU to ensure files meet regulatory requirements and internal documentation standards. Coach underwriters to articulate thought process, decision making within both account reviews and file documentation.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 10 years progressive underwriting experience expected, including a minimum of 2 years of proven underwriting management experience, preferred
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate high impact underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required
  • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role.   • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills

Description

The North America (NA) Chief Reserving Actuary will lead the North America Reserving function. Position involves being responsible for the team performing thorough reserve analysis, maintaining reasonable and adequate reserves for this $20 Billion reserve base, clearly and transparently communicating results of reserve studies to key stakeholders, identifying elements of the reserve analysis that is particularly relevant to future business decisions by the NA business unit, effectively managing and leading a large team, and building strong relationships with business leaders and other key leaders throughout the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Provide an independent assessment of the NA reserves and associated reserve risks, ensuring the adequacy and accuracy of the NA reserves.
  • Ensure use of accurate, sound, and innovative approaches in projecting and setting reserving guidelines that are consistent with those of Global Risk Solutions (GRS).
  • Communicate the quarterly reserve analyses to the NA leadership.

  • Provide proactive insights that are sought out by the business leaders.
  • Identify key trends, areas of uncertainty to monitor, and macroeconomic factors that are impacting the business.
  • Work in close collaboration with underwriting, pricing, claims and finance to develop a common view of the business.
  • Work in partnership with the various stakeholders to identify emerging trends that could impact results and propose corrective action in a timely manner.
  • Apply innovative approaches and leading-edge tools to analyze the business.
  • Ensure the quality of the data and its consistent application in the reserving process.
  • Foster a culture of technical rigor, transparency, and consistency.
  • Execute a governance framework that ensures that reserving guidelines are consistently applied and all processes comply with internal operational control requirements and all external regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the broader actuarial organization and other strategic business units to share knowledge and advance the business.
  • Seek opportunities to continuously improve and streamline processes.
  • Keep abreast of new reserving methodologies, trends and product/ tort reforms and other external issues.

Underwriter – Builder's Risk

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

AXIS' U.S. Construction team is seeking an underwriter with a focus on Builder's Risk (Project and Master). This role will support the growth and profitability of our Builder's Risk portfolio by underwriting new and renewal business, building broker and customer relationships, and developing technical expertise and supporting business development within the Construction team. This position can be based out of any of our Midwest or West Coast offices.

What will you do in this role?

  • Continue developing Builder's Risk expertise while building strong relationships with brokers and customers and contributing to underwriting, retention, and growth objectives across the portfolio.
  • Analyze and qualify opportunities based upon the organization's appetite and be able to effectively communicate such.
  • Underwrite within the underwriting governance framework.
  • Evaluate, underwrite, and negotiate new and renewal business within delegated authority and underwriting guidelines while exercising sound underwriting judgment.
  • Develop and/or maintain relationships with our broker partners in support of desired business retention as well as work with our customers and brokers to identify their insurance needs and provide recommendations and possible solutions to achieve it where possible.
  • Support business development efforts through broker interactions and the identification of growth opportunities within assigned accounts and territories.
  • Manage assigned underwriting responsibilities and contribute to portfolio performance objectives in support of organizational goals.
  • Participate in industry functions and professional events to continue building market knowledge and representing AXIS professionally.
  • Participate in and help facilitate broker and customer meetings to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities, and support retention and growth objectives
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across the organization to ensure our customer's needs are met.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.

What you need to have:

  • 3 - 5 years of Builder's Risk, Property, or Commercial Insurance underwriting experience.
  • Curiosity and desire to learn
  • Experience analyzing and underwriting a range of commercial property or Builder's Risk exposures.
  • Solid understanding of Builder's Risk coverage, exposure analysis, pricing principles, and marketplace dynamics.
  • Able to analyze standard and moderately complex risks and communicate underwriting concepts or positions to audiences of varying experience.
  • Able to independently manage routine underwriting responsibilities while collaborating effectively in a team setting.
  • Capable of handling time constraints for quoting new and renewal business.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Understanding of both admitted (retail) and non-admitted / Excess & Surplus (wholesale) underwriting framework.
  • Experience collaborating with brokers and supporting relationship development within an assigned market or territory.
  • Creative problem-solving skills.
  • Reasonably proficient with Microsoft Office applications.

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • This will be a hybrid role with an expectation of being in an AXIS office 3 days per week (as applicable)
  • Travel roughly 25%
  • Participate on weekly team calls / meetings when operating in hybrid environments

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $130,000 - $165,000K. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.

Job Description: Head of Finance Transformation

Reporting To: Chief Financial Officer

About the Team

The Finance function at AXIS plays a central role in enabling enterprise strategy, capital stewardship, regulatory integrity, and performance insight. As AXIS continues to evolve, Finance is undertaking significant transformation to modernize its operating model, strengthen scalability and controls, and enhance its strategic contribution to the business.


This role sits within the CFO organization and operates as a senior Finance transformation leader, working alongside the CFO and Finance Leadership Team to modernize Finance processes, capabilities, systems and ways of working across a multi-year horizon.


How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Head of Finance Transformation is accountable for shaping and delivering the Finance transformation strategy and roadmap in line with Finance priorities and AXIS business objectives. Acting as the CFO's senior adviser on Finance transformation, the role ensures Finance has the operating model, capabilities, technology and ways of working needed to support AXIS's strategic objectives over a multi-year horizon.


The role exists to improve Finance's scalability, decision support, control maturity and adoption of modernized ways of working, helping Finance operate as a more integrated and insight-driven partner to the business.


Scope

Transformation is delivered through functional leadership, not around it. The role develops and recommends Finance transformation standards, target-state designs, and prioritization approaches, while execution accountability remains with Finance functional leaders.


The role partners across Finance (e.g., FP&A, Controllership, Finance Operations, Treasury, Investor Relations, Tax, and other Finance teams) and with enterprise partners (BTS, Data, Operations, Underwriting, Actuarial, Risk, and others) to drive integrated solutions and consistent adoption of the future state.
The role owns the Finance transformation strategy, roadmap, governance and benefits framework. The Chief of Staff integrates transformation progress, dependencies and decisions into the broader CFO agenda and executive operating cadence.


What will you do in this role?

  • Define and maintain the Finance Transformation strategy, roadmap, and target operating model aligned to Finance priorities and approved investment plans.
  • Serve as the senior Finance transformation adviser to the CFO, providing recommendations on transformation investment, capability development, modernization priorities and key decisions requiring CFO or Finance Leadership Team direction.
  • Shape and coordinate the Finance technology, data and analytics roadmap in partnership with BTS, Data and Risk, embedding advanced analytics and AI-enabled capabilities into Finance workflows such as forecasting, variance analysis, controls monitoring and management reporting.
  • Establish and lead governance for the Finance transformation portfolio, including recommendations on investment trade-offs, sequencing, prioritization and resource allocation to ensure initiatives are value-driven, risk-managed and controlled.
  • Build alignment across the Finance Leadership Team and key stakeholders on the Finance target operating model, transformation roadmap, design standards and adoption of future-state processes and ways of working, reinforcing accountability and addressing resistance as needed.
  • Provide oversight of major Finance transformation programs, ensuring delivery aligns to strategic intent, regulatory requirements, and enterprise risk appetite—while monitoring benefits and outcomes (efficiency, effectiveness, control strength, analytic maturity, and business value).
  • Partner with the CFO and Finance Leadership Team to evaluate Finance operating structures, resource deployment, and capability requirements needed to support future business priorities.
  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of Finance policies, operating standards, governance frameworks, and transformation practices that improve effectiveness, scalability, and organizational performance.
  • Represent Finance transformation in senior leadership forums, contributing to broader enterprise strategy and change discussions.

Outcomes and how success is measured

  • Measurable reductions in Finance cost-to-serve and improvements in cycle times (e.g., close, forecast, management reporting).
  • Finance transformation roadmap delivered against agreed milestones, with clear governance, active risk management, documented decisions, and tracked benefits realization.
  • Sustained improvement in control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and quality of regulatory engagement.
  • Improved quality, timeliness, and actionability of management and board reporting; materially better analytics supporting decision-making.
  • Increased adoption of standardized tools, processes, and data across Finance; reduced fragmentation and manual effort.
  • Clear evidence of Finance operating as a strategic business partner to underwriting, investments, and operations, with documented decision support impact.

Authority

To accelerate delivery and avoid transformation drift, the role is empowered—through the CFO and Finance Leadership Team—to:

  • Recommend transformation standards, target-state design principles and governance requirements for CFO and Finance Leadership Team approval.
  • Recommend prioritization, sequencing, acceleration, pausing, or redirection of initiatives to ensure focus on the highest-value outcomes.
  • Establish the governance, reporting and review cadence specifically required to oversee Finance transformation delivery, adoption and benefits realization.
  • Convene and chair cross-functional decision forums as needed to remove barriers and drive resolution.

About You – What we're looking for

  • In-depth expertise in Finance transformation, including operating model design, technology enablement, analytics modernization, governance, and strategic execution.
  • Proven ability to advise executive and senior Finance leaders, influencing decisions with long-term and enterprise implications.
  • Extensive experience leading large-scale, complex transformation initiatives in highly regulated, global environments.
  • Strong enterprise judgement, balancing strategic ambition with governance, risk, and control considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through other leaders—aligning and influencing senior stakeholders without relying on direct execution ownership.
  • Strong strategic, systems, and data perspective—integrating Finance, technology, data, and operational considerations.
  • Ability to communicate complex strategic topics clearly and persuasively to Executive Leadership and senior stakeholders.

Role Factors

  • Significant and regular interaction with Executive Leadership and senior management across AXIS.
  • Accountability for Finance transformation outcomes, including sustained adoption, capability uplift and measurable business impact.
  • High degree of autonomy in shaping objectives, frameworks, and approaches.
  • Periodic travel will be required.
  • Hybrid or in-office presence aligned with senior leadership expectations.

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $250 - 310,000 (NY), $210 - 285,000 (IL), $220 - 295,000 (NJ), $200 - 275,000 (GA). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is [Exempt/Non-Exempt] for FLSA purposes.

About the Team

The Strategic Sourcing & Procurement team helps AXIS make informed supplier, sourcing, contracting, and purchasing decisions. The team partners with business stakeholders to manage supplier value, improve procurement discipline, support contract governance, and identify opportunities to reduce cost, risk, and complexity across the organization.


How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Strategic Sourcing Operations Lead supports effective procurement decision-making by providing analysis, sourcing coordination, supplier research, contract administration, and stakeholder support across assigned spend categories. The role helps AXIS improve savings visibility, contract discipline, supplier performance, and procurement governance while building future capability within the Strategic Sourcing & Procurement function.

What will you do in this role?

  • Supporting Category Managers with category plans, sourcing pipelines, savings trackers, supplier documentation, and leadership-ready updates.

  • Coordinating sourcing activities by managing documentation, supplier communications, timelines, bid analysis, stakeholder meetings, and recommendation materials.

  • Analyzing spend, supplier, contract, and pricing information to identify savings, consolidation, risk reduction, and process improvement opportunities.

  • Managing contract administration activities by tracking renewals, expiration dates, notice periods, pricing obligations, service commitments, and key contractual requirements.

  • Preparing contract summaries, renewal options, supplier comparison materials, total cost summaries, dashboards, reports, and other decision-support materials.

  • Conducting supplier research and market scans to identify potential vendors, alternative supply options, emerging providers, market trends, and supplier risks.

  • Supporting supplier onboarding, due diligence, performance tracking, issue follow-up, supplier business reviews, and compliance documentation.

  • Serving as a day-to-day procurement operations contact for assigned internal stakeholders and helping them navigate sourcing, contracting, onboarding, and procurement processes.

  • Maintaining accurate procurement records, templates, process documentation, trackers, systems data, and audit-ready supporting materials.

  • Escalating complex commercial, contractual, supplier performance, governance, or risk-related matters to Category Managers or senior procurement professionals when appropriate.

  • You may also be asked to perform other reasonable duties, as required, to support the needs of the business.


About You

What we're looking for:

  • Possess a bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Operations, or a related field, or demonstrate equivalent relevant experience.

  • Demonstrate experience supporting procurement, sourcing, supplier management, contract administration, finance, consulting, operations, data analytics, or a related business support function.

  • Able to analyze data, prepare reports, identify trends, and translate findings into practical business insights and recommendations.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, records, and stakeholder requests with accuracy and consistent follow-through.

  • Demonstrate experience working with contracts, suppliers, purchasing processes, business stakeholders, or highly transactional operational work.

  • Able to communicate clearly with internal stakeholders and suppliers, including summarizing information, documenting requirements, and preparing concise materials for review.

  • Able to work independently on routine and lower-risk matters while recognizing when to escalate complex commercial, contractual, supplier, or risk-related issues.

  • Demonstrate a service-oriented, collaborative, curious, and proactive approach to supporting stakeholders and building procurement capability.

  • Possess working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, compare, and analyze data; experience with pivot tables, lookup formulas, or dashboards is preferred.

  • Experience with procurement, sourcing, contract lifecycle, spend analytics, reporting, or supplier management platforms is preferred.

Role Factors

  • This is a hybrid role with onsite office attendance required at least 3 days a week minimum.

  • This role may require participation in supplier or stakeholder meetings across different time zones, depending on business needs.

  • Travel is not expected to be a regular requirement, but occasional travel may be required for business meetings or supplier-related activity.

What we offer

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary of $76k to $95k in Alpharetta, Georgia. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate performance and your individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.

Where this role is based in the United States of America, the FLSA exemption status should be reviewed and confirmed by HR before posting.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Technology / Insurtech, Customer Service / Account Support
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time, includes weekends

About this job

Lead ongoing support and maintenance of production AI solutions at AXIS Capital. Coordinate with engineering teams, data science, and business stakeholders to ensure AI systems remain stable, performant, compliant, and deliver measurable business value.

Good fit if you have experience managing production systems, leading technical teams, and coordinating across multiple departments in a complex organization.

Full job description

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

How does this role contribute to our collective success?
AI solutions are becoming increasingly important to AXIS' ability to drive efficiency, improve decision making, and enhance customer and employee experiences. As AI capabilities mature and move into production, maintaining their effectiveness, reliability, fairness, and business value becomes critical.

The AI Solutions Support Lead is responsible for the ongoing support, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of AI solutions that have been deployed into production. Once an AI solution has been delivered and transitioned from the Data Science & AI Delivery team, ownership of day-to-day operational support and continuous improvement will transfer to this role.

Leading a team of AI engineers provided through our strategic delivery partners, the AI Solutions Support Lead will ensure production AI solutions remain stable, performant, compliant, and aligned to evolving business needs. This role acts as the central coordination point between AI engineering, Data Science & AI Delivery, Data Engineering, BTS, business stakeholders, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions continue to deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle.

The role combines technical leadership, operational excellence, stakeholder management, and people leadership, requiring an individual who is equally comfortable discussing model performance, coordinating incident response activities, managing enhancement roadmaps, and engaging senior business stakeholders.


What will you do in this role?

Own Production AI Solutions

  • Assume operational ownership of AI solutions following successful deployment and handover from delivery teams.

  • Establish and maintain support processes, documentation, runbooks, monitoring dashboards, escalation paths, defect management and operational procedures. once a solution has met agreed production acceptance criteria, including runbooks(those will need to be created and handed over to support team), monitoring dashboards, support ownership, escalation paths, defect management, and release evidence

  • Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and service management practices are in place for all production AI solutions.

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of supported solutions, dependencies, business owners, and support requirements.


Lead AI Support & Incident Management

  • Coordinate investigation and resolution of production issues affecting AI solutions.

  • Manage defect remediation activities and oversee the delivery of code fixes through internal and partner engineering teams.

  • Act as the primary point of coordination during major incidents impacting AI services.

  • Ensure issues are identified, triaged, prioritised, communicated, and resolved effectively.

  • Support post-incident reviews and implementation of preventative actions.


Monitor Solution Performance & Effectiveness

  • Own monitoring frameworks to assess solution performance, reliability, usage, accuracy, cost, and value realization.

  • Monitor AI outputs for signs of performance degradation, model drift, bias, fairness concerns, or changing business effectiveness.

  • Ensure solutions continue to meet business objectives, operational requirements, and governance standards.

  • Identify optimisation opportunities and drive continuous improvement activities.


Drive Continuous Improvement & Enhancements

  • Own and manage enhancement backlogs for production AI solutions.

  • Coordinate development and deployment of approved enhancements.

  • Ensure solutions evolve in line with changing business processes, regulatory expectations, and technology capabilities.

  • Support release planning and production deployments.


Collaborate Across Technology & Data Teams

  • Work closely with the broader Data Science & AI Delivery team to ensure effective transition of solutions into support.

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to maintain data pipelines, integrations, and platform dependencies.

  • Collaborate with BTS teams to align with enterprise support processes, infrastructure standards, change management, and operational controls.

  • Coordinate activities across internal and external delivery teams to ensure service excellence.


Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure AI solutions operate in accordance with AXIS AI governance policies and standards.

  • Support periodic reviews of AI solutions to confirm continued appropriateness, effectiveness, transparency, and risk management.

  • Maintain appropriate operational documentation, support evidence, and audit artefacts.

  • Contribute to governance forums, operational reviews, and risk assessments where required.


What success looks like

  • Success in this role will be measured through:

  • High availability and reliability of production AI solutions.

  • Timely resolution of incidents and defects.

  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction with AI services and support.

  • Evidence that AI solutions continue to deliver expected business outcomes.

  • Effective monitoring and management of performance, fairness, bias, drift, and operational risk.

  • Delivery of enhancements and continuous improvements aligned to business priorities.

  • Smooth transition of solutions from delivery into operational support.

  • Well-managed support teams and partner resources.



About You
You are an organised, technically strong leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, operations, and business value. You have experience supporting complex production systems and can confidently coordinate multidisciplinary teams to resolve issues and drive continuous improvement.

You combine strong technical understanding with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to translate business priorities into practical operational outcomes.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Significant experience supporting, operating, or maintaining production AI, machine learning, analytics, or data-driven solutions.

  • Strong understanding of AI solution lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement.

  • Experience leading technical teams and coordinating third-party delivery partners.

  • Strong incident management and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Experience managing application support, service management, or operational delivery functions.

  • Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, cloud environments, and software delivery practices.

  • Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Ability to prioritise effectively and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

  • Strong organisational and leadership capabilities.


Desirable

  • Experience supporting Generative AI, machine learning, large language model (LLM), or agentic AI solutions.

  • Experience with Azure AI, Databricks, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Foundry, or similar AI technologies.

  • Understanding of Responsible AI principles, model monitoring, bias management, and AI governance requirements.

  • Experience within insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with ITIL, Service Management, or Site Reliability Engineering practices.



Working Arrangements

This role forms part of the operational backbone of AXIS' AI capability.

Given the critical nature of production support responsibilities, occasional out-of-hours work, including evenings and weekends, may be required to support incident resolution, production deployments, testing activities, or other business-critical operational events.

Role Factors:
In this role, you will typically be required to:

Attend your local office at least three (3) days per week to meet and build relationships with colleagues and the wider business.

Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture.

What we offer:
For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $175,000 - $200,000 USD (New York, NY), $110,000 - $130,000 CAD (Halifax, Nova Scotia) Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.  

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.
