Job Description

Surety Account Manager II

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients.

This role is hybrid and can be located near an Aon office.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

You'll work closely with clients, surety carriers, and internal collaborators to deliver bond programs with accuracy, compliance, and outstanding service. This role involves significant client interaction and ownership of key accounts. It offers the chance to create an immediate impact while further developing your expertise in the specialized field of surety.

  • Works under minimal supervision, exercising good judgment in routine and moderately complex client and market situations.
  • Takes primary accountability in managing selected accounts.
  • Possesses a working knowledge of surety bonds, including bond program structures, indemnity concepts, and market practices including accurate client interaction and advisement.
  • May assist in onboarding, mentoring, and training internal team.
  • Works closely with carriers every day to address evolving needs. Prepares and processes various surety instruments, such as bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds. Ensures these align with underwriting guidelines and client expectations.
  • Collaborates with clients daily to meet their changing requirements. Implements Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other obligations required by clients in line with State rules. Determines the necessary documents to complete issuance, including power-of-attorney, resident license, and others, ensuring attention to contractual, legal, and financial details.
  • Prepares General Indemnity Agreements and bond applications. Coordinates with and advises clients to acquire complete, accurate financial and corporate information for underwriting review. This includes any other nuanced client needs or requirements.
  • Maintains and supports data accuracy and promotes proactive oversight of bond programs in AonBondLink (ABL).
  • Works closely with internal collaborators to implement and ensure accurate, complete electronic bond files in AonBondLink (ABL). Also confirms and manages related client financial and underwriting records while following internal controls and audit requirements to prevent E&O.
  • Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
  • Provides technical surety mentorship and support to non-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal collaborators.
  • Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
  • Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority. Assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests exceeding standard limits or outside delegated authority.

How this opportunity is different

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in process improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Is able to effectively interpret a variety of technical instructions involving abstract and concrete variables and apply them to client and bond-specific scenarios.
  • Shows excellent organizational, time-management, and multi-tasking abilities, successfully managing various client and market requirements.
  • Retains Notary Public certification.
  • Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and exercises such authority responsibly and in accordance with internal controls.
  • Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook. Uses them to facilitate deliverables for clients and with markets around exposures, new bond needs, changes, expirations, or similar.

Education and licensing requirements:

  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Producer license.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

The role plays a crucial part in driving principled growth, margin expansion, and returns, while ensuring rigorous financial governance in a sophisticated, and market‑sensitive business.

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer Reinsurance, the CFO, Reinsurance North America will bring strong strategic judgment, deep financial acumen, and executive presence. The role requires a leader who can operate at both altitude and detail—translating market dynamics, portfolio decisions, and capital deployment into clear, actionable financial insights for senior leadership.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

Strategic Finance & Decision Support

  • Act as the primary finance advisor to the leadership team of North American Reinsurance, providing clear, actionable insights on growth, profitability, and capital deployment.

  • Evaluate critical initiatives, including organic investments, talent deployment, pricing and portfolio mix, and M&A, with a focus on return on investment, return on invested capital, and value creation.

Performance Management & Analytics

  • Deep financial modeling and analytical expertise, including assessment of profitability against capital employed, valuation, and scenario planning.

Job Description

Technical Product Manager – Facultative Reinsurance

Do you have technical product management experience and a passion for driving digital transformation? Are you a strategic leader who can connect business and technology to deliver innovative solutions? Join us as a Product Manager and help build the future of our placement platforms at Aon!

This position is located in Bloomington, MN, USA, offering the option to work remotely or from our nearby office.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

As a Technical Product Manager, your day is dynamic and collaborative. You'll work closely with senior business leaders and cross-functional teams to drive product innovation in the reinsurance sector. Your focus will be on aligning technology solutions with business strategy, ensuring regulatory compliance, and championing digital transformation across the facultative business. You'll balance planning, working with partners, and hands-on leadership to deliver impactful results in a fast-paced environment.

Typical Daily Activities:

  • Meet with senior leadership to align product roadmaps with strategic objectives and market trends.
  • Represent the technology team in meetings with collaborators, promoting transparency and accountability.
  • Communicate product vision and strategy to both internal and external collaborators.
  • Analyze market research and competitive intelligence to identify new opportunities for product differentiation.
  • Lead cross-functional sessions with engineering, architecture, and business SMEs to define and prioritize product features.
  • Guide teams through the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch.
  • Advocate for coordinated technology platforms and drive adoption among users.
  • Monitor product performance using important metrics and customer feedback, driving continuous improvement.
  • Ensure compliance with insurance market regulations and industry standards around the globe.
  • Facilitate conflict resolution and keep product initiatives on track with business goals.

How this opportunity is different

This role is crafted to serve as a strategic link between important business partners and technology teams. It ensures technology solutions directly drive business growth and improve operational efficiency. The position includes representing the Technology team in meetings with collaborators and aligning efforts across regions with global goals. Principal Duties and Responsibilities / Essential Functions:

Lead the platform architecture and build

  • Own the design, build, and ongoing maintenance of our Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold), ensuring data flows optimally from raw ingestion through conformed, analytics-ready models.
  • Make and document key architectural decisions around ingestion patterns, storage, the serving layer, orchestration, and performance — balancing speed, reliability, and cost.
  • Establish the engineering practices that keep the platform healthy as it scales: version control, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation.

Lead and grow the team

  • Guide a small team of data engineers — setting coding and design standards, running code reviews, and unblocking day-to-day work.
  • Mentor engineers and help grow their technical skills, giving the team a clear sense of how “good” is defined.
  • Help shape hiring and team structure as the function grows.

Build and maintain the data pipelines

  • Develop and operate ingestion pipelines from multiple sources — pharmacy claims, eligibility, formulary, contract data, rebate and actuarial data, and public reference APIs (e.g., NADAC, NCPDP, CMS, 340B).
  • Normalize and conform data across differing PBM file specifications, formularies, and claims layouts so that downstream models are consistent and trustworthy.
  • Design and evolve the conformed data model and star schema that serve as the analytical source of truth.

Serve the business

  • Ensure the platform reliably feeds downstream consumers: Power BI, Excel reporting, internal web applications, and AI/Copilot-ready data services.
  • Serve as a point for complex reporting and data issues, guiding to resolution across reporting and data teams
  • Own data quality, governance, lineage, performance, and cost optimization end to end.
  • Partner with the platform architect, analytics, clinical, and product teams to align the technical roadmap with business and client priorities, and translate ambiguous requirements into concrete data solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to prioritize initiatives and allocate resources

Minimum Requirements for Education, Experience, and Certifications/Licenses:

  • 7+ years in data engineering, including 2+ years leading, mentoring, or acting as tech lead for other engineers.
  • Deep experience building lakehouse / medallion architectures. Microsoft Fabric strongly preferred; comparable experience with Azure Synapse, Databricks, or similar platforms will be considered.
  • Strong SQL and hands-on proficiency in Python and/or PySpark for large-scale data transformation.
  • Dimensional modeling expertise — you can design and maintain star schemas that hold up as reporting needs grow.
  • BI analytics fluency, including an understanding of the semantic/serving layer that makes BI performant and trustworthy.
  • A track record of taming messy data — ingesting and conforming heterogeneous sources and file formats into clean, reliable models.
  • Solid engineering fundamentals — data governance, data quality frameworks, and CI/CD for data pipelines.
  • Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with pharmacy, PBM, healthcare claims, or payer data.
  • Familiarity with pharmacy data standards (NCPDP, claims file layouts) and healthcare reference data.
  • Experience enabling AI/Copilot or MCP-based data access on top of a data platform.
  • Broader Azure ecosystem experience (Azure SQL, data pipelines, security/RBAC, cost management).
  • Experience standing up a data platform or engineering function in an early or growth-stage environment.

Job Description

Representations & Warranties M&A Insurance- Vice President

The San Francisco office of Aon is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Vice President to join its market-leading M&A and Transaction Solutions team. This is an outstanding opportunity for a corporate attorney with 3-5 years of M&A experience to transition from private practice into a client-facing advisory role supporting some of the most sophisticated private equity and strategic clients in the market.

This role is a hybrid role, with the flexibility of working both virtually and form our San Francisco office.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

How this opportunity is different

As a Vice President you will work alongside senior and junior brokers, underwriters, private equity sponsors, corporate clients and leading law firms to structure and place Representations & Warranties Insurance (RWI) on domestic and cross-border transactions. We will provide hands-on experience, industry-leading training and mentorship in a collaborative environment.

This position offers a broad range of responsibilities and will allow candidates to remain deeply involved in complex corporate transactions while developing commercial negotiation and client relationship skills in a fast-paced M&A environment.

We value continued growth and learning, collaboration and pride in delivering exceptional work. If you are looking to take the next step in your career and gain hands on MA& transaction insurance experience, we encourage you to reach out and explore this opportunity!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Advise private equity sponsors, strategic buyers and their advisors on transactional risk insurance solutions.
  • Review purchase agreements, disclosure schedules, diligence reports and transaction documentation to identify underwriting considerations and coverage issues.
  • Coordinate the underwriting process with leading insurance carriers from initial marketing through policy binding.
  • Analyze legal and commercial risks associated with mergers and acquisitions across a broad range of industries.
  • Draft and negotiate policy terms and facilitate discussions between insurers and transaction parties.
  • Manage multiple transactions simultaneously while meeting demanding deal timelines.
  • Build and maintain relationships with law firms, investment bankers, private equity firms and corporate clients.
  • Support business development initiatives and participate in client presentations, industry conferences and educational seminars.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Aon's global Transaction Solutions platform on domestic and international transactions.

Qualifications:

To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com

Position Overview

NFP is seeking an experienced Account Executive, Broker (P&C) for its South Central region. This position is responsible for broking new and renewal business for a varied portfolio of energy and non-energy clients, including middle-market and large, complex accounts. The broker will handle all aspects of the placement from strategy development through policy delivery, ensuring client needs are promptly and accurately addressed, deadlines are met, and service standards are achieved.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Austin or Houston, Texas. Regular in-office presence is required to support collaboration and strong partnerships across teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead marketing for a book of energy and non-energy P&C clients in the South Central region, partnering with account teams and clients to align on strategy, timelines, and execution.
  • Execute national and regional broking strategies to support optimal client outcomes, retention, and profitable growth.
  • Develop strategies for at-risk accounts and identify book-of-business optimization opportunities.

Operational Process

  • Drive placement strategy and execution, including client needs assessment, program design, carrier negotiation, and marketing execution.
  • Coordinate complete and timely submissions, respond to carrier questions, analyze quotes, and present clear recommendations to clients.
  • Determine appropriate coverage based on the client's risk profile, business objectives, and risk appetite.
  • Develop creative solutions for complex placement scenarios and manage the placement cycle in accordance with NFP's service standards and timelines.
  • Use NFP's strategic carriers, panels, and preferred wholesalers to secure appropriate coverage, terms, and pricing.
  • Prepare proposals, coverage and policy comparisons, and related client materials; review binders and policies for accuracy.
  • Use data and analytics to provide meaningful program insight and support informed placement decisions.
  • Support prospect activity, retention, and appropriate cross-sell and up-sell opportunities.

Talent Development

  • Promote consistency in broking standards and client delivery across the region.
  • Educate account executives and account managers on market dynamics, carrier trends, and how those factors affect clients and placement strategy.
  • Partner with account executives, account managers, and service teams to resolve client needs promptly.

Carrier Relationships

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with carrier and wholesale partners to enhance placement outcomes and market access.
  • Stay current on carrier appetites, market dynamics, and terms and conditions to ensure the right markets are approached for each risk.
  • Share relevant market insight with clients and internal partners to support informed risk-transfer decisions.
  • Operate as a steward of the broader NFP while engaging in the marketplace.

Qualifications

  • Five or more years of commercial P&C broking experience with middle-market, large-account, or similarly complex business.
  • Demonstrated success leading marketing discussions, negotiating with carriers and wholesalers, and managing complex new and renewal placements.
  • Strong technical knowledge and creativity in developing effective property and casualty solutions.
  • Strong client-facing, carrier-facing, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • TX P&C insurance license required.
  • Energy industry experience is preferred but not required; candidates with strong non-energy commercial P&C experience will also be considered.
  • Experience with Epic, the agency management system, is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to travel as required for client, prospect, and industry events.

Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

What the day will look like

As a Senior Account Executive, you will advise clients on effective risk transfer, insurance design, and contract risk oversight to deliver outstanding results. The position also acts as a client representative with contracting and financing partners and leads collaborative brokerage teams across various insurance lines, including Workers' Compensation or equivalent experience, General Liability, Professional Liability, Environmental Liability, and Builders Risk.

Strategic Advisory & Risk Management

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on construction-phase risk transfer, risk financing, and risk control strategies
  • Evaluate project-specific risks and provide assessments of risk allocation, insurability, and market appetite
  • Advise clients on value-for-money risk transfer strategies applying Aon's proprietary data, benchmarking, and analytics
  • Provide guidance to ensure seamless and effective risk transfer among all project collaborators
  • Establish and maintain insurance cost benchmarks to support informed client decision-making

Client Advocacy & Contract Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients in discussions with contractors, lenders, and joint venture partners
  • Provide contract risk advisory services, including insurance and indemnity review and negotiation support
  • Deliver thought leadership and client education sessions, including insights on U.S. versus international construction risk and insurance practices

Insurance Program Development & Brokerage Delivery

  • Lead the design and placement of best-in-class, project-specific insurance programs in collaboration with Aon product and specialty leaders
  • Coordinate brokerage teams across multiple lines of coverage to provide integrated, efficient insurance solutions
  • Prepare and lead insurance market presentations and insurer engagement strategies
  • Collaborate with internal analytics teams and external experts on EML/PML analyses and related risk modeling

Project & Collaborator Management

  • Act as the project manager across Aon's brokerage, advisory, analytics, and global service teams
  • Drive alignment across geographies, fields, and service lines to deliver consistent client outcomes
  • Translate complex insurance structures and coverage concepts into clear, practical guidance for non-insurance collaborators

How this opportunity is different

This role sits at the dynamic intersection of strategic advisory and brokerage execution within Aon's global construction and infrastructure platform. As a Senior Account Executive, you will use Aon's comprehensive data, analytics, and market relationships to design and place integrated, multi-line insurance solutions for complex, large-scale projects. You'll coordinate specialist teams across geographies, influence risk outcomes from project inception through delivery, and deliver distinctive, impactful solutions that go well beyond traditional placement.

  • Strong understanding of construction contracts, risk allocation, and delivery models

Job Description

We are seeking a Sr. Director of Internal Consulting to lead central initiatives for Aon. The role starts with building and carrying out a multi-year strategic overhaul of our Operating Model. Reporting to the leadership team of Aon Business Services (ABS), this role leads internal consulting and program management teams. It involves crafting, orchestrating, and scaling the transformation of the enterprise operating model at Aon. The goal is to improve how we deliver value to clients, colleagues, and other interested parties. This role will engage with senior leaders across Solution Lines, Regions, and Functions. It will also lead a cross‑functional group of internal advisors, project managers, and subject matter experts to deliver measurable performance outcomes.

This role is open to a Virtual or Hybrid colleague based in Central or Eastern Time Zone.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Partner with ABS leadership as well as business leaders, key collaborators, and cross-functional partners to advance the vision, objectives, and scope related to operating model transformation efforts
  • Translate strategic priorities into a clear transformation roadmap with defined business outcomes, benchmarks, and value realization targets
  • Apply structured consulting methodologies (e.g., problem framing, analytical reasoning, benchmarking, argument development) to advise recommendations
  • Develop and validate arguments for operating model changes, including financial, operational, and qualitative benefits

Operating Model Design & Alignment

  • Lead the end‑to‑end diagnostic, build and transition of the target operating model across Aon's Business Units, geographic areas, and departments
  • Translate enterprise strategy into detailed organizational framework components, including capabilities, organizational structure, roles and responsibilities, governance models, and cross functional interaction patterns
  • Be responsible for phased implementation, including pilots, scaling strategies, and stabilization, ensuring alignment with regional and solution line needs
  • Build and maintain operating model blueprints, ensuring all components (capability models, interaction models, RACIs, team structures, decision rights, important metrics) integrate across the enterprise

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives. Provide insight on opportunities, trade-offs, and risks related to the operating model. Ensure agreement and engagement in strategy and roadmap.
  • Shape and deliver a compelling change narrative that articulates the “why,” “what,” and “how” of the transformation for different audiences
  • Work closely with executive sponsors and the PMO to establish and maintain robust governance, decision‑making, and blocking issue mechanisms
  • Partner with Change & Communications teams to define implications of design changes, highlight required behavior shifts, and identify points of resistance or adoption needs
  • Facilitate executive and working‑level forums to align decisions, resolve conflicts, and maintain momentum

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Recruit, develop, and mentor a high‑performing team members with capabilities in strategy, transformation, operations, change, and analytics
  • Lead a team of internal consultants and business analysts to diagnose current‑state challenges, define solutions, and support implementation
  • Build consulting capabilities within the broader organization by sharing methodologies, tools, and guidelines
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement
  • Bring together and embed lessons learned into subsequent waves of organizational build changes

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Technology, or related field; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) strongly preferred
  • Proven experience in management consulting, internal strategy/consulting or equivalent internal consulting function, including significant experience at the Director level or above
  • Demonstrated experience leading sophisticated, multi‑workstream operating model or large‑scale transformation programs in a global, matrixed organization, including design, process transition and governance framework setup
  • Experience working in or with professional services, insurance, or financial services environments is highly desirable

Skills & Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to build and coach high‑performing, complementary teams and work effectively across cultures and geographies
  • Ability to operate as a generalist across strategy development, organizational framework building, and execution support
  • Ability to roll up the sleeves and problem solve
  • Strong strategic and conceptual abilities; able to connect enterprise strategy to detailed building and implementation
  • Expertise in building operating frameworks, process re‑engineering, and organizational development
  • Excellent collaborator management and influencing skills, including experience engaging C‑suite and senior executives
  • Outstanding ability to present complex topics clearly and build engaging narratives and materials
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities; comfortable with data, financial modeling, and performance metrics
  • Growth mindset toward emerging technologies, with the ability to incorporate AI into daily work and support others in embracing new digital tools with confidence and ease. Proficiency in MS

About this job

Review medical records and documentation to validate DRG coding accuracy and determine correct billing reimbursement. Requires expertise in ICD-10-CM and PCS coding guidelines, knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid regulations, and clinical understanding of disease processes.

Good fit if you have a CCS or CIC certification with DRG auditing experience, an RN or LVN license, and clinical background in OR, ICU, or ER settings.

Full job description

The Diagnostic Related Groups (DRG) Clinical Auditor will be responsible for performing DRG validation (clinical/coding) reviews of medical records and/or other documentation. This role will determine correct DRG/coding as defined by review methodologies specific to the type of review. This involves completing medical record reviews, accurately documenting findings and non-findings and providing clinical/policy/regulatory support for the determination. This role will utilize their experience with ICD-10-CM & PCS coding guidelines, the ability to understand modern pharmacology, disease management and clinical intervention procedures. The ideal DRG Clinical Auditor candidate has strong written and verbal communication skills, clinical knowledge of disease processes, and knowledge of medical necessity rules.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • The Clinical Auditor will review medical records to determine accuracy of billing through verification of coding and review of supporting clinical documentation
  • Conduct audits to ensure accurate reimbursement and identifying potential savings
  • Demonstrated knowledge of ICD-10-CM codes, PCS and DRG coding, understanding of payer rules and regulations, including Medicare and Medicaid
  • Understand and comply with all internal and external policies
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules
  • Assist Quality Control team and medical director with appeals, rebuttals, etc.
  • Notify leadership of any issues or concerns in a timely manner
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Proficient understanding of Medicare, CMS guidelines and ICD-10 coding guidelines
  • Effective and professional communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment

  • Support data centers and digital infrastructure projects by contributing to a consistent US delivery approach, common methodology and high-quality technical deliverables.

  • Strong background in construction risk engineering, project risk engineering, construction insurance engineering or a closely related technical engineering discipline.
  • Experience with construction-phase risk reviews, design advisory / review work, site surveys, underwriting reports and technical risk recommendations.
  • Ability to review and interpret engineering reports, drawings and interfaces between design disciplines, particularly where assignments require short turnaround times.
  • Good understanding of data center / digital infrastructure risk drivers would be highly beneficial, including power supply, redundancy, cooling, commissioning, integrated systems testing and handover risks.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent years of industry experience and professional certifications.

  • Fire protection certification preferred but not required.

Posting Description

Summary:We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Compensation Manager to lead the design, execution, and governance of our compensation programs. This role will partner closely with HR and business leaders to ensure competitive, equitable, and data-driven pay practices that support organizational growth and talent strategy.

What You'll Do

Own Compensation Strategy & Program Design

  • Partner with the CPO to define and evolve the company's compensation philosophy and pay practices.
  • Design, implement, and continuously refine compensation structures including base pay, incentive plans, bonus programs, and special pay arrangements.
  • Develop and maintain salary structures, pay grades, and job architecture frameworks.
  • Conduct market benchmarking and external salary survey analysis to ensure competitiveness and alignment with business strategy.
  • Evaluate and recommend enhancements to compensation programs based on workforce trends, market conditions, and organizational growth.

Lead Annual Compensation Cycles

  • Own the end-to-end annual merit, bonus, and promotion cycles — including planning, modeling, budgeting, system configuration (Workday), manager enablement, and final approvals.
  • Develop compensation modeling scenarios and provide executive-ready analytics and recommendations.
  • Ensure timely and accurate implementation of approved changes within HRIS and payroll systems.
  • Partner with Finance on budget alignment and accrual forecasting.

Ensure Pay Equity & Governance

  • Conduct internal equity analyses to prevent compression and ensure fairness across functions and levels.
  • Analyze compensation data to identify disparities, trends, and risk areas; provide data-driven recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including pay transparency requirements.
  • Maintain documentation and governance standards for compensation processes and decisions.
  • Establish internal controls to mitigate risk and ensure consistency in pay decisions.

Support Talent Acquisition & Offer Governance

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners to evaluate offers, sign-on bonuses, and promotional increases.
  • Review and approve compensation packages to ensure alignment with internal equity and market positioning.
  • Provide guidance on job leveling, salary bands, and offer strategy.
  • Verify compensation-related components of offer letters and ensure accurate system entry.

Oversee Compensation-Related Payroll & Adjustments

  • Partner with Payroll to ensure accurate processing of compensation changes, where applicable.
  • Review payroll data to validate compensation-related changes prior to final disbursement (e.g, mass merit uploads)
  • Collaborate with HR and Legal on severance modeling and payment processing.

Deliver Data-Driven Insights

  • Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards related to compensation trends, budget utilization, pay equity, and workforce analytics.
  • Conduct scenario modeling to support workforce planning and strategic decision-making.
  • Maintain data integrity within Workday and ensure alignment between HRIS and payroll systems.

Drive Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to streamline compensation workflows and enhance automation within Workday.
  • Develop SOPs and documentation to ensure consistency and audit readiness.
  • Stay current on compensation best practices, regulatory changes, and emerging market trends.
  • undefined

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, or related field preferred.

About this job

Support treasury and banking systems for Aon's North America operations, managing Kyriba configurations, system testing, and integrations. Role includes process automation, reporting and analytics development, and participation in treasury transformation initiatives.

Good fit if you have treasury or finance systems experience, know Treasury Management Systems like Kyriba, and understand internal controls and bank connectivity.

Full job description

Job Description

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Treasury systems ownership and support

  • Act as the primary contact for day‑to‑day issues for Treasury and Banking applications for North America and support other team members with global issues.
  • Maintain system configurations, reference data, user profiles, roles, and permissions in accordance with internal controls and segregation‑of‑duties requirements.
  • Coordinate and perform system testing (unit, regression, and user acceptance testing) for upgrades, patches, new modules, and configuration changes.
  • Develop and maintain system documentation, user guides, training materials and job aids for Treasury and Finance users.

Process and control enhancement

  • Partner with Treasury operations, cash management, debt, investments and risk teams to understand business requirements and translate them into system and process solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes (e.g., bank statement processing, cash positioning, payments, intercompany settlements, forecasting) and improve data quality and control.
  • Support the design and execution of key controls around treasury system access, payments, interfaces, and reconciliations; assist with internal and external audit requests related to treasury systems.

Kyriba / banking connectivity and integrations

  • Support implementation and maintenance of bank connectivity (SWIFT, host‑to‑host, APIs) within Kyriba and related tools.
  • Monitor and help resolve issues with payment files, bank statements, and other interfaces between Kyriba, banks, ERP systems, and downstream applications.
  • Collaborate with IT and external vendors on integration design, testing, incident resolution, and enhancement work.

Reporting, analytics and data management

  • Build and maintain standard reports and dashboards in Kyriba and related tools to support cash visibility, liquidity management, and operational performance.
  • Assist in the production and enhancement of recurring Treasury reporting (e.g., daily cash positions, liquidity and investment reports, bank fee and account analytics).
  • Ensure data integrity across systems; identify and remediate data quality issues in master data (banks, accounts, entities, counterparties, instruments, etc.).

Projects and transformation

  • Support on Treasury and Finance transformation initiatives (e.g., new country roll‑outs, bank rationalization, payment factory implementations, netting solutions, system migrations).
  • Contribute to business case development and benefits tracking for treasury systems initiatives.
  • Stay current on Kyriba and market best practices and bring ideas forward to enhance Aon's Treasury technology and processes

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, IT, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Several years of experience in a corporate Treasury function and/or in systems/business analysis supporting finance/treasury processes.
  • Hands‑on experience with at least one Treasury Management System (TMS); familiarity with payment formats (SWIFT MT / ISO 20022), bank connectivity and standard treasury processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with demonstrated ability to understand end‑to‑end processes and their technology enablers.
  • Solid understanding of internal controls, risk and compliance considerations in a Treasury environment.
  • Proficiency with Excel and comfort working with data from multiple systems.

Preferred

  • Direct, practical experience configuring or supporting Kyriba (e.g., core cash, payments, bank connectivity, cash forecasting, debt and investments modules).
  • Experience working in a large, global organization with complex banking and entity structures.
  • Exposure to ERP systems (such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, etc.) and integrations between TMS and ERP.
  • Experience participating in or leading system implementation, upgrade, or process‑reengineering projects.
  • Familiarity with basic scripting, data tools, or BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, SQL) is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • High attention to detail and a control‑minded approach, with a focus on data quality and operational risk mitigation.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver high‑quality work in a fast‑paced, global environment.
  • Collaborative team player who is comfortable working across functions, regions, and time zones.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement, learning, and leveraging data and technology to support better decisions.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Property Risk Consultant for our Property Consulting Group

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for a Property Risk Control Consultant. This position will support Aon's Property Risk Consulting Group.

The successful candidate can expect to work with colleagues and clients to develop an understanding of the many property risks posed by fire, earthquake, flood, and other Natural Catastrophes.

This is a remote opportunity but there will be some travel involved.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like:

  • The successful applicant should be familiar with the following:
  • Assembly of Construction, Occupancy, Protection and Exposure (COPE) Data.
  • Brokerage submission information
  • Data assembly
  • Summary documents
  • Broker renewal support
  • Attendance & participation at carrier meetings
  • Vendor management
  • Recommendation review & analysis

Complete property risk control surveys and develop property underwriting reports for a variety of occupancies:

  • Conduct Nat Cat surveys and populate primary and secondary modeling characteristics for modeling.
  • Review of available data to determine natural catastrophe exposure at client locations. Use of available online tools to analyze flood exposures in accordance with NIFP and FEMA guidelines.
  • Coordination of vendor RFPs
  • Knowledge of B&M Jurisdictional inspection requirements
  • Development and review of Maximum Foreseeable (MFL), Probable Maximum (PML) and Normal Loss (NLE) estimates.
  • Hazards associated with a variety of occupancies including manufacturing, warehousing, soft occupancies, etc.
  • Problem solving using the application of Client Standards, NFPA, FM Global or other best practices to resolve technical fire protection issues.
  • 30 to 40% travel will be involved as you may have to visit client sites.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 8 to 10 years with a Highly Protected Risk insurance carrier or vendor.
  • Technically proficient in understanding, interpreting, and applying NFPA and/or FM Global standards; and, evaluating fire protection systems (automatic sprinklers, special extinguishing systems, etc.)
  • Ideal candidate is self-sufficient, organized, and has good written and oral communication skills.
  • Must be physical fit and able to climb ladders and stairs and transition to and from ladders or stairs to access building roof areas and upper or lower floors within a customer site during surveys.
  • Ability to work from home.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent years of industry experience and professional certifications.

  • Fire protection certification preferred but not required.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Pay Transparency Laws:

The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $137,000 to $160,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive [an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

A summary of all the benefits offered for this position:

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

Full job description

CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in <>.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides Medical Case Management to individuals through in person and telephonic communications with the patient, physician, other health care providers, employer and others.

  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation of patient's progress.
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney's visits.
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, et cetera for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy. Initial home visit for initial evaluation.
  • Implements care such as negotiation the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services.
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker's injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • This role may require overnight travel.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Experience as a RN, Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred.
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, and advisors/clients and coworkers.
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful.
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills.
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize MS Office including Excel spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
  • Bilingual

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing.
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation.
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications are preferred.
  • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required.

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers' compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

NFP is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced relationship management professional. This role will be focused on strategic relationship management and retention of Mid-Market core clients.

Location: Chicago preferred

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for managing the overall relationship with assigned Mid-Market core clients including developing and engaging multiple relationships throughout and within the client organization.
  • Establish oneself as client's primary point of contact and communication conduit for NFP; keep client producer informed at all times.
  • Cultivate internal and external relationships to establish effective open collaboration, client advocacy, and trust.
  • Develop and obtain a broad knowledge of internal operations to efficiently and effectively solve the needs of the audience and the circumstances at hand.
  • Maintain accurate records of client (or prospect) contacts and their products utilizing account management software or other technology. Developing and maintaining a robust understanding and tracking system of key client personnel and their products is essential.
  • Drive revenue growth on existing and new clients through development of a strategic consultative sales plan in conjunction with producer including identifying and executing cross-sell opportunities when appropriate.
  • Establish oneself as a self-starter leader with client account teams and take ownership of the success of client and colleague relationships.
  • Contribute to client team's holistic service strategy and establish quality standards to improve client's experience.
  • Demonstrate a broad understanding of insurance products and coverages, their applicability, relevant industry trends, and basic program design. The ability to understand basic insurance program structure and content is essential.
  • Develop expertise, and remain current, in assigned client industry and/or market area, NFP's resources and capabilities, and engage in structured continuing education
  • Produce an annual or semi-annual stewardship report that highlights NFP's efforts for the client over the previous twelve months.
  • Establish, execute, and accountable for implementation of the formal NFP strategic relationship management cadence.
    • Seeks annual client feedback/grading on NFP's performance
  • Travel to visit clients and engage in client development activities and entertainment. Travel approximately 25%-40%; must see clients in person at least twice annually.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALITIES:

  • 10+ years' experience in relationship management with face-to-face private equity (or similar) client experience.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills capable of interacting with private equity and C-suite clients to cultivate strong relationships through effective communication and trust.
  • Elite project management, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Manages time effectively through excellent organization, time-management, and multi-tasking skills.

As a Senior Sales Enablement Program Analyst, you will help turn business needs into scalable solutions, AI-enabled capabilities, stronger insights, and practical tools that improve seller productivity, client planning, pipeline visibility, and commercial execution.

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from an Aon office, aligned to local Smart Working policy.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, team with varied strengths, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

As a Senior Sales Enablement Program Analyst, you will support pivotal initiatives that help Aon's commercial organization drive growth, deepen client relationships, and deliver better client outcomes through improved execution, stronger insights, scalable solutions, and AI-enabled innovation. You will simplify the seller experience, increase adoption of sales technologies and emerging capabilities, and act as both a business analyst and project manager. You will partner across Sales Enablement, Sales Operations, Marketing, Data & Analytics, Technology, Bid & Proposal Management, and regional commercial teams to find opportunities, build better solutions, and drive innovation from concept through adoption.

  • Support strategic programs that improve commercial growth, seller productivity, pipeline transparency, client planning, and the commercial organization's ability to identify, pursue, and support client opportunities.
  • Gather, document, and prioritize business requirements from commercial leaders and cross-functional strategy teams.
  • Translate business needs into scalable technology, reporting, and process solutions.
  • Explore and apply AI-enabled approaches to improve workflows, automate manual effort, strengthen insights, and create better experiences for sellers and commercial leaders.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics teams to define important metric frameworks, validate reporting logic, and develop executive-ready insights.
  • Create user guides, playbooks, training materials, communications, and field activation plans that support adoption.
  • Facilitate working sessions, governance forums, and stakeholder discussions to align priorities and drive decisions.

How this opportunity is different

This role offers the opportunity to move beyond task execution and own meaningful workstreams that shape how Aon's commercial teams grow, sell, plan, report, and support clients. You will help find opportunities to use AI, automation, data, and technology to build smarter, more scalable solutions that improve commercial focus, strengthen decision-making, and make it easier for colleagues to deliver value to clients. You will work on transformation initiatives such as commercial reporting modernization, client and market planning optimization, AI-enabled productivity solutions, and sales intelligence platform governance. The role is highly cross-functional, giving you exposure to senior leaders and teams across Sales Enablement, Marketing, Bid & Proposal Management, Sales Operations, Data & Analytics, Technology, regional commercial leadership, and external platform partners.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 3+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Consulting, Business Analysis, or a related field.
  • Strong ability to gather requirements, improve processes, and support technology, reporting, automation, or AI-enabled solution implementations.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to connect data, business needs, and commercial outcomes into clear recommendations.
  • Curiosity and comfort experimenting with emerging tools, including AI and automation, to solve business problems and improve how teams work.
  • Experience developing executive presentations, business cases, leadership updates, training materials, or change management communications.
  • Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, written communication, and prioritization skills in a global, matrixed environment.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent years of proven experience.

Full job description

Job Description

Health Analytics Advisory Leader

Are you ready to shape how sophisticated health analytics advise executive decision-making? Join Aon and help bring our analytics capabilities together to deliver clearer insights and greater impact for clients!

This role may be based in Atlanta, Chicago, New York, or near another Aon office. Proximity to an Aon location is preferred; however, strong candidates who require greater virtual flexibility may also be considered.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

As Lead for our Health Analytics Advisory team, you will serve as the senior client advisor and advance our impact delivering, packaging and scaling leading analytics insights content across a growing range of analytic domains. Your role sits at the intersection of client advisory, analytics content strategy, financial measurement, and health economics. It also involves total-cost-of-care optimization and advancing Aon's data-driven, AI-enabled client delivery model.

You will be the trusted voice clients and consultants rely on to interpret sophisticated analytics across many domains. You will also connect our financial, predictive modeling, health economics, clinical, pharmacy, network, and care delivery analytics into one clear set of client content and solutions.

You will:

  • Advise clients and prospects on sophisticated, cross-domain analytics, translating financial, predictive, clinical, pharmacy, network, and cost-of-care analyses into actionable guidance for HR, Finance, and C-suite audiences.
  • Lead sophisticated client engagements that bring together multiple Aon capabilities, including Cost Efficiency Measurement, Health Risk Analyzer, data warehouse and informatics content, Financial Experience Monitoring, and emerging analytics solutions.
  • Develop unified client-facing analytics content that integrates different areas of expertise while balancing consultant-led, subject-matter expert-led, automated, and AI-enabled delivery.
  • Partner with leaders across data platforms, clinical, and pharmacy analytics, actuarial and financial analytics, networks, care delivery, data science, AI enablement, analytics engineering, and Centers of Excellence.
  • Develop measurement approaches that quantify the financial, utilization, engagement, and clinical impact of benefit programs, point solutions, and other interventions.
  • Create data-driven thought leadership, including white papers, trend studies, market analyses, vendor category assessments, and regulatory impact analyses.
  • Provide senior technical and methodological review across analytics domains, ensuring client content is consistent, accurate, and ready for delivery.
  • Mentor colleagues and support special projects requiring alignment across clinical, actuarial, financial, and network analytics.

How this opportunity is different

You'll partner closely with analytics domain leaders, consultants, and client leaders to bring together repeatable, scalable analytics with deep-dive domain expertise — building a shared content capability that raises the quality, consistency, and client impact of everything Aon delivers.

You'll shape how we progressively deliver insight across the full client spectrum: from early-stage prospects with limited available data, to established clients with rich, longitudinal data ecosystems — and across employer segments of every size.

Success in this role depends on deep credibility in health and benefits analytics. It also requires a genuine passion for client advisory, positive relationship skills, and rigor to turn sophisticated analysis into scalable content.

The right candidate will have a track record of advising clients directly on sophisticated analytics decisions including evaluating health carriers, vendors, and point solutions, and bridging technical domains to produce unified, scalable models and deliverables.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Extensive experience with U.S. healthcare data, employer benefits, and insurance.
  • Demonstrable experience as a client-facing analytics advisor, with excellent writing and presentation skills — able to guide senior partners (C-suite, HR, Finance) through sophisticated, multi-domain analytics with clarity and confidence.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across various analytics fields by building consensus among actuaries, analytics leaders, and clinical/pharmacy experts. You also unify content across groups with different methods and priorities.
  • Experience in measurement and validation of healthcare programs, including financial, utilization, engagement, clinical outcomes, and metrics related to return on investment.
  • Experience serving large/complex Fortune 500 organizations as well as developing scaled solutions for smaller and mid-market self-insured groups.
  • Experience with the broader vendor ecosystem serving the self-insured employer — Health Plans, PBMs, emerging point solutions, chronic condition management programs, and data warehouses/analytics platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with statistical measurement, causal inference, and data science/predictive modeling techniques, including work with large health claims datasets (HIPAA, de-identification, data cleaning, exploratory analysis).
  • Solid understanding of medical and pharmacy claims reporting and billing — including ICD-10, CPT, DRG, ICD-10 PCS, National Drug Codes, and CMS codes — sufficient to engage credibly with clinical and pharmacy domain leaders.
  • Ability to review technical work product across domains and mentor junior technical staff, including analysts, data scientists, statisticians, and actuaries.
  • Well-developed project management and planning skills, particularly coordinating content and work across multiple partner groups.
  • Advanced degree or bachelor's with equivalent certification in Health Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Actuarial Science, Epidemiology, or a related field is required. Candidates with equivalent experience are encouraged to apply. Ability to travel 10–20% is needed.
  • Experience with recent AI transformation projects is a plus.
  • Project Management, Python (Programming Language), R Programming, Statistical Analysis, Statistical Models, Structured Query Language (SQL), Business Planning, Conflict Resolution, Organizational Leadership, Organizational Strategy, Performance Management (PM), Stakeholder Management, Strategic Planning, Talent Management, Team Development, Team Management, Training and Development, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Analysis, Data Integration, Data Management, Data Mining, Data Modeling, Data Science, Data Visualization, Deep Learning, Language Models, Machine Learning (ML), Predictive Modeling

Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective Clinical Trial solutions for our clients as part of our Life Science Practice Group.

This position will be based in Philadelphia, PA. We are open to considering candidates located in Philadelphia as well as other East Coast states, including but not limited to New York, Charlotte, Boston, and Connecticut (Hartford). This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with a combination of in-office and remote work options.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Responsible for broking/placing primarily Clinical Trials Liability as well Products Liability, Errors & Omissions Liability, and Excess Liability
  • Market new and renewal business, handling all aspects of the placements from initial market selection through the long-term servicing until the clinical trials these policies are covering are over.
  • Demonstrate effective negotiation skills on behalf of clients and prospects.
  • Ensure that placements are handled timely and correctly
  • Develop productive business relationships with key insurance underwriters and Aon local office teams
  • Identify and analyze prospect and client exposures.
  • Coordinate activities with other internal units as required to meet customer needs.
  • Create presentations such as Renewal Strategies and Coverage Proposals.
  • Responsible for planning, scheduling, resourcing and executing complex projects/programs.
  • Frequently interacts with senior level colleagues and clients, normally involving matters between functional areas, other company divisions or units, or clients and the company.

How this opportunity is different

Join Aon's industry-leading team in the Life Sciences sector, where you'll provide innovative Clinical Trial Liability solutions to clients in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with opportunities to work from Philadelphia or other East Coast locations. You'll manage complex insurance placements, build key relationships with underwriters, and contribute to vital clinical trials that support the approval of life-saving drugs and devices. With a focus on collaboration, trust, and professional growth, this is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact in healthcare.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Unlike most insurance programs, the primary purpose of Clinical Trial Liability insurance is to support Pharma and Biotech companies through regulatory approvals and contractual compliance while simultaneously protecting these trial sponsors and their research partners from financial liability in case of injury or harm.

Clinical trials are essential for the approval of new drugs and medical devices, as they provide the data needed to assess safety and efficacy in humans, a requirement for regulatory approval by agencies like the FDA. To generate this volume of data, clinical trials must take place in many countries who closely regulate the activity including the clinical trial liability insurance. Our team of specialized brokers, through global and local insurance partners, provides the necessary local insurance ensuring no trial is ever delayed due to insurance reasons thus supporting our clients in their mission of saving and improving lives.

  • Attention to detail, ability to multi-task, exceptional organizational skills, ability to present complex insurance programs.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of insurance brokerage and/or underwriting experience (preferred Life Sciences in Clinical Trials Liability and/or Casualty Line experience)
  • Effective working knowledge of carrier underwriting practices & processes.
  • Proven client facing skills including effective presentations & communications.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively at various levels in the organization.
  • Ability to independently manage a dynamic book of clients
  • Successfully operates in a fast-paced driven environment that requires the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Must maintain appropriate broker's and Surplus Lines licenses.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry experience.

  • A Property and Casualty Brokers License is required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already active.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Aon values an innovative and inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Aon provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran, marital, domestic partner status, or other legally protected status. People with criminal histories are encouraged to apply.

We welcome applications from all and provide individuals with disabilities with reasonable adjustments to participate in the job application, interview process and to perform essential job functions once onboard. If you would like to learn more about the reasonable accommodations we provide, email ReasonableAccommodations@Aon.com

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

A summary of all the benefits offered for this position:

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions.
