Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are

Lenox Advisors brings together sophisticated solutions in wealth management and insurance services to high-net-worth individuals and their families. As a wholly owned subsidiary of NFP Corp., an Aon Company, we combine the culture of a boutique firm with the stability and backing of a large corporation to create an environment that's truly unique. NFP is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We're a recognized Elite Agency award winner and a leading property and casualty broker, benefits consultant, wealth manager, and retirement plan advisor. NFP provides solutions enabling client success through the expertise of over 8,000 global employees, investments in innovative technologies, and enduring relationships with highly rated insurers, vendors and financial institutions. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Position Summary

Supports the Relationship Manager by scheduling and coordinating activities and initiatives that facilitate the new policy and client service processes. The Client Services Associate must provide superior client service by identifying the client's wants and needs, acting on, and/or delegating items and following through to completion while keeping all parties informed throughout the process.

Responsibilities

Pre-Sale and New Business

  • Assembles meeting preparation documents pertaining to the client/prospect prior to sales meetings, including but not limited to, illustrations, policy and product summaries, reports, presentations, and marketing packets
  • Performs all insurance underwriting duties, including preparation and completion of multi-life and individual disability, life, and long term care applications
  • Schedules medical insurance exams and orders all Attending Physician Statements based on insurance underwriting guidelines
  • Follows up with the client and Relationship Manager during the underwriting process, keeps notes on the process and conversations in MOSAIC
  • Collaborates with the New Business Team to manage all new business arguments using MOSAIC as the system of record for status, notes, and tasks. Communicates with RM and client as necessary.
  • Participates in Relationship Manager/New Business case management calls
  • Reviews insurance policies and prepares them for delivery; follows up on delivery requirements when needed
  • Ensures Relationship Manager has appropriate Licensing and Appointments and works with internal contracting and licensing contact to obtain and renew licenses
  • Partners with Advanced Sales to acquire and/or generate the appropriate illustrations/one-pagers
  • Processes all policy changes including reinstatement of lapsed cases, smoker rating changes, addition or removal of policy riders, and face amount reductions
  • Partners with Private Wealth Management Team to process individual asset management applications, service requests, and performance summaries
  • Coordinates tasks and responsibilities for all joint work

Client Service

  • Processes all insurance policy service requests, including address, beneficiary/ownership changes, premium mode changes, and dividend option changes
  • Provides outstanding client service through recognizing client's wants and needs, acting on, and/or delegating items and following through to completion, keeping all parties informed throughout the process
  • Coordinates all collateral assignments, death or disability claims, and fund allocation changes with the assistance of the Relationship Manager
  • Interacts with insurance carriers and vendors daily to ensure accurate and timely execution of client service requests
  • Takes a proactive lead on conserving the Relationship Manager's existing block of business by advising clients of overdue insurance premiums and coverage in danger of lapsing, tracking all attempts and progress, and keeping the Relationship Manager informed of problematic cases
  • Ability to follow through on a variety of requests and ability to resolve client and/or service related matters.
  • Crafts client correspondence as needed according to the Lenox Style Guide

Business Operations

  • Responsible for greeting clients, fielding phone calls, reviewing incoming mail, managing office supplies, ordering client gifts, and maintaining client files
  • Manages the Relationship Manager's calendar, scheduling and confirming client meetings, registering visitors with security, and booking conference rooms
  • Ensures data accuracy by regularly and routinely updating information in MOSAIC and maintaining client files. This includes, but is not limited to, fact find information and notes, case management (individual and MultiLife), task management, and client and policy information
  • Participates in occasional training and development sessions as directed by department(s) and Regional Manager
  • Builds feeder lists as requested
  • Partners with the Relationship Manager when participating in Lenox marketing campaigns, including MOSAIC list updates as well as updating client email addresses

Job Competencies

Required Knowledge

  • Knowledge of office equipment operations (copier, scanner, printers) and electronic calendaring programs (Microsoft Outlook)
  • Familiarity with business principles and practices
  • Familiarity working with Client Database Management systems
  • Knowledge of customer support principles

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written (email, written memos, telephone, voicemail, etc.)
  • Ability to interact with clients diplomatically and professionally
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast paced sales environment
  • Ability to work independently and also to collaborate with teams
  • Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
  • Organizational, planning and critical thinking skills
  • Ability to multitask

Required Behaviors/Attitudes

  • Demonstrates initiative, dependability, confidences and assertiveness
  • Team oriented; demonstrates a service attitude
  • Cares about delivering quality
  • Excels in planning & organizing
  • Take personal ownership for delivery of superior results; conscientious
  • Demonstrate strong dedication to meeting the needs of internal and external clients

Education/experience/license requirements

Education

  • High School Diploma Required
  • College Degree Preferred

Experience

  • 1-3 Years of Customer Service Experience
  • 3-5 Years of Industry Experience Preferred

What We Offer

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Job Description

Aon Is Looking for A Manager of Claims Operations - Professional Liability

The Manager of Claims Operations with Aon Business Services – Integrated Services and will support our Professional Liability & License Protection Claims function, leads the end-to-end management of professional liability, malpractice, regulatory, and licensing board claims. The role oversees claims administration, Escalation service team support, email customer service, legal coordination, quality, compliance, and team performance. This position serves as a subject matter expert and escalation point for insured professionals facing allegations, investigations, disciplinary actions, or civil liability matters, with a focus on protecting professional licenses, reputations, and financial interests. This position is for a hybrid schedule, in office and remote throughout the week in Fort Washington, PA

***Must have people management experience, preferred in the insurance industry***

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Direct the handling of professional liability and license protection claims from initial notification through resolution
  • Manage Escalation service team support and email customer service, responding to inquiries, resolving issues, providing coverage guidance, and delivering exceptional service in a timely and professional manner
  • Oversee matters involving licensing board complaints, administrative hearings, professional misconduct allegations, malpractice claims, and disciplinary actions
  • Ensure timely claim investigations, coverage reviews, documentation, reserving, and resolution strategies
  • Serve as the escalation point for high-exposure, sensitive, urgent, or complex claims
  • Monitor claim inventory, aging, workloads, service levels, and closure activity
  • Interact with key business stakeholders up to executive level
  • Act as key liaison with carrier partner including complex claim resolution and audit administration
  • Evaluate need for system improvements based on feedback from process owners and operations teams
  • Work with advanced reporting and metrics, provide analysis and report out

Required Experience:

  • 5+ years of business experience preferably in the insurance industry
  • Experience in Team Management, Project Management and Resource Planning
  • Self-starter with operational improvement / mentality
  • Has technical expertise to accomplish complex processes/tasks
  • Experience analyzing complex issues and coming up with creative solutions
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite
  • Strong organizational skills. Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication; both written and verbal
  • Proactive Management Style and consistent follow-through
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment
  • P&C License

Preferred experience:

  • Professional Liability Insurance

Job Description

As part of an industry-leading team, you will help empower results for our clients by delivering innovative and effective Clinical Trial solutions for our clients as part of our Life Science Practice Group.

This position will be based in Philadelphia, PA. We are open to considering candidates located in Philadelphia as well as other East Coast states, including but not limited to New York, Charlotte, Boston, and Connecticut (Hartford). This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with a combination of in-office and remote work options.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Responsible for broking/placing primarily Clinical Trials Liability as well Products Liability, Errors & Omissions Liability, and Excess Liability
  • Market new and renewal business, handling all aspects of the placements from initial market selection through the long-term servicing until the clinical trials these policies are covering are over.
  • Demonstrate effective negotiation skills on behalf of clients and prospects.
  • Ensure that placements are handled timely and correctly
  • Develop productive business relationships with key insurance underwriters and Aon local office teams
  • Identify and analyze prospect and client exposures.
  • Coordinate activities with other internal units as required to meet customer needs.
  • Create presentations such as Renewal Strategies and Coverage Proposals.
  • Responsible for planning, scheduling, resourcing and executing complex projects/programs.
  • Frequently interacts with senior level colleagues and clients, normally involving matters between functional areas, other company divisions or units, or clients and the company.

How this opportunity is different

Join Aon's industry-leading team in the Life Sciences sector, where you'll provide innovative Clinical Trial Liability solutions to clients in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries. This role offers flexibility for hybrid work, with opportunities to work from Philadelphia or other East Coast locations. You'll manage complex insurance placements, build key relationships with underwriters, and contribute to vital clinical trials that support the approval of life-saving drugs and devices. With a focus on collaboration, trust, and professional growth, this is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact in healthcare.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Unlike most insurance programs, the primary purpose of Clinical Trial Liability insurance is to support Pharma and Biotech companies through regulatory approvals and contractual compliance while simultaneously protecting these trial sponsors and their research partners from financial liability in case of injury or harm.

Clinical trials are essential for the approval of new drugs and medical devices, as they provide the data needed to assess safety and efficacy in humans, a requirement for regulatory approval by agencies like the FDA. To generate this volume of data, clinical trials must take place in many countries who closely regulate the activity including the clinical trial liability insurance. Our team of specialized brokers, through global and local insurance partners, provides the necessary local insurance ensuring no trial is ever delayed due to insurance reasons thus supporting our clients in their mission of saving and improving lives.

  • Attention to detail, ability to multi-task, exceptional organizational skills, ability to present complex insurance programs.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of insurance brokerage and/or underwriting experience (preferred Life Sciences in Clinical Trials Liability and/or Casualty Line experience)
  • Effective working knowledge of carrier underwriting practices & processes.
  • Proven client facing skills including effective presentations & communications.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively at various levels in the organization.
  • Ability to independently manage a dynamic book of clients
  • Successfully operates in a fast-paced driven environment that requires the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Must maintain appropriate broker's and Surplus Lines licenses.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry experience.

  • A Property and Casualty Brokers License is required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already active.

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

About Excess Reinsurance

Founded in 1988, Excess Reinsurance was one of the first managing general underwriters in the nation to specialize in stop-loss insurance. Stop-loss insurance helps protect self-funded employers from the financial impact of large and unexpected healthcare claims, placing our actuarial team at the intersection of healthcare, insurance, data analytics, and risk management.

What began as a team of three underwriters has grown into a diverse organization spanning actuarial, underwriting, sales, claims, legal, and operations. Today, Excess Reinsurance underwrites stop-loss coverage for more than 1,000 employer groups annually while remaining guided by four core principles: integrity, stability, innovation, and quality service.

Our sister company, Argo Capital Group, was founded in 1996 to facilitate risk sharing for Excess Reinsurance's partners and clients.

**Candidate selected will be required to attend the office 4x per week**

Summary of the Role:As an Actuarial Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing claims and risk data, developing actuarial models, projecting costs and liabilities, and supporting underwriting and reinsurance decision-making. The role combines technical actuarial work with data analysis to help evaluate risk exposure, pricing, reserves, and program performance.

Essential Duties and Responsabilities:

  • Analyze medical claims, membership, pricing, and underwriting data to identify trends and support business decisions
  • Conduct actuarial research and experience studies, applying actuarial methods to develop and refine pricing assumptions

  • Support the review and ongoing refinement of manual rates, trend assumptions, and other pricing factors
  • Contribute to the development and pricing of new products and benefit offerings

Education and/or Experience:

About this job

Lead Aon's North America Rewards business with full P&L accountability for revenue growth and profitability across mid-market and enterprise segments. Shape strategy, drive market leadership, and oversee large-scale rewards transformations while building and developing a high-performing consulting team.

Good fit if you have extensive total rewards consulting experience, have led a business with P&L accountability, and have established relationships with executive leadership teams.

Full job description

Job Description

Partner, Head of Rewards Advisory, North America

Role Overview

As the Head of Rewards Advisory, North America, you will lead Aon's Rewards business across the region, shaping strategy, driving growth and delivering market-leading rewards solutions to Aon's clients across enterprise and mid-market segments! This role combines deep rewards expertise with strategic business leadership, commercial acumen, and a strong understanding of how total rewards can create measurable value for clients.

In addition to serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams, you will be accountable for the growth, profitability, talent strategy, and market leadership of the North America Rewards practice, while partnering closely with Rewards & Workforce Analytics colleagues to connect rewards, workforce transformation, and talent advisory opportunities across the market!

Key Responsibilities

Practice Leadership & P&L Accountability

  • Lead the North America Rewards business with full accountability for revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, budgeting, resource deployment, and overall business performance across mid-market and enterprise rewards offerings.
  • Develop and implement the strategic vision and growth agenda for the practice, making sure it aligns with broader Human Capital objectives and Aon's business strategy. Coordinate this with the priorities of the North American Talent group.
  • Provide leadership for the continued evolution, positioning, and operational execution of both the mid-market rewards and enterprise rewards solutions, ensuring each offering is clearly differentiated, scalable, and connected to broader client needs.
  • Monitor market trends, client demand, competitive dynamics, and emerging workforce challenges to find opportunities for innovation, expansion, and investment across compensation, total rewards, organizational change, and talent consulting solutions.
  • Drive disciplined business management, operational excellence, and performance accountability across the practice, including active collaboration with the Head of Rewards & Workforce Analytics, NA Talent Solutions on shared growth priorities, integrated offerings, and cross-practice execution.

Business Development & Market Leadership

  • Act as the senior market leader for Rewards in North America, driving the growth of existing client relationships and originating new opportunities with large multinational organizations, middle-market companies, and other priority client segments.
  • Establish trusted advisor relationships with CHROs, CFOs, Boards of Directors, Compensation Committees, and Executive Leadership Teams.
  • Develop and enact go-to-market strategies, drive market visibility, and shape Aon's Rewards value proposition across both mid-market and enterprise client needs.
  • Identify and advance total rewards opportunities with clients, including compensation strategy, benefits integration, wellbeing, recognition, pay transparency, career frameworks, workforce analytics, and broader talent transformation needs.
  • Champion Aon's United model by partnering across Human Capital, Health, Wealth, Risk Capital, and Talent Solutions to deliver integrated client solutions that connect rewards, workforce transformation, and broader talent advisory capabilities.
  • Represent Aon externally through thought leadership, speaking engagements, industry forums, research initiatives, and client events to strengthen the firm's market position in rewards and total rewards advisory.

Client Leadership & Advisory

  • Lead large-scale, enterprise rewards transformations spanning multiple geographies and business units, while also supporting scalable mid-market rewards solutions that meet evolving client needs.
  • Orchestrate complex consulting engagements involving global job architecture, position management, job evaluation, market benchmarking, incentive program development, rewards governance, pay transparency, and total rewards strategy.
  • Advise clients on compensation strategy, pay competitiveness, internal equity, workforce effectiveness, and the broader employee value proposition created through total rewards.
  • Support clients in integrating rewards strategies into broader talent, workforce, analytics, and business transformation initiatives, in partnership with relevant leaders across NA Talent Solutions.

Talent & Team Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of rewards consultants across North America with the capabilities required to serve mid-market and enterprise clients.
  • Drive colleague engagement, capability development, succession planning, and leadership pipeline growth within the practice.
  • Mentor and coach senior leaders and consultants to strengthen commercial insight, consulting excellence, technical expertise, and the ability to identify total rewards opportunities with clients.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and leading from the middle, including strong partnership with the Head of Rewards & Workforce Analytics, NA Talent Solutions and other cross-solution leaders.
  • Ensure effective workforce planning and prioritisation throughout the practice, aligning talent deployment to client demand, growth priorities, and the needs of both mid-market and enterprise rewards solutions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Extensive experience in total rewards consulting or senior in-house rewards leadership within large, complex, multi-national or global organizations, including significant experience advising executive leadership teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading a consulting practice, business unit, or significant portfolio with direct accountability for revenue, profitability, forecasting, and strategic growth across multiple client segments.
  • Proven track record of originating, leading, and closing complex, multi-year consulting engagements and consistently achieving growth objectives in rewards, total rewards, and adjacent talent advisory solutions.
  • Deep expertise in global rewards strategy, compensation program design, incentive plan development, rewards governance, workforce analytics, pay transparency, and talent strategy.
  • Strong commercial and financial competence, including experience managing P&L performance, building scalable market offerings, and driving sustainable business growth.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing high-performing teams, building leadership pipelines, implementing succession strategies, and collaborating across matrixed teams to deliver integrated client solutions.
  • Outstanding executive presence, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with senior stakeholders across complex organizations.
  • Established success navigating global and matrixed environments while leading multiple strategic priorities and delivering exceptional client outcomes.

Full job description

Farmers– where ambition meets opportunity.

Farmers is known for more than its unforgettable jingle – it's a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. Job Summary

This role will lead a team of Integration Engineers, Data Engineers, and Test Engineers in LATAM, partnering closely with the India team to provide continuity of IT delivery and support across locations. The role will serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, developing a strong understanding of business capabilities, priorities, processes, and outcomes and translating them into effective technology solutions. The individual will have end-to-end ownership of technology solutions supporting assigned business capabilities, including solutions delivered through vendor platforms, and will be accountable for ensuring they meet business needs, architectural direction, quality expectations, and operational requirements.

This leader is expected to operate independently, lead technical teams through influence, constructively challenge proposed solutions when appropriate, and drive decisions toward the best business and technology outcome. The role will also partner with technical leadership and functional Centers of Excellence (COEs) to ensure delivery teams consistently follow established engineering, architecture, integration, data, testing, security, and operational standards.

Essential Job Functions

Business & Solution Ownership

  • Develop a strong understanding of assigned business capabilities, processes, priorities, and outcomes, working closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technology solutions.
  • Act as the end-to-end technology owner for assigned business capabilities, maintaining accountability across solution design, integration, data, testing, implementation, production support, and ongoing evolution.
  • Ensure technology solutions address the underlying business need, rather than simply implementing individual requirements or vendor capabilities.
  • Maintain a holistic view of the solution across internal systems, integrations, data flows, vendor platforms, and operational processes.

Technical Leadership & Challenge

  • Provide technical leadership across delivery teams, ensuring proposed solutions are fit for purpose, scalable, supportable, secure, and aligned with enterprise technology direction.
  • Review and constructively challenge technical designs, estimates, vendor recommendations, implementation approaches, and delivery decisions when they do not sufficiently address business needs or established technical standards.
  • Lead technical teams through influence rather than organizational authority, creating alignment across engineering, data, integration, testing, architecture, operations, and vendor teams.
  • Drive technical decisions and facilitate resolution when multiple teams, technologies, or vendors are involved in delivering a business capability.

Vendor Solution Ownership

  • Own the overall solution outcome even when significant components are delivered by third-party vendors, ensuring accountability does not stop at the vendor or platform boundary.
  • Evaluate vendor solutions in the context of the broader business capability, including integration, data, security, supportability, resiliency, and operational impact.
  • Hold vendors and internal delivery teams accountable for meeting agreed technical standards, solution requirements, quality expectations, and delivery commitments.
  • Ensure vendor capabilities are appropriately integrated into the enterprise technology landscape rather than treated as standalone solutions.

COE & Engineering Standards

  • Partner with technical leadership and relevant Centers of Excellence (COEs) to understand established architecture, engineering, integration, data, testing, security, and operational standards.
  • Ensure delivery teams consistently apply COE standards, approved patterns, reusable components, and engineering practices.
  • Identify and escalate deviations from established standards, working with technical leadership to determine when exceptions are justified.
  • Provide feedback to COEs based on delivery experience to help evolve standards and practices where appropriate.

Delivery & Operational Accountability

  • Maintain end-to-end accountability from business need through design, build, testing, implementation, stabilization, and production support.
  • Proactively identify dependencies, technical risks, delivery constraints, and cross-team impacts and drive them to resolution.
  • Balance business priorities, technical quality, delivery timelines, cost, and operational risk when making or influencing solution decisions.
  • Ensure solutions transition effectively into production with appropriate documentation, controls, monitoring, support processes, and knowledge transfer.

Physical Actions

Physical Environment

Education Requirements

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent, relevant experience.

Experience Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience working as a Solution Engineer
  • Strong understanding of Mulesoft
  • Experience working with cloud environments like AWS
  • Experience working with Vendors managing integrations
  • Strong integration and data experience

Special Skill Requirement

Additional Qualification

  • Experience working with Dremio & CDGC

Benefits

This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. While specific benefits may vary by country and employee level, offerings generally include competitive salary opportunities, performance-based bonuses, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing training and development resources.

Important Hiring Conditions and Disclosures

By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:

• Personal Data Processing: The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies.

• Legal Authorization to Work: Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated.

• Exclusivity of Employment and Conflict of Interest: Upon acceptance of an offer and during employment with FBS, employees will not be permitted to engage in parallel employment, professional activities, or paid work for other entities. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise.

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.

Landscape Services Technician supporting grounds maintenance, snow removal, and outdoor care at Farmers Insurance corporate office in Caledonia, MI. Role includes landscaping tasks, equipment operation, chemical application, and seasonal snow removal with flexible winter scheduling.

Good fit if you have a high school diploma, experience in landscaping or irrigation, and can obtain state pesticide applicator certification.

Full job description

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

This role supports and maintains a sustainable, landscaping, snow removal and outdoor maintenance program. Performs day-to-day landscaping and maintenance activities at one or all of three or more separate locations or a campus environment.

Shift Hours & Location

  • This role is an essential onsite role in Caledonia, MI.
  • Shift hours generally will be 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; Monday - Friday.
  • Pls note: shift hours will have to adjust during the Winter season, depending on when snow accumulations takes place.
    • This could include working weekends and the opportunity for overtime.

To apply: https://jobs.farmersinsurance.com/job-invite/36435/

Essential Job Functions

  • Performs tasks common to the care of grounds and landscapes by seeding, watering, mulching, fertilizing, and applying chemicals to outside plantings, lawns and turf, transplanting; inspecting plant materials for insects, disease, physical and mechanical damage to irrigation systems and identifying replacements; transplanting, pruning, trimming, and cultivating trees, shrubs, ground cover, and flowers; pest management; storing and caring for bulbs and cuttings in the winter season.
  • Performs regular and directed grounds and landscape maintenance by mowing lawns with riding or push mowers; trimming and edging around trees, shrubs, ground cover, flowers, sidewalks and buildings; weeding, thinning, and cleaning flower beds and other grounds by hand or utilizing proper tools and equipment; and setting up, adjusting, repairing, and cleaning irrigation systems.
  • Operates light and medium equipment in the winter months to clear snow from parking lots, sidewalks, and other traversed areas. As part of the snow removal program, candidate must be available to work differing shifts depending on when snow accumulations take place.
  • Applies chemicals used in grounds keeping (horticulture, turf management, and floriculture) properly and safely by wearing prescribed protective clothing, masks, and/or rubber gloves and boots, following either written or verbal directions for mixing chemical compounds according to specifications, applying the chemicals properly on grounds and landscapes designated for their use, and disposing of residual chemical products as directed or storing and labeling them for future use.
  • Documents a record of grounds and landscape watering and chemical spraying by keeping daily logs of areas watered and duration of watering and the application of chemicals, including areas sprayed, amount and type of chemicals used, substances sprayed and reason, and the wind speed and direction at time of spraying.
  • Safely operates light and medium duty vehicles such as pick-up trucks, tractors, loaders, skid steers, street sweepers or riding mowers.
  • Operates portable power tools and equipment such as saws, grass trimmers, snow/leaf blowers, sprayers, paint machines and other grounds keeping equipment.
  • Obeys applicable traffic laws, follows operator instructions, and wears appropriate safety items such as goggles, gloves, or other appropriate protective clothing.
  • Ensures grounds maintenance equipment and building maintenance equipment are operational by performing routine and preventative maintenance and cleaning of tools, equipment and machines within reasonable capabilities.
  • Maintains record of mechanical equipment operations, building/landscape maintenance, and vendor service visits.
  • Initiates or advises needs for purchases requisitions, verifies receipt of services or product or service.
  • Responsible for the inspection, maintenance, and repair of the campus grounds and out buildings.
  • Responsible for recommending modifications of the grounds systems including electrical, lighting, plumbing, painting and remodeling and irrigation systems, pumps, ponds, drainage and grading of terrain.
  • As needed, consults and reports any security related matters to leadership as well as Corporate Security.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Licensed by state Department of Agriculture as a certified applicator or handler of insecticides, herbicides, and fungicides where required or a willingness to obtain such certifications within the first year.
  • 1-3 years experience in the landscaping or irrigation industry preferred.
  • Medium/heavy equipment operation will be preferred. This will involve operating a large tractor for snow removal in the wintertime, skid steers, mowers, etc, throughout the rest of the year.

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills including written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated customer service skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and team building skills.
  • Friendly and service-oriented; maintains professionalism at all times.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude; proficient in Microsoft applications.
  • Strong mechanical skills; knowledgeable and skilled in the safe use and maintenance of hand tools, power tools, user-moved aids, mechanical equipment and measuring devices.

Physical Actions

Requires ability to perform physical actions, primarily outdoors, such as frequent walking and standing on feet for long periods of time, maneuvering different terrain, bending, stooping, pushing, pulling, climbing, and using a ladder. Ability to lift up to 50lbs.

Physical Environment

Exposure to noise and extreme temperatures, exposure to hazards such as chemicals and paint.

Benefits

Job Summary

  • This is for a person with expertise in product execution. This role supports the rate setting process which is the most important driver of our business results.
  • The role leads large scale processes and drives process improvement.
  • You will be leading a team working on specific markets or countrywide efforts that is responsible for supporting profitable growth of the business; assignments are generally larger and more complex than Product Managers.

  • Performs work independently with limited guidance. May manage a team of Product Managers and Analysts.

Essential Job Functions

  • Demonstrates an expertise in the principles of product management, filing process, quoting platforms and systems, knowledge management, underwriting guidelines and defining data requirements in support of the profit and growth of the business.
  • Demonstrates understanding of how the rate order of calculation works.
  • Able to guide their team's ability to navigate the organization's processes (filing, IT programming/delivery/testing, compliance, underwriting, regulatory) to influence the timeline and sequencing of both rate and non-rate initiatives that drive and influence business results. Demonstrates ability to proactively guide team's management of complex rate and non-rate initiatives.
  • Proactively works with key business partners to drive complex process improvements across the organization. Provides guidance to Product Managers and analysts on ways to optimize product changes, project implementation, and underwriting guideline updates.
  • Provides guidance for scheduling and deployment of rate revisions, multi-state product initiatives, and non-rate projects, ensuring alignment across impacted states and teams. Owns scheduling and deployment of complex rate revisions, multi-state product initiatives, and non-rate initiatives, ensuring alignment across impacted states.
  • Provides direction and guidance for all stages of the rate execution, filing process, compliance and regulatory, rate and non-rate initiatives, and timeline and sequencing.
  • Regulatory expert for assigned market or product.
  • Influences key business partners and leadership on complex rate and non-rate timeline and sequencing.
  • Demonstrates expertise of competitor product structure, underwriting rules, systems and quoting platforms. Provides direction and guidance on competitor research into compliance and regulatory changes.
  • Develops training and onboarding plan and responsible for consistent development of team members related to key processes and progression. Responsible for leading the hiring and onboarding process of new team members.
  • Escalation owner for complex or high-impact product issues.
  • Review team recommendations and facilitate presentations with leaders and business partners regarding proposed product or underwriting rule changes.
  • Business owner of complex interactions and negotiation for proposed product or underwriting rule changes with departments of insurance and other regulatory entities.
  • Able to drive and coach team prioritization.
  • Able to leverage extensive network with key internal business partners.
  • Responsible for escalation resolution and leadership communication of complex structured and unstructured problems impacting the Product team.

Physical Actions

Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

  • Bachelor's degree with focus in Business, or Research such as Economics, Business Administration, Marketing, Risk Management preferred.

Experience Requirements

Additional Qualification

Job.JobTitle: Inside Auto Claims Adjuster - Hybrid (Uniondale, NY)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Inside Auto Claims Adjuster is responsible for investigating basic and occasionally moderately complex auto insurance claims. This role may handle non-represented claims and requires evaluating coverage, determining liability, and negotiating settlements. The adjuster works directly with claimants, insureds, and other involved parties to ensure timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim resolution.

Work Location & Schedule


Projected Start Date: January 11, 2027


During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:45pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Hours: MondayFriday between 8:00 AM 5:30 PM, with occasional Saturday
  • Work Arrangement: Hybrid schedule 3 days in office (Tuesday-Thursday), 2 days remote (Monday, Friday)

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Investigate minor to moderately complex auto accidents and prepare clear, concise claim summaries.
  • Conduct recorded statements with claimants, insureds, and witnesses.
  • Evaluate auto claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages.
  • Negotiate and settle claims in alignment with established guidelines and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed and well-documented claim files, including notes, summaries, and decision rationale.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support efficient and customer-centric claim handling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of prior claim handling experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with solid critical-thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable using technology and learning claims-related software and tools.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington, and Hawaii residents.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets.
  • All required licenses must be obtained within 60 days of hire.
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal.
  • This role offers a $1,000 sign on bonus if you have an active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state.
  • Current employees and former employees seeking rehire at Allstate or its affiliated companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

What You Need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What Allstate Provides:

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitor, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset a portion of your internet costs.

Allstate Benefits:

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives
  • Allstate Foundation donation match and grant opportunities

Skills

Liability Analysis

Basecompensationoffered for this role is $50,000-$60,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Experience: 4+ years

About this job

Digital Product Manager role at Allstate leading strategy and lifecycle management for billing and payments platform capabilities. Requires partnering across engineering, design, and business teams to drive customer-centric financial experiences and measurable outcomes.

Good fit if you have 4+ years managing technical products with strong billing or payments platform experience and ability to partner closely with engineering teams.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Technical Product Manager is responsible for defining product strategy, shaping vision, and driving measurable customer and business outcomes for one or more technical products within Allstates Billing and Payments ecosystem. This role owns the direction, prioritization, and lifecycle of complex platform capabilities that enable accurate, reliable, scalable, and customer-centric financial experiences.

This leader partners closely with engineering, design, architecture, data, finance, and business stakeholders to identify problems worth solving, validate opportunities through discovery, and translate strategy into a clear roadmap and prioritized backlog. Success in this role requires strong product judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to balance long-term platform health with near-term delivery and business value.

The ideal candidate is a strong product strategist with deep technical fluency, a data-driven mindset, and experience managing enterprise-scale billing, payments, or financial platforms.

Key responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a technical product or platform within Billing and Payments.

  • Own product outcomes byestablishingsuccess measures, tracking performance, and using data to inform prioritization and strategic tradeoffs.

  • Lead discovery, framing, and test-and-learn activities tovalidatecustomer, business, and operational assumptions before scaling solutions.

  • Partner deeply with engineering to shape platform direction, evaluate architectural and operational tradeoffs, and prioritize work across features, defects, resiliency, and technical debt.

  • Translate complex business and customer problems into well-sequenced product investments with clear value, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Represent the voice of the customer, user, and enterprise by combining customer insight, market context, operational signals, and internal stakeholder needs.

  • Drive alignment across business, technology, design, and operational partners to deliver high-impact solutions and ensure successful adoption.

  • Manage and prioritize the backlog to support iterative delivery while preserving focus on strategic outcomes rather than output alone.

  • Author, refine, test, and accept stories as needed to enable effective execution by the product team.

  • Communicate product direction, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.

Essential Skills:

  • A minimum of4 years of product management experience leading technical products, platforms, APIs, services, data products, or developer experiences.

  • Strong experience in billing, payments, or adjacent financial platforms, preferably within insurance or another highly regulated financial environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with engineering and architecture teams on systems thinking, service design, integration patterns, data flows, reliability, and scalability.

  • Proventrack recordof defining strategy and using metrics to drive prioritization, decision-making, and measurable outcomes.

  • Experience leading discovery and experimentation tovalidateassumptions and improve product direction.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience withcustomerfacing financial flows where accuracy, auditability, resiliency, and operational excellence are critical.

  • Experience using analytics, automation, or AI/ML in pragmatic product use cases such as anomaly detection, operational efficiency, explainability, or decision support.

  • Experience working across multiple teams or products in a complex enterprise platform environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This role does not have direct people-managementresponsibilities butenjoys the highest level of ownership and autonomy.

Skills

Business Case Analyses, Business Outcomes, Customer Insights, Digital Products, Product Development, Product Direction, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Vision, Software Product Management, Systems Thinking, Waterfall Model

Compensation offered for this role is 110,000.00 - 181,025.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobTitle: Field Auto Damage Appraiser - Nassau County
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Experience: 3 to 5 years
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Field-based auto damage appraiser for Allstate Insurance in Nassau County. You'll meet customers on-site to assess vehicle damage, write estimates, and guide them through the repair or total loss process using in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication.

Good fit if you have 3-5 years of auto collision estimating experience with CCC or Mitchell software and a valid driver's license.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, solving problems, and making a real impact for customers? As a Field Auto Appraiser, you'll be at the forefront of our claims processmeeting customers where they are, whether it's at their home, a repair shop, or a tow yard.

You'll take the lead in writing estimates and guiding customers through the repair or total loss process, using a mix of in-person visits, virtual inspections, and written communication. No two days are the samewhether you're evaluating damage on-site or collaborating with body shops and service providers, you'll enjoy a fast-paced, hands-on role that keeps you engaged and on your toes.

If you're looking for a career that blends technical know-how, customer service, and the freedom of field work, this is your chance to thrive in a role where your expertise truly matters.


Sign-On Bonus: A $5,000 sign-on bonus may be offered to qualified candidates who receive and accept an employment offer. Eligibility, payment timing, and conditions will be outlined in the official offer letter.


Preferred Qualifications

  • You have 3-5 years' experience in auto collision estimating using CCC or Mitchell
  • You have a High School Diploma or a GED
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to write precise and comprehensive estimates
  • Comfortable with utilizing technology and various platforms for claims processing
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills to manage multiple assignments effectively
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements

A day in the life of the Field Auto Damage Appraiser, and what it takes to do the job!

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Your Eye for Detail Keeps Everything on Track- In this role, youll ensure claims are documented accurately and in line with policy agreements. As you handle each case, youll maintain clear, timely records in our claims system (which well train you on). Your attention to detail helps keep the process smooth, organized, and transparent from start to finish.

Work Location

  • This position is a field-based role.To be eligible for this role, you must be located in the following locations: Nassau County - Long Island, NY

Company Car
Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.


Training:

The first approximately eight weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.


Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters' and/or appraisers' license in multiple markets
  • All required licenses will need to be obtained within 60 days of hire
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal
  • This role offers a sign on bonus of $1,000 if you have an active appraiser license or active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state (current employees and candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus)

Benefits

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our offerings:

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of higher exposure cases and more complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the independent handling of a caseload of higher exposure cases and most complex litigation matters, including Major Case and Complex Claim depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including independent responsibility for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Initiate special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 7+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Strong aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Advanced oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Excels in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates strong leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 7 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Travelers Investigative Services provides industry-first resources designed to detect and deter fraudulent claims. Using some of the most comprehensive technology available, we have the abilities and expertise to identify potential risks and combat fraudulent practices. As an SIU Investigator, you will analyze, summarize and prioritize information to uncover potentially fraudulent activity. The investigator, supporting a Claim Center, will investigate claims deemed suspicious in nature within all lines of business. The investigator will conduct thorough and comprehensive investigations in a dynamic, fast paced environment.

***Ideal candidate must live or reside in Las Vegas or surrounding area****

What Will You Do?

  • Conducts insurance investigations including applicable data base searches with a focus on uncovering all potentially fraudulent aspects of a claim. Periodically engages in specialized investigative area, including Medical, Cyber, Cargo, Fire Motive & Opportunity, etc.
  • Analyzes, monitors and summarizes technical information into actionable investigative strategies. Applies the techniques of critical thinking to dismantle complex problems and reasoning through to its logical conclusion.
  • Provides exceptional customer service by maintaining contact with business partners, customers and external resources throughout the life of each investigation, including liaison network with claim, legal, underwriting partners, public officials, law enforcement officers and others to obtain assistance in conducting investigations.
  • Serves as the subject matter expert (liaison) on fraud to business and industry partners.
  • Applies rules of evidence; recognizes evidence and determines its value to specific claim, evidence collection and interpretation.
  • Applies Local, State and Federal statutes to ensure investigations are carried out within the requirements of applicable law and local office expectations.
  • Identifies cases for potential insurance fraud prosecution and submits questionable claims to the National Insurance Crime Bureau.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to use and interpret information and facts as well as apply critical techniques to investigative process.
  • Strong case management skills and the ability to manage your own work independently.
  • Ability to work in a high volume, fast paced environment managing multiple shifting priorities.
  • Influence and conflict management skills
  • Working level knowledge of insurance and claim operations, Commercial Lines, Personal Lines, and Workers Compensation insurance products.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of investigative experience or a minimum of three years insurance claim or underwriting or legal related experience.

About this job

Senior Network Engineer at Church Mutual Insurance in Merrill, Wisconsin. Provides technical leadership for enterprise network infrastructure across routing, switching, security, cloud, and communications, mentoring junior engineers while managing complex design, implementation, and incident response.

Good fit if you have 7-10+ years hands-on network engineering experience, advanced voice and collaboration expertise, and can lead technical initiatives and mentor others.

Full job description

BASIC PURPOSE:

The Senior Network Engineer provides technical leadership for enterprise network infrastructure, driving architecture standards, design improvements, and alignment with business objectives. This role leads complex network design, implementation, troubleshooting, and optimization across routing, switching, security, cloud, and enterprise connectivity (voice, data, wireless, and collaboration), while ensuring high availability through proactive monitoring, rapid incident response, and effective disaster recovery planning. The position also mentors junior engineers and requires deep cross-domain expertise with the ability to lead hands-on technical work and resolve complex incidents. Individuals unable to do so will not meet expectations.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, implement, and support complex enterprise network and communications solutions (voice, data, video, wireless)
  • Lead complex troubleshooting efforts and root cause analysis for network, voice, and collaboration incidents
  • Oversee network operations and lead response to high-impact incidents, ensuring timely resolution and service restoration
  • Guide incident triage and escalation efforts, contributing to improvements in response processes
  • Architect and optimize multi-domain network solutions across routing, switching, security, cloud, and unified communications
  • Analyze network performance data (telemetry, logs, packet captures, VoIP metrics) to identify trends and drive improvements
  • Lead implementation and integration of new technologies across on-premises and cloud environments
  • Support and enhance network architecture standards, configurations, and documentation practices
  • Drive capacity planning, performance tuning, and lifecycle management to ensure scalability and reliability
  • Partner with vendors and stakeholders to design, implement, and improve network and communication solutions
  • Lead infrastructure-related projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and architectural standards
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to engineers, supporting skill development and problem resolution
  • Support IT service management processes, disaster recovery planning, and continuous improvement initiatives

 

Level Expectations (Performance and Scope Indicators)

The following outlines how performance is evaluated at this level. These are not additional job responsibilities, but indicators of scope, autonomy, impact, and influence expected of this role.

Scope: Leads major initiatives, projects, and engineering workstreams across multiple domains. Serves as subject-matter expert for technical architecture, and ensures alignment with enterprise standards, investigation methodology, and enterprise tooling.

Autonomy: Operates with high autonomy. Makes technical decisions, designs solutions, and resolves complex issues. Escalates only when strategic trade-offs or cross-team impacts arise.

Impact: Shapes network and telecommunications capabilities across the entire organization. Defines engineering patterns, raises maturity levels, and drives large-scale improvements that reduce risk and improve operational efficiency.

People Influence: Mentors less experienced team members. Leads technical project teams. Provides input into workforce capability development. Influences Architecture, Infrastructure, and Operations as a subject matter expert.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • Degree in Computer Science, Networking, Telecommunications, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent work experience;7-10+ years hands-on experience.
  • Proven leadership in Network Engineering and architecture.
  • Ability to design and maintain enterprise systems and automation workflows.
  • Advanced experience with Networking, Voice Technologies and Collaboration systems at engineering depth.
  • Ability to act as escalation point for complex, multi-vector incidents.
  • Expertise across endpoint, cloud, network, and data security domains.

Technical Competencies

  • Capability to evaluate and improve network and voice architecture.
  • Ability to drive technical initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination.
  • Design and Implementation experience in voice, data communications, contact center technologies, and video conferencing.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, H.323, and other VoIP protocols.
  • In-depth understanding of communication protocols and routing protocols.
  • Solid background in network administration and architecture.

Preferred

  • Cisco CCNA or CCNP or CCDP – Voice/Collaboration certification a plus.
  • Experience influencing enterprise architecture and leadership decision-making.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Office

  • Professional office environment. Regularly uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.
  • Regularly required to communicate; sit; stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
  • Supervisory Responsibilities – None
  • CM Group Office – Hybrid

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, is seeking a Regional Small Commercial Sales Manager to lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of small commercial producers. In this role, youll drive regional sales, retention, and customer satisfaction by developing agents, strengthening carrier partnerships, and promoting excellence across sales and service. Youll also have the opportunity to help shape Comparions growing small commercial business while advancing your leadership career.

Territory and travel
This role supports the Southeast region, covering Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, and West Virginia. Youll recruit, onboard, coach, and support commercial sales professionals across the region and help drive commercial growth.

The position involves approximately 60% travel within the territory. Travel may include visits to team locations, recruiting events, agent or client meetings, carrier partners, and regional business or community events. Candidates should be comfortable with frequent regional travel.

We are seeking candidates based in Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, or West Virginia.

The successful candidate will be eligible to earn variable compensation of up to 50% of base salary in 2026, contingent upon achieving designated key performance measures.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of small commercial producers to meet or exceed new-business, retention, premium growth, and profitability goals.
  • Provide strategic guidance to expand and optimize the agency, identifying and evaluating new market and business opportunities
  • Support agents through the sales cycle: advise on policy types, effective coverage, renewals, policy changes, and complex submissions/renewals.
  • Drive new business development by coaching agents on lead follow-up, cross-selling, prospect cultivation, and referral strategies.
  • Act as a primary liaison among agents, clients, and internal teams to ensure clear communication and timely resolution of post-enrollment issues.
  • Maintain and strengthen carrier relationships in partnership with Relationship Managers to enhance product access and service.
  • Oversee local marketing and community networking initiatives to ensure strong market penetration.
  • Ensure high service levels (on-time renewals, prompt certificate issuance, timely responses to client inquiries) and instill accountability for SLAs across the team.
  • Recruit, staff, and manage personnel levels to align with business needs.
  • Monitor and analyze performance metrics (retention, premium growth, loss ratios, revenue per producer) to identify opportunities, trends, and obstacles; provide data-driven coaching and action plans.
  • Mentor, conduct performance reviews, and deliver ongoing feedback to support career development and goal attainment.
  • Stay current on small commercial industry trends, products, and regulatory changes affecting clients and carriers.

What we offer:

  • Competitive base salary with meaningful performance-based upside (variable compensation up to 50% of base salary).
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision; 401(k) with company match; paid time off
  • Eligibility for a company fleet vehicle for qualified employees
  • Professional development, ongoing training, and tuition assistance.
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs, employee discounts and other voluntary benefits.
  • Opportunity for career growth within Comparion and a collaborative, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.
  • A leadership role with visible impact, autonomy, and the ability to influence product, process and market strategy.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of commercial lines products and services; proven success with prior sales or related experience required.
  • Must possess highly effective oral and written communication skills, including group and individual presentation, persuasion, negotiation and customer service skills.
  • Requires excellent organizational skills, effective time management, strong leadership, interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Incumbents must have, or be able to secure, a current state license, in property, casualty and life insurance.
  • Prior supervisory experience helpful
