Description

We are looking for an Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Edina, MN office. This is not a remote position.

Were Hiring Immediately!

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in driving profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen actively and empathize with customers will be key, as you will serve as their initial point of contact. Success in this role requires building a strong local network and developing meaningful, in-person relationships within the community.

Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means being part of an organization committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. Are you ready to discover what it means to work for an agency backed by Liberty Mutual, a Fortune 100 company committed to putting people first, acting responsibly, and making a positive impact?

Responsibilities

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect for and generate new business opportunities.
  • Assist with the processing of new business, including contacting customers to finalize sales and service transactions.
  • Identify cross-selling opportunities and refer them to the Sales Agent.
  • Contribute to and help execute marketing plans in partnership with the Sales Agent.
  • Identify mass-marketing prospects through the existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly new business sales goals.
  • Conduct follow-up activities on new policies to maintain high retention rates and maximize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinate with other departments to ensure a high level of customer service.
  • Serve as the initial point of contact for customer inquiries and concerns regarding policy establishment and new account status.
  • Unlicensed candidates will be enrolled in a new-hire training program upon joining Comparion. This program includes licensing preparation, with Comparion covering the cost of training materials and licensing exam fees.

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS. Must reside in the state of Illinois.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

Pay Details

  • The typical training salary is $55k - $65k
  • Through a combination of base, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, typical total first year compensation ranges from $55k - $75k
  • Potential for top performers to earn over $100k in their first year

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Qualifications

Day One Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

Licensing:

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired (P&C and Life).

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS. Must reside in the state of Illinois.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

Pay Details

  • The typical training salary is $55k - $65k
  • Through a combination of base, bonuses, and uncapped commissions, typical total first year compensation ranges from $55k - $75k

  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.

Description

Come join the Specialty Product team! We're focused on achieving profitable growth for US Retail Markets by building innovative products that meet evolving customer and agent needs, and we own the P&L for a niche but high-value part of the portfolio. This role will align to our Motorcycle, RV, Watercraft, and Classic Car products. It's a segment where customers are passionate about what they own, and where getting the product right takes curiosity and creativity. As a Specialty Product Analyst, you'll dig into performance data, oversee product changes and initiatives, and work closely with underwriting, actuarial, and regulators to innovate, influence, and collaborate across the business. This role has a high degree of influence as your analysis directly shapes how we compete and helps set the strategy for where we go next and how we win in this market.

Responsibilities:

  • Performs high complexity analyses under minimal direction to evaluate business performance and identify trends and issues in assigned product line; makes actionable recommendations for improvements.
  • Influences the direction of and implements adapted country-wide or state-level initiatives and conducts high level analyses to support strategic direction of assigned product line.
  • Independently manages projects of low to moderate complexity. Presents LOB reviews, other high complexity analyses and results of countrywide initiatives to Product managers.
  • Queries data to conduct ad hoc analysis of metrics and answer advanced business questions and builds advanced tools and queries for others to use. Serves as point person for high complexity country wide implementations.
  • Based on strong understanding of how competitor actions impact marketplace, distribution channel and customers, conducts in depth research of competitor filings utilizing various sources.
  • Research may be at the state, competitor or countrywide level. Through research, identifies and proposes changes to our product offerings.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or other quantitative field. Minimum 3 years, typically 4 years or more of relevant work experience.
  • Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis software (e.g., SAS, Access).
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, decision making and communication skills.

About this job

Staff Attorney for Liberty Mutual Insurance managing moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims up to $50,000 exposure. Position is primarily remote in California, requiring independent case management, legal strategy development, and mentoring of junior attorneys.

Good fit if you have 5+ years trial attorney experience, California bar admission, insurance law background, and proficiency with e-discovery tools.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of California except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If youre looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual is seeking a skilled and proactive Attorney to independently manage moderately complex civil litigation matters. This role requires a deep understanding of legal principles and insurance law, strategic case management, advanced technology utilization, and strong clientrelationship skills. The Attorney will develop and execute sophisticated legal strategies, lead settlement negotiations, mentor junior attorneys, and contribute to organizational improvements while maintaining the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Management and Execution: Independently manage all phases of litigation involving claims of moderate to heavy value (up to approximately $50,000 exposure). Conduct comprehensive legal research, draft precise pleadings, motions, and other legal documents. Lead settlement negotiations and participate in hearings, trials, and mediations to achieve optimal case outcomes.
  • Litigation Support: Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Legal Strategy Development: Develop, implement, and continuously refine advanced legal strategies for discovery, investigation, and trial preparation.
  • Technology Utilization: Employ advanced e-discovery tools, case management systems, and data analysis software to streamline workflows and reduce costs.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear, well-reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to clients and Claims Representatives. Build and sustain trusted relationships by understanding client operations and legal challenges.
  • Risk Evaluation and Mitigation: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with cases in collaboration with clients and senior attorneys.
  • Training, Mentoring, and Leadership: Design and conduct training sessions and workshops for Legal, Claims, and related departments. Mentor junior attorneys and legal support staff, offering guidance and direction to elevate team performance.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with relevant laws, regulations, and company policies. Adhere strictly to ethical guidelines, licensing requirements, and the Model Rules of Professional Conduct (MRPC).
  • Organizational Improvement and Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities for process automation and workflow enhancements.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Californiaand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of successful trial attorney experience, preferably within insurance law and related litigation.
  • Proven experience managing moderately complex litigation with demonstrated success in achieving favorable outcomes.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation
  • Exceptional legal research, writing, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficient in advanced e-discovery tools, legal case management software, and remote collaboration technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and lead junior attorneys and legal staff.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Commitment to ethical legal practice and compliance with all regulatory and professional standards.

Description

We are seeking an experienced Middle Market Senior Underwriter to underwrite commercial property & casualty risks in the middle market segment. As an individual contributor, you will make analytical, data-driven underwriting decisions within delegated authority, with limited guidance from leadership. You will evaluate and price moderately complex to complex accounts (including high individual line sizes and unusual exposures in parts of North America), manage broker and client relationships, and help shape product and portfolio strategy for your line of business.

To be considered for this role, candidates must reside within the specified geographic location. This position requires regular in-person visits with local brokers and agents, so remote hires outside the designated territory cannot be accommodated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Underwrite middle market commercial accounts within assigned authority by assessing submissions, reviewing coverage terms, exposures, loss history, financials, and supporting information to determine accept/decline, terms, and pricing.
  • Make independent, data-driven decisions on risk selection and pricing consistent with underwriting appetite and profitability objectives.
  • Coordinate referrals for accounts above individual authority or that require specialized support.
  • Manage a portfolio of brokers, agents, and insureds:
  • Maintain and grow relationships with producing brokers and agents; act as a visible Liberty representative in the market.
  • Develop targeted broker strategies to source profitable middle market business and expand market share.
  • Provide timely, clear responses to brokers and clients; negotiate coverage and terms while protecting portfolio profitability.
  • Underwrite higher-limit, complex, or unusual submissions typical to middle market clients (specialty exposures, large single-location risks, multi-location schedules, or industry-specific hazards).
  • Engageinternal partners (Claims, Actuarial, Risk Control, Legal) to structure appropriate terms and risk mitigation plans.
  • Mentor and coach junior underwriters and new hires on middle market underwriting practices, decision-making, and Liberty processes
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Full job description


Description

Launch Your Auto Claims Career with a Fortune 100 Company!

No Claims Experience Needed, Paid Training & Licensing Included!

Location: Naperville, IL
Applicants must live within 50 miles of the office.

  • Minimum 2 in-office days per month
  • Additional in-person training during the first 6 months
  • Start Date: January 11, 2027

Career Opportunity:

Do you thrive in a high-volume, fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy the challenge of a role where no two days are alike? We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate customer service professionals. Qualities like these cannot be taught, but they can be sharpened, strengthened and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as an Auto Claims Representative.

As a licensed claims adjuster, you will be fulfilling the promise we made to our customers when they purchased their policy by working with those who have been in an auto accident and need our help. In this role, you will guide our insureds and claimants through the auto claims process from start to finish. There are many moving pieces you will manage. You need to have strong organizational skills and be a time management expert, love problem solving and helping others. Your job is speaking to and engaging customers who have just been in an accident and need your help, this is where the passion for service comes into play. We strive to treat our customers as we would want to be treated!

Learn more about this role:A Day in the Life of an Auto-Physical Claims Adjuster

Youd be a great fit if you are:

An Empathetic Service Professional:When a claim is received, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your customer centricity and problem-solving skills to confidently assure our customers that you are there to guide them through the process.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in delivering on our promise.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules and the varying needs of our customers.

A Customer-Centric Claims Representative:Integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that customers get exactly what they paid for and need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • An engaging, outgoing personality and passion for helping customers
  • Able to think critically, use resources and seek answers when needed in virtual environment
  • Excellent oral, written, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing and multi-tasking capabilities in a structured paperless work environment
  • Requires strong working knowledge and ability to utilize multiple systems during virtual training and to handle/process claims.
  • General understanding of overall claim operations and key stakeholders.
  • College degree preferred, and/or 1-3 years of related customer service experience or applicable insurance knowledge.
  • Only open to US based employees.

Description

Senior Builders Risk Underwriter

Underwrites Builders Risk policies within established underwriting authority, with limited guidance from leadership. Makes analytical, data-driven decisions on new and renewal business, including evaluating project-specific exposures, structuring coverage, and pricing risks appropriately. Assesses complex construction and renovation projects, including risks with significant values, challenging locations, unusual construction methods, or high individual line sizes.

Responsibilities

  • Manages a portfolio of brokers, agents, contractors, developers, owners, and other construction-related clients while developing profitable Builders Risk business for Liberty Mutual.
  • Evaluates project plans, budgets, construction schedules, valuations, contracts, loss history, site conditions, catastrophe exposures, contractor experience, and risk-control measures.
  • Determines appropriate coverage terms, conditions, limits, deductibles, exclusions, and pricing for commercial, residential, infrastructure, renovation, and specialty construction projects.
  • Maintains strong relationships with agents and brokers, strengthens existing partnerships, develops new opportunities, and represents Liberty Mutual effectively in the marketplace.
  • Monitors evolving project exposures, including construction delays, changes in scope or values, occupancy transitions, fire, theft, water damage, windstorm, flood, earthquake, collapse, and other Builders Risk loss drivers.
  • Collaborates with UW Support, Claims, Actuarial, Risk Engineering, Product, Legal, and Directors of Underwriting in GRS North America; contributes to product, process, and underwriting tool improvements.
  • Mentors junior underwriters and new hires, analyzes portfolio performance, and communicates emerging construction and Builders Risk trends, underwriting recommendations, and opportunities for profitable growth.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Business or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 2.5 years, typically 3 or more years, of progressive underwriting experience and/or other related experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility that includes competence with all phases and aspects of the underwriting process, and proficiency in the use of qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Description

Under limited supervision and established practices, the Technical Claims Specialist is responsible for the investigation, evaluation, and disposition of Complex Unit Auto and General Liability cases of moderate to high exposure.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigate, evaluate, and manage complex environmental claims from initial notice through resolution.
  • Analyze policy language, coverage issues, exclusions, conditions, and applicable environmental liability provisions.
  • Coordinate with defense counsel, coverage counsel, environmental consultants, and other specialists
  • Investigates claims to determine whether coverage is provided, establish liability and verify damages. Resolves claims within authority and makes recommendations regarding case value and resolution strategy to Branch Office Management and HO Examining on cases which exceed authority.
  • Works closely with staff and outside defense counsel in managing litigated files according to established litigation management protocols.
  • Identifies and appropriately handles suspicious claims.
  • Identifies and appropriately handles claims with third party subrogation potential.
  • Establishes and maintains accurate reserves on all assigned files. Makes timely reserve recommendations to Branch Office Management and HO Examining on cases which exceed authority.
  • Prepares for and attends mediation sessions and/or settlement conferences and negotiates on behalf of LMG and LMG Insureds.
  • Monitors trials and reports daily to Branch Office and HO Examining. Makes recommendations regarding strategy based upon developments.
  • Confers directly with policyholders on coverage and resolution strategy issues.
  • Establishes and updates -Action Plans- on assigned claims which clearly reflect file status and disposition strategy.
  • Participates in training sessions for less experienced staff.
Qualifications
  • Solid understanding of Complex Unit Auto and General Liability claims handling techniques and a working knowledge of LMG Claims procedures and demonstrated the ability to communicate effectively.
  • A Bachelors Degree or equivalent business experience is required.
  • In addition, the candidate will generally possess 4-5 years of related claims experience.

Description

Under limited supervision and established practices, the Technical Claims Specialist is responsible for the investigation, evaluation, and disposition of Complex Unit Auto and General Liability cases of moderate to high exposure.

  • Investigate, evaluate, and manage complex environmental claims from initial notice through resolution.

  • Monitors trials and reports daily to Branch Office and HO Examining. Makes recommendations regarding strategy based upon developments.
  • Confers directly with policyholders on coverage and resolution strategy issues.
  • Establishes and updates -Action Plans- on assigned claims which clearly reflect file status and disposition strategy.
  • Participates in training sessions for less experienced staff.
Qualifications
  • Solid understanding of Complex Unit Auto and General Liability claims handling techniques and a working knowledge of LMG Claims procedures and demonstrated the ability to communicate effectively.
  • A Bachelors Degree or equivalent business experience is required.

Description

Are you ready to help build a fast-growing business? As a Liberty Mutual equipment breakdown underwriter, you'll do exactly that. Our equipment breakdown team writes monoline business, internal reinsurance and external reinsurance, and we've grown rapidly over the past several years. As an underwriter, you'll help us reach our goal of doubling our business in the next several years.

You'll develop, grow and maintain a profitable, diversified book of business. You'll do this through marketing, underwriting decisions, strong agent and broker relationships, a market-facing leadership presence and smart use of underwriting tools, systems and expert resources. You'll also guide and mentor less experienced underwriters, coaching them and sharing feedback with their manager on their progress.

We're considering candidates for our senior or executive-level positions, depending on experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Risk selection: Review, rate and underwrite business applying for insurance. Qualify accounts, identify and assess risk, and determine premium, terms and conditions. Get approvals, present proposals to agents and brokers, and negotiate deals successfully.
  • Agent/broker relationships: Respond quickly and stay focused on what agents and brokers need. Build strong, lasting relationships through responsive service, site visits, in-person renewal meetings and a deep understanding of their customers' businesses. Grow your personal brand to build a long-term, high-quality pipeline with agents and brokers.
  • Portfolio management: Manage your book of business by analyzing the portfolio, spotting opportunities for growth, profit and diversification, and executing marketing plans including broker calls to grow market share.
  • Documenting the deal: Document files clearly, showing solid thinking and decision-making through comprehensive account reviews, sign-offs and referrals. Follow state regulations, letter-of-authority requirements and underwriting guidelines.
  • Leadership: Mentor and coach underwriters and account analysts, both formally and informally, on technical and professional skills.
  • Continuous improvement: Take part in problem-solving activities and use continuous-improvement tools to support your team's work.
Qualifications

Intermediate-level knowledge of insurance products/coverage, knowledge of underwriting, pricing, risk selection, market segments and marketplace; insurance finance and actuarial concepts; loss control/risk engineering; marketing techniques, regulatory environment and reinsurance; advanced-level knowledge of territory management. Ability to apply underwriting/appetite, tools, systems, and resources to achieve goals, solve complex problems, establish and build healthy working relationships, participate in mentoring relationships, and negotiate as normally acquired a related bachelors degree, four to seven years of relevant experience preferred; CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred.

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work. Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!  

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE 

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.  

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING 

We have assignments available to help our insurance carrier clients in Commercial Auto Claims Adjuster / Examiner positions. Responsibilities include: 

  • Manage a caseload of commercial auto claims from first notice of loss through resolution, ensuring timely, fair and accurate claims outcomes.
  • Set-up claim in claims management system.
  • Properly document all claim activity thoroughly and maintain compliance with company and regulatory standards.
  • Investigate, evaluate, and negotiate commercial auto claims.
  • Review police reports, legal and medical bills, etc. 
  • Review coverage, analyze liability, and determine appropriate settlements.
  • Communicate with insureds, claimants, agents and vendors throughout the claim cycle. 

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE 

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most current years of commercial auto claims adjusting experience with insurance carrier 

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT 

  • Health insurance based on eligibility.
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility.
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).
  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules. 
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself! 

HOW TO GET STARTED 

Click APPLY NOW to complete our simple preliminary profile. Be sure to include your preferred contact information as one of our Qualification Specialists will connect with you promptly. 

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As an Associate Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of predominatly moderate to higher complexity matters, which may include Major Case matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers, and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a caseload of predominantly moderate and higher exposure cases, including Major Case litigation matters depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage pre-trial and trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct proficient to advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including accountability for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Contributes to special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Demonstrates an aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of preparing and/or litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes.
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Proficient oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Capably fosters collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service.
  • Demonstrates leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency and responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 4 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

What Is the Opportunity?

Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) provides management and professional liability, cyber, crime insurance, and surety bonds to or on behalf of businesses of all sizes. The BSI Claim Counsel team conducts thorough investigation, analysis, evaluation, and disposition of claims and claim litigation to achieve superior customer service and to optimize claim results. Travelers' Private/Non-Profit Team provides executive and organizational management liability coverage to privately held companies and non-profit entities of all types and sizes as well as certain governmental public entities. As a valued member of our team, in addition to claim, you also will provide legal advice to our underwriting colleagues and non-attorney claim colleagues, and participate in BSI claim strategic initiatives.

As o the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that this posting will be open until November 23, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Follow operational policies to analyze, investigate, and resolve BSI claims of varying levels of severity with moderate supervision from claims management.
  • Prepare and present reports for management that accurately reflect loss development, potential/actual financial exposure, reserve adjustments, coverage issues, and claim and recovery strategies.
  • Retain, monitor, and manage outside counsel actively utilizing litigation management plans and budgets.
  • Communicate with underwriting on significant claim exposures.
  • Continue to develop the ability to identify all recovery opportunities and coordinate recovery efforts with the Recovery Management Unit and Claim management.
  • Travel to and attend mediations, settlement conferences, claim conferences, field office visits, trials and depositions.
  • Refine policy interpretation/coverage analysis skills including drafting coverage opinions with case law included.
  • Strengthen the ability to negotiate settlements/resolutions, review releases and settlement agreements, including confidentiality and non-disclosure provisions.
  • Support underwriting marketing efforts, including participation in broker and account visits and risk mitigation seminars and authoring customer-focused white papers and articles.
  • Monitor marketplace conditions, conduct research, and draft reference materials to inform claim and underwriting colleagues on law impacting Travelers' underwriting and claim decisions.
  • Obtain and maintain required adjusters' licenses.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Five or more years of relevant legal or claim handling work experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively work through conflict and resolve issues with a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and negotiate terms and conditions within designated authority limit.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate coverage determinations.
  • Time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities with an attention to detail, data and analytics.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective and collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Juris Doctorate Degree.
  • Properly licensed, registered or authorized, and in good standing, to practice law in the jurisdiction in which you will be working.
  • Two years of relevant legal experience.

What Is in It for You?

When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers' Experience Design (XD) team creates best-in-class experiences for our customers, agents, employees, and partners. We're looking for a Senior Experience Design Lead to join our Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) Experience Design team, supporting the One Surety Value Stream which includes Commercial Surety & Construction Services business area as we grow and transform.

In this role, you'll lead a small team of designers while personally driving research and design for high-impact initiatives - including a major business transformation and the integration of AI-enabled capabilities into cross-cutting experiences. You'll set experience vision and strategy, turn insights into action, and define, test, and implement product and service solutions. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US.The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, this this role.

What Will You Do?

The Senior Lead Experience Designer provides domain expertise and design leadership within the One Surety Value Stream, shaping experience vision and strategy while collaborating with product, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to deliver unified, inclusive, and valuable experiences for customers, agents, and employees.

  • Provide domain expertise and design leadership across initiatives, supporting product and journey vision and strategy, mitigating risks, and informing organizational decision-making.
  • Lead the research and design of solutions for products and services by defining, creating, and improving models, concepts, and design elements (e.g., experience goals, journey maps, information architecture, scenarios, personas, interactions, content, visuals, etc.) guided by established design objectives, principles, and standards.
  • Plan and execute qualitative user research and usability testing; lead strategic synthesis and insights generation; analyze and communicate results and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Guide collaborative activities with end users, business and technology partners, and outside partners, integrating a human-centered focus informed by research-based insights and design exploration.
  • Communicate design direction and rationale clearly; solicit and synthesize feedback; lead prioritization.
  • Drive the application of accessibility standards including WCAG and Travelers Digital Accessibility Policy, integrating inclusive design principles and demonstrating familiarity with accessibility testing tools such as Axe,  and screen readers.
  • Apply the Travelers Design System and Agile methodology, demonstrating and leading design phases using the Human-Centered Design Double Diamond approach.
  • Leverage experience strategy and design to enhance business outcomes; identify missed opportunities and areas where experiences no longer align with goals, influencing strategic direction and improvements.
  • Identify and advocate for the adoption of improved tools, methods, and processes within the XD practice.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance and leadership to a small team of designers across the One Surety Value Stream, without formal HR or performance management responsibility.
  • Mentor and coach XD team members to support their advancement; contribute to team and practice development, grow leadership capacity, and help attract top design talent.
  • Ensure all design work is aligned with brand guidelines and standards, maintaining a high bar for quality and consistency across projects.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, and prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Stay current on industry trends and best practices in experience design and apply them to advance the practice.
  • Actively participate in and contribute to Experience Design Community events, sharing knowledge across value streams and the broader enterprise to advance design practices.
  • Continuously learn and mentor others in adopting emerging tools, methods, and processes; embody a growth mindset and actively seek personal development of leadership skills.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Deep experience in UX/experience design, including research, strategy, and end-to-end delivery
  • Demonstrated ability to lead designers and influence cross-functional partners
  • Strong design thinking and ability to work across complex, multi-channel environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder presentation skills
  • Strong knowledge with AI-enabled product design

Strong knowledge of most of the following, with proficiency in application of three or more:

  • Design research
  • Information architecture
  • Interaction design
  • Visual design
  • Service design
  • Presentation and communication
  • Collaboration and facilitation skills
  • Prototyping
  • Accessibility
  • WCAG 2.1
  • Figma Make
  • Claude Code
  • Claude Design
  • Facilitator of workshops
  • Usability testing
  • Design Systems

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree or its equivalent in work experience.
  • Six years of related experience.

If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $136,100 to $224,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Saint Paul, MN
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

AVP role handling complex General Liability, Cyber, and Technology Errors and Omissions claims from initiation through resolution across multiple jurisdictions. Requires investigating, evaluating, negotiating, and resolving high-exposure claims with significant autonomy and subject matter expertise.

Good fit if you have seven years of bodily injury, property damage, or comparable claims experience and an active adjuster license where required.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an AVP, Business Torts Complex Claim Liability Specialist, you are responsible for investigating, evaluating, negotiating, and resolving the most complex and high exposure claims across multiple jurisdictions. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role serves as a subject matter expert on complex, litigated, and coverage-disputed claims. You will collaborate and partner closely with business partners, reinsurance, legal counsel, underwriting, and/or leadership to deliver optimal outcomes.

What Will You Do?

  • Directly handle the most severe and complex General Liability Coverage B, Technology Errors and Omissions and 1st and 3rd party Cyber claims from initiation to resolution, ensuring compliance with company policies and industry regulations.
  • Lead end-to-end investigation of high severity complex claims and conduct thorough coverage analysis, draft reservation of rights and coverage disclaimer letters, and/or assess recovery potential.
  • Establish accurate reserves and adjust as needed throughout the claim lifecycle to reflect current and anticipated exposure.
  • Evaluate complex liability, damage issues and/or recovery potential, including large data breach, ransomware, business interruption, errors and omissions, defamation/disparagement, anti-trust, unfair competition and privacy claims.
  • Manage assigned files from inception through resolution; Actively participate in selection of counsel and entire litigation team, where appropriate. Develop and execute claim resolution and litigation strategies.
  • Attend and participate in mediations, arbitrations, pre-trial conferences, and settlement conferences, and negotiate settlements within granted authority levels.
  • Identify and assess risk transfer and/or subrogation opportunities, as needed.
  • Partner closely with and present to underwriting, internal stakeholders, and leadership teams to provide claims intelligence on emerging risks, coverage gaps, and loss trends.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to claims professionals.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

The Materials Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth flow of materials and products necessary for production and operational success within the depots. In addition to managing the entire lifecycle of materials, from procurement to distribution, ensuring that production processes run smoothly, maintains optimal inventory levels to prevent shortages or excess, which can disrupt production or tie up capital unnecessarily, and implement strategies to reduce costs while maintaining quality and supply continuity. This is accomplished through the development of lean processes and procedures that meet internal and external customer requirements and the effective leadership of Inventory Control resources through clear and precise communications of responsibilities and goals.

This is an onsite role at our Irving, TX facility with a schedule of Monday - Thursday from 6 AM to 4:30 PM.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Effective operation by working with the supervisors to complete customer priorities based on demand schedules, assigning tasks/projects as needed, coordinating the flow of work, oversee completion of work, monitor key performance metrics (KPI), managing labor efficiency across the area of responsibility, mentor/coach leaders and manage headcount
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and process standards, while maintaining employee morale and overseeing the training of new and existing staff for the department
  • Establish, track, and analyze departmental reports/measurements and present findings as appropriate
  • Work with senior management to establish department and company goals, and rely on experience, judgment and innovation to achieve them
  • Identify process improvements for the department along with the design of KPIs and coordinate new model introductions
  • Create and utilize reports to accurately represent product flow and task completion rates and percentages
  • Develop and utilize reporting to ensure SLAs are achieved
  • Manage cycle counts and inventory control processes to ensure inventory accuracy maintained
  • Liaison between teams, shifts, and departments, and partners with vendor/customer/client representatives while fostering true partner relationships that allow us to manage change and growth within the individual business
  • Monitor inventory of stock and ensure adequate levels are maintained
  • Provides technical and operational support during the business development process and new customer acquisition
  • Maintain a clean, organized and safe work environment for personnel to work in while ensuring all safety and environmental regulations are followed
  • Develop and establish document controls to ensure accuracy of inventory
  • Hires, develops, evaluates, and (when necessary) disciplines and discharges subordinates' personnel or makes authoritative recommendations in such matters
  • Develops function-specific orientation and training programs for area personnel
  • Establishes standards for effective job performance and evaluates subordinates according to such standards

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in any business or related discipline
  • Minimum seven (7) years' experience required in a logistics/distribution, fast paced, high volume manufacturing environment with at least five (5) years of data interpretation/analysis and logistics experience and 2 of inventory management experience
  • Minimum of five (5) years leadership experience with at least five (5) years' experience managing supervisory personnel

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • APICS CPIM designation
  • Working knowledge and understanding of MRP/ERP systems, WIP & Planning, Preferred knowledge with Oracle
  • Experience with Microsoft Great Plains
  • Highly skilled inventory control leader with extensive strategic and tactical experience, results-oriented, high energy, high urgency, and embraces effective change
  • High level of customer interaction; frequent interruptions and re-prioritization of projects based upon customer needs, working under deadlines, creative thinking, working on multiple projects simultaneously, and ability making decisions based on various levels of information
  • Working knowledge of Visio
  • Ability to interact and understand IT issues related to business processes and systems changes
  • Knowledge of inventory and warehousing processing procedures
  • Experience in, manufacturing, automation, electronics, systems integration, life cycle modeling, new product introduction, process development and deployment, leveraging Lean/6 Sigma tools, project and resource planning, and systems implementation

Erie Insurance is committed to helping you learn and grow with a challenging internship position that will offer you relevant and real-world business experience. Position Summary

The purpose of the Internal Audit Department is to provide independent, objective assurance and consulting services designed to add value and improve ERIE's operations. The mission of internal audit is to enhance and protect organizational value by providing independent risk-based and objective assurance, advice, and insight. The Internal Audit Department helps the organization accomplish its strategy and objectives by bringing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, control and governance processes.


As an IT Internal Audit intern, you will:

• Be provided opportunities to develop skills and gain experience and knowledge of the IT Internal Audit profession, including risk management practices, identity and access management, and information systems controls;
• Participate in a IT audit project that identifies risks, tests the control environment that mitigates those risks, and provide executive management with assurance as to the adequacy of the design and the effectiveness of the controls in place;
• Interact and network with members of Internal Audit, IT process and control owners, and leaders throughout the organization, enabling the intern to build relationships that will benefit them throughout their entire career;
• Use business systems and applications to electronically communicate, perform analysis, document tests of controls, and complete audit assignments.
• Use data analysis tools and visualization software to deliver successful projects.

About this job

Associate Actuary role in Lincoln Financial's Actuarial Development Program supporting pricing execution reporting across Group Protection products. Responsibilities include data transformation, renewal and new business forecasting, and building dashboards for cross-functional stakeholders.

Good fit if you have 3-6+ years actuarial experience, proficiency in SQL and Dataiku, and are pursuing ASA credentials.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Omaha, NE (Nebraska); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina); Hartford, CT (Connecticut); Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76828

The Role at a Glance

The Actuarial Development Program (ADP) at Lincoln Financial is an industry-leading program that demonstrates Lincoln Financial' s commitment to creating highly qualified business leaders. As an ADP participant, you'll be able to explore your unique interests while developing the essential actuarial, technical, management, communication, and leadership skills you need to succeed. The Actuarial Development Program includes a series of rotations, typically every 18-24 months. For each rotation, roles are available in different business areas including Life and Annuities, Retirement and Group Protection. Experience gained will enable participants to become well-rounded actuaries with knowledge that may include Product Development, Pricing, Valuation, Modeling, Risk Management, Asset Liability Management, Investments, Data Analytics, and Internal Audit.

ADP participants are expected to pass the Society of Actuaries' exams at a prescribed pace. The program is designed to support you as you work towards your FSA and provide the training and resources necessary to become a well-rounded actuarial leader.

Additional Program Highlights:
•Highly competitive compensation package with salary increases and bonuses upon successful exam completion
•Social and training opportunities to enhance skills, network with ADP participants and build long-lasting industry relationships
•Dedicated leaders and mentors to assist with career development
Work with actuarial and data science software and technologies including MG-ALFA, Axis, Prophet, Dataiku, R, and Tableau
•Generous study time allowances for each exam session
•Payment and/or reimbursement of actuarial exam fees, materials, review courses, and seminars taken during the program

The Associate Actuary, Pricing Analytics & Reporting role will support the highly visible pricing execution reporting across Lincoln's Group Protection product suite – Life/AD&D, LTD, STD, Leave, Dental, and Supplemental Health. This role will be responsible for producing critical metrics & forecasts that drive business decisions across pricing, underwriting, and sales/distribution. You will be an end-to-end owner of the reporting process including data transformation, pricing strategy implementation, and data visualization.

What you'll be doing

•Data Transformation: Maintain data pipeline (i.e. Dataiku) that produces the team's renewal and new business execution reports, proactively identifying and implementing improvements to accuracy, functionality, and business impact.
•Renewal Execution Reporting/Forecasting: Produce reporting on key renewal metrics such as persistency, rate action, and profitability. Track & forecast metric development throughout operational year and influence intra-year strategy decisions.
•New Business Execution Reporting/Forecasting: Produce reporting on new business sales & profitability relative to targets. Integrate region, segment, or product-specific strategies into target benchmarks. Act as a technical liaison to sales leadership.
•Cross-Functional Collaboration: Closely partner with leaders from pricing, underwriting, data engineering, sales, and account management to drive business decisions through accurate and relevant reporting.
•Data Visualization: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that are used by a variety of stakeholders. Develop creative solutions to display insights in new and meaningful ways.

What we're looking for

•3-6+ years of actuarial experience
•Pursuing actuarial credentials (ASA designation preferred)
•Proficiency in SQL, experience with Dataiku & Oracle databases
•Experience with data visualization or other reporting tools (Ex: Tableau)
•Demonstrated ability to maintain data accuracy, cleanliness, and functionality
•Motivated and collaborative approach to the role
•4 Year/Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) (Minimum Required)

About this job

Lead Software Engineer providing technical leadership for an Agile team building cloud-native applications on AWS. The role involves hands-on development in Java, Node.js, or Python, designing serverless architectures, and modernizing the technology landscape through cloud migration and DevOps practices.

Good fit if you have 5+ years developing enterprise applications, 2+ years leading distributed Agile teams, and strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless services and infrastructure as code.

Full job description

Alternate Locations: Greensboro, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76826

The Role at a Glance

The Lead Software Engineer / Technical Lead provides hands-on technical leadership for an Agile delivery team responsible for building industry-leading capabilities while modernizing the technology landscape through cloud migration, DevOps, artificial intelligence and architectural advancement. This role guides solution design and application delivery from initial proposal and estimation through development, testing, deployment, and production support.

The position partners with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architecture, federated architecture teams, Security, and other technology groups to deliver scalable, secure, cost-effective solutions. The role also champions engineering practices such as CI/CD, independent architecture, secure coding, automated testing, and a “you build it, you own it” operating model.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of AWS cloud-native and serverless applications using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, and Step Functions.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures supporting enterprise integrations.
  • Provide hands-on development using Java, Node.js, and Python, including code reviews, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Design and manage infrastructure as code using AWS CDK and CloudFormation.
  • Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, including automated testing, security scanning, and deployment automation.
  • Implement asynchronous processing, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, idempotency, and resilient integration patterns.
  • Collaborate with Security and Identity teams on OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS (mTLS), IAM, Secrets Manager, and secure API integrations.
  • Drive application observability and production troubleshooting using CloudWatch, Splunk, and New Relic.
  • Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, estimation, and implementation planning across distributed Agile teams.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize legacy applications, reduce technical debt, improve system reliability, and optimize AWS costs.
  • Promote engineering excellence through secure coding, automated testing, peer reviews, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development tools.
  • Assess emerging technology trends and advise senior management on their potential impact, particularly in AWS, microservices, cloud architecture, and artificial intelligence.
  • Identify and lead process improvements that reduce defects, shorten code turnaround time, strengthen pipelines, improve cost and performance, and enhance application security.
  • Provide business and technical subject matter expertise to team members and internal and external stakeholders on complex assignments and initiatives.
  • Lead technical response and solution coordination for production issues; support resolution estimation, root-cause analysis, remediation, and service restoration.
  • Direct and enhance organizational initiatives by positively influencing and supporting change management and/or departmental/enterprise initiatives within assigned area(s) of responsibility including but not limited to transition to AIDLC, enterprise cloud migration, etc. that support IT partners in delivering applications that increase adoption of self-service capabilities.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications.
  • 2+ years of experience providing technical leadership to distributed Agile development teams.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS serverless services, including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Event Bridge, and SQS.
  • Proficiency in one or more backend technologies, including Java, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, preferably AWS CDK or CloudFormation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining GitLab CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and secure deployment processes.
  • Understanding of cloud security, IAM, OAuth 2.0, API authentication, and secure integration patterns.
  • Experience with application monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply generative AI responsibly within the software development lifecycle, including validating AI-generated outputs, protecting confidential information, following secure coding practices, and complying with enterprise AI governance and intellectual property requirements.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, or comparable generative AI tools to accelerate code development, technical analysis, documentation, testing, debugging, and modernization activities.
  • Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, security teams, and engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical assignments, communicate architectural decisions, and collaborate effectively with business and technology stakeholders.

TECHNOLOGY EXPERIENCE

Cloud Platform & Serverless

  • AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, AWS Step Functions
  • Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon S3, Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, AWS IAM, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, Amazon VPC, Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail

Programming Languages & Frameworks

  • Java, Node.js, Python
  • Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices

Infrastructure as Code & DevOps

  • AWS CDK, AWS CloudFormation
  • GitLab CI/CD, Git, automated deployment pipelines
  • Automated testing, code quality analysis, vulnerability scanning

Architecture & Integration

  • Serverless architecture, event-driven architecture, microservices
  • REST APIs, asynchronous messaging, distributed systems
  • OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS (mTLS), secure API integrations
  • Retry handling, dead-letter queues, idempotency, and fault tolerance

Monitoring & Observability

  • Amazon CloudWatch, Splunk, New Relic
  • Application logging, monitoring, performance analysis, production troubleshooting
  • Databases
  • DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, DB2, SQL

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable AI-assisted development tools
  • Responsible use of generative AI for development, code reviews, testing, documentation, and modernization

  • Experience with contact center, fraud/authentication, quality and analytics, cloud, or AI platforms, and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
  • Experience in capacity planning or workforce management.

About this job

Hands-on Network Engineer managing day-to-day operations of enterprise LAN, WAN, and cloud infrastructure across on-premises data centers and Microsoft Azure. Role spans Cisco switching and UCS compute fabric, Palo Alto firewalls, NetApp storage networking, and multi-site routing.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of hands-on network engineering experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, Azure, and enterprise storage systems.

Full job description

Position Summary:

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. Reporting to the Senior Network Engineer, this role owns the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and improvement of the company's network, firewall, and connectivity infrastructure across on-premises data centers and a growing Microsoft Azure environment, including the Cisco compute fabric, NetApp storage networking, and Palo Alto security platforms that support it. The ideal candidate is a deeply technical engineer with strong fundamentals, disciplined troubleshooting, and excellent documentation.

Work Location:
This is a full-time, in-person position based at our Boca Raton, Florida office. Remote and hybrid work arrangements are not available for this role.

Technical Environment:

  • Security: Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls (PAN-OS) across on-premises data centers and Azure, GlobalProtect VPN, Cloudflare, and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Switching and compute fabric: Cisco Catalyst campus switching and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) data-center switching; Cisco UCS X-Series (chassis, Fabric Interconnects, Intersight).
  • Routing and WAN: BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP across a multi-site WAN (MPLS / DIA circuits) with site-to-site IPSec VPN.
  • Storage networking: NetApp ONTAP (FAS / AFF) with SnapMirror replication; Tintri.
  • Cloud: a substantial and growing Microsoft Azure networking footprint (hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes).
  • Wireless and monitoring: UniFi wireless; Site24x7 monitoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and monitor enterprise LAN, WAN, and UniFi wireless infrastructure across multiple sites.
  • Administer Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, threat prevention, URL filtering, and GlobalProtect VPN; tune App-ID and SSL / TLS decryption.
  • Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure networking, including hub-and-spoke VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, Azure Firewall, NSGs, and user-defined routes.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing and switching (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) across Cisco Catalyst and Cisco Nexus (NX-OS) switches and the Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnect environment in a multi-site network.
  • Build and maintain site-to-site IPSec VPN connectivity with business partners and vendors.
  • Support NetApp ONTAP storage networking and replication.
  • Administer network monitoring platforms; maintain alerting, dashboards, NetFlow, and device-health visibility.
  • Administer and support network security applications and Zero Trust / network access control.
  • Respond to network alerts and incidents; perform root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Participate in planned maintenance windows, including change preparation, verification, and rollback procedures.
  • Create and maintain network documentation, diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), and runbooks.
  • Install, rack, and cable network hardware; support equipment lifecycle and refresh projects.
  • Assist with network security tasks, including certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and access reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation.

Why Windward Risk Managers:

  • Windward Risk Managers is proud to be recognized on Fortune's 2026 Best Medium Workplaces list, ranking #28 among the Top 100 companies
  • 100% employer paid health insurance for employees
  • Up to 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting

  • 3 weeks PTO to start + generous paid holidays

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on network engineering or network administration experience.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP fundamentals, including subnetting, routing, NAT, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Production experience with enterprise-class routers and switches, including Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus (NX-OS), and Cisco UCS X-Series Fabric Interconnects.
  • Hands-on production experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls (PAN-OS), including security policy, NAT, and VPN.
  • Working knowledge of at least one dynamic routing protocol (OSPF, EIGRP, or BGP).
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Azure networking (VNets, peering, VPN Gateway, NSGs, and routing).
  • Experience with NetApp (or comparable enterprise) storage and its supporting network connectivity.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools and alerting platforms.
  • Experience supporting network security applications.
  • Methodical troubleshooting skills using packet captures, logs, and device diagnostics.
  • Strong written documentation skills.
  • Works well in a collaborative team environment, with strong self-motivation to drive projects through to completion.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Palo Alto Networks Network Security Professional, the entry-level certification in the current role-based program. The legacy PCNSA also applies.
  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA).

  • Experience with Cisco UCS X-Series and Intersight data-center compute fabric.
  • IPSec VPN design and troubleshooting experience.
  • Familiarity with server, virtualization, or storage environments.

Work Environment:

  • Scope: owns day-to-day network operations and project execution; partners with the Senior Network Engineer, who leads network architecture and standards.

Job Description

As a part of Taiwan/Greater China Global Solutions in U.S., you will manage and coordinate accounts and prospects, building and maintaining strong relationships with key client stakeholders and internal account service teams. The ideal candidate must have insurance industry experience.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

Aon is in the business of better decisions. At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the Day Will Look Like

The role involves production and strategic account coordination of key U.S. Taiwan/Greater China clients & prospects, frequently interacting with client leadership externally and Aon's Account Service Teams.

  • Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities, expanding the book of business and strengthening overall client relationships.
  • Act as the lead Account Executive within Aon U.S. for Taiwan clients' U.S. risks, serving as the primary point of contact for Taiwan-headquartered clients on their U.S. exposures.
  • Serve U.S. local client entities directly, answering questions and resolving issues during U.S. business hours to ensure timely responses and issue resolution
  • Collaborate with practice & geographical offices to advance opportunities, support account plans, and contribute to pipeline development and revenue growth initiatives.
  • Facilitate client-facing discussions and internal alignment to ensure opportunities are effectively positioned and progressed.
