About this job

Principal Software Engineer role at Allstate's Technology Operations, Risk & Compliance division, building the Unified System of Controls platform for enterprise-scale risk management. Requires leading engineering team development, establishing engineering practices, and delivering secure, sustainable control and compliance capabilities across the organization.

Good fit if you have 12+ years leading enterprise-scale software delivery, building high-performing engineering teams, and translating strategy into technical execution.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Technology Operations, Risk & Compliance (TORC) is ACCs first-line operating system for controls, risk management and remediation, compliance, and resilience. TORC operates at the intersection of cybersecurity, technology operations, risk, controls, compliance, resilience, and enterprise transformation, turning ACC priorities and enterprise obligations into measurable controls, actionable intelligence, accountability, and sustained risk reduction.

TORC is entering the next phase of that evolution: engineering risk and control capabilities that operate at enterprise scale. A cornerstone of this work is the Unified System of Controls (USC), a strategic ACC product intended to provide a sustainable command-and-control capability for controls, bringing together control expectations, procedures, measurement, evidence, reporting, exceptions, ownership, and accountability.

The Principal Engineer will help build the engineering function required to make that ambition real.

Job Summary

The role will also establish close engineering partnerships with Product Security (ProdSec) and Security Operations (SecOps) across ACC, leveraging and integrating their capabilities into TORC products where appropriate and avoiding creation of parallel security engineering capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

Build and Lead the TORC Engineering Function

  • Build and mature TORC's engineering capability, including the talent, engineering practices, operating model, delivery discipline, and technical competencies necessary to deliver enterprise-scale products.
  • Establish an engineering culture centered on quality, automation, reliability, security, reuse, observability, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization capable of solving complex technology, risk, and control problems.
  • Establish clear engineering accountability and decision rights while developing future technical leaders and strengthening engineering capability across the organization.
  • Create reusable engineering patterns and capabilities that enable TORC to scale beyond individual solutions.


Deliver the Unified System of Controls (USC)

  • Provide senior engineering leadership for the Unified System of Controls, translating its product direction and requirements into scalable, production-grade technology.
  • Lead engineering delivery of capabilities supporting control measurement, evidence, reporting, exceptions, workflow, integration, accountability, and decision-grade insight.
  • Enable the movement from point-in-time and manually intensive control processes toward sustainable capabilities supported by automation and continuous telemetry.
  • Ensure USC engineering is designed for enterprise scale, sustainability, interoperability, security, reliability, and reuse.
  • Establish an extensible engineering foundation that can support additional TORC and ACC strategic products over time.


Translate Strategy and Product Direction into Engineering Execution

  • Partner with Digital Product leadership to convert product vision, priorities, and outcomes into executable engineering roadmaps and delivery.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment to determine how capabilities should be implemented within established enterprise technology and architecture direction.
  • Bring an engineering perspective into product discovery, helping teams understand technical feasibility, complexity, dependencies, scalability, and implementation tradeoffs.
  • Maintain strong discipline between strategy ownership, product ownership, architecture accountability, and engineering execution.


What Success Looks Like

Success is not simply delivering a technology solution. It is establishing engineering as a durable capability within TORC.


The Principal Engineer will have:

  • Built a mature, high-performing TORC engineering function with clear accountability, strong talent, disciplined engineering practices, and an outcome-oriented culture.
  • Delivered significant engineering capabilities supporting the Unified System of Controls and demonstrated that USC can operate as a sustainable enterprise product.
  • Created strong working relationships across Platform Consulting, Digital Product, Architecture, Product Security, Security Operations, and other ACC engineering functions.
  • Established reusable engineering capabilities that can scale additional TORC and ACC strategic products.
  • Increased the use of automation, integration, telemetry, and continuous measurement within TORC products.
  • Demonstrated that complex risk and control challenges can increasingly be addressed through sustainable engineering rather than additional manual process.
  • Established TORC Engineering as a trusted, high-impact technology partner within ACC.


Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field required.
  • Master's degree or equivalent advanced technical experience preferred.


Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive technology and engineering experience preferred.
  • Significant experience leading enterprise-scale software, platform, or engineering capability.
  • Demonstrated experience building or materially transforming engineering teams and engineering practices.
  • Experience delivering secure, enterprise-scale applications or platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple organizations and technology domains.
  • Experience translating strategy, product direction, and business requirements into engineering execution.
  • Demonstrated success operating with senior executives and influencing across organizational boundaries.


Leadership & Functional Capabilities

  • Exceptional engineering depth, with significant experience delivering secure, reliable, and scalable enterprise technology.
  • Strong knowledge of modern software engineering, APIs, data integration, automation, cloud, telemetry, observability, reliability, and secure engineering practices.
  • Ability to assess highly complex technical and business challenges, evaluate implementation options and tradeoffs, and make sound decisions in high-pressure or time-sensitive environments.
  • Strong product and business orientation, with the ability to translate strategy and desired outcomes into executable engineering roadmaps, standards, reusable patterns, and delivery disciplines.
  • Ability to communicate complex engineering concepts in clear business language and influence senior executives, engineering leaders, peers, and cross-functional partners without relying solely on positional authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead across highly matrixed and distributed environments, building alignment among product, platform, architecture, cybersecurity, risk, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Experience leading significant technology, engineering, or operating-model transformation and establishing the practices required to sustain change.
  • Strong talent and capability-building skills, including coaching, role clarity, accountability, upskilling, and development of future technical leaders.
  • Sound judgment regarding the application of modern technology, AI, and automation, including the ability to balance innovation, business value, security, and risk.
  • Ability to connect engineering decisions to measurable business outcomes through analytical rigor, technology fluency, and disciplined execution.


Why This Role Matters

TORC's next evolution depends on our ability to engineer solutions to risk and control problems that historically relieve process, manual intervention, and point-in-time visibility.


The Principal Engineer will be the senior engineering leader responsible for helping make that transition real.


This leader will build the engineering capability behind TORC, deliver foundational products such as the Unified System of Controls, and connect Product, Platform, Architecture, ProdSec, SecOps, and engineering execution to create sustainable technology solutions that improve how Allstate understands and manages control and technology risk.

Skills

Automation, Data Integration, Enterprise Architecture (EA), Executive Leadership, People Leadership, Software Engineering

Compensation offered for this role is 199,000.00 - 274,000.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule:

During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:30pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm with rotational Saturday duty

  • Mondays and Fridays (remote)

  • Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays (in-office)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of previous customer service experience.

  • Excellent organization skills.

  • Ability to multi-task.

  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.

  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in an office and virtual work environment.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality and efficient claim resolutions.

  • Previous industry experience is highly desired.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license wheninstructed toby the licensing team. Byproceedingwith the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree tocomply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as anAllstater,youllenjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit:www.allstategoodlife.comto learn more.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $56,500 to $82,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Cheyenne, WY

About this job

Field Property Adjuster for National General in Cheyenne, Wyoming, investigating and adjusting complex homeowner and farm/ranch insurance claims. Requires strong estimating skills and Xactimate proficiency, with on-site inspections and virtual claim handling responsibilities.

Good fit if you have property claims experience, Xactimate skills, and preferably background in agricultural or farm and ranch claims.

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

As the Field Property Adjuster you are responsible for investigating and confirming the facts of loss for the most complex Homeowner's Claims. Determines coverage, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within limit of authority. Responsible for creating a comprehensive estimate of damages for the most complex first party homeowner claims leading to the proper disposition. This role is utilized as peer mentor and may assign direction to more junior employees, having mastered our processes and obtained technical expertise

We are seeking a motivated and customer-focused Property Field Adjuster to join our team. The ideal candidate will reside in Wyoming, preferably near Laramie, Platte, Fremont or Campbell county and will play a key role in helping customers navigate the claims process with confidence and care.


In this role, you will investigate and manage moderate to complex residential property claims, as well as farm and ranch claims, through a combination of on-site inspections and virtual claim handling. The successful candidate will possess strong estimating skills, proficiency with Xactimate, and the ability to effectively manage challenging situations while delivering an exceptional customer experience. Experience handling agricultural, farm, and ranch claims is highly preferred.


If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy working independently, and are passionate about helping customers during critical moments, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities

  • Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex first party homeowner losses of all severities
  • Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers
  • Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices
  • Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files
  • Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training
  • Recommends process improvements


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Job Description

Producer, Senior Vice President

Do you have a passion for using your ambition and creativity to build new relationships? Do you want to be part of a sales culture where producers are recognized, valued and perform significantly better than their industry peer group?

Aon has an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Producer, Senior Vice President!

Aon is in the business of better decisions.

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Showcase connections and networking capabilities to generate new business
  • Influence and collaborate with others to build strategic plans and present a variation of risk solutions to meet client needs
  • Broaden your consultative reach by engaging prospects and providing creative and applicable advice across all of Aon's solutions.
  • Solve complex business issues using the data and analytics available at your fingertips from Aon's research teams combining your eye for business and understanding of current trends
  • Support a team in the management of a portfolio of prospects' business

How this opportunity is different:

Aon is the leading global professional services firm providing advice and solutions in Risk, Retirement and Health at a time when those topics have never been more important to the global economy. Aon develops insights - driven by data and delivered by experts - that reduce the volatility our clients face and help them enhance their performance.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 4 - 6+ years of experience in insurance, consulting or enterprise products and/or services
  • Demonstrated capability to adhere to and champion a successful sales process
  • Currently have or willingness to acquire P&C license and/or Life & Health license.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of industry experience.

Pay Transparency Laws

The salary range for this position is $180,000 - $220,000 annually. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive production incentives in addition to base salary. The amount of any production incentives varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Newark, NJ
  • Experience: 4+ years
  • License: Valid driver's license

About this job

Large Loss Field Property Adjuster for Allstate, based in New Brunswick, NJ. You will conduct on-site inspections, investigate property claims, prepare estimates, and handle virtual claims countrywide, with focus on water losses.

Good fit if you have 4+ years outside adjuster experience, proficiency with Xactimate, can travel to customer homes, and live near New Brunswick, NJ.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 4 years previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency near New Brunswick, NJ is mandatory for this role.

  • Schedule: Full-time

About this job

Field Property Adjuster conducting on-site inspections, investigating claims, and preparing estimates for property damage. Role includes traveling to customer homes and handling virtual claims, with focus on water losses using tools like Xactimate.

Good fit if you have 2-3 years outside property adjuster experience, live within 25 miles of Houston, and can physically access roofs with a ladder.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Reside within a 25 mile-radius of Houston, TX.
  • 2-3 years experience as an outside property adjuster is highly desired.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work. Excellent desk organization and time management skills.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on either a one to two-story roof.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers Data Engineering team constructs pipelines that contextualize and provide easy access to data by the entire enterprise. As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in growing and transforming our analytics landscape. In addition to your strong analytical mind, you will bring your inquisitive attitude and ability to translate the stories found in data. You will leverage your ability to design, build and deploy data solutions that capture, explore, transform, and utilize data to support Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and business intelligence/insights. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

What Will You Do?

  • Build and operationalize complex data solutions, correct problems, apply transformations, and recommend data cleansing/quality solutions.
  • Design data solutions.
  • Analyze sources to determine value and recommend data to include in analytical processes.
  • Incorporate core data management competencies including data governance, data security and data quality.
  • Collaborate within and across teams to support delivery and educate end users on data products/analytic environment.
  • Perform data and system analysis, assessment and resolution for defects and incidents of moderate complexity and correct as appropriate.
  • Test data movement, transformation code, and data components.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree in STEM related field or equivalent.
  • Six years of related experience.
  • Hands-on Expertise with Databricks and AWS: you've built and shipped real solutions on these platforms and are comfortable working in the cloud.
  • Strong SQL Skills: you know how to turn complex data into clear, reliable answers.
  • Snowflake Experience is a Pus: bring your knowledge of modern data warehousing and help us push it further.
  • Curiosity about AI is a Plus: experience or exposure to artificial intelligence is welcome, and you'll have room to grow it here.
  • Fluent in the Modern Engineering Toolkit: you're proficient with cloud platforms and programming languages, and you apply sound software engineering practices to everything you build.
  • Technical Excellence and Problem Solving: Proficient with cloud platforms, programming languages, and software engineering practices, with proven domain expertise, in-depth knowledge of the systems you support, and strong debugging skills to resolve issues in unfamiliar code and recurring problems.
  • Delivery, Communication, and Leadership: Deliver work at a steady, predictable pace using small-batch releases, contribute to tradeoff and negotiation discussions, communicate clearly with team members and business partners, and show self-motivated leadership by pursuing your own growth.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 2 additional years of software/data engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage personal and business insurance damage claims involving various types of automobiles as well as heavy equipment, mobile equipment, and property damage. This role involves frequent customer interactions through telephone and written communications.

This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Assess coverage to determine compensability.
  • Investigate by gathering information from policyholders, claimants, and witnesses.
  • Partner with resources, as needed, to obtain other evidence in order to properly handle the claim. Assess claims for potential fraud.

  • Develop and execute action plans for effective claim resolution.
  • Communicate and apprise all parties regarding claim status, including business customers.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new workflows, technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.

BASIC PURPOSE:

 

Support the development, configuration, implementation, and maintenance of commercial property and casualty insurance products through a blend of insurance expertise, product analysis, and technology-enabled solutions. Partner with underwriting, actuarial, compliance, product, and technology stakeholders to translate business requirements into configured product solutions that support profitability, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and speed to market.

Conduct research, analysis, product configuration, testing, and implementation activities within Guidewire PolicyCenter and related policy administration systems. Leverage commercial insurance knowledge and technical capabilities to optimize product performance, streamline workflows, improve data quality, and support strategic business initiatives.

PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

  • Lead insurance product initiatives through research, analysis, no/low-code configuration, testing, implementation, and post-production validation activities.
  • Apply a strong understanding of commercial property and casualty insurance products, underwriting workflows, and policy lifecycle processes to support product development and operational effectiveness.
  • Partner with underwriting, product, actuarial, compliance, and technology teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into configurable product solutions.
  • Configure and maintain commercial insurance products within Guidewire PolicyCenter's no/low-code Advanced Product Designer application, including coverages, business rules, forms, workflows, and product attributes.
  • Support the development of business requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation that clearly communicate intended product behavior and system functionality.
  • Participate in testing activities, including functional testing, regression testing, product validation, rate verification, forms attachment testing, and integration testing.
  • Identify, analyze, and resolve product configuration, workflow, system, and data issues in partnership with business and technology teams.
  • Conduct competitor analysis, market research, rate analysis, and filing analysis to support product recommendations and business strategy.
  • Support development, submission, implementation, and maintenance of state filings in partnership with product, compliance, and actuarial teams.
  • Analyze data relationships, system integrations, workflow impacts, and operational requirements to support product enhancements and business initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline business processes, improve data quality, optimize workflows, and increase operational efficiency across highly configurable systems.
  • Communicate project status, technical issues, timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and business impacts to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain underwriting protocols, product documentation, and no/low-code configuration standards supporting consistent business practices and regulatory compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or comparable industry experience may be considered with a high school diploma or equivalent required.
  • CPCU, ARM, ASLI, or evidence of continuing and progressive insurance education preferred.
  • Five years or more of commercial property and casualty insurance experience in underwriting, product development, product management, configuration, actuarial, underwriting administration, business analysis, or related functions.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and casualty insurance products, underwriting operations, policy administration processes, and policy lifecycle activities.
  • Experience configuring products within Guidewire PolicyCenter or similar no/low-code configurable policy administration systems preferred.
  • Understanding of configurable business rules, product structures, workflows, data relationships, system integrations, and policy administration technology.
  • Working knowledge of XML, JSON, query tools, data structures, integrations, or related technologies preferred.
  • Experience conducting market analysis, competitor analysis, rate analysis, product analysis, or filing analysis to support business recommendations and implementation decisions.
  • Understanding of modern product development methodologies including business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing, defect resolution, and implementation practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills supporting the ability to develop, test, implement, and support solutions for complex business, product, and system issues.
  • Strong listening, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Organized, analytical, self-motivated, and capable of managing multiple priorities and deadlines

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Professional office or home office environment.

  • Facilitate an engaging environment in which agents are inspired and feel supported.
  • Manage acquisition and service cost for Branch assignment.

  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience required.

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Grow Here. Go Further.

Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist - Northeast Region

At Liberty Mutual, we do more than offer a job in claims. We offer the opportunity to build a lasting career. Through ongoing development, coaching, technical training, mentoring, and internal mobility, we help high-performing and motivated claims professionals continue growing throughout their careers. Whether your long-term goals include people leadership, technical claims, litigation, specialty operations, quality, strategy, or another area of the business, we provide opportunities to expand your expertise and take on greater responsibility.

Trusted to Decide. Empowered to Lead.

Complex claims require experience, judgment, confidence, and the ability to make thoughtful decisions in uncertain and high-stakes situations. At Liberty Mutual, we trust our claims professionals to lead their work. In this role, you will be empowered to make timely decisions within your authority, while having access to experienced leaders, technical specialists, legal partners, and other resources when collaboration is needed.

About the Role

As a Senior Complex Casualty Claims Resolution Specialist, you will manage high-severity personal lines auto and homeowners liability claims involving significant injuries, complex liability questions, attorney representation, and litigation.

Responsibilities

  • Manages, investigates, and resolves claims. Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles claims within prescribed procedures and authority.
  • Recommends ultimate resolution on assigned cases in excess of their authority to local claims management and Home Office.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Prepares for and attends trials, hearings and conferences as required.
  • Communicates proactively and clearly with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims.
  • Responds to various written and telephone inquiries including status reports in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves. Recommends reserve increases on cases in excess of authority.
  • Contributes to a culture of innovation, positivity, and engagement through collaboration, continuous improvement, and active participation in team initiatives.
  • Effectively prepares and delivers presentations by gathering and organizing key information, identifying relevant facts and insights, tailoring content to the audience, and communicating information clearly, concisely, and professionally.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Responsible for managing the practices and billing activities of outside and in-house counsel.
  • May assist in the absence of the Claims Unit Manager, representing the company on matters involving state or federal regulatory agencies.
  • May be involved in special projects and/or mentoring at the direction of local management.

Ideal Experience Includes:

  • 5+ years managing complex and litigated casualty claims
  • Homeowners experience
  • Deep expertise handling severe to catastrophic injuries and fatalities
  • Strong analytical thinking, negotiation skills, and sound judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fastpaced, highstakes environment
  • Professionalism, empathy, and exceptional communication skills

Competitive Bonus Opportunity

External candidates with an active FL or TX AllLines Adjuster License (CEs current) may qualify for a $2,500 signon bonus.

Where You Can Work:

If you live within 50 miles of one of our hub locations, the role is hybrid (2 days in office). Otherwise, it may be fully remote. Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones would be most ideal as this position supports claims located in the Eastern Time Zones.

Hub Locations:


Chandler, AZ
Clifton Park, NY
Columbus, OH
Indianapolis, IN
Lake Mary, FL
Liberty Lake, WA
Marlton, NJ
Plano, TX
Suwanee, GA
Naperville, IL
Westborough, MA

Travel:10% for mediations, arbitrations, trials, or inperson events.

Your Expertise Opens Doors

The work you do here can be the foundation for what comes next. As you build technical depth, demonstrate leadership, and expand your impact, you will have opportunities to pursue new challenges and advance within the organization.

At Liberty Mutual, growth is not limited to one job title and trust is not limited to one decision. We give you the opportunity to build your career and the authority to make a difference.

Training That Sets You Up for Success:

Your growth begins on day one.Active engagement and reliable attendance during training are mandatoryand crucial to your success in this highimpact role.

Qualifications
  • Must have an expert knowledge of coverage, liability, and complex claims handling procedures.
  • Must be able to effectively handle claims at the highest technical and complexity level.
  • Must be knowledgeable of state and federal laws in the adjuster's jurisdiction.
  • A full working knowledge of claims operations and procedures is required.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills required as well as strong interpersonal, analytical, investigative and negotiation skills.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and at least 7 years of directly related experience.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Description

Do You Thrive in a Fast-Paced Environment Where No Two Days Are Alike?

Join Our Auto Damage Appraisal Team.

We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate auto damage appraisal professionals.

As a Desk or Hybrid Auto Damage Appraiser, you will be completing quality appraisals of damaged vehicles either virtually with reference to photos or occasionally in-person, to help our customers restore vehicles to their pre-loss condition. You will complete moderate to higher complexity claims within assigned authority limits. Daily expectations include explaining the repair process and damage details to our customers, writing original and supplemental damage estimates, making total loss determinations and valuations, negotiating with auto body shops on repair strategies and costs, and occasionally conducting independent adjuster appraisal re-inspections. You will provide best-in-class service to our internal and external customers and need to have strong analytical, organizational and multi-tasking skills, and be a time management expert. We look for people who are creative, love problem solving, and have a passion for helping others. Your job involves speaking to and engaging with customers who have just been in an accident and need your help and this is where the passion for service comes into play. We strive to treat our customers as we would want to be treated!

Location:

  • With ample growth opportunities, you are in-charge of your future. If you are selected for one of our Desk Appraisal roles, the position will offer a hybrid at-home and in-office work schedule in one of our hub office locations, including Liberty Lake, WA, Chandler, AZ, Naperville, IL, or Plano, TX.
  • If you are selected for a Hybrid Appraisal role, you may be based near one of those office locations or in a remote location where we have need for in-person Appraisal support.

Training:

  • Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance.
  • Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.

Responsibilities:

  • An Empathetic Service Professional: When a claim is received, you skillfully use your customer centricity skills to confidently assure our customers that you are there to guide them through the process.
  • A Front Lines Liaison: You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in delivering on our promise.
  • A Reliable Teammate: Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules and the varying needs of our customers.
  • A Problem Solver: Integrity is in your nature and critical thinking is part of your decision-making process. That means you sincerely care that customers get exactly what they paid for and need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.
  • Using multiple software systems and claims best practices, you will prepare itemized appraisals indicating costs of parts, materials and labor necessary to restore damaged vehicles to their pre-damage condition.
  • You will provide technical advice on vehicle repair, parts costs, garage expertise and opinions on specific damages.
  • You will complete auto body shop, independent re-inspections, and supplements as warranted to verify damage or confirm repairs are completed.
  • You will resolve disagreements and negotiate with auto body shops, Independent Adjusters, claimants and policyholders and assist claims management in the resolution of complaints and evaluate claims for potential fraud or subrogation.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.
Qualifications

Qualifications

  • An engaging, outgoing personality, a passion for helping customers, and demonstrated ability to effectively communicate in both written and verbal form.
  • Extensive knowledge of automobile parts and repair techniques, terminology and vehicle construction.
  • Prior experience using auto estimating software, CCC Pathways, Audatex, Mitchell, etc.
  • Requires strong negotiation, analytical, decision-making, organizational and computer skills, as well as the ability to work with multi-faceted systems.
  • A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and 1-3 years of directly related experience.
  • Auto Damage Appraisal Licensing and certification are required.
  • Varying conditions may be encountered while inspecting vehicles.
  • Must be able to work outside in inclement weather conditions and drive substantial distances.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be required to complete inspections of damaged vehicles which will include but not be limited to inspecting the underside of and around vehicles, inspecting vehicles in tight quarters at body shops and salvage yards, etc.

About this job

SAP Configuration Engineer supporting general ledger configuration and maintenance for Liberty Mutual's OneGL finance environment. Role involves mapping business requirements to SAP capabilities, configuring GL settings, troubleshooting production issues, and supporting the monthly financial close process.

Good fit if you have 2-3+ years of SAP Finance experience with 1-2+ years of hands-on general ledger configuration and at least one implementation project.

Full job description


Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, Boston, MA, Plano, TX, Indianapolis, IN and Columbus, OH.

You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. We will not sponsor employment visas. Candidates who will require future sponsorship, including candidates on CPT/OPT/STEMOPT who will require future sponsorship, are not eligible to apply.

Job Introduction:

The Global Finance Technology organization is looking to hire a SAP Configuration Engineer to join the OneGL team, supporting the OneGL BAU, US2.2, and LII releases. The primary focus of this role will be supporting the SAP general ledger, with opportunities to learn and support other SAP FICO areas, including Fixed Assets (FA) and Reporting, as well as related areas such as SAP Master Data Governance (MDG). Under supervision, this individual would be responsible for analyzing, developing, and configuring new business requirements and enhancements in the SAP general ledger. This role would entail supporting production users and configuration/testing/training to support maintenance and enhancement of the OneGL finance environment supporting the financial month-end close process.

About the job:

  • Maps business requirements to SAP system capabilities to support functional and technical solutions.
  • Configures SAP general ledger system settings and options (such as company codes, chart of accounts, ledgers, account determination, and posting rules), and over time, settings in other FICO areas such as FA and Reporting, executes unit and integration testing, and documents functional and technical specifications.
  • Develops and maintains an understanding of the integrations related to the general ledger, including upstream source systems and subledger feeds, downstream reporting and consolidation, and the interfaces, data mappings, and reconciliation points between them.
  • Supports the monthly financial close by monitoring close activities, responding to production issues during close windows, and configuring period-end settings such as posting periods, accruals, foreign currency valuation, and intercompany processing.
  • Develops understanding of current business processes and system practices to support ongoing configuration and enhancement activities.
  • Performs troubleshooting and resolves defect issues, including posting errors, reconciliation breaks, and close-blocking issues, and traces issues across integrated systems to identify root cause, in collaboration with senior team members and subject matter experts.
  • Identifies test scenarios and cases with product owners, executes test cases (including end-to-end integration scenarios), documents test results and test scripts, and provides quality assurance results to the business.
  • Supports pieces of the implementation process such as post-implementation support, cutover activities, and documentation.
  • Participates in team discussions around system optimization and efficiency opportunities, including opportunities to streamline the close process.

In Addition to the Qualifications Listed Below, the Ideal Candidate Will Also Have:

  • Working understanding of financial transactional flow and SAP general ledger concepts such as company codes, chart of accounts, ledgers, coding blocks, profit centers, cost centers, and currencies.
  • Familiarity with how data flows into and out of the general ledger, such as subledger postings, interface files, and reporting extracts, and an interest in learning the integrations that support it.
  • Foundational understanding of month-end close processes, including accruals, foreign currency valuation, intercompany, and reconciliation, and a willingness to support the close calendar, including occasional extended hours during peak close periods.
  • Exposure to, or interest in learning, other SAP FICO areas such as Fixed Assets, and financial reporting, as well as master data governance concepts (such as SAP MDG).
  • Demonstrated curiosity and eagerness to deepen technical and functional expertise within the SAP Finance space and broader finance technology landscape.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to work with ambiguous and incomplete information.
  • Working knowledge of agile software development concepts including backlog tracking, participation in scrum ceremonies, and incremental delivery.
  • A growth mindset with a desire to develop within the SAP Finance configuration job family, taking on increasing responsibility over time as expertise and confidence grow.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor degree in technical or business discipline or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 2-3+ years of technical/functional SAP Finance experience.
  • Minimum 1-2+ years of hands-on experience with SAP general ledger configuration, including involvement in at least one implementation or system enhancement.
  • The ideal candidate will have the ability to quickly learn new technical concepts and have strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Configures SAP general ledger system settings and options (such as company codes, chart of accounts, ledgers, account determination, and posting rules), and over time, settings in other FICO areas such as FA and Reporting, executes unit and integration testing, and documents functional and technical specifications.
  • Develops and maintains an understanding of the integrations related to the general ledger, including upstream source systems and subledger feeds, downstream reporting and consolidation, and the interfaces, data mappings, and reconciliation points between them.
  • Supports the monthly financial close by monitoring close activities, responding to production issues during close windows, and configuring period-end settings such as posting periods, accruals, foreign currency valuation, and intercompany processing.
  • Develops understanding of current business processes and system practices to support ongoing configuration and enhancement activities.
  • Performs troubleshooting and resolves defect issues, including posting errors, reconciliation breaks, and close-blocking issues, and traces issues across integrated systems to identify root cause, in collaboration with senior team members and subject matter experts.
  • Identifies test scenarios and cases with product owners, executes test cases (including end-to-end integration scenarios), documents test results and test scripts, and provides quality assurance results to the business.
  • Supports pieces of the implementation process such as post-implementation support, cutover activities, and documentation.
  • Participates in team discussions around system optimization and efficiency opportunities, including opportunities to streamline the close process.

In Addition to the Qualifications Listed Below, the Ideal Candidate Will Also Have:

  • Working understanding of financial transactional flow and SAP general ledger concepts such as company codes, chart of accounts, ledgers, coding blocks, profit centers, cost centers, and currencies.
  • Familiarity with how data flows into and out of the general ledger, such as subledger postings, interface files, and reporting extracts, and an interest in learning the integrations that support it.
  • Foundational understanding of month-end close processes, including accruals, foreign currency valuation, intercompany, and reconciliation, and a willingness to support the close calendar, including occasional extended hours during peak close periods.
  • Exposure to, or interest in learning, other SAP FICO areas such as Fixed Assets, and financial reporting, as well as master data governance concepts (such as SAP MDG).
  • Demonstrated curiosity and eagerness to deepen technical and functional expertise within the SAP Finance space and broader finance technology landscape.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an ability to work with ambiguous and incomplete information.
  • Working knowledge of agile software development concepts including backlog tracking, participation in scrum ceremonies, and incremental delivery.
  • A growth mindset with a desire to develop within the SAP Finance configuration job family, taking on increasing responsibility over time as expertise and confidence grow.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor degree in technical or business discipline or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 2-3+ years of technical/functional SAP Finance experience.
  • Minimum 1-2+ years of hands-on experience with SAP general ledger configuration, including involvement in at least one implementation or system enhancement.
  • The ideal candidate will have the ability to quickly learn new technical concepts and have strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Suwanee, GA

About this job

Liberty Mutual seeks a Claims Resolution Specialist to investigate, evaluate, and settle bodily injury claims directly with injured parties. No prior bodily injury claims experience required; position offers clear growth path with two days in-office monthly minimum after training.

Good fit if you have strong communication and negotiation skills, customer service experience, and can obtain proper licensing as required.

Full job description


Description

Advance your career with our Personal Lines Casualty Team!

No bodily injury claims experience required!

Take the next step in your development with meaningful work and clear growth path.

The Bodily Injury Claims Specialist will investigate, manage and resolve Bodily Injury claims assigned directly with injured parties, as well as assist in providing service to policyholders.

All qualified applicants will reside within a 50-mile radius of the Indianapolis / Lake Mary / Suwanee office.

The start date for the role is February 8, 2027.

There may be several in-office days per month for the first few months following initial virtual training to support your learning and to build relationships with leaders and others in the department. This position requires a minimum of two days in office per month as the standard beyond the training period, with occasional additional days for special meetings a few times a year.

Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory.


In a high performing culture,WEin PL Core:

  • Strive to be better tomorrow than today; little improvements lead to big ones!
  • Embrace change.We may need to let go of what's familiar in order to embrace and try something new.
  • Understandhow our individual work contributes to our teams, our organizations and the company
  • Are adaptable and resilient. Change is imperative to being better tomorrow and resiliency allows us to handle unexpected challenges
  • Are an exporter of Talent.We maintain a focus on development and growth.
  • Contribute positively; We come to work every day with the intent to make a positive impact on our work and on everyone around us. One positive interaction with you can turn someone's day around.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates and evaluates coverage, liability, damages, and settles Bodily Injury claims directly with injured parties, within prescribed authority levels.
  • Pursues proactive contact with injured parties through various creative means to connect, listen, empathize and make early settlement offers whenever appropriate to resolve injury claims.
  • Identifies potential suspicious claims and refers to SIU and identifies opportunities for third party subrogation.
  • Communicates with policyholders, witnesses, and claimants in order to gather information regarding claims; refers tasks to auxiliary resources as necessary and advises as to proper course of action. Sends and responds to various written, telephone and SMS text inquiries to pursue resolution of the claim.
  • Ensures adequacy of reserves.
  • Accountable for security of financial processing of claims, as well as security information contained in claims files.
  • Makes effective use of loss management tools and techniques to ensure accuracy in decision making.
  • Keeps files updated with clear documentation for ease in understanding the status of investigations, evaluations and negotiations throughout the claim life cycle.
Qualifications
  • Strong written and oral communication skills required.
  • Good interpersonal, analytical, investigative, and negotiation skills required.
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Growth mindset; adapts well to change including new standard work and new tools
  • Basic knowledge of legal liability, general insurance policy coverage and State Tort Law preferred.
  • Liability experience or policy and claims knowledge preferred.
  • Bachelors degree preferred.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit.

Job.JobTitle: Director, Data Science - Rollout acceleration AI
Job.JobDescription:
Description

AI has the potential to transform how insurers bring new products to market. Help us make sure it does. US Data Science (USDS) is building a new team that will use advanced AI to bring our pricing programs to market faster, and we are hiring three senior data scientists to help launch it. The team will build state-of-the-art evaluations for AI and agentic systems. Those evaluations tell us how much value the AI delivers, how accurate it is, and what the risk is when it gets something wrong, so we can move high-value applications into production with confidence. This is a new, highly visible team, and its work will shape how AI is used in the core pricing work of US Retail Markets (USRM). Each of the three roles reports into the Rollout AI team in USDS and has a dotted-line relationship with one of our lines of business: Property & Specialty, Auto, or Small Commercial. You will be the data science partner for your line of business while working as one team with the other two, sharing methods and tools. These roles will be filled at the Assistant Director or Director I level, depending on experience and skills.

**Level of position offered will be based on skills and experience at manager discretion**

This role may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location

**Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote with occasional travel.**

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with your line of business's pricing, delivery, and technology teams to find where AI can speed up pricing program rollout.
  • Build state-of-the-art evaluations for AI and agentic applications. Define accuracy metrics and ground truth, generate statistical tests and edge cases, and design experiments, including tests in production.
  • Measure the value and risk of AI applications, including effort reduced, errors avoided, and time to market gained.
  • Bring pricing expertise and product sense to AI projects, translating business needs into requirements and evaluation criteria.
  • Prototype and build evaluation tooling and, over time, AI applications that accelerate rollout.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying insurance pricing models.
  • Strong expertise in model evaluation, statistics, and experimental design.
  • Strong coding skills (for example, Python) and a track record of building and shipping data science solutions.
  • Strong, recent hands-on experience with modern LLMs, including but not limited to agentic coding, building LLMs into applications, and/or RAG.
  • Experience evaluating generative AI or agentic systems is a plus.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, comfortable working across business, delivery, and technology teams.
  • Resilient, curious, acts in service of the best answer, holds themselves to a high standard and wants to be around others who do the same.
Qualifications
  • Broad knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
  • Advanced knowledge of predictive toolset; reflects as expert resource for tool development.
  • Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to establish and build relationships within and outside the organization.
  • Ability to give effective training and presentations to management and other groups.
  • Ability to use results of analysis to persuade team, department management or senior management to a particular course of action.
  • Broad knowledge of business drivers and market context.
  • Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact.
  • Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, a Master`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role.
