Build state-of-the-art evaluations for AI and agentic systems to accelerate insurance pricing program rollout at Liberty Mutual. Partner with pricing, delivery, and technology teams to measure AI value and risk, then prototype evaluation tools and applications.

Good fit if you have hands-on insurance pricing model experience, expertise in model evaluation and statistics, strong Python skills, and recent LLM or agentic systems experience.

Full job description


Description

AI has the potential to transform how insurers bring new products to market. Help us make sure it does. US Data Science (USDS) is building a new team that will use advanced AI to bring our pricing programs to market faster, and we are hiring three senior data scientists to help launch it. The team will build state-of-the-art evaluations for AI and agentic systems. Those evaluations tell us how much value the AI delivers, how accurate it is, and what the risk is when it gets something wrong, so we can move high-value applications into production with confidence. This is a new, highly visible team, and its work will shape how AI is used in the core pricing work of US Retail Markets (USRM). Each of the three roles reports into the Rollout AI team in USDS and has a dotted-line relationship with one of our lines of business: Property & Specialty, Auto, or Small Commercial. You will be the data science partner for your line of business while working as one team with the other two, sharing methods and tools. These roles will be filled at the Assistant Director or Director I level, depending on experience and skills.

**Level of position offered will be based on skills and experience at manager discretion**

This role may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location

**Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote with occasional travel.**

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with your line of business's pricing, delivery, and technology teams to find where AI can speed up pricing program rollout.
  • Build state-of-the-art evaluations for AI and agentic applications. Define accuracy metrics and ground truth, generate statistical tests and edge cases, and design experiments, including tests in production.
  • Measure the value and risk of AI applications, including effort reduced, errors avoided, and time to market gained.
  • Bring pricing expertise and product sense to AI projects, translating business needs into requirements and evaluation criteria.
  • Prototype and build evaluation tooling and, over time, AI applications that accelerate rollout.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying insurance pricing models.
  • Strong expertise in model evaluation, statistics, and experimental design.
  • Strong coding skills (for example, Python) and a track record of building and shipping data science solutions.
  • Strong, recent hands-on experience with modern LLMs, including but not limited to agentic coding, building LLMs into applications, and/or RAG.
  • Experience evaluating generative AI or agentic systems is a plus.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, comfortable working across business, delivery, and technology teams.
  • Resilient, curious, acts in service of the best answer, holds themselves to a high standard and wants to be around others who do the same.
Qualifications
  • Broad knowledge of predictive analytic techniques and statistical diagnostics of models.
  • Advanced knowledge of predictive toolset; reflects as expert resource for tool development.
  • Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to establish and build relationships within and outside the organization.
  • Ability to give effective training and presentations to management and other groups.
  • Ability to use results of analysis to persuade team, department management or senior management to a particular course of action.
  • Broad knowledge of business drivers and market context.
  • Has a value driven perspective with regard to understanding of work context and impact.
  • Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, a Master`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience or may be acquired through a Bachelor`s degree (scientific field of study) and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.

Description

In today's rapidly evolving cyber landscape, our insureds face increasingly complex threats from ransomware and business email compromise to largescale data breaches. Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Claims Officer, NAS Cyber Claims position.

As a Cyber Claim Officer, you will manage highexposure, often timesensitive matters, working closely with breach coaches, forensic investigators, underwriters, actuaries and cybersecurity experts. You will play a critical role in helping organizations respond to emergent cyber incidents and privacy, media and technology errors & omissions litigation, ensuring a confident and coordinated response, and shaping best practices in our cyber claims strategy. This is a highimpact opportunity for someone who thrives on novel issues, technical complexity, fastmoving incidents, and collaborative problemsolving.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzes, investigates, and evaluates the loss to determine coverage and claim disposition.
  • Utilizes CMS to document claims and to diary future events or follow-up.
  • Within prescribed settlement authority, establishes appropriate reserves for both indemnity and expense and reviews on a regular basis to ensure adequacy.
  • Makes recommendations to set reserves at appropriate level for claims outside of authority level.
  • Prepares comprehensive reports as required. Identifies and communicates specific claim trends and account and/or policy issues to management and underwriting.
  • Manages the litigation process through the retention of counsel.
  • Adheres to the line of business litigation guidelines to include budget, bill review and payment.
  • Pro-actively manages the case resolution process.
  • Actively participates in mediations and arbitrations, as well as negotiation discussions within limit of settlement authority.
  • Participates in the claims audit process.
  • Provides claims marketing services by meeting with brokers, risk managers and reinsurers.
  • As required, maintains insurance adjuster licenses.

Additional CyberSpecific Responsibilities Added:

  • Coordinates incident response activities with breach coaches, forensic firms, crisiscommunications teams, and cybersecurity vendors during active cyber events.
  • Evaluates forensic findings (e.g., Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR), Forensic Accounting) and integrates conclusions into coverage and liability decisions.
  • Advises insureds on recovery strategies, including business interruption documentation, data restoration processes, and postincident cyberhygiene improvements.
  • Engages in thought leadership such as panel presentations, white papers, conference attendance, etc.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices: Westborough, MA; Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Chandler, AZ; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; or Suwanee, GA. Please note this policy is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors' and/or advanced degree
  • 10 + years claims experience, with at least 5 years within a technical specialty. Advanced Cyber claims experience preferred.
  • Highly advanced knowledge of claims handling concepts, practices and techniques, to include but not limited to coverage issues, and product line knowledge
  • Functional knowledge of law and insurance regulations in various jurisdictions
  • Demonstrated superior verbal and written communications skills
  • Highest level of advanced analytical, decision making and negotiation skills

Job.JobTitle: Consultant, Personal Lines Property & Specialty Product
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Property State Management team seeks to achieve our combined ratio while growing faster than the industry growth rate. We accomplish these goals by engaging with the rest of the organization in setting the customer price level within the state, launching new pricing programs and product features, root cause analysis on issues impacting profitability or growth, and partnering with our distribution organization on how to more effectively sell our Direct and Agency products. Join our dynamic team where your analytical skills and strategic insights will directly influence product performance and business success across multiple states! In this role, youll tackle moderate to high complexity challenges, lead impactful projects, and collaborate with diverse teams to shape the future of our property products.

** This position may be filled at the Analyst, Senior Analyst, or Consultant level, depending on the candidates experience and qualifications, at the hiring managers discretion.This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location. **

What Youll Do:

  • Dive deep into data analysis to uncover trends, performance insights, and opportunities for growth in assigned states.
  • Be the go-to expert for state-specific property product strategy, delivering actionable recommendations that improve pricing, training, and overall product offerings.
  • Lead and drive your own projects, managing work streams that have meaningful business impact.
  • Collaborate closely with state teams, DSOs, IT partners, and product managers to align strategies and implement nationwide initiatives.
  • Stay ahead of the competition by researching market dynamics, competitor filings, and customer needs to inform innovative product changes.
  • Share your expertise by mentoring junior analysts, developing training materials, and leading sessions that empower your colleagues.

Why Youll Love This Role:

  • Make a difference: Your insights will help shape personal homeowners insurance products that millions of customers rely on.
  • Lead with impact: Take ownership of projects that influence business decisions at the state and national levels
  • Grow your skills: Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment that encourages continuous learning and development.
  • Be recognized: Your expertise and leadership will be valued and rewarded as you contribute to complex, strategic initiatives.

If youre ready to challenge yourself and play a key role in transforming property insurance products, we want to hear from you! Join us and accelerate your career while helping us deliver smarter, more competitive solutions for our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Conducts moderate to high complexity analysis under general direction.
  • As subject matter expert for assigned states, completes state reviews and similar work for basic states independently and for complex states or countrywide programs under general direction.
  • Queries data to conduct ad hoc analysis of metrics and builds simple tools and queries for others to use.
  • Provides recommendations to training and processes to manager.
  • Provides complex analysis to help drive and support business decisions.
  • Provides thoughtful recommendations to state teams on pricing, strategy, etc.
  • Consults on complex business issues and design considerations.
  • Educates IT partners on business vision and plan, and both IT and business partners on the impact of changes.
  • Serves as point person for moderate to high complexity country wide implementations.
  • Leads own work streams on medium to long-term or moderate to high complexity projects. May manage aspects of low to moderate complexity projects.
  • Based on strong understanding of how competitor actions impact marketplace, distribution channel and customers, conducts in depth research of competitor filings utilizing various sources. Research may be at the state, competitor or countrywide level.
  • Through research, identifies and proposes changes to our product offerings.
  • Analyzes trends and is responsible for tactical and strategic recommendations.
  • May create and/or be owner of training material content.
  • May create formal training sessions and modules.
  • Actively shares job knowledge with less experienced analysts.
  • Leads job shadow discussions with less experienced analysts.
  • Provides technical training and user support to business groups.
  • May be assigned to mentor a new hire.
  • May supervise interns.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in business, information management, economics, or other quantitative field. Masters degree preferred.
  • Minimum 4 years, typically 6 years or more of relevant work experience.
  • Knowledgeable in data query languages and tools; proficient in new and emerging technologies; may possess data modeling skills.
  • Highly developed communication and presentation skills.
  • In-depth knowledge of data concepts, strategies, and methodologies.
  • In-depth knowledge of data architectures, solutions and designs; extensive knowledge of business operations, strategies and objectives.
  • Highly developed negotiation, facilitation and consensus building skills.

Quick facts

About this job

Consultant role with Liberty Mutual's Property State Management team in Plano, Texas. You'll conduct data analysis on property insurance products, develop pricing strategies, lead projects across assigned states, and mentor junior analysts.

Good fit if you have 4+ years of relevant work experience, strong data analysis skills, and expertise in business strategy or insurance operations.

Full job description


Description

The Property State Management team seeks to achieve our combined ratio while growing faster than the industry growth rate. We accomplish these goals by engaging with the rest of the organization in setting the customer price level within the state, launching new pricing programs and product features, root cause analysis on issues impacting profitability or growth, and partnering with our distribution organization on how to more effectively sell our Direct and Agency products. Join our dynamic team where your analytical skills and strategic insights will directly influence product performance and business success across multiple states! In this role, youll tackle moderate to high complexity challenges, lead impactful projects, and collaborate with diverse teams to shape the future of our property products.

** This position may be filled at the Analyst, Senior Analyst, or Consultant level, depending on the candidates experience and qualifications, at the hiring managers discretion.This position may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location. **

What Youll Do:

  • Dive deep into data analysis to uncover trends, performance insights, and opportunities for growth in assigned states.
  • Be the go-to expert for state-specific property product strategy, delivering actionable recommendations that improve pricing, training, and overall product offerings.
  • Lead and drive your own projects, managing work streams that have meaningful business impact.
  • Collaborate closely with state teams, DSOs, IT partners, and product managers to align strategies and implement nationwide initiatives.
  • Stay ahead of the competition by researching market dynamics, competitor filings, and customer needs to inform innovative product changes.
  • Share your expertise by mentoring junior analysts, developing training materials, and leading sessions that empower your colleagues.

Why Youll Love This Role:

  • Make a difference: Your insights will help shape personal homeowners insurance products that millions of customers rely on.
  • Lead with impact: Take ownership of projects that influence business decisions at the state and national levels
  • Grow your skills: Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment that encourages continuous learning and development.
  • Be recognized: Your expertise and leadership will be valued and rewarded as you contribute to complex, strategic initiatives.

If youre ready to challenge yourself and play a key role in transforming property insurance products, we want to hear from you! Join us and accelerate your career while helping us deliver smarter, more competitive solutions for our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Conducts moderate to high complexity analysis under general direction.
  • As subject matter expert for assigned states, completes state reviews and similar work for basic states independently and for complex states or countrywide programs under general direction.
  • Queries data to conduct ad hoc analysis of metrics and builds simple tools and queries for others to use.
  • Provides recommendations to training and processes to manager.
  • Provides complex analysis to help drive and support business decisions.
  • Provides thoughtful recommendations to state teams on pricing, strategy, etc.
  • Consults on complex business issues and design considerations.
  • Educates IT partners on business vision and plan, and both IT and business partners on the impact of changes.
  • Serves as point person for moderate to high complexity country wide implementations.
  • Leads own work streams on medium to long-term or moderate to high complexity projects. May manage aspects of low to moderate complexity projects.
  • Based on strong understanding of how competitor actions impact marketplace, distribution channel and customers, conducts in depth research of competitor filings utilizing various sources. Research may be at the state, competitor or countrywide level.
  • Through research, identifies and proposes changes to our product offerings.
  • Analyzes trends and is responsible for tactical and strategic recommendations.
  • May create and/or be owner of training material content.
  • May create formal training sessions and modules.
  • Actively shares job knowledge with less experienced analysts.
  • Leads job shadow discussions with less experienced analysts.
  • Provides technical training and user support to business groups.
  • May be assigned to mentor a new hire.
  • May supervise interns.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in business, information management, economics, or other quantitative field. Masters degree preferred.
  • Minimum 4 years, typically 6 years or more of relevant work experience.
  • Knowledgeable in data query languages and tools; proficient in new and emerging technologies; may possess data modeling skills.
  • Highly developed communication and presentation skills.
  • In-depth knowledge of data concepts, strategies, and methodologies.
  • In-depth knowledge of data architectures, solutions and designs; extensive knowledge of business operations, strategies and objectives.
  • Highly developed negotiation, facilitation and consensus building skills.

  • Provide mentorship to junior underwriters and contribute insights on portfolio trends, emerging risks, and product or process improvements.

Description

About the Team

The Corporate Strategy & Research (CS&R) group is an award-winning ~40-person enterprise strategy and internal strategy consulting team within Liberty Mutual Insurance, a Fortune 100 company with 40,000 employees operating in 28 countries and economies worldwide. The group serves as trusted strategic advisers to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team and drives transformational change by taking an enterprise-wide, customer-centric perspective.

Established in 1972, CS&R has an outstanding track record of developing future leaders and serving as a top talent feeder to the organization by creating an environment that fosters intellectual curiosity, professional development, and personal fulfillment. Alumni of the group include our current Chairman & CEO, Chief Insights & Solutions Officer, EVP & General Manager of Sales and Service, SVP & Head of BU Strategy, VP & Managing Director of Corporate Development, and Vice President of Product Strategy. This is a great opportunity for an energetic individual to join a vibrant, high performance and tight-knit team environment that will be front and center in driving change across the enterprise.

The Details

Were in search of intellectually curious, creative, driven individuals who have a strong desire to expand their management consulting toolkit as part of an energetic and high-impact team.

As a Senior Manager I, youll oversee a workstream within a tight-knit consulting team led by a Managing Director that will collectively advise Liberty Mutuals senior executives in making key strategic decisions. Projects are typically in the areas of strategy development, growth strategy, organizational design & operating model, innovation, or business transformation, and typically run for 2-5 months.

Youll develop key relationships with leaders and executives across the organization and communicate with senior leadership to influence and galvanize the organization into action.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Deciphering strategic issues faced by Liberty Mutual stakeholders, and determining how best to address them
  • Designing work plans for your workstream, and collecting data from various internal and external sources (e.g., executive interviews and workshops, customer surveys)
  • Crafting compelling storylines that clearly articulate findings, insights, and recommendations
  • Building and owning relationships with key client stakeholders
  • Directing team and client stakeholders towards consensus points and gaining buy-in
  • Communicating with senior leadership to influence and drive the organization to action
  • Supporting the development and coaching of Associate Consultants and Senior Associate Consultants
  • Contributing to CS&R initiatives such as recruiting, talent development, culture building and engagement, or alumni engagement

Your compensation will include:

    • Base salary plus an annual short term incentive bonus target: 17.5%
Qualifications

The group is looking for intellectually curious, creative, and driven individuals with an interest in developing the management consulting toolkit.

Candidates should, at minimum, possess the following:

  • MBA with a demonstrated record of success or equivalent business and analytical background
  • 3+ years of experience with a MBA or 5+ years of work experience with a Bachelors
  • Strong critical thinking skills with ability to elevate thinking and apply judgment during analysis about how components fit together and with bigger picture
  • Ability to leverage experience and analysis to gain support and influence others
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and written and oral communication skills
  • Strong leadership skills and ability to work independently and as a member of a team, and coach junior team members
  • Ability to manage multiple projects or priorities
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience a plus

What really gets our attention:

  • Top-tier strategy consulting experience
  • You are motivated by high impact, high visibility work
  • You can independently navigate and decipher an ambiguous environment
  • You have demonstrated strong leadership abilities and care about professionally developing those around you

Required steps:

  • All candidates must apply to the job posting on the Liberty Mutual Careers website, with their resume.

About this job

Reinsurance Claims Specialist role at AXIS Capital handling assigned claims portfolios through timely documentation, evaluation, and processing. The role partners across underwriting, actuarial, and finance teams to support claim resolution, sound reserving, and high-quality service to brokers and clients.

Good fit if you have at least 3 years of insurance or reinsurance claims experience and understand coverage analysis, claims handling practices, and applicable insurance laws.

Full job description

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Claims Lead – Grade I

Job Family Grouping: Claims Group

Job Family: Claims Specialist

How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Claims Specialist plays an important role in protecting AXIS Re's balance sheet, reputation, and client relationships through the timely, accurate, and consistent handling of reinsurance claims. The role supports effective claim resolution, sound reserving practices, and high-quality service to internal and external stakeholders while ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements.

By working closely with underwriting, actuarial, finance, brokers, cedents, and fellow claims professionals, the Claims Specialist contributes to loss analysis, reserve monitoring, and portfolio understanding. Through disciplined claim management and effective communication, the role helps deliver reliable claims outcomes and supports informed business decision-making. Through effective communication and knowledge sharing, the Claims Specialist helps bridge the gap between claims activity, business strategy, and operational decision-making. The role transforms complex claims information, loss data, and emerging risk developments into practical insights that support underwriting, actuarial, finance, and management stakeholders.

Ultimately, the Claims Specialist helps AXIS Re maintain strong claims governance, operational excellence, and trusted client service while supporting the broader objectives of the Reinsurance Claims team.

What will you do in this role?


  • Handle assigned reinsurance claims and claim portfolios in accordance with AXIS Re claims guidelines, delegated authorities, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure claims are promptly and accurately documented, evaluated, reserved, and processed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Analyze claim submissions, loss notices, and supporting documentation to assess coverage, liability, financial exposure, and reporting requirements.
  • Identify and escalate coverage issues, large losses, accumulation concerns, and other material developments in a timely manner.
  • Maintain case reserves and monitor claim activity and loss development on assigned accounts.
  • Partner with underwriting, actuarial, finance, and legal teams to support effective claim management and informed business decision making.
  • Communicate directly with brokers, cedants, and other stakeholders regarding claim developments, information requests, coverage matters, and reporting requirements.
  • Participate in claims audits, including audit planning, file selection, audit attendance, preparation of audit reports, and communication of findings and recommendations.
  • Monitor legal, regulatory, and market developments that may impact claims handling, reserving practices, or portfolio performance.
  • Maintain high-quality claim files and ensure accurate, complete, and reliable claims data within company systems.
  • Contribute to management reporting, portfolio reviews, and other initiatives that support effective oversight of the claims portfolio.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including underwriting, actuarial, finance, brokers, cedants, auditors, and service providers.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance claims handling practices, operational efficiency, reporting capabilities, and data quality.
  • Assist in the development and maintenance of training materials, desk guides, reference tools, and process documentation to promote consistency and operational effectiveness across the Claims team.
  • Translate complex claims, coverage, legal, and reserving concepts into clear and concise communications tailored to a variety of business audiences.
  • Support the effective use of data, reporting tools, automation, and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence solutions, to improve workflows and business processes.
  • Collaborate across global teams and functions to improve the quality, consistency, accessibility, and usability of claims information.
  • Contribute to a culture of learning, collaboration, and continuous professional development by sharing knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.

About You:

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.


What you need to have:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in insurance and/or reinsurance claims handling.
  • Good understanding of insurance and reinsurance principles, coverage analysis, and claims handling practices.
  • Working knowledge of legal processes and laws applicable to insurance claims.
  • Familiarity with reinsurance customs and practices and laws applicable to reinsurance.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Experience using claims management systems; knowledge of SICS is beneficial.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Experience handling casualty, professional liability, cyber, specialty, or other complex insurance and reinsurance claims.
  • Experience participating in claims audits, portfolio reviews, or file quality assurance initiatives.
  • Experience working directly with brokers, cedants, reinsurers, underwriters, or other external stakeholders.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and familiarity with data visualization, reporting, or analytics tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience working in data-intensive environments and leveraging information to support business, operational, or claims-related decision making.
  • Familiarity with B2B operational processes and stakeholder engagement.
  • Interest in or experience supporting the use of automation, data solutions, artificial intelligence, or other emerging technologies within insurance or financial services environments.
  • Experience developing training materials, process documentation, job aids, or knowledge-sharing resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical, legal, financial, or operational concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Experience supporting onboarding, mentoring, coaching, or training initiatives within a professional environment.
  • Knowledge of emerging issues, market developments, and trends affecting the insurance and reinsurance industry.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) designation preferred but not required.

Role Factors:

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Maintain a regular onsite presence of a minimum of three days per week, in line with AXIS Re office attendance expectations.
  • Travel occasionally to support claims audits, market meetings, and stakeholder engagement activities.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders including Underwriting, Actuarial, Finance, and Legal, as well as external partners such as cedants, brokers, auditors, and service providers.

What we offer:

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $90,000 to $120,000. The specific salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors, including the experience of the successful candidate and work location. In addition, all employees are eligible for competitive incentive opportunities based on overall corporate and individual performance.

You will also be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including medical plans for employees and their families, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

What Is the Opportunity?

At Travelers, our Cybersecurity Engineering teams are responsible for the overall implementation and management of strategic platforms that provide oversight, process management, protection and enablement of security control processes and allow for an effective Cybersecurity practice.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer II, you will provide subject matter expertise and consultation on complex cybersecurity platforms to ensure correct installation, configuration, and maintenance. You will consult with business partners on any changes and/or enhancements and will effectively communicate potential operational impacts. Leveraging your technical expertise on strategic platforms, you will troubleshoot complex issues that may be escalated and provide guidance and coaching to team members.

What Will You Do?

  • Own the architecture, deployment, and lifecycle of self-hosted CyberArk components, including the Password Vault Web Access (PVWA), Central Policy Manager (CPM), and Privileged Session Manager (PSM/PSMP).
  • Maintain platform configurations, safe structures, access policies, and master policy settings that align with least-privilege and separation-of-duties principles.
  • Onboard privileged accounts and secrets across Windows, Linux/Unix, databases, network devices, and cloud platforms, developing custom CPM plugins and connectors where out-of-the-box support falls short.
  • Lead vault resilience efforts, including disaster recovery, high-availability configuration, backup validation, and version upgrades with minimal disruption.
  • Build automation for onboarding, reconciliation, reporting, and health monitoring using the CyberArk REST API, PowerShell, and related tooling.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across the PAM stack, from connection component failures and PSM recordings to CPM rotation errors and vault performance tuning.
  • Document standards and runbooks and contribute to the technical maturity of the broader team.
  • Help advance our privileged access roadmap toward password-less and modern authentication by reducing reliance on static credentials through ephemeral, certificate-based, and just-in-time access models, and tighter integration with our broader identity platform.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Hands-on experience operating self-hosted (on-premises) CyberArk PAM in a production enterprise environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of the full CyberArk component set: Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM/PSMP, and familiarity with PTA, Conjur, or CyberArk's SaaS offerings.
  • Experience developing custom connection components and CPM plugins for non-standard platforms.
  • Proficiency with the CyberArk REST API and scripting in PowerShell (Python a plus) to automate operational tasks.
  • Solid command of Windows Server and Active Directory, with working knowledge of Linux/Unix privileged access models.
  • Practical understanding of authentication protocols and PKI concepts (LDAP, SAML, Kerberos, certificates) as they relate to PAM.
  • Understanding of just-in-time and zero-standing-privilege access models, and how to move a program from static, always-on credentials toward ephemeral access.
  • Working knowledge of password-less and certificate-based authentication concepts, and how they apply to privileged access.
  • Experience integrating PAM with the surrounding identity and operations ecosystem IdP/SSO (Entra ID, Okta), ITSM (ServiceNow), SIEM, and secrets consumers via API.
  • Experience evaluating, piloting, or integrating new capabilities into an existing PAM program - able to weigh build-vs-buy tradeoffs and plan phased rollouts.
  • A track record of leading upgrades, migrations, or resilience improvements in a self-hosted deployment.
  • CyberArk certifications (Defender, Sentry, or Guardian).
  • Exposure to hybrid and cloud privileged access patterns (AWS, Azure).
  • Experience supporting privileged access in a regulated industry.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar degree, or its equivalent in work experience.
  • 4 years of experience in Information Technology Security Engineering or Software engineering.

  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Job Description

Aon is looking for a strategic Product Manager, Intelligence to help build and develop a new Intelligence function. This role focuses on transforming information into improved decisions, enhanced experiences, and stronger business results. This is a virtual position based in the United States.

You will function in a dynamic setting where plans, talents, and processes are still being established. The ideal candidate prospers amid ambiguity, acts independently, simplifies complexity, and converts emerging prospects into valuable business outcomes.

You will be responsible for the product strategy and roadmap for Intelligence. You will identify where information, insights, and decision capabilities drive business value. Then, you will transform these opportunities into scalable products and features. You will collaborate with Product, Experience, business, analytics, and technology teams to advance Intelligence beyond standard reporting toward improved decisions and smarter, adaptive experiences.

This is a product management role, not product ownership. You will identify the right problems to solve, set product strategy and direction, make prioritization and investment decisions, and own outcomes rather than just managing requirements or completing a predefined backlog.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like:

Product Strategy & Management

  • Define and take responsibility for the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Intelligence capabilities across the business.
  • Identify business challenges and opportunities where information, analysis, and intelligence can drive better results.
  • Manage products from discovering problems through strategy, requirements, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and continuous refinement.
  • Balance immediate business needs with longer-term investments, scalability, and reuse.
  • Establish success measures and evaluate product adoption, business impact, and value realization.
  • Make clear prioritization and investment tradeoffs grounded in business value, customer needs, strategic alignment, and feasibility.

Intelligence & Business Enablement

  • Help define the product direction, capabilities, and ways of working for an emerging Intelligence function.
  • Propel the shift from traditional reporting toward self-service intelligence, decision support, and increasingly proactive and adaptive capabilities.
  • Find opportunities to turn data and information into reusable products and capabilities that improve decisions and business performance.
  • Partner with Product and Experience teams to embed intelligence into customer and colleague journeys.
  • Enable capabilities that support personalization, recommendations, proactive interventions, and more relevant experiences.
  • Explore advanced analytics, AI, and emerging technologies in ways that generate significant business value.
  • Promote a shift from reactive reporting toward proactive, data-driven decision-making.

Collaboration & Influence

  • Bring structure and clarity to ambiguous business challenges, proactively finding opportunities rather than waiting for defined requirements.
  • Develop solid collaborations with Product, Experience, business, analytics, and technology groups.
  • Develop efficient methods of working, prioritization techniques, and success criteria as the Intelligence function evolves.
  • Connect business needs and desired outcomes to the appropriate intelligence opportunities and capabilities.
  • Communicate product strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to collaborators and leadership.

Skills and experience that will lead to success:

  • 4+ years of direct product management experience with accountability for product strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, delivery, and outcomes.
  • Proven experience guiding products from problem identification through strategy, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable product solutions.
  • Strong product discovery, prioritization, requirements definition, and collaborator management skills.
  • Excellent business insight, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving measurable business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success operating in ambiguous or evolving environments, establishing direction, and independently driving progress.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence across organizational levels.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or demonstrated equivalent experience in the industry.

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Covala Group (part of NFP, an Aon company) is a proven enroller and administrator of voluntary, supplemental and individual disability benefits for large employers. Since 1993 we have connected employees of our clients to over $4.5 billion of income protection. We have also assisted Fortune 500 companies in the development and implementation of group life insurance, corporate owned life insurance, and long-term care programs. Our name, Covala, was inspired by the covalent bond, the strongest type of chemical bond there is. Covala embodies our dedication to forming powerful bonds with our clients and plan participants — connecting them to the benefits they need and the service they deserve.

Position Summary:

The Account Management position is an integral part of a ten-person team. The role is central within the organization and is responsible for managing relationships with corporate clients and overseeing internal operations among different functional groups.The individual in this position will participate in company-wide projects that involve collaboration across departments. This is an excellent opportunity for someone seeking to contribute meaningfully to a growing business and gain valuable experience. Success in this role requires a proactive and results-driven mindset, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. Intellectual curiosity, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and professional integrity are also essential qualities.

Schedule:

This full-time, exempt position follows a standard schedule of Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time. The role is open to a hybrid arrangement from our New York City office or a fully remote arrangement within the United States.

Hybrid employees may work onsite up to three days per week during the first three months for training, with ongoing attendance based on business needs thereafter. Remote employees must maintain the established Eastern Time schedule, along with a private, confidential workspace and reliable high-speed internet.

Position Responsibilities:

Essential Functions:

  • Interact daily with Benefit / Human Resource contacts at large corporate clients and top law firms providing administration and client service support for their individual disability insurance benefits.
  • Coordinate annual enrollment and communication campaigns to executives of our corporate clients.
  • Analyze census data from our corporate clients and determine eligible executive populations for enrollment campaigns.
  • Handle inquiries from eligible executives about the disability insurance being offered through our enrollments.
  • Team with our IT Group to develop reports for our corporate clients.

Qualifications:

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strong attention to detail with a high level of accountability and ownership.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with clients, HR and Benefits contacts, executives, plan participants, and internal partners.
  • Resourcefulness and sound judgment, including knowing when to engage others to resolve questions or issues.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative, fast-paced team.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with particular comfort reviewing and working with data in Excel.
  • A professional, client-focused approach and the ability to adapt to changing priorities.

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • Life and Health Insurance License required.
  • Able to obtain Long-Term Care (LTC) certification within three months of hire.
  • 5-10 years of relevant experience in client service, account management, insurance, or employee benefits required.
  • Executive benefits, individual disability insurance, and/or enrollment program experience preferred.

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $61,500 – $80,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Who We Are

About NFP's Safety & Risk Consulting (SRC)

NFP's Safety & Risk Consulting (SRC) practice is a national team of safety, loss control and risk management professionals who support clients across industries and geographies. The team provides practical, client-specific consulting focused on protecting people, strengthening operations, reducing loss drivers and improving risk quality. SRC works collaboratively with clients, NFP account teams, producers, insurance carriers and other technical specialists to connect field-based risk improvement with broader insurance and business objectives.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Construction Safety Consultant to provide hands-on safety and risk control consulting to construction clients primarily throughout the New York, New Jersey and Connecticut Tri-State area, while also supporting national clients and projects. The consultant will evaluate jobsite and operational exposures, develop practical risk improvement strategies, deliver training, and serve as a technical resource to client leadership, field teams, NFP colleagues and insurance partners.

This is a full-time, field-based position with remote flexibility when not traveling. Approximately 60% travel is expected, including local jobsite travel and periodic overnight national travel. The ideal candidate will live in or near the New York City metropolitan area with convenient access to a major airport.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct construction jobsite safety assessments, loss control surveys and management-system reviews for general contractors, owners, developers and trade contractors.
  • Evaluate high-hazard construction exposures and controls, including falls, scaffolds, ladders, excavation and trenching, cranes and rigging, electrical work, hot work, confined spaces, temporary structures, material handling, public protection and contractor management.
  • Review and help strengthen corporate and project-specific safety programs, site safety plans, emergency action plans, job hazard analyses, pre-task plans, subcontractor controls and written compliance programs.
  • Analyze loss runs, incident trends, experience modifiers and other available risk data to identify loss drivers, prioritize resources and develop measurable service plans.
  • Perform incident and near-miss reviews, support root-cause analysis, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. This role does not replace the client's legal, claims or regulatory counsel.
  • Deliver practical training, executive briefings, supervisor coaching and toolbox-style education on construction safety, regulatory compliance and risk improvement topics.
  • Prepare clear, timely reports that document observations, identify priority hazards, recommend corrective actions and communicate risk implications to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Partner with NFP producers, account teams, claims professionals and carrier risk control representatives to support client stewardship, renewal strategy, prospect evaluations and coordinated service delivery, including Owner Controlled Insurance Program (OCIP) and Contractor Controlled Insurance Program (CCIP) safety and loss-control activities.
  • Support OCIP and CCIP program activities, including preconstruction safety reviews, contractor and subcontractor safety qualification, project-specific safety planning, orientation and training coordination, site audits, loss-trend review, corrective-action tracking, stewardship reporting and collaboration with program sponsors, administrators, carriers and claims partners.
  • Participate in client meetings and business development activities as a construction safety subject matter resource, including service-plan development and presentation of findings to senior leadership.
  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable federal, state and local requirements and accepted industry practices, including OSHA construction standards and relevant New York City construction and local regulations safety requirements.
  • Manage multiple client engagements independently, document activity in designated systems and consistently meet agreed timelines and service expectations.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of progressive construction safety, loss control or construction risk consulting experience, with substantial field-based jobsite experience.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Owner Controlled Insurance Programs (OCIPs) and Contractor Controlled Insurance Programs (CCIPs), including project safety oversight, contractor coordination, loss-control activities and program reporting.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in occupational safety, construction management, engineering, risk management or a related subject area, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • OSHA 510, Occupational Safety and Health Standards for the Construction Industry.
  • Completion of applicable New York City Department of Buildings Site Safety Training (SST) requirements and other NYC construction safety training required for the consultant's assigned project duties.
  • Working knowledge of OSHA 29 CFR 1926 and the ability to interpret and apply applicable federal, state and local construction safety requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify hazards, evaluate controls, analyze incidents and losses, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Strong written, presentation, facilitation and client relationship skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, project managers, superintendents, safety professionals and craft employees.
  • Valid driver's license, an acceptable driving record consistent with company requirements, and the ability to drive to client and project locations and travel approximately 60%, including local travel and overnight national travel.
  • Ability to perform field-based construction work while wearing required safety PPE. The position requires walking active jobsites; climbing stairs and ladders; accessing elevated, confined, uneven or unfinished work areas; standing for extended periods; bending, stooping, kneeling and reaching; and lifting or carrying up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and comfort using web-based safety, risk control and client-management platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST). Associate Safety Professional (ASP) may be considered for candidates actively progressing toward the CSP.
  • OSHA 500 authorized trainer status is strongly preferred for candidates who will deliver OSHA Outreach training.
  • Experience supporting complex commercial, infrastructure, civil, high-rise, healthcare, industrial or large general-contractor construction programs.
  • Experience within a property and casualty insurance carrier, insurance brokerage, risk consulting firm or owner-controlled/contractor-controlled insurance program environment.
  • Familiarity with workers' compensation, general liability, auto/fleet and builders risk loss drivers, as well as insurance-related stewardship and carrier risk control processes.
  • Bilingual communication skills, particularly English and Spanish, are a plus.

Work Environment and Travel

This position is virtual when not at client or project locations. The consultant will primarily assist clients in the New York, New Jersey and Connecticut Tri-State area and will also support national clients as business needs require. Approximately 60% travel is expected. Residence in or around New York City, with convenient access to John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport or another major airport serving the region, is preferred. The work includes active construction environments and requires use of appropriate PPE, ladder and stair access, regular walking and standing, and occasional lifting or carrying up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Job Description

Captive Client Leader | Aon Captive & Insurance Management (ACIM)

Are you a client leader who turns strong relationships into long‑term strategic value?

Do you thrive in complex client environments where success depends on judgment, influence, and cross‑functional collaboration?

Join us to help clients make better captive and risk financing decisions!

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work from our Burlington, Vermont office and from home in line with Aon's U.S. smart working policy.

This role must be based in Vermont. Candidates will need to already reside in the state or be willing to relocate.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

This role exists to strengthen client outcomes through consultative captive leadership. As a Captive Client Services Director, you will act as the principal interface between captive clients and Aon, ensuring clients receive high‑quality service, strategic insight, and access to the right expertise across the business. You will help clients make better decisions about captive performance, risk financing strategy, and long‑term value creation.

Typical activities include:

  • Leading strategic client engagement for a portfolio of captive clients, acting as the primary relationship lead for senior executives
  • Running annual account planning discussions aligned to client priorities, service requirements, and commercial objectives
  • Coordinating strategy check‑ins with subject matter experts to provide external perspectives, market insight, and forward‑looking recommendations
  • Reviewing stewardship reports, performance data, and service metrics to find opportunities for improvement and additional value creation
  • Orchestrating internal teams across domiciles, Global Capability Centres, and wider Aon businesses to deliver integrated client outcomes
  • Finding opportunities to strengthen client relationships, improve account profitability, and expand relevant Aon services
  • Translating technical, financial, and performance information into clear client narratives and actionable recommendations
  • Coaching and supporting more junior colleagues to strengthen client leadership capability and consistency of service delivery
  • Maintaining delivery discipline across service schedules, governance commitments, and regulatory requirements

How this opportunity is different

This role is differentiated by the level of client influence, strategic ownership, and cross‑functional coordination involved. You will operate as the central connector between captive clients and Aon, bringing together expertise from across the organization to support better client decisions and stronger long‑term partnerships.

The role is shifting from transactional service delivery toward consultative client leadership. Success depends on your ability to deeply understand client priorities, proactively find opportunities, and build value through strategic conversations, insight‑led communication, and effective orchestration of Aon capabilities.

You will help shape the future‑state client leadership model within ACIM, supporting a more proactive, data-driven, and commercially focused approach to client engagement.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Demonstrated advisory client engagement, building deep understanding of client priorities, challenges, and risk financing objectives and operating as a trusted advisor
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking, connecting client strategies, commercial opportunities, and Aon capabilities to create measurable value and support profitable growth
  • Confirmed ability to orchestrate expertise across a matrixed organization, influencing without formal authority and aligning teams around shared client objectives
  • Track record of owning client service delivery, managing service schedules and stewardship activity, and maintaining high standards of execution and governance
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn technical information, market insight, and performance data into compelling narratives for senior collaborators
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving situations, with sound judgment, learning agility, and the ability to draw on specialist expertise when needed
  • Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring colleagues to build capability and consistent client leadership standards across teams
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, risk management, or a related field.

Key Responsibilities

Plan Administration & Compliance

  • Be responsible for the full administration cycle for a block of defined contribution retirement plans
  • Perform non-discrimination and compliance testing, including ADP/ACP, 410(b) coverage, top-heavy, 415 annual addition limit, 401(a)(4) cross-testing and other necessary measurements
  • Calculate and allocate employer contributions
  • Reconcile payroll contributions to determine prior activity aligns with prior instructions and reconcile employee census data to determine current year plan eligibility
  • Review and approve participant distribution and loan requests performed by a centralized, supporting group
  • Review Qualified Domestic Relations Orders (QDROs) and calculate distributions to alternate payees
  • Reconcile trust assets and contributions, interpreting trust financial statements to resolve discrepancies
  • Support plan conversions and takeovers, including coordination with prior TPAs, investment advisors, and clients
  • Interpret plan document provisions to ensure accurate, compliant administration
  • Ensure clients adhere to government filing and regulatory requirements

Government Filings & Regulatory Support

  • Complete, review, and provide audit support for Forms 5500, 5330, 8955-SSA, 1099-R, and related schedules
  • Review and validate work completed by other plan administrators and support staff to ensure accuracy prior to delivery
  • Maintain and expand ERISA compliance and software knowledge in step with evolving regulations and our evolving technology platform capabilities

Client & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and consultant for an assigned block of clients, guiding plan design and ongoing maintenance to meet their needs
  • Consult with clients on the timely deposit and remittance of deferrals and employer contributions
  • Assist clients in navigating plan sponsor and participant recordkeeping portals
  • Accompany relationship managers to client and participant meetings, contributing to discussion and presentation of plan results
  • Develop effective working relationships with clients, internal teams, and external advisors, recordkeepers, and auditors supporting shared client relationships
  • Identify and surface opportunities for new business development

Analysis & Communication

  • Review, analyze, and summarize plan data in clear, succinct written communication to support Advisors, Consultants, and fellow Plan Administrators
  • Serve as a technical resource for research and plan analysis projects for internal and external clients

Professional Development

  • Align with continuing education requirements and pursue ongoing credentialing
  • Participate in professional organizations and independent study to stay current on ERISA and industry developments
  • Integrate new knowledge and skills into daily work, sharing insights with colleagues as appropriate

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in business administration, business analytics, mathematical economics, finance, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

High school diploma required.

Experience

Three to five years of directly related experience in retirement plan administration and consulting.

Credentialing (one or more preferred):

  • ASPPA: Qualified 401(k) Administrator (QKA), Qualified Plan Specialist (QKS), Qualified 401(k) Consultant (QKC), and/or Qualified Pension Administrator (QPA)
  • NIPA: Accredited 401(k) Specialist (AKS), Accredited Pension Administrator (APA), and/or Accredited Pension Representative (APR)
  • IRS Enrolled Retirement Plan Agent (ERPA)
  • NAPA: Certified Plan Fiduciary Advisor (CPFA) and/or Qualified Plan Financial Consultant (QPFC)

Technical Skills

Experience with Stax.ai, FT William, and PensionPro strongly preferred; familiarity with ASC a plus. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams. High degree of technical and legal knowledge, including familiarity with the Internal Revenue Code and ERISA as they apply to qualified plans.

Skills You'll Use Every Day

  • Communication – effective oral, written, and interpersonal skills; communicates clearly and interactively with team members and support staff
  • Judgment & problem-solving – proven organizational and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on plan design and compliance matters
  • Client service – demonstrated ability to deliver quality customer service while managing multiple tasks with a high degree of accuracy
  • Ownership – a sense of urgency and commitment to timely, high-quality project completion, balanced with attention to detail and confidentiality
  • Collaboration – ability to work independently and within a team, bringing a positive, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset

Job Description

Captive Client Leader | Aon Captive & Insurance Management (ACIM)

Are you a client leader who turns strong relationships into long‑term strategic value?

Do you thrive in complex client environments where success depends on judgment, influence, and cross‑functional collaboration?

Join us to help clients make better captive and risk financing decisions!

This is a virtual role with the flexibility to work virtually across the U.S.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

This role exists to strengthen client outcomes through consultative captive leadership. As a Captive Client Services Director, you will act as the principal interface between captive clients and Aon, ensuring clients receive high‑quality service, strategic insight, and access to the right expertise across the business. You will help clients make better decisions about captive performance, risk financing strategy, and long‑term value creation.

Typical activities include:

  • Leading strategic client engagement for a portfolio of captive clients, acting as the primary relationship lead for senior executives
  • Running annual account planning discussions aligned to client priorities, service requirements, and commercial objectives
  • Coordinating strategy check‑ins with subject matter experts to provide external perspectives, market insight, and forward‑looking recommendations
  • Reviewing stewardship reports, performance data, and service metrics to find opportunities for improvement and additional value creation
  • Orchestrating internal teams across domiciles, Global Capability Centres, and wider Aon businesses to deliver integrated client outcomes
  • Finding opportunities to strengthen client relationships, improve account profitability, and expand relevant Aon services
  • Translating technical, financial, and performance information into clear client narratives and actionable recommendations
  • Coaching and supporting more junior colleagues to strengthen client leadership capability and consistency of service delivery
  • Maintaining delivery discipline across service schedules, governance commitments, and regulatory requirements

How this opportunity is different

This role is differentiated by the level of client influence, strategic ownership, and cross‑functional coordination involved. You will operate as the central connector between captive clients and Aon, bringing together expertise from across the organization to support better client decisions and stronger long‑term partnerships.

The role is shifting from transactional service delivery toward consultative client leadership. Success depends on your ability to deeply understand client priorities, proactively find opportunities, and build value through strategic conversations, insight‑led communication, and effective orchestration of Aon capabilities.

You will help shape the future‑state client leadership model within ACIM, supporting a more proactive, data-driven, and commercially focused approach to client engagement.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Demonstrated advisory client engagement, building deep understanding of client priorities, challenges, and risk financing objectives and operating as a trusted advisor
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking, connecting client strategies, commercial opportunities, and Aon capabilities to create measurable value and support profitable growth
  • Confirmed ability to orchestrate expertise across a matrixed organization, influencing without formal authority and aligning teams around shared client objectives
  • Track record of owning client service delivery, managing service schedules and stewardship activity, and maintaining high standards of execution and governance
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn technical information, market insight, and performance data into compelling narratives for senior collaborators
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous or evolving situations, with sound judgment, learning agility, and the ability to draw on specialist expertise when needed
  • Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring colleagues to build capability and consistent client leadership standards across teams
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, finance, risk management, or a related field.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share, and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Full job description

Job Description

Wildfire Scientist – Wildfire Spread Modeler

This is a hybrid role with the opportunity to work virtually and from our Boston office

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Operate, maintain, and enhance Aon's current wildfire spread modeling workflows, including:
    • Running large catalogs of simulated events for model development, testing, and calibration.
    • Working directly with our current wildfire spread engine and associated tooling to ensure reliable, repeatable runs
    • Diagnosing performance bottlenecks and improving stability and throughput of spread simulations.
  • Work on improving how our models represent spread in and through the WUI, including:
    • Representing transitions from wildland fuels to urban and suburban areas.
    • Incorporating ember generation, spotting, and structure‑to‑structure fire spread behaviors.
    • Evaluating how different fuels, topography, and exposures influence spread into built environments.
    • Helping to shape new modeling approaches that better capture fire behavior in the WUI.
  • Develop, test, and maintain modeling and data‑processing pipelines in R and/or Python, including:
    • Automation and orchestration of large batches of spread simulations on HPC / cloud resources.
    • Efficient handling of large geospatial datasets (fuels, topography, exposure grids, fire perimeters).
  • Evaluate and integrate traditional wildfire spread science into our modeling framework:
    • Work with established fire behavior models (e.g., Rothermel‑based approaches and related methods).
    • Assess model behavior against historical wildfire perimeters, growth patterns, and impact footprints.
  • Perform model validation and verification:
    • Compare modeled spread and burned area to observed historical events across different fuel types and regions.
    • Document and communicate findings and recommended improvements back into the modeling workflow.
  • Collaborate closely with an international, interdisciplinary team of:
    • Catastrophe model developers, wildfire scientists, meteorologists, engineers, and exposure/vulnerability specialists.
    • Software developers and client‑facing colleagues who bring the models to market.
  • Prepare technical documentation, presentations, and summaries of modeling work for both internal and external audiences.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in wildfire science, fire behavior, environmental science, applied geoscience, atmospheric science, a closely related field (required) or equivalent years of industry experience
  • Direct experience with wildfire spread modeling (required), which may include:
    • Operational or research use of tools such as FARSITE, FlamMap, BehavePlus, or similar fire behavior models, and/or
    • Experience developing or working with custom spread models (cellular automata, level‑set methods, or other numerical approaches).
  • Demonstrated understanding of wildland–urban interface (WUI) fire behavior, including:
    • How fires transition from wildland fuels into communities.
    • The role of embers/spotting and structure‑to‑structure spread (preferred).
  • Strong programming / scripting skills, preferably in R and/or Python (required).
  • Experience working with geospatial data and tools (e.g., raster/vector data, GDAL, ArcGIS, QGIS, sf/terra in R, or equivalent) (required).
  • Experience with numerical or environmental models in an HPC or cloud environment (preferred).
  • Solid analytical and statistical skills, including working with large datasets and time series (required).
  • Experience with SQL or other database tools (preferred).
