Job.JobTitle: Senior Surety Underwriter - Small to Mid Commercial
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Commercial Lines Underwriter, Underwriting, Surety Underwriter
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual Surety is currently recruiting for a Senior Surety Underwriter to join our Small to Mid Commercial team in Maryland.

As a Senior Surety Underwriter you will develop and underwrite profitable surety business, and service independent agents, brokers, and small to mid commercial accounts within an assigned territory. Using your excellent relationship skills, you will build and maintain positive partnerships our agents, brokers, and accounts as a trusted advisor and underwriting resource for our producers and customers. You will also use your business and financial acumen to perform primary credit underwriting and financial/risk analysis, provide recommendations, and make decisions on new and existing accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced and self-motivated surety professional looking to grow their career with a top surety company that focuses on its employees and customers first.

Responsibilities:

  • Underwrite and negotiate accounts to maximize profitability whilst minimizing risk, which may include the most complex accounts based on level of role. Makes thorough evaluations and assessments of a customers financial, technical, organizational, and management capacities, including experience, desired objectives as well as a subjective judgment of character.
  • Manage the profitability and retention of an assigned book of business while continue to develop the portfolio through strong relationships and active engagement with new and existing agents and brokers. May assist in developing the marketing plan.
  • Performs analytical evaluations of financial statements on both a static and trend basis. Determines the present and historical financial position of accounts and monitors financial position of risk through analysis of quarterly statements and work in progress data as appropriate.
  • Stay abreast of Liberty Mutual Surety and Global Risk Solutions product lines and identify/promote opportunities across with agents and brokers, leveraging domestic and global capabilities.
  • Responsible for investigation, analyzing, and managing all necessary underwriting/accounting/workflow issues, within framework ofSurety policies and procedures.
  • May assess and identify changes in all aspects of the business including, but not limited to, work program to financial strength criteria, nature of work performed (inherent risk), accuracy and timeliness of data flow, and exposure analyses. Coordinate and surface issues to Home Office Underwriters and Field Management.
  • Assists in the evaluation of business continuity arrangements and funding mechanisms (such as adequacy of life insurance) to preclude financial drain of customer in the event of the demise of (an) owner or other insurable loss.
  • May mentor more junior staff based on level.
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.

If the selected candidate lives within 50 miles of a GRS office, then the selected candidate must be prepared to come into the office two days/week. This policy is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or equivalent and a minimum of 2.5 years experience expected, preferably 3 or more years surety underwriting experience and/or equivalent surety related business experience . Strong preference with the small to mid commercial Surety product line.
  • Solid understanding of financial and accounting principles and the ability to demonstrate sound business judgment in the evaluation of the financial condition and credit history.
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge surety underwriting risks within scope of responsibility.
  • AFSB certification preferred.
  • Demonstrates strong ability to communicate complex analyses and information in understandable written and/or oral directives for underwriting or training purposes.
  • Demonstrates strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills as well as attention to detail.
  • Salary and level based on experience and location.

  • May mentor more junior staff based on level.
  • Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.

If the selected candidate lives within 50 miles of a GRS office, then the selected candidate must be prepared to come into the office two days/week. This policy is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or equivalent and a minimum of 2.5 years experience expected, preferably 3 or more years surety underwriting experience and/or equivalent surety related business experience . Strong preference with the small to mid commercial Surety product line.
  • Solid understanding of financial and accounting principles and the ability to demonstrate sound business judgment in the evaluation of the financial condition and credit history.
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge surety underwriting risks within scope of responsibility.
  • AFSB certification preferred.
  • Demonstrates strong ability to communicate complex analyses and information in understandable written and/or oral directives for underwriting or training purposes.
  • Demonstrates strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills as well as attention to detail.
  • Salary and level based on experience and location.

Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

Note: This role has a hybrid (2x per week in office) work arrangement in our Boston, MA location.

LMI Technology is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead a team of data, configuration, and software engineers supporting the Finance, Accounting, and Operations domain, including our Accounting and CECL platforms, integrations, and reporting and analytics solutions. This role owns end-to-end solution delivery across a platform-centric ecosystem in close partnership with product and business stakeholders, with direct accountability for team effectiveness, stakeholder relationships, delivery quality, and fostering an engineering culture of continuous learning and accountability.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Development

  • Managing, coaching, and developing a team of engineers; fostering a culture of continuous learning, quality, and accountability.
  • Driving high-performing engineering practices across the team, with AI and agentic tool adoption as a core enabler.
  • Owning performance management, professional development, and team health across both full-time and contract resources
  • Engaging actively in hiring and talent development as the team evolves.

Solution Delivery

  • Owning delivery outcomes across data integration, configuration, and reporting solutions, increasingly leveraging AI and agentic capabilities to improve quality and accelerate delivery.
  • Partnering with product owners to define priorities, track delivery against commitments, and maintain a clear line of sight from team output to business value.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Building and maintaining direct relationships with business stakeholders in the Finance, Accounting, and Operations domain.
  • Serving as the primary technology point of contact for business partners; communicating delivery status and trade-offs clearly and ensuring business needs are well understood by the team.

Engineering Practice & Continuous Improvement

  • Elevating engineering craft across the team setting a high bar for solution design, data engineering discipline, and technical decision-making as AI reshapes what great engineering looks like.
  • Championing agile delivery practices within the team while staying aligned to broader engineering community standards and best practices.
  • Leading platform and solution modernization efforts retiring legacy approaches, reducing complexity, and evolving the team's tooling and practices over time.
  • Driving adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools and workflows to improve solution quality, accelerate delivery, and reduce manual effort.
  • Engaging with the broader LMI engineering community to share practices and drive consistency across teams.
Qualifications

  • Background in financial services, asset management, or a related domain is strongly preferred; familiarity with financial and accounting data in a regulated environment is a meaningful advantage.

  • 7+ years of experience in a relevant engineering discipline, including experience leading or working closely with data engineering teams across integration, pipeline, or analytics delivery.

  • 3+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.

  • Familiarity with agile delivery practices and experience managing delivery within an agile team structure.

  • Experience working within or alongside large enterprise platforms, with an understanding of integrations, reporting, and analytics solutions.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and a working understanding of how AI is reshaping engineering practices and solution delivery.

  • Experience managing mixed teams of full-time and contract resources.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort engaging directly with business stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent experience.

Quick facts

About this job

Executive Underwriter for Liberty Mutual's emerging Mobility Solutions team in Chicago. You will underwrite commercial auto, workers compensation, and general liability for ridehail, delivery, and autonomous vehicle sectors, working across multiple underwriting segments.

Good fit if you have 7+ years of progressive underwriting experience, strong analytical skills, and a business or finance degree or equivalent.

Full job description


Description

Drawing on Libertys vast commercial and personal lines expertise, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions team embodies a new collaborative model that brings a full range of tailored solutions and nuanced pricing approaches to the emerging mobility spectrum. This dedicated practice combines creative commercial underwriting with product, actuarial, legal, and claims teams to deliver robust client experience. You will help shape the future of Libertys role in the Mobility space through your Underwriting Research and Consultative skills covering the Ridehail, Delivery, Autonomous Vehicles sectors to name a few.

We may consider applicants at various experience levels for this role.

As a Mobility Executive Underwriter you will:

  • Help to develop creative insights andapply sophisticated capabilities as we navigate the evolving blend of commercial and personal insurance exposures and products.
  • Underwrite commercial auto, workers compensation and general liability as well ascollaborate with other underwriting segments for cross sell opportunities suchas umbrella, excess, cyber, tech E&O, property, and inland marine
  • Be responsible for curating a profitable,diversified book of business through collaboration, marketing, informed decision-making, sustaining mutually beneficial agent/broker relationships, and reinforcing our market leading credibility and thought leadership
  • Underwriting emerging mobility risks requires curiosity and innovation to understand how businesses look today and what they will become tomorrow as the market develops.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills and are seeking to explore an emerging underwriting space, this dynamic and collaborative environment is the place to thrive.
Qualifications
  • Degree in business, finance, risk management, or equivalent typically required
  • A minimum of 7 years expected, typically 10 years or more, of progressive underwriting experience
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate and judge underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information in understandable written and/or oral directives to other persons in the organization for underwriting or training purposes
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external stakeholders
  • Must demonstrate comprehension of most complex technical underwriting issues and be capable of defining and implementing necessary underwriting and administrative processes/workflows to properly manage or administer those issues
  • Proven track record of developing and underwriting profitable business

Description

The Senior Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to review, analyze and process claims that are routinely characterized as moderately complex to complex within assigned authority limits. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. The Senior Claims Specialist may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

We value flexibility and collaboration. If you live within 50 miles of one of our office locationsHoffman Estates, IL and Plano, TX; - youll be asked to join us onsite twice a month. These visits are a great opportunity to connect with your team, build relationships, and engage in meaningful collaboration.

This position includes mandatory training. The first portion will be conducted remotely, followed by in-person training at our office in Plano, Texas. Full attendance and active participation are required for both. Liberty Mutual will cover travel, lodging, and meals during the in-office training.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims (including such activities as interviewing insureds, witnesses and claimants, collecting and evaluating appropriate documentation and securing evidence and protecting the chain-of-custody) to analyze and confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability and damages; determines need for, and engages independent adjusters, cause and origin experts and independent medical examiners. Refers to claim to subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Coordinates the litigation activities associated with assigned claims to ensure a timely and cost-effective resolution; attends trials as a representative of the company.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, assisting team members with escalated issues. Mentors and trains new team members. Participates in Quality Review process.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to communicate and negotiate with customers and conduct investigations required.
  • Leadership ability and demonstrated time management skills to delegate work appropriately and organize resources effectively.
  • Demonstrates an advanced knowledge of claims case handling practices, legal liability, general insurance policy coverage, and the state`s tort laws as normally acquired through a bachelor`s degree (or equivalent training) plus 3 to 5 years directly related work experience.
  • Required to obtain and maintain all applicable licenses.

Job.JobTitle: Vice President, Loan Admin Oversight & Partnerships
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Boston, MA
  • Experience: 10+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Liberty Mutual Investments seeks a Vice President to oversee loan administration operations, vendor partnerships, and data integrity across their loan operations platform. The role owns day-to-day loan book management, manages relationships with loan administrators and external collaborators, and drives operational improvements across multiple systems.

Good fit if you have 10+ years in loan operations or similar financial services roles, deep knowledge of loan administration platforms and systems, and experience managing vendor relationships and corporate actions.

Full job description


Description

Vice President, Loan Admin Oversight & Partnerships

Team: Loan OperationsOperational Strategy & Delivery

Location: Boston, MA

About the Role

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is seeking a detail-oriented and relationship-driven operations professional to join our growing Loan Operations team as Vice President, Loan Admin Oversight & Partnerships. This is a senior, high-impact role and a key addition to a newly formed function being purpose-built to support the continued growth and build-out of a best-in-class loan operations platform.

This VP will serve as the primary owner of LMI's loan administration relationships and the operational integrity of the loan book of record. The role is responsible for overseeing day-to-day loan administration performance, managing vendor and collaborator partnerships, and ensuring cross-system alignment across LMI's multi-platform loan operations environment.

This role reports to the Head of Loan Operations and owns the run and oversight layer of the loan operations operating model within the enterprise framework that role sets.

The ideal candidate brings deep loan administration and vendor management expertise, strong familiarity with loan systems and data, and the ability to drive accountability across both internal and external partners. #LMI #LI-LMI

Key Responsibilities

Loan Book of Record & System Integrity

  • Own the operational data integrity of LMI's loan book of record on a day-to-day basis ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of positions, cash flows, and valuations across the loan administration platform
  • Ensure tight alignment across LMI's multi-system loan operations environment across positions, cash flows, and valuations
  • Run and monitor daily processing; review and approve critical updates and own the resolution of data quality issues before they impact downstream systems or reporting
  • Consume reconciliation break data to identify systemic root causes and drive durable operational improvements

Loan Administrator Oversight

  • Serve as the primary liaison and relationship owner for LMI's loan administration partners; day-to-day performance management of the loan administrator encompassing service level monitoring, processing accuracy, issue escalation, weekly operational reviews, monthly KPI tracking, and quarterly strategic reviews
  • Manage the relationship with the loan servicer on internal securitization structures, ensuring operational alignment with LMI's investment and reporting requirements
  • Track administrator capacity and performance against projected portfolio growth; proactively surface risks and propose solutions to ensure scalability

External Collaborator Management

  • Manage LMI's external operational collaborators (e.g., eClerx, EXL) supporting loan operations workflows providing oversight of their work, ensuring procedure documentation is current and accurate, and determining where they are best positioned to add value
  • Educate and train collaborators on LMI's operational standards, workflows, and system requirements; ensure consistent execution and quality across all collaborator-supported activities
  • Establish clear standards and expectations for collaborator output; monitor quality and consistency of work product against LMI's operational framework, ensuring issues are identified and addressed promptly
  • Identify opportunities to optimize how collaborator capacity is deployed as the portfolio and team evolve

Platform Strategy & Vendor Management

  • Support the management of vendor relationships across the loan operations technology and services ecosystem, contributing operational expertise and day-to-day performance insights to inform vendor governance and oversight
  • Lead or contribute to the evaluation and selection of loan administration platform enhancements or alternatives, representing Loan Operations' requirements in vendor assessments and platform discussions
  • Partner with Technology and Data teams to drive improvements to data flows, system integrations, and automation across the loan administration environment

Agent Bank Coordination

  • Manage operational relationships with agent banks across LMI's loan portfolio; oversee and coordinate the processing of complex loan activity including distressed exchanges, restructurings, and amendments ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and appropriate escalation
  • Establish and maintain governance frameworks for agency functions including oversight standards, KYC requirements, SLA accountability, and escalation paths

Operational Risk, Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain the loan administration layer of the enterprise operational risk and control framework owned by the Head of Loan Operations; ensure processes align with internal policies, audit standards, and industry best practices
  • Identify and drive automation and process improvement opportunities to increase efficiency, reduce manual touchpoints, and support scale
  • Collaborate with Investor, Finance, Treasury, Portfolio Operations, Product, Technology, and Data teams to ensure alignment across the loan operations and investment lifecycle
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field
  • Advanced degrees (e.g., MBA) are a plus
  • CPA or CFA preferred but not required
  • 10+ years of experience in loan operations, loan administration, or a related middle or back-office function within an asset manager, bank, or financial institution
  • Deep knowledge of loan administration operations across private credit and broadly syndicated loan portfolios, including strong familiarity with loan lifecycle events, cash flow management, and reconciliation processes
  • Significant experience with loan administration platforms and systems; strong working knowledge of book of record management and cross-system data flows
  • Prior experience with corporate actions, amendments, restructures, workouts, and distressed exchanges, including familiarity with the operational requirements and documentation standards associated with each
  • Proven track record of managing loan administration relationships, including SLA governance, performance management, and issue escalation
  • Experience with agent bank operations and familiarity with loan agency services
  • Demonstrated expertise in operational risk controls, audit readiness, and process documentation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a track record of driving process improvements and automation in a loan operations environment
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to represent LMI professionally with external partners and communicate clearly with senior leadership
  • Able to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels with hands-on operational ownership
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, with the ability to apply them practically in a loan operations context whether to accelerate process documentation, synthesize complex information, draft communications, or identify patterns across large datasets

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, is seeking a Regional Small Commercial Sales Manager to lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of small commercial producers. In this role, youll drive regional sales, retention, and customer satisfaction by developing agents, strengthening carrier partnerships, and promoting excellence across sales and service. Youll also have the opportunity to help shape Comparions growing small commercial business while advancing your leadership career.

Territory and travel
This role supports the Southeast region, covering Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, and West Virginia. Youll recruit, onboard, coach, and support commercial sales professionals across the region and help drive commercial growth.

The position involves approximately 60% travel within the territory. Travel may include visits to team locations, recruiting events, agent or client meetings, carrier partners, and regional business or community events. Candidates should be comfortable with frequent regional travel.

We are seeking candidates based in Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, or West Virginia.

The successful candidate will be eligible to earn variable compensation of up to 50% of base salary in 2026, contingent upon achieving designated key performance measures.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of small commercial producers to meet or exceed new-business, retention, premium growth, and profitability goals.
  • Provide strategic guidance to expand and optimize the agency, identifying and evaluating new market and business opportunities
  • Support agents through the sales cycle: advise on policy types, effective coverage, renewals, policy changes, and complex submissions/renewals.
  • Drive new business development by coaching agents on lead follow-up, cross-selling, prospect cultivation, and referral strategies.
  • Act as a primary liaison among agents, clients, and internal teams to ensure clear communication and timely resolution of post-enrollment issues.
  • Maintain and strengthen carrier relationships in partnership with Relationship Managers to enhance product access and service.
  • Oversee local marketing and community networking initiatives to ensure strong market penetration.
  • Ensure high service levels (on-time renewals, prompt certificate issuance, timely responses to client inquiries) and instill accountability for SLAs across the team.
  • Recruit, staff, and manage personnel levels to align with business needs.
  • Monitor and analyze performance metrics (retention, premium growth, loss ratios, revenue per producer) to identify opportunities, trends, and obstacles; provide data-driven coaching and action plans.
  • Mentor, conduct performance reviews, and deliver ongoing feedback to support career development and goal attainment.
  • Stay current on small commercial industry trends, products, and regulatory changes affecting clients and carriers.

What we offer:

  • Competitive base salary with meaningful performance-based upside (variable compensation up to 50% of base salary).
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision; 401(k) with company match; paid time off
  • Eligibility for a company fleet vehicle for qualified employees
  • Professional development, ongoing training, and tuition assistance.
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs, employee discounts and other voluntary benefits.
  • Opportunity for career growth within Comparion and a collaborative, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.
  • A leadership role with visible impact, autonomy, and the ability to influence product, process and market strategy.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of commercial lines products and services; proven success with prior sales or related experience required.
  • Must possess highly effective oral and written communication skills, including group and individual presentation, persuasion, negotiation and customer service skills.
  • Requires excellent organizational skills, effective time management, strong leadership, interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Incumbents must have, or be able to secure, a current state license, in property, casualty and life insurance.
  • Prior supervisory experience helpful
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Good fit if you have commercial insurance sales experience, a bachelor's degree, state insurance licenses or ability to obtain them, and can travel 60% within the Southeast region.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, is seeking a Regional Small Commercial Sales Manager to lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of small commercial producers. In this role, youll drive regional sales, retention, and customer satisfaction by developing agents, strengthening carrier partnerships, and promoting excellence across sales and service. Youll also have the opportunity to help shape Comparions growing small commercial business while advancing your leadership career.

Territory and travel
This role supports the Southeast region, covering Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, and West Virginia. Youll recruit, onboard, coach, and support commercial sales professionals across the region and help drive commercial growth.

The position involves approximately 60% travel within the territory. Travel may include visits to team locations, recruiting events, agent or client meetings, carrier partners, and regional business or community events. Candidates should be comfortable with frequent regional travel.

We are seeking candidates based in Tennessee, South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Arkansas, Kentucky, Mississippi, Virginia, or West Virginia.

The successful candidate will be eligible to earn variable compensation of up to 50% of base salary in 2026, contingent upon achieving designated key performance measures.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of small commercial producers to meet or exceed new-business, retention, premium growth, and profitability goals.
  • Provide strategic guidance to expand and optimize the agency, identifying and evaluating new market and business opportunities
  • Support agents through the sales cycle: advise on policy types, effective coverage, renewals, policy changes, and complex submissions/renewals.
  • Drive new business development by coaching agents on lead follow-up, cross-selling, prospect cultivation, and referral strategies.
  • Act as a primary liaison among agents, clients, and internal teams to ensure clear communication and timely resolution of post-enrollment issues.
  • Maintain and strengthen carrier relationships in partnership with Relationship Managers to enhance product access and service.
  • Oversee local marketing and community networking initiatives to ensure strong market penetration.
  • Ensure high service levels (on-time renewals, prompt certificate issuance, timely responses to client inquiries) and instill accountability for SLAs across the team.
  • Recruit, staff, and manage personnel levels to align with business needs.
  • Monitor and analyze performance metrics (retention, premium growth, loss ratios, revenue per producer) to identify opportunities, trends, and obstacles; provide data-driven coaching and action plans.
  • Mentor, conduct performance reviews, and deliver ongoing feedback to support career development and goal attainment.
  • Stay current on small commercial industry trends, products, and regulatory changes affecting clients and carriers.

What we offer:

  • Competitive base salary with meaningful performance-based upside (variable compensation up to 50% of base salary).
  • Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision; 401(k) with company match; paid time off
  • Eligibility for a company fleet vehicle for qualified employees
  • Professional development, ongoing training, and tuition assistance.
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs, employee discounts and other voluntary benefits.
  • Opportunity for career growth within Comparion and a collaborative, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives.
  • A leadership role with visible impact, autonomy, and the ability to influence product, process and market strategy.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of commercial lines products and services; proven success with prior sales or related experience required.
  • Must possess highly effective oral and written communication skills, including group and individual presentation, persuasion, negotiation and customer service skills.
  • Requires excellent organizational skills, effective time management, strong leadership, interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Incumbents must have, or be able to secure, a current state license, in property, casualty and life insurance.
  • Prior supervisory experience helpful
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

This internship is more than just about learning the ropes. The Sales Internship at Comparion Insurance Agency involves immersing yourself in a fast-paced and supportive environment where youre encouraged to sharpen your selling skills.


As a Sales Intern, you will join a network of over 400 Liberty Mutual interns and participate in educational and social programs that contribute to your professional development. We offer a robust intern onboarding program that brings summer interns together to build connections in their first week!

Job.JobTitle: Senior Account Executive Officer/Senior Underwriter National Accounts
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Underwriter, Underwriting, Insurance Account Executive
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $136,100 to $224,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Charlotte, NC
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Senior Account Executive Officer role managing complex national accounts with casualty solutions including workers compensation and commercial liability. Serves as technical resource, managing book of business profitability while underwriting complex risks and cultivating agent and broker relationships.

Good fit if you have 4+ years underwriting experience, ideally in national accounts, with deep knowledge of loss sensitive products and CPCU designation.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$136,100.00 - $224,500.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

National Accounts provides casualty solutions for clients with significant risk with coverages such as Workers' Compensation, General and Product Liability, as well as Commercial Automobile Liability. The Senior Account Executive Officer (Senior AEO), National Accounts will partner with agents, brokers, and customers to provide guaranteed cost and loss sensitive coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. This role is seen as a technical resource for the region/business unit. As a Senior AEO, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to independently assess highly complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business. The book of business owned is primarily comprised of accounts with high complexity.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate highly complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using advanced consultative marketing and sales skills. The sales process to target new accounts has a long runway (6 months to 1 year).
  • Independently develop and execute agency sales plans and frequently partner with your Managing Director (MD) to develop region/group sales plans.
  • Support the development of less experienced underwriters leveraging advanced coaching and mentorship skills.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Eight to ten years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in National Accounts.
  • Deep knowledge of loss sensitive products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • Advanced sales and marketing skills.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of underwriting experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

What Is the Opportunity?

We're pleased to announce that our Staff Counsel virtual office in Tulsa, Oklahoma is expanding. We are currently seeking a candidate for a fully remote position based in the Tulsa area.

This position handles liability cases. The ability to manage some Workers' Compensation cases is a plus.

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to handle a caseload of predominantly low to moderate complexity and deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a caseload of predominantly low to moderate complexity, your responsibilities will include:
  • Develop and apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide advice and training to Claim partners and clients.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 3+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Experience independently handling cases from inception through trial/hearing & appeal.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to present information on litigated matters to diverse audiences
  • Skilled in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates persuasive legal writing skills and oral advocacy skills.
  • Strong legal research skills & ability to utilize technology.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses strong negotiation skills.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 2 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Associate Claim Representative position in workers compensation at Travelers Insurance in Hunt Valley, Maryland. Includes comprehensive training in claim handling and policy interpretation over approximately 12 months, with hybrid work flexibility.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree, one year of customer service experience, and willingness to obtain an adjuster license.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Workers Compensation, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage workers compensation claims. This program can typically last up to 12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

Travelers offers a hybrid work location model that is designed to support flexibility.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Assist in reviewing, investigating, and documenting Workers Compensation claims under close supervision.
  • Investigate, develop, and evaluate action plans for claim resolution. Assess coverage and determine if a claim is compensable under Workers Compensation including evaluating claims for potential fraud.
  • Participate in Telephonic and/or onsite File Reviews.
  • Learn how to determine coverage, compensability, and exposure based on policy terms and claim facts.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Communicate and apprise all parties regarding claim status which may include our business customers, injured employees, medical providers, and legal counsel.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Achieve a positive result by returning an injured party to work when appropriate. This may include coordinating medical treatment in collaboration with internal or external resources.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Summer 2027 Intern to support Assurant's Global Onboarding program, incorporating analytics and insights to improve.


This internship offers an opportunity to contribute to strategic work that improves how new employees connect, learn, and succeed across the organization. The intern will partner with leaders and team members to analyze onboarding data and feedback, identify opportunities for improvement, support program design, and help strengthen the end-to-end experiences for key stakeholders.


The successful candidate will gain hands-on experience applying analytics, research, design thinking, and project management skills to real business challenges while contributing to an enterprise-wide onboarding program.

Analytics & Insights

Current undergraduate student graduating between December 2027 - May 2029

  • Business Administration
  • Management
  • Data Analytics
  • Analytics & Information Systems
  • Psychology
  • Sociology
  • Communications
  • Learning & Development
  • Public Policy

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret data and identify meaningful insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organization.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Teams.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, survey platforms, or analytics tools is a plus.
  • Curiosity, learning agility, and a desire to improve employee experiences.

What You'll Gain

  • Exposure to enterprise Global Onboarding and employee experience work.
  • Hands-on experience supporting an enterprise-wide People Organization program.
  • Opportunities to work with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience using data and insights to improve employee experience and solve business problems.

Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. About this job

Senior Account Executive managing key client relationships and coordinating implementation of new client programs across operations, IT, marketing, and service teams. Remote role with up to 15% annual travel, requiring a bachelor's degree and minimum 4 years of account management or client-facing experience.

Good fit if you have 4+ years in account management or program management, 3+ years with mid-to-large clients, and strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

Full job description

As a Senior Account Executive, you will play a critical role in supporting the implementation and ongoing management of significant new client programs. This role serves as the primary relationship owner and strategic coordinator between external clients and internal teams, ensuring successful program launches, operational excellence, and long-term client satisfaction. You will act as the central point of coordination across operations, IT, marketing, actuarial, and service teams while helping drive measurable client outcomes.


Why Join Assurant?

At Assurant, you will join a collaborative, results-driven team that values clear communication, strong leadership, and meaningful contributions. This role offers the opportunity to make an immediate impact by helping launch and grow important client programs, building trusted relationships with leading brands, and partnering with experienced colleagues across the business. You will gain broad exposure to a global organization while working in an environment where your ideas, initiative, and expertise can help shape successful outcomes for our clients and their customers.


What Will Be My Duties and Responsibilities in This Job?

  • Own and manage key client relationships, serving as the primary point of contact for client needs and escalations.
  • Coordinate implementation activities and ensure readiness for new client program launches.
  • Lead project execution, requirements tracking, issue resolution, and ongoing program management.
  • Present program results, recommendations, and business updates to client and corporate stakeholders.
  • Develop and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and performance metrics.
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other client-facing meetings.
  • Partner with operations, IT, marketing, actuarial, service, and other internal teams to drive successful outcomes.
  • Manage escalations and ensure timely communication and resolution of business-critical issues.

What Are the Requirements Needed for This Position?

  • Bachelor's degree
  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in account management, client success, program management, or a related client-facing role.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience interacting with mid-to-large clients.
  • Proven client relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Proven project management and execution experience.
  • Ability to analyze KPIs, performance metrics, and business results.
  • Financial acumen and ability to discuss performance data with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience working across multiple functions in a complex business environment.
  • Ability to thrive in implementation-focused environments and navigate ambiguity with confidence.

What Other Skills/Experience Would Be Helpful to Have?

  • Experience within the appliance industry.
  • Background with OEM, warranty, service contract, protection-plan, or client service organizations.
  • Experience supporting large-scale client implementations or program launches.
  • Experience leading executive-level presentations and strategic business reviews.

How Much Should I Expect to Travel?

  • Up to 15% annual travel.

#LI-Remote



Pay Range

$88,000.00 - $147,000.00

Expected Application Deadline

11/06/2026

Job.JobTitle: Principal Sourcing Manager - Enterprise & Supply Chain Services
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $103,800 to $173,300 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: La Vergne, TN
  • Experience: 8+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Principal Sourcing Manager for Assurant's Nashville Device Care Center, serving as on-site sourcing partner to Operations, Engineering, Logistics, and other teams. Translates enterprise sourcing strategies into site-level execution while managing supplier relationships, procurement processes, and cost efficiency initiatives.

Good fit if you have 8+ years of strategic sourcing or procurement experience, including supplier performance management and cost optimization, and have worked in operational or manufacturing environments.

Full job description

The Principal Sourcing Manager serves as the on-site sourcing partner for the Nashville, TN or Dallas, TX Device Care Center , working closely with Operations, Engineering, Logistics, and GREF to support effective and efficient sourcing outcomes. This role helps translate enterprise sourcing strategies into practical, site-level execution by providing structure, insight, and commercial guidance. The individual will need to collaborate with stakeholders to enhance visibility, streamline supplier engagement, and strengthen continuity of supply, while supporting cost efficiency and operational agility. A key focus is on evolving sourcing practices in a way that balances speed, flexibility, and governance enabling teams to operate effectively while benefiting from scalable, transparent sourcing approaches.


What You'll Do

On-Site Sourcing Partnership & Vendor Support

  • Act as the primary on-site sourcing partner for the Nashville DCC.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and suppliers to support day-to-day needs and priorities.
  • Provide guidance on supplier considerations including capacity, performance, and risk.
  • Partner with teams to incorporate sourcing perspectives early in planning and decision-making.

End-to-End Sourcing Collaboration

  • Facilitate sourcing processes from requirements definition through implementation and transition to BAU.
  • Work cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Logistics, Facilities, Finance, Legal, and GREF to ensure aligned and seamless execution.
  • Support the implementation of contracts, catalogues, and purchasing frameworks that enable efficient and compliant buying.

Buying Practices & Enablement

  • Promote consistent and effective buying practices across the DCC.
  • Provide clarity, tools, and support to help teams make informed purchasing decisions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to simplify processes and encourage adoption of preferred sourcing channels.

Supplier Strategy & Value Realization

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to optimize the supplier landscape, improving resilience and operational simplicity.
  • Support delivery of cost efficiencies and productivity improvements aligned with enterprise priorities.
  • Balance immediate opportunities with longer-term enhancements to sourcing approaches.

Performance Insight & Continuous Improvement

  • Support supplier performance management and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Provide insights on spend, usage, and supplier trends to inform decision-making.
  • Act as a collaborative change partner, helping teams realize the benefits of structured sourcing while maintaining operational momentum.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required (MBA/Master's a plus).
  • 8+ years' experience in Strategic Sourcing / Procurement with end‑to‑end ownership (RFx through BAU).
  • Experience operating in fast‑paced operational, manufacturing, or logistics environments.
  • Strong capability across supplier performance management, continuity of supply, and vendor risk.
  • Proven delivery of cost optimization, supplier consolidation, and governed buying adoption. Solid commercial, financial, and contract acumen; able to influence cross‑functional stakeholders.


Why Assurant?

  • People First – we prioritize employee well-being and development
  • Empowerment – we enable our people to do their best work
  • Benefits effective day one
  • 401K Match – up to 6% dollar-for-dollar

The Company

Assurant, Inc. redefines the boundaries of protection — safeguarding and servicing connected devices, homes, automobiles, and commercial equipment in partnership with the world's most successful brands. As a Fortune 500 company operating in 21 countries, Assurant leads the way in leveraging insights and technology to transform customer connections that build loyalty and drive value. With more than 325 million consumers protected worldwide, Assurant is behind the scenes helping brands deliver reliable, meaningful experiences customers can count on, so brands can shine and customers can have peace of mind.

Global Impact

Assurant is a purpose-driven company committed to advancing a connected, respected, and protected world. Through our focus on Connected Communities , Respected Resources , and a Protected Planet , we integrate sustainability into our long-term strategy in ways that support our business, strengthen operations, and help us deliver value for clients, customers, employees, and communities.

Assurant Culture

The Assurant Way defines how we show up for our clients, customers, communities, and one another — with Common Sense, Common Decency, Uncommon Thinking, and Uncommon Results. Recognized on Forbes' list of the World's Best Employers , named among Fortune's America's Most Innovative Companies , and consistently ranked as a “Best/Great Place to Work” in 14 countries, Assurant attracts talented people who are passionate about service, practical innovation, and delivering meaningful results.

Benefits & Rewards

Assurant is committed to providing a competitive rewards package that offers market-competitive benefits and resources designed to support physical, emotional, financial, and social wellbeing.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hornell, NY
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Physical: Lifting up to 20 lbs
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Senior District Sales Manager for Erie Insurance's Southern Tier of New York territory. Recruits, trains, and manages independent agents in sales, underwriting, and agency performance. Company car and home office equipment provided.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree plus six years of sales, underwriting, claims or marketing experience, and can relocate to Hornell or surrounding areas.

Full job description

*This range represents a national range and the actual salary will depend on several factors including the scope and complexity of the role and the skills, education, training, credentials, location (State) based on ERIE's geographical differences, and experience of an applicant, as well as level of role for which the successful candidate is hired. Position may be eligible for an annual bonus payment.

At Erie Insurance, you're not just part of a Fortune 500 company; you're also a valued member of a diverse and inclusive team that includes more than 6,000 employees and over 13,000 independent agencies. Our Employees work in the Home Office complex located in Erie, PA, and in our Field Offices that span 12 states and the District of Columbia.

Benefits That Go Beyond The Basics

We strive to be Above all in Service® to our customers—and to our employees. That's why Erie Insurance offers you an exceptional benefits package, including:

  • Premier health, prescription, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents. Coverage begins your first day of work.
  • Low contributions to medical and prescription premiums. We currently pay up to 97% of employees' monthly premium costs.
  • Pension. We are among the 2% of Fortune 500 companies to offer a traditional pension plan. Full-time employees are vested after five years of services.
  • 401(k) with up to 4% contribution match. The 401(k) is offered in addition to the pension.
  • Paid time off. Paid vacation, personal days, sick days, bereavement days and parental leave.
  • Career development. Including a tuition reimbursement program for higher education and industry designations.

Additional benefits that include company-paid basic life insurance; short-and long-term disability insurance; orthodontic coverage for children and adults; adoption assistance; fertility and infertility coverage; well-being programs; paid volunteer hours for service to your community; and dollar-for-dollar matching of your charitable gifts each year.

Position Summary

  • The selected candidate will ideally live in Hornell or Corning, New York or surrounding areas. The territory for this role is the Southern Tier of New York.
  • A company car and equipment to work from home will provided.
  • Candidates with below minimum qualifications may be considered for District Sales Manager (G11) will be used to determine the level.

Recruits, trains and guides assigned Agents in matters of sales, underwriting and re-underwriting, profitability, agency management and related matters. Serves as a company representative in maintaining favorable Policyholder relationships. Interacts with, supports, coaches and motivates Agents.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Recruits, hires, and develops Agents.
  • Influences ERIE's independent Agents in the selling process, oversees complaints and holds them accountable for performance.
  • Serves as a subject matter expert.
  • Represents ERIE at community and industry events.
  • Serves as Agents link to the company, field underwriter and liaison for sales and customer service problems.
  • Communicates changes to Agents, implements best practices, and sponsors sales contest/promotions, etc..
  • Develops Agents business plans and achieves long and short-term goals.
  • Serves as a licensed, non-commission company Agent proficient in selling ERIE products and services to customers and prospects.
  • Serves as the Agent's knowledge broker. Maintains and applies a current knowledge of trends and latest developments in the industry. Assists independent Agents and their staff in the process of identifying and solving all Agency level sales and marketing problems and opportunities.
  • Utilizes best practices for managing new and experienced Independent Agents. Participates with the branch manager or designee in assessing Agency performance trends and results. Conducts one-on-one reviews of Agent's underwriting, reunderwriting, profitability and compliance results and partners with the Agent to implement corrective action as necessary.


The first seven duties listed are the functions identified as essential to the job. Essential functions are those job duties that must be performed in order for the job to be accomplished.

Regular and predictable attendance is an essential job function. For certain positions at ERIE, including leadership roles, regular and predictable onsite presence may also be an essential job function based on business and operational needs.

This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the incumbent. Employees are required to follow any other job-related instruction and to perform any other duties as requested by their supervisor, or as become evident.

Capabilities

  • Values Diversity
  • Nimble Learning
  • Self-Development
  • Collaborates
  • Customer Focus
  • Cultivates Innovation
  • Instills Trust
  • Optimizes Work Processes (IC)
  • Decision Quality
  • Ensures Accountability

Qualifications

Minimum Educational and Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent of four years of sales, underwriting, claims or marketing experience, required.
  • MBA preferred.

Additional Experience

  • Six years of sales, underwriting, claims or marketing experience OR Four years and participation in DSM Training Program
  • The incumbent must live in the territory assigned unless a change is approved by the company.
  • An understanding of and commitment to ERIE's "Above All in Service" philosophy required.
  • Extensive local travel, including overnight stays, required.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheet, word processing and e-mail software required.
  • LOMA testing required.


Designations and/or Licenses

  • Related industry designations, such as CIC, CPCU, CLU, preferred.
  • Valid driver's license and good driving record required.

Physical Requirements

  • Lifting/Moving 0-20 lbs; Occasional (<20%)
  • Lifting/Moving 20-50 lbs; Occasional (<20%)
  • Ability to move over 50 lbs using lifting aide equipment; Occasional (<20%)
  • Driving; Frequent (50-80%)
  • Pushing/Pulling/moving objects, equipment with wheels; Occasional (<20%)
  • Manual Keying/Data Entry/inputting information/computer use; Often (20-50%)
  • Climbing/accessing heights; Rarely

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Education: Bachelor's degree
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Physical: Lifting up to 20 lbs
  • Benefits: 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance

About this job

Property adjuster handling claims investigations, inspections, and estimates within an assigned territory in the Monroeville area. Position works from home with a company car provided and requires daily travel for property inspections.

Good fit if you have two years of claims handling experience or a bachelor's degree and can travel regularly within an assigned territory.

Full job description

*This range represents a national range and the actual salary will depend on several factors including the scope and complexity of the role and the skills, education, training, credentials, location (State) based on ERIE's geographical differences, and experience of an applicant, as well as level of role for which the successful candidate is hired. Position may be eligible for an annual bonus payment.

At Erie Insurance, you're not just part of a Fortune 500 company; you're also a valued member of a diverse and inclusive team that includes more than 6,000 employees and over 13,000 independent agencies. Our Employees work in the Home Office complex located in Erie, PA, and in our Field Offices that span 12 states and the District of Columbia.

Benefits That Go Beyond The Basics

We strive to be Above all in Service® to our customers—and to our employees. That's why Erie Insurance offers you an exceptional benefits package, including:

  • Premier health, prescription, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents. Coverage begins your first day of work.
  • Low contributions to medical and prescription premiums. We currently pay up to 97% of employees' monthly premium costs.
  • Pension. We are among the 2% of Fortune 500 companies to offer a traditional pension plan. Full-time employees are vested after five years of services.
  • 401(k) with up to 4% contribution match. The 401(k) is offered in addition to the pension.
  • Paid time off. Paid vacation, personal days, sick days, bereavement days and parental leave.
  • Career development. Including a tuition reimbursement program for higher education and industry designations.

Additional benefits that include company-paid basic life insurance; short-and long-term disability insurance; orthodontic coverage for children and adults; adoption assistance; fertility and infertility coverage; well-being programs; paid volunteer hours for service to your community; and dollar-for-dollar matching of your charitable gifts each year.

Position Summary

Exercises independent discretion or judgment in handling property claims within designated level of authority. Also responsible for servicing assigned territory and may handle litigated claims.

  • This position operates from a home office but requires daily travel to conduct property inspections within the assigned territory.
  • The selected candidate will ideally live within Eastern Allegheny County or surrounding areas (Monroeville, PA).
  • A company car and equipment to work from home will be provided.
  • Good time management and organization skills preferred.
  • Ability to drive/travel regularly within the assigned territory.
  • The hiring manager will also consider candidates for Property Adjuster II. Level of position offered will be based upon the depth and breadth of selected candidate's experience and qualifications.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Contacts Policyholders regarding property claims within level of authority. Conducts investigations, interviews insureds and witnesses, inspects damage and prepares estimates. Evaluates and makes recommendations regarding coverage of claims.
  • Handles property claims within designated authority. Sets and maintains adequate reserves. Obtains and reviews reports, statements, records and related materials as required. Evaluates information to determine coverage and total value of claim. Determines payments and issues checks or declines payment as required.
  • Documents claim files and submits final report to file for closure.
  • Identifies subrogation situations and initiates appropriate action.
  • Services assigned territory and brings assigned claims to conclusion.
  • Interacts with Agents and district sales managers on matters of mutual concern.
  • Handles property claims involving damages or coverage. May handle litigated claims, including negotiating with plaintiff attorney, or coordinates litigation with defense counsel as required.
  • Develops and applies a working knowledge of estimating practices and procedures relating to the adjustment of property claims.
  • Attends industry-related training programs and attends other training sessions to stay current on policy changes, interpretation or new legislation.
  • Successfully completes Technical Learning Center Training within one year of hire date.
  • Participates on Catastrophe Team when required.

Duties and Responsibilities (cont'd if applicable)

The first five duties listed are the functions identified as essential to the job. Essential functions are those job duties that must be performed in order for the job to be accomplished.

Regular and predictable attendance is an essential job function. For certain positions at ERIE, including leadership roles, regular and predictable onsite presence may also be an essential job function based on business and operational needs.


This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the incumbent. Employees are required to follow any other job-related instruction and to perform any other duties as requested by their supervisor, or as become clear.

Capabilities

  • Values Diversity
  • Nimble Learning
  • Self-Development
  • Collaborates
  • Customer Focus
  • Information Management Skills
  • Cultivates Innovation
  • Optimizes Work Processes (IC)
  • Job-Specific Knowledge
  • Instills Trust
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Decision Quality

Qualifications

Minimum Educational and Experience Requirements

  • High School Diploma or GED and two years of claims handling experience, or equivalent required; or
  • High School Diploma or GED and successful completion of ERIE sponsored formal education; or
  • Bachelor's Degree required.


Additional Experience

  • Incumbent must live in territory assigned unless a change is approved by the company.
  • Position requires incumbent to serve on catastrophe duty, which may include travel on short notice to other locations for periods in excess of two consecutive weeks.


Designations and/or Licenses

  • Willingness to pursue and complete Technical Learning Center Training required.
  • Successful completion of AIC 33 and AIC 35 preferred.
  • Willingness to obtain and maintain any required licenses.
  • Valid driver's license and good driving record required.

Physical Requirements

  • Use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required for this role.
  • Ability to move over 50 lbs using lifting aide equipment; Often (20-50%)
  • Climbing/accessing heights; Rarely
  • Driving; Frequent (50-80%)
  • Lifting/Moving 0-20 lbs; Often (20-50%)
  • Lifting/Moving 20-50 lbs; Often (20-50%)
  • Manual Keying/Data Entry/inputting information/computer use; Often (20-50%)
