About this job

Lead Assurant Dealer Services' automotive business in a defined geographic region, responsible for revenue targets, market share growth, and client satisfaction. Oversee a regional sales team of approximately 20-35 people and develop strategies aligned with company goals.

Full job description


Job Description

The Division Vice President (DVP) of Assurant Dealer Services leads the strategic and operational direction of a defined geographic business. This executive is responsible for achieving and exceeding revenue targets, growing market share, budget management, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction across a portfolio of automotive accounts. The DVP oversees performance of the regional sales team, drives new business development, and builds strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Develop and execute sales strategies aligned with Assurant Dealer Services (ADS) goals based on expertise within the channel, participants, markets, products and competitive landscape (traditional and disruptive).
  • Drive revenue growth, margin performance, and cost management across the division, creating a roadmap for increased profitability and commercial excellence within their division.
  • Research and proposes innovative strategies for ADS sales strategic accounts growth for their division; monitor sales effectiveness in delivering points of difference to increase our position in value creation for AIZ and our partners.
  • Provides leadership in developing best practices for measuring and optimizing strategic activities to drive data-driven decision making and excellence in their division.
  • Proactively analyze segments of customer data to uncover insights and key takeaways that inform strategic planning, increase revenue and drives business value in their division.
  • Synthesize and present data on account performance, identify areas of potential income improvement, and implement strategies to cross-sell products in their division.
  • Ensures any service gaps are addressed quickly and effectively and in situations of conflict with the client, leads the management team(s) to resolution looking to accomplish a win-win situation. Measures client satisfaction and uses findings to identify and address areas of opportunities as well as build upon success stories in their division.
  • Collaborates with risk management team related to current clients to mitigate regulatory risk and manage client compliance and oversight requirements in their division.
  • Lead, mentor, develop and performance manage regional sales managers and support staff. Build a high-performance, results-driven culture.
  • Monitor division sales performance/pipeline metrics and provide coaching.
  • Creating a roadmap for increased profitability and excellence within their division.

Team Leadership:


Direct reports

  • 8 Regional Managers

Number of direct and indirect reports

  • Approx. 20-35


What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing or related field.
  • A minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in retail automotive space with concentration in the F&I arena, with demonstrated experience showing progression and increasing scope of responsibility.
  • 15 or more years in the Automotive Insurance experience and/or training industry.
  • Proven track record of strategic goal setting and personnel oversight, development and managing large, complex accounts.
  • Strong knowledge of the automotive ecosystem—OEMs, tiered suppliers, dealers, or fleet/aftermarket services.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
  • Change Management - Develops workable implementation plans; Communicates changes effectively; Builds commitment and overcomes resistance; Prepares and supports those affected by change; Monitors transition and evaluates results.
  • Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns work with strategic goals.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve business goals that support the overall organization's goals; Understands business strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred.​

How much should I expect to travel?

  • Up to 70% travel

Strong preference to candidates that reside or are open to relocation to the Dallas, Houston, Phoenix, Los Angeles, or Chicago markets.

Overview

The Global Finance Internship Program at Assurant is a 12-week immersive experience designed to provide hands-on exposure within Accounting, Business Finance, Tax, Investments, Internal Audit & Analytics, Vendor Management or Actuarial. This program offers students meaningful, real-world experience while building foundational technical and business skills in a Fortune 500 organization.


Interns will contribute to meaningful business initiatives, gain insight into enterprise financial operations, and develop professional capabilities through structured learning and mentorship. This program concludes with a capstone presentation delivered to leadership.


Interns will be placed into one of several functional teams based on interests, coursework, and business need. High-performing interns may be considered for future full-time opportunities within Assurant's Finance organization.


What You'll Do

Responsibilities vary by placement area, but interns can expect to perform one or more of the following tasks:

  • Support financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, and reconciliation activities
  • Participate in month‑end financial close tasks and audit preparation
  • Analyze structured data and develop insights to support business decisions
  • Assist in building dashboards, financial models, and KPI reports
  • Conduct research, synthesize findings, and communicate recommendations
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on ongoing projects and strategic initiatives
  • Present project outcomes and learnings during final capstone

Specialized Finance Tracks

  • Accounting : Gain exposure to corporate and international accounting operations, financial reporting (including SEC and statutory), controllership activities, audit support, and balance sheet reconciliation processes.
  • Finance: Support financial planning, forecasting, expense management, client profitability analysis, and financial modeling across domestic and international business units.
  • Vendor Management: Assist in global vendor risk oversight, regulatory research, and emerging risk analysis to support enterprise compliance and operational resilience.
  • Internal Audit & Analytics : Contribute to risk-based audit activities and leverage data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI) to enhance audit insights and financial transparency.
  • Tax : Support state and local tax compliance, research, and planning initiatives within a complex regulatory environment.
  • Investments : Assist with portfolio analytics, income forecasting, risk assessment, and strategic asset allocation activities within the enterprise investment function.
  • Actuarial : Support pricing, ratemaking, reserving, forecasting, and financial reporting activities that inform risk and profitability management.

Basic Qualifications

  • You are currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, Actuarial Science/Mathematics, or related field and will have at least on semester remaining following the summer internship
  • Expected graduation between December 2027 – June 2029
  • Basic Excel skills
  • Willingness to develop advanced Excel & Power BI skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical mindset with curiosity and problem-solving ability
  • Ability to organize and interpret structured data
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach
  • Interest in accounting, finance, risk, investments, or analytics

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Excel: pivot tables, lookups, data cleaning
  • Power BI: dashboards, KPIs (training provided)
  • SQL and/or other data tools (preferred for some tracks)
  • Understanding of performance metrics and financial statements
  • Automation/AI exposure
  • PowerPoint and executive-level presentation skills
  • Progress towards professional designations (CPA, CFA, ACAS, etc.)

Finance at Assurant

Finance at Assurant is about more than numbers—it's about creating clarity and confidence in a complex world. Our teams operate across global markets and provide analytical insight and financial stewardship that empower the organization to invest smartly, innovate boldly, and deliver long‑term value. This internship will provide exposure to how finance helps strengthen and sustain our business globally.

The Maintenance Technician is a technical leader and subject matter expert (SME) responsible for maximizing equipment reliability, uptime, and operational performance within a highly automated production environment. This role leads advanced troubleshooting and repair efforts across robotics, vision systems, conveyors, PLC-controlled equipment, and other production technologies. Beyond hands-on maintenance, the Maintenance Technician mentors team members, drives continuous improvement initiatives, champions safety and compliance, and serves as the primary escalation point for complex equipment issues. Working cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Quality, and Production teams, this individual helps optimize productivity, enhance equipment performance, and minimize downtime.

This is an onsite role in our Lewisville TX facility, with a schedule of Monday-Thursday 6AM-4:30PM.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair complex mechanical, electrical, robotic, vision, and automation systems, including KUKA robots, Cognex vision systems, shrink tunnels, conveyors, and PLC-controlled equipment
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring failures
  • Serve as the primary escalation resource for advanced equipment and automation issues
  • Analyze maintenance data and identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, and equipment performance
  • Recommend equipment upgrades, design enhancements, and process improvements to reduce downtime
  • Mentor and train Maintenance Technicians on troubleshooting, safety, maintenance procedures, and best practices
  • Support onboarding and development of new technicians through structured training and hands-on coaching
  • Lead daily shift meetings to communicate safety updates, maintenance priorities, and operational goals
  • Provide feedback to leadership regarding team performance and development opportunities
  • Coordinate maintenance activities and provide shift leadership when supervisors are unavailable
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and ensure compliance with CMMS (e.g., eMaint) work order standards
  • Develop and update SOPs, PM procedures, troubleshooting guides, and LOTO documentation
  • Audit preventive maintenance activities to ensure quality and effectiveness
  • Participate in Kaizen, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity and equipment reliability
  • Champion workplace safety through LOTO compliance, safety audits, and proactive risk identification
  • Assist in developing Job Safety Analyses (JSAs) and support ongoing safety training efforts
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure maintenance activities meet safety, quality, and customer compliance requirements
  • Identify critical spare parts requirements and support inventory optimization efforts
  • Assist with storeroom audits and ensure availability of essential repair components

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 4+ years of industrial maintenance experience, including experience with automation systems and advanced troubleshooting
  • Strong knowledge of electromechanical systems, robotics, PLCs, vision systems, motors, sensors, and industrial controls
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and equipment documentation
  • Experience using CMMS platforms such as eMaint or similar maintenance management systems
  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex equipment issues in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or training maintenance technicians
  • Hands-on experience with KUKA robotics, Cognex vision systems, Siemens TIA Portal, or similar automation platforms
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification
  • Experience leading continuous improvement, reliability, or equipment optimization projects

We are seeking a Shared Services Specialist to support the printing, balancing, reconciliation, and quality review of hazard, claims, and loss draft checks. The Role at a Glance

We are creating a new AI/ML Ops pillar to own the reliability, safety, and cost-effectiveness of every model, pipeline, and agent we run in production. This is fundamentally an operations leadership role: someone who has built monitoring, escalation, and change management discipline from the ground up during a technology or business transformation, and who can apply that same rigor to AI/ML systems. This leader will build and run the function that closes the gap between "built" and "running well at scale." They will report to the Chief Data & AI Engineering Officer and sit alongside the leaders of AI/Data Infrastructure, Data Strategy & Governance, Data & Delivery Platform, AI/ML/Agentic Engineering, and AI Native Intelligence Platform.

What you'll be doing

Operating Foundation & Change Management

  • Define the operating model for how AI/ML systems move from build to production: intake, change approval, release governance.
  • Build change management processes for model, pipeline, and agent releases, including change advisory review, risk tiering, rollback authority, and communication protocols.
  • Establish a clear ownership and accountability model (RACI) across Engineering, Ops, and Governance for every production AI/ML asset.

Monitoring, Observability & Notifications

  • Build monitoring for performance, drift, latency, quality, and safety across production AI/ML systems.
  • Design the notification and alerting architecture: what gets flagged, to whom, at what severity, with what SLA for acknowledgment.
  • Implement in-production evals and guardrails; enforce governance policy at runtime in partnership with Data Strategy & Governance.

Incident Response & Escalation Management

  • Define and own SLOs/SLAs for production models, pipelines, and agents.
  • Build on-call rotations, incident response, escalation tiers, and postmortem practice for AI/ML systems.
  • Own the detection and escalation path for misuse, abuse, or safety incidents.
  • Drive mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-recovery down as the estate scales.

Deployment & Lifecycle Governance

  • Partner with Platform Engineering to stand up CI/CD, versioning, and rollback for models, pipelines, and agents, partnering with Engineering on execution.
  • Establish safe rollout patterns (canary, shadow, staged) in partnership with Engineering.
  • Own the retirement and deprecation process for models and agents no longer in use.

Cost & Capacity

  • Own inference and compute cost visibility and optimization; build unit economics per model and agent.
  • Partner with AI/Data Infrastructure on capacity planning. Organization Building
  • Define the operating model, team structure, and hiring plan for the pillar.
  • Build the feedback loop that routes production failure modes and cost signals back to Engineering.
  • Establish the pillar's KPIs and report on them to the Chief Data & AI Engineering Officer and broader leadership.

What we're looking for

  • Proven track record leading operations through a major transformation: building the operating model, monitoring and observability foundation, and escalation discipline for a function that didn't have one before, ideally in technology, platform, or shared-services operations.
  • Deep experience in change management: standing up change advisory processes, risk tiering, release governance, and rollback authority in a fast-moving technical environment.
  • Strong background in monitoring, observability, and notification and escalation design: knowing what to alert on, who gets paged, and how severity and ownership are defined.
  • Experience building incident response and postmortem practices, including on-call rotations and MTTD/MTTR reduction, in any production technology environment. AI/ML-specific experience is a strong plus, not a prerequisite.
  • Working knowledge of (or demonstrated ability to quickly learn) ML/LLM system failure modes: drift, degradation, hallucination, latency and cost blowups, and how to instrument against them.
  • Experience partnering with governance and risk functions to enforce policy in live systems.
  • Strong track record hiring, developing, and leading technical or operational teams, ideally from an early stage.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building process from scratch, not just running an existing playbook.

Job.JobDescription:
Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance: is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #: 76678

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial's AI, Data and Analytics (AIDA) organization is building the capabilities required for an AI-enabled business. Within AIDA, Data Strategy & Governance turns priority insurance and retirement use cases into governed, reusable data products and services. We work backward from the decisions and actions AI agents and applications must support, then build the common meaning, quality, metadata, lineage, and secure access needed to trust the result. We deliver with AIDA's infrastructure, platform, engineering, MLOps, and AI-native platform teams, with governance built into the product.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you wil lead the end-to-end technical direction and delivery of complex AI-ready data products. You will connect priority business and AI use cases to the data capabilities beneath them, including shared meaning, rules, quality, lineage, secure access, and reusable services. You will also lead hands-on graph and GraphRAG delivery where relationships and unstructured knowledge matter, while choosing simpler relational, search, or rules-based patterns when they fit better.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead discovery with business and product owners, domain experts, stewards, source owners, and partner AIDA pillars to define the questions, actions, outcomes, product boundaries, and accountable owners.
  • Design the product's canonical and consumer models, ontology and semantic layer, business rules, contracts, interfaces, quality controls, metadata, lineage, provenance, and secure access.
  • Design and build graph models in Amazon Neptune or comparable technology, including entities, relationships, effective dates, rules, provenance, SPARQL queries, and performance tuning.
  • Implement GraphRAG and hybrid graph-vector retrieval, including ingestion, entity and relationship extraction, embeddings, graph enrichment, filtering, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citations.
  • Design and build AWS source-to-product pipelines and agent-facing APIs or Model Context Protocol interfaces using fit-for-purpose lakehouse, orchestration, transformation, and infrastructure-as-code patterns.
  • Evaluate graph, relational, vector, search, and rules-based approaches against representative questions, expected evidence, answer quality, latency, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  • Lead a blended delivery pod through production readiness, code and design review, incident prevention, partner knowledge transfer, and reusable patterns that avoid unnecessary complexity and lock-in.

What we're looking for

Must Haves:

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience, plus typically 5 or more years of relevant experience with ownership of complex production data systems or products.
  • Substantial hands-on experience building and operating graph solutions with Amazon Neptune or comparable technology, including graph modeling, SPARQL, query analysis, and performance tuning.
  • Hands-on implementation of GraphRAG or comparable hybrid graph-vector retrieval, including ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citations.
  • Advanced Python and SQL, plus strong AWS data-platform experience, orchestration, data modeling, distributed processing, automated testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
  • Proven ability to translate a business capability into semantics, rules, contracts, controls, interfaces, and measurable evaluations, and to lead architecture decisions through influence while contributing hands-on.
  • Ownership of quality, lineage, privacy, access, observability, recovery, and production operations for sensitive or regulated data.

Nice to Haves:

  • Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch, Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker, MLflow, or comparable production AI and retrieval services.
  • Model Context Protocol design, authorization propagation, agent evaluation and observability, ontologies, entity resolution, feature stores, or knowledge-graph governance.
  • Deep insurance or financial-services experience and technical leadership across employees, contractors, consultants, or managed-service teams.

About this job

Underwriting intern position with W.R. Berkley Corporation's management liability insurance unit. Gain in-depth knowledge of the insurance industry through on-the-job training and meaningful assignments under an AVP's direction.

Good fit if you are pursuing a bachelor's degree, proficient with Microsoft Office, have strong communication skills, and are naturally curious about how insurance works.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley Professional was founded in October 2008 as an operating unit of W. R. Berkley Corporation, one of the nation's premier commercial property casualty insurance providers, by a team of management liability professionals with a combined total of over fifty years of experience in insurance and financial services. Backed by superior financial strength, Berkley Professional brings fresh capacity, underwriting acumen, claims handling expertise, and extensive relationships with insureds and brokers to the management liability marketplace. Since then, Berkley Professional has enjoyed calculated and consistent growth, while exceeding the needs of our business partners. We provide customized coverage solutions with fairness, responsibility and superior claims servicing. Berkley Professional continues to expand its product capabilities as well as geographic reach in order to better serve the dynamic management liability environment. This growth includes the addition of a dedicated Financial Institutions team as well as an experienced group of Transactional Liability underwriters furthering Berkley Professional's capabilities.

Responsibilities

Under the direction of the AVP, Underwriting, this position will gain an in-depth knowledge of the insurance industry. The Intern will receive on-the-job training and be given the opportunity to work on meaningful assignments.

Responsibilities

- Develop an understanding of the insurance industry from multiple facets.

- Achieve a proficiency in the technical and professional skills/knowledge of the assigned position through on-the-job training.

- Collaborate on projects as assigned and develop an understanding of the insurance industry.

- Perform other duties that will support business strategies.

Qualifications

Education

- Pursuing a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.

Qualifications

- Knowledgeable and proficient with Microsoft Professional products in addition to Internet search capabilities.

- Previous customer service work experience a plus.

- Exceptional oral and written communication skills. Your communication style is flexible to the situation. You communicate clearly and with a purpose.

- Calm under pressure. You have excellent organizational skills, integrity, and great follow-through on tasks. You are comfortable challenging norms while working collaboratively with colleagues.

- A strong customer service bias. You want to get to yes. You are known for your super responsiveness. You can say no and preserve your relationships.

- Natural curiosity. You love learning how things work and you are always looking for innovative improvements.

- You are open minded, looking for the best result. You treat team members with respect and value their contributions. You are inclusive, committed to working together to achieve common goals.

- Demonstrated ability to achieve results by setting goals, prioritizing tasks and staying accountable to stakeholders.

- The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Requisition #: 76672

The Role at a Glance

As a Sr. Group Underwriter on the Specialty Health team, you will underwrite new and existing business for Lincoln's Supplemental Health (Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity) products. You'll assess risk, develop pricing recommendations, and support profitable growth and customer retention through sound underwriting decisions.

This role offers the opportunity to work independently on more complex underwriting assignments while partnering with Sales, Account Management, Product, Pricing, and Operations teams to drive business results. You'll build strong relationships, influence underwriting outcomes, contribute to process improvements, and continue to grow your technical and industry expertise.

What you'll be doing

  • Underwrite new business, renewals, and amendments for Supplemental Health products
  • Manage an assigned in-force book of business
  • Assess risk by evaluating group characteristics, demographics, participation, benefit design, claims experience, and other underwriting factors
  • Perform experience rating and collaborate with actuarial partners to evaluate pricing and risk
  • Apply underwriting guidelines, authority limits, and pricing methodologies to determine appropriate coverage terms and rates
  • Make underwriting decisions within assigned authority and recommend actions requiring additional review or approval
  • Prepare and communicate underwriting analyses, pricing recommendations, and renewal strategies to business partners
  • Support the RFP process, including responding to underwriting requirements and completing submissions through third-party platforms
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Product, Pricing, Operations, and underwriting partners across product lines to develop coordinated customer solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners, support the development of underwriting expertise across the team, and serve as a trusted resource on underwriting strategies and risk assessment
  • Identify opportunities to improve underwriting processes, tools, and reporting capabilities

What we're looking for

Must-Haves:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of degree)
  • 4+ years of Supplemental Health underwriting experience
  • Strong analytical, communication, and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have:

  • Expertise in experience rating and renewal underwriting

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through 1/24/27 subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

Requisition #: 76667

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking an enthusiastic Senior IT Auditor who is a self-starter and initiative-driven, ready to take ownership of critical audit processes and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This position is perfect for someone inclined to leverage their IT Audit and technology expertise in an internal audit environment, while focusing on an in-depth review of IT systems, cybersecurity, and data integrity controls. As a Sr. IT Auditor, you will independently manage IT audits, perform advisory reviews, and support integrated audits in collaboration with the broader Internal Audit team. If you are passionate about driving improvements and ensuring robust IT governance, we want to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

  • Plan audit engagements, identify inherent risks and control objectives, perform risk assessments and identify IT-related risks and vulnerabilities based on business objectives, regulatory requirements, and emerging threats.
  • Conduct end-to-end audit engagements, perform detailed testing, facilitate meetings, and document and review the results of testing according to internal audit methodology.
  • Perform advisory reviews by assessing project governance, risks, controls, and implementation activities.
  • Support integrated audits in collaboration with the broader Internal Audit team by evaluating IT risks and controls relevant to the audit objectives.
  • Demonstrate expertise in IT disciplines (but not limited to): cybersecurity, hardware, networking, firewalls, servers, database management systems, operating systems, disaster recovery, cloud technologies, identity and access management, incident management, vulnerability management, risk assessment, IT governance, and system development.
  • Provide IT subject matter expertise, audit knowledge, and professional judgment to assess a broad range of business processes, risks, and control objectives.
  • Prepare detailed audit reports outlining findings, risk criteria, and recommendations for management, lead audit closing meetings, and ensure all audit documentation is finalized and conforms with department policies and standards.
  • Monitor and report on issue remediation, retesting, and closure status.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and stay informed about emerging IT and industry trends, including developments in AI, and share those insights with team members.
  • Manage co-source partner(s) and ensure they are adhering to LF IA methodology, review deliverables, and hold them accountable for budget and scope.
  • Partner with IT infrastructure, security, risk management, and other control groups within the company to establish strong working relationships while maintaining independence.
  • Collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Internal Audit, the department, and the broader organization while expanding knowledge of the insurance industry, products, and operations.
  • Perform duties in compliance with all state and federal regulations, as well as company policies and procedures.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • Expertise in IT disciplines (but not limited to): cybersecurity, hardware, networking, cloud environments, firewalls, servers, database management systems, operating systems, disaster recovery, identity and access management, incident management, vulnerability management, risk assessment, IT governance, and system development
  • 4+ years of experience in IT audit and/or information technology that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position
  • Certifications/Licensures: CISA, CISSP and/or CIA
  • Knowledge of internal controls, business / information technology risk, regulatory and compliance frameworks (ITIL, NIST, COBIT, NY DFS, CCPA/CPRA, SEC, PCI DSS etc.), project management, and audit techniques
  • Demonstrates problem solving skills, root-cause analysis, and critical-thinking skills to assess complex IT environments and identify control gaps
  • Demonstrates relationship management skills and organizational skills and can independently manage engagements and prioritize workload
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • 4 Year / Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or another related IT field

Nice-to-haves:

  • Interest in emerging technologies, including AI, and how they may impact business risk.
  • Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
  • Experience in the insurance or financial services industry
  • Other related certifications (PMP, GSNA, CRISC, CCSP, CISM, etc.)

Company Details

BerkleyNet is an innovative workers compensation insurance provider that does all of our business online. Our Goal? To make doing business “Ridiculously Fast. Amazingly Easy.”

Responsibilities

The Senior Accountant owns complex accounting, reporting, and control responsibilities while using data, technology, and process-improvement methods to strengthen financial operations. This role analyzes financial and operational results, identifies risks and performance drivers, and translates findings into actionable business insights. In partnership with Finance, Operations, Technology, and other stakeholders, the Senior Accountant improves processes and leverages automation to increase the speed, accuracy, and usability of financial information.

As BNET continues to streamline selected finance activities, this position will operate across both current-state execution and future-state improvement. The Senior Accountant will maintain reliable day-to-day financial operations while helping simplify workflows, strengthen controls, document procedures, and support evolving responsibilities in a dynamic and changing environment.

Key Functions/Duties of Position: Describe the overall job responsibilities (including any decision-making authority) for this position.

  • Own assigned areas of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, including preparation and review of complex journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, and management reporting.
  • Apply sound accounting judgment to ensure compliance with GAAP, statutory, regulatory, internal-control, and corporate reporting requirements.
  • Investigate unusual activity, reconcile differences, identify root causes, and resolve accounting or data issues at the source; clearly communicate risks, impacts, and recommended actions.
  • Combine financial, policy, claims, and operational data to perform trend, variance, exception, and root-cause analyses that explain business performance.
  • Develop clear dashboards, visualizations, and management-ready narratives that translate analytical findings into decisions and actions for financial and non-financial audiences.
  • Define and maintain trusted metrics, data definitions, and validation controls to improve the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and usability of financial information.
  • Identify repetitive, manual, or control-sensitive activities suitable for redesign or automation; map current processes, quantify effort and risk, and help implement sustainable solutions using approved tools.
  • Test automated outputs, establish appropriate controls, document procedures, maintain implemented solutions, and measure benefits such as reduced cycle time, errors, or manual effort.
  • Partner across Finance, Operations, Technology, Underwriting, Claims, and Corporate functions to frame business questions, improve processes, and deliver reliable outcomes.
  • Support audits, regulatory requests, special projects, system implementations, and other initiatives requiring accounting, analytical, or process expertise.
  • Share knowledge, create clear documentation, and help strengthen the Finance team's accounting, analytical, automation, and technology capabilities.
  • Constructively challenge inefficient practices, test new ideas, and foster a collaborative, innovative, and psychologically safe workplace.

Qualifications

  • Three to five years of progressive professional accounting or finance experience, including ownership of complex close, reconciliation, reporting, or analytical responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of GAAP and internal controls; insurance accounting, statutory reporting, or workers compensation experience is preferred.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and demonstrated ability to organize, analyze, validate, and communicate information from multiple data sources.
  • Experience with data-preparation tools and with improving or automating a financial process
  • Experience with analytics and workflow automation tools. Familiarity with Power BI and SQL, and the ability to retrieve data from a data warehouse is preferred.
  • Ability to learn and use approved AI-assisted tools responsibly, validate outputs, exercise professional judgment, and protect confidential information.

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln's Investment Strategy & Portfolio Management team is evolving its Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) and asset liability modeling toolkit to better support enterprise risk appetite, capital, liquidity, and new business growth across U.S.A. and Bermuda entities.

The team partners with insurance businesses and the Investments team to design and maintain the enterprise SAA across legal entities, integrating new business pricing with in force optimization, and operating within U.S. and Bermuda regulatory regimes. In this role, you will own the quantitative modeling and analytics that power strategic asset allocation, in-force optimization, and new business pricing support — drawing on ALM analytics as a key input, and building select ALM components as needed. You will work as a close quantitative partner to investment strategy and portfolio management, bringing deep understanding of SAA and portfolio construction to develop models and dashboards, and ensuring our analytics incorporate regulatory requirements for NAIC and Bermuda Monetary Authority standards. Your efforts will enable our investment strategies to be produced faster across regimes and improve our documentation and governance controls.

What you'll be doing

Build and own the SAA analytics platform
•Engineer reliable Python services and SQL backed data pipelines that ingest asset, liability, and market data; orchestrate runs; and expose results to strategy and risk partners (APIs, notebooks, dashboards).
•Productionize research prototypes into hardened components (configuration management, unit/integration tests, logging, lineage, and automated documentation) supporting enterprise wide SAA across U.S. and Bermuda entities.


Portfolio construction & optimization enablement
•Implement and scale optimization, scenario analysis, and stress testing tools used to construct SAA under capital, rating, liquidity, and ALM constraints; parameterize for both U.S. RBC and Bermuda BSCR frameworks.
•Integrate cash flow projections (e.g., BondEdge outputs) and reconcile them to portfolio views with auditable data controls.

Regulatory aware data modeling
•Model and map security master and position data to NAIC designations and statutory schedules and to BMA BSCR asset categories and SBA portfolios; embed validation checks aligned to reporting rules.

Partner across the enterprise
•Work across the Investments team to partner with insurance business units, ALM, Actuarial, Enterprise Risk Management, and Finance.

What we're looking for

Quantitative & technical skills
•Fluent in multiple languages with depth in Python and SQL (required). You also bring working proficiency in other languages for legacy model integration.
•Hands on experience building scalable, object-oriented solutions/components for model enhancements/extensions across different products/assumptions. Enhancing existing core framework to scale model with change requests from product owners (annuities, life, group etc.) while maintaining code readability, documentation, and audit trail.
•Hands on data engineering: relational modeling, performance tuning, data integration (with tools like Bloomberg & Intex), orchestration, version control, testing frameworks, and observability.
•Quant/optimization toolkit experience (e.g., pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Pyomo/OR Tools) and time series/scenario modeling.
•Code testing/automation using CI/CD framework, Backtesting of strategy – creating backtesting data and summarizing model results and reporting Investment analytics by potentially leveraging Lincoln's AI tools/suite of products.
•Experience in producing asset cashflows utilizing tools like Factset/Bloomberg/Intex is a plus.

Insurance investing & regulatory literacy
•Required: Practical familiarity with NAIC investment regulations, statutory accounting and reporting (including RBC capital concepts and statutory investment schedules)
•Required: Understanding of Bermuda Monetary Authority capital and reporting
•Required: Deep understanding of SAA optimization incorporating the matching of insurance product liability cash flows across multiple economic scenarios

Domain context
•Exposure to ALM and insurance balance sheet dynamics (duration/convexity, liquidity ladders, reinvestment, asset rating migration).
•Comfort integrating third party and internal data sources (e.g., pricing/spread inputs, cash flow engines) into reproducible SAA processes.
Ways of working
•Product mindset: ability to decompose ambiguous strategy problems into small, testable engineering increments with clear documentation.
•Excellent communication with non engineers; able to explain model assumptions, caveats, and results succinctly for decision makers.

Minimum qualifications
•Bachelor's degree in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline (Master's degree, CFA, or FRM preferred).
•10+ years of experience within the financial services or related industry; 5+ years of professional experience in quantitative investment strategy, strategic asset allocation, portfolio construction, or asset-liability management, with strong hands-on software/data engineering skills to build and productionize the underlying analytics.
•Demonstrated track record building production data/analytics platforms supporting portfolio construction or risk/ALM.

The Role at a Glance

Lincoln Financial Group is seeking a Data Scientist to join our AI Product & Delivery organization, focused on the agentic AI systems powering our next generation of products. You will generate insights from data, build and validate models, design experiments, and measure the business value AI agents deliver — while establishing rigorous evaluation frameworks that keep agentic systems accurate, safe, and reliable in a regulated financial services environment. You will partner closely with product owners, engineers, and business stakeholders to turn analysis into decisions and evals into guardrails.

What you'll be doing

Insights & Analysis

  • Analyze usage, performance, and outcome data to surface actionable insights on how agentic AI features are used and where they fall short.
  • Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that track agent performance and business impact.

Modeling & Agentic AI Systems

  • Design, build, and validate models and agentic workflows.
  • Evaluate model and agent architecture choices, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and risk.
  • Collaborate with engineering to productionize models and agents and monitor them post-launch.

Experimentation

  • Design and run experiments — A/B tests, offline evaluations, holdouts — to test agent behavior, prompt or model changes, and feature variants.
  • Define hypotheses, success metrics, and sample size or power requirements; ensure statistical rigor.
  • Interpret results and translate them into clear go/no-go recommendations.

Value Measurement

  • Define and track metrics that connect agentic AI features to business value — efficiency gains, cost savings, revenue, and customer or employee experience.
  • Build measurement frameworks that isolate AI-driven impact from other contributing factors.
  • Report on ROI and value realization to product and business leadership.

Evaluations (Evals) for Agentic AI

  • Design and maintain eval suites and benchmarks covering task success, reasoning quality, tool-use correctness, safety, and failure modes.
  • Build regression frameworks and test case libraries to catch performance degradation across model or prompt updates.
  • Partner with product owners on human-in-the-loop review processes and use eval findings to guide model and agent improvements.

What we're looking for

Must haves:

  • 3–8 years of experience in data science, applied machine learning, or a related analytical role.
  • Hands-on experience building and evaluating ML models; experience with agentic AI systems (LLM agents, tool use, multi-step reasoning) strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing and analyzing experiments (A/B testing, causal inference, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and standard ML/data science tooling.
  • Strong ability to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Grade level: final grade level for this position will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience building or evaluating LLM-based agents or multi-agent systems.
  • Familiarity with eval frameworks and observability tools (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, Ragas).
  • Experience with LLM APIs or enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Google Vertex AI).
  • Advanced degree (Master's or Ph.D.) in a quantitative field.
  • Domain experience in life insurance, annuities, retirement planning, or employee benefits.

Customer Service Representative for Berkley One's Contact Center team, handling multi-channel support (phone, chat, email) for high-net-worth customers and broker partners. Role includes policy servicing, identity verification, and processing transactions like quotes and endorsements.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of call center customer service experience and strong communication skills across multiple channels.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley One is a modern insurance provider for a modern generation of affluence. We serve clients who live dynamic, adventurous lives and expect their insurance experience to match. Our mission is to deliver highly personalized risk and claims management through a blend of expert independent agents, cutting-edge digital tools, and the strength of the W.R. Berkley brand.

Why Join Us?

At Berkley One, you'll be part of a forward-thinking team that's reimagining personal insurance. We're building solutions that are as sophisticated and agile as the clients we serve—individuals and families who value innovation, simplicity, and exceptional service. You'll collaborate with passionate professionals, leverage modern technology, and help shape the future of our industry.

What We Value

  • A client-first mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences
  • Curiosity, creativity, and a drive to challenge the status quo
  • Collaboration across disciplines to build smarter, more intuitive solutions
  • Integrity, expertise, and a commitment to excellence

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer. #LI-V1 #LI-HYBRID

Responsibilities

Berkley One is seeking a highly motivated and service-oriented Customer Service Representative to join our Contact Center team. This role is responsible for delivering a best-in-class service experience to both our high-net-worth customers and broker partners, while supporting business growth and operational excellence. The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in multi-channel customer service and a demonstrated ability to manage complex inquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and efficiency. We'll trust you to serve as a primary point of contact for customers and agents, handling a variety of policy servicing and support activities. You'll play a critical role in ensuring seamless interactions across phone, chat, and email channels, while maintaining the highest standards of service delivery. This role offers an excellent entry point into the insurance industry, with significant opportunities for career growth and advancement within Berkley One.

This role will be based in our Phoenix, AZ or Wilmington, DE office. We offer a hybrid work schedule with 4 days in the office; and 1 day remote where it makes sense to do so. The hours of operation are 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM Eastern from Monday – Friday. Shifts vary based on customer needs and will fall within the hours outlined above.

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
  • Internal mobility opportunities
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
  • Opportunity to impact change
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

We'll count on you to:

  • Deliver timely, accurate, and high-quality service to customers and broker partners across multiple communication channels
  • Manage inbound inquiries and service requests with a focus on professionalism, responsiveness,
    and resolution
  • Process policy transactions including quotes, endorsements, cancellations, and payment activities with a high degree of accuracy
  • Maintain detailed and compliant documentation of all customer and agent interactions
  • Verify identities in accordance with regulatory and security protocols
  • Serve as a key resource for agents, providing guidance on policy inquiries and supporting quote-to-bind activities
  • Provide technical assistance and training related to internal systems, including policy administration, billing, and claims platforms
  • Demonstrate empathy and professionalism when supporting customers through sensitive situations, including first notice of loss
  • Proactively manage follow-ups and ensure timely completion of open service items
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues and escalate as appropriate
  • Consistently achieve performance metrics related to productivity, quality, and service standards
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, including process optimization initiatives and innovation programs
  • Support a culture of service excellence aligned with Berkley One's brand and values

Qualifications

What you need to have:

  • High school education or equivalent required
  • 2+ years experience delivering high-quality customer service in a fast-paced call center environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across multiple channels (phone, chat, email)
  • Strong problem-solving, and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with technology and ability to quickly learn new systems and platforms
  • Commitment to teamwork, continuous improvement, and operational excellence
  • Proficiency with technology and Microsoft Office required

About this job

Director of Claims for a public entity insurance company handling Professional Liability, General Liability, and Automobile claims for schools, municipalities, and other public entities. Role includes claims evaluation, litigation management, reserve setting, and TPA oversight.

Good fit if you have 10+ years of commercial liability claims experience, litigation background, and strong Professional Liability knowledge.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley Public Entity (BPE) was founded in 2012 as a member company of W.R. Berkley Corporation. BPE is a growing, dynamic company with the vision of being the preeminent carrier in our marketplace. As our name implies, BPE is 100% focused on providing innovative insurance and reinsurance solutions to public entities.

We have a welcoming culture valuing our employees – we trademarked the phrase Everything Counts, Everyone Matters® to describe the Berkley commitment to our people and how we do business. We believe that every person in the organization is important, and every accomplishment makes a difference in our results. Come join us!

The company is an equal opportunity employer.

https://www.berkleypublicentity.com/

Responsibilities

We have an opportunity for a Director, Claims - Public Entity to join our team! You will be responsible for the review, oversight, and specific handling of Professional Liability, General Liability, and Automobile claims including: Law Enforcement and Sexual Abuse involving schools, municipalities, and other public entities. This is an individual contributor role.

Key functions include but are not limited to:

  • Identify and evaluate risk transfer opportunities pursuant to contracts, lease agreements, certificates of insurance.
  • Evaluate claims for coverage, liability, and damages to negotiate and resolve claims on reasonable terms and at an appropriate value.
  • Communicate with insureds, brokers and TPA's to secure additional claim information, communicate loss information, and monitor Self Insured Retentions and determine the extent of exposure to the insured and the company.
  • Sets reserves within authority or makes claim recommendations concerning reserve changes to supervisor.
  • Retain, direct, and manage litigation counsel through trial, developing and managing strategy for complex litigation; attend arbitrations, mediations, trials.
  • Prepare timely and accurate reports to management regarding significant claim developments.
  • Lead and participate in audits of TPA's to ensure adherence to BPE claims guidelines.
  • Communicate and collaborate across the organization- underwriting, marketing, and senior management to achieve organizational success.
  • Contribute to business development; participate in marketing and renewal events differentiating the BPE claims process within the marketplace.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree required.
  • 10+ years of commercial liability claims experience required.
  • Public Entity experience, preferred.
  • Proven track record of building and maintaining strong business relationships with insureds, agents, brokers, and TPAs.
  • Litigation experience necessary.
  • Strong experience handling Professional Liability, along with a good knowledge of General Liability and Auto.
  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills; your communication style is flexible to the situation; you communicate clearly and with a purpose.
  • Calm under pressure; you have excellent organizational skills, integrity, and great follow-through on tasks; you are comfortable challenging norms while working collaboratively with colleagues at all levels of the organization.

About this job

Senior Underwriting Quality Consultant role focused on driving underwriting quality and operational excellence across Nautilus Insurance Group. Position involves conducting comprehensive reviews of underwriting files, analyzing trends, supporting compliance audits, and partnering with leadership on strategic initiatives. Hybrid or remote option available for qualified candidates.

Good fit if you have at least three years of commercial insurance underwriting experience and strong technical underwriting knowledge across multiple lines of business.

Full job description

Company Details

As an elite Excess and Surplus Lines market, Nautilus Insurance Group offers commercial property and casualty insurance solutions to appointed wholesale surplus lines producers countrywide. We have specialized in providing these solutions for more than 35 years.

We have more flexible policy terms and premium rates on a non-admitted basis. Our focus is small to medium Property and Casualty risks on both an admitted and a non-admitted basis.

Our offerings are distributed through partnerships with appointed wholesale surplus lines producers. Our relationships are defined by mutual success, speed to market, customer-centric focus and an expanded appetite.

Coverage placed by Nautilus Insurance Group is provided by Nautilus Insurance Company and Great Divide Insurance Company, both W. R. Berkley Corporation members with A.M. Best (Superior) A+ XV ratings.

Benefit Highlights:

  • Paid Parental Leave! At Nautilus, we offer Childbirth Recovery Leave as well as Primary Caregiver Leave, for up to a maximum of 12 weeks of paid leave.
  • Nautilus offers Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage options, along with Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) choices
  • We help our employees feel secure by providing a 401(k) program, profit sharing, stock purchase plan, life insurance, and travel accident insurance options.
  • One of our core values is “Committed to Serve” and these aren't idle words. We provide every employee one paid day off per year to volunteer at a local charity. That's serving with a smile!
  • We take risk management excellence and your professional growth seriously by offering Tuition Assistance and Industry-Related Education and Exam programs.
  • Can you hear us now? Employees are eligible for special cell phone service discounts with Verizon and AT&T. We've got a plum position for you! We participate in the Plum Benefits program offering employees cost-free access to thousands of exclusive travel and entertainment discounts.
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • On site newly renovated fitness center - free to use for employees. Yoga and other classes available for a nominal fee.

Responsibilities

Nautilus Insurance is seeking a Senior Underwriting Quality Consultant to join their team. This role can be located on a hybrid schedule in our Scottsdale, AZ office or remotely for a highly qualified candidate.

The Underwriting Excellence Team is responsible for driving underwriting quality, consistency, and operational excellence across the organization.

The role serves as a key resource for identifying emerging trends, monitoring agency and underwriting effectiveness, supporting regulatory and compliance expectations, and providing actionable insights that enhance decision making.

Key Functions/Duties of Position

  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of new business, renewals, and quotes to evaluate risk quality and file handling from underwriting, pricing, and policy construction perspectives, ensuring adherence to established underwriting procedures and authorities.

We support the market through close partnerships with an established distribution network of retail and wholesale insurance professionals. Our brokers and agents cater to a global base of clients in a variety of environments, including private and corporate art collections, museums, galleries, and exhibition, jewelry wholesalers, retailers, and manufacturers, along with those who work with collectibles, currencies, securities, and other high-value assets. Our claims and loss control operation is the undisputed gold standard for the entire fine art and jewelry insurance industry.

The company is an equal opportunity employer. #LI-AV1 #LI-HYBRID

Responsibilities

Shape the Future of Fine Art and Jewelry Claims

At Berkley Asset Protection, we're trusted to protect some of the world's most valuable jewelry, collections, and treasured assets. As our business continues to expand across the United States and internationally, we're seeking an experienced and visionary Assistant Vice President, Claims to be an integral member of the claims operations for our specialized niche product portfolio. This is far more than a traditional claims leadership position. It is an opportunity to become a visible and influential leader within a growing specialty organization, working closely with the President, senior executives, key distribution partners, and WR Berkley corporate leadership. You'll have significant autonomy to shape the direction of the role, strengthen strategic partnerships, and help define the future of our claims organization.

If you're passionate about combining technical claims expertise, customer advocacy, industry relationship building, and thought leadership, this is a career-defining opportunity.

This role will be based in our midtown Manhattan office (Third Ave between 47th and 48th). We offer a hybrid work schedule with 4 days in the office; and 1 day remote where it makes sense to do so.

What you can expect:

  • Influence Beyond Claims - You'll serve as a trusted advisor to insureds, agents, underwriters, collectors, museums, jewelry industry leaders, and executive stakeholders. Your expertise will help shape customer outcomes, underwriting insights, loss prevention strategies, and business growth initiatives.
  • High Visibility and Executive Exposure - This role offers regular interaction with the President and senior WR Berkley leadership, providing a platform to influence key business decisions and make a measurable impact on organizational success.
  • Opportunity to Shape the Future - As our business continues to expand domestically and internationally, you'll have the freedom to help evolve processes, enhance customer experiences, strengthen partnerships, and create innovative solutions in a highly specialized market.
  • Industry Presence - You'll represent Berkley Asset Protection at industry events, conferences, art and jewelry exhibitions, and client meetings, helping strengthen our market presence while building relationships across the high-net-worth ecosystem.

We'll count on you to:

In addition to leading complex claims and managing a high-performing team, you'll:

  • Lead the investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of complex high-value jewelry and valuable articles claims.
  • Collaborate with jewelry replacement vendors and oversee all aspects of jewelry salvage operations.
  • Partner closely with underwriting teams on large accounts, providing claims insights and supporting pre-bind and post-bind risk management strategies.
  • Work directly with collectors, museums, brokers, agents, and policyholders to provide loss-control guidance and risk mitigation recommendations.
  • Represent Berkley Asset Protection at industry conferences, jewelry trade shows, art-related events, and customer-facing engagements.
  • Deliver portfolio insights and strategic reporting to executive leadership.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Claims Adjusters and support staff.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational excellence, customer experience, vendor performance, and claim outcomes.

Qualifications

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience.
  • 10+ years of claims experience, ideally within High-Net-Worth personal lines, jewelry, fine art,
  • valuable articles, inland marine, or specialty insurance.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience with a demonstrated ability to develop people and drive results.
  • Strong technical claims expertise, including coverage analysis, investigation, reserving, negotiation, and resolution.
  • A passion for relationship management and serving as a trusted advisor to sophisticated clients and business partners.
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to travel to meet with clients, agents, industry partners, collectors, museums, and other stakeholders throughout the U.S. and, at times, internationally.

What makes you stand out:

You're equally comfortable discussing a multimillion-dollar jewelry loss, presenting at an industry conference, advising a museum on risk mitigation strategies, or partnering with underwriting leadership on a complex account.

  • Prior experience with high net worth claims.
  • Deep empathy and a customer-first mindset.
  • Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior stakeholders.
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills.
  • Curiosity and a desire to become a recognized thought leader within the jewelry, fine art, and valuable articles space.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to influence across functions.
  • The ambition and leadership capability to grow into broader executive responsibilities over time.

Company Details

Berkley Luxury Group is an operating unit of W.R. Berkley Corporation, one of America's largest commercial lines writers in the United states. At Berkley Luxury Group we offer tailored, all-inclusive insurance solutions for luxury condo, co-op, rental properties and fine dining restaurants.

At Berkley Luxury Group, our employees are our most important asset. As such, we have created a high performing culture incorporating our values into work practices, policies, and processes to foster, reinforce and sustain an environment where employees share a strong sense of purpose, commitment, and motivation to meet and exceed their goals.

About this job

Claims Analyst III role handling EPL and D&O claims at AIG in New York. Responsibilities include investigating coverage issues, coordinating with defense counsel, analyzing litigation budgets, and determining claim values.

Good fit if you have at least 1 year of claims or litigation experience, strong analytical skills, and a bachelor's degree or JD.

Full job description

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Claims Analyst III – EPL and D&O to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Claims

Our Claims teams are the proven problem solvers of choice for clients, delivering consistent technical excellence and showcasing our service differentiation to create an unparalleled global claims handling experience. Through a robust stakeholder feedback loop and supported by consistent processes and leadership, we take pride in delivering responsive, fair and professional service with empathy and efficiency.


How you will create an impact

As a Claims Analyst III, you will be responsible for identifying, investigating, and resolving multiple coverage issues at the earliest appropriate time and providing clear and concise written and verbal communication of policy coverage issues to insureds, brokers, underwriters and risk managers.

  • Timely coordinate with defense counsel/insureds/monitoring counsel to facilitate coverage, liability and damage analysis.
  • Explore the use of technology, structured settlements, and other means to find strategic and cost effective claims resolutions.
  • Effectively analyze and budget the litigation of each claim on pending through timely discussions with counsel, vendors and insureds.
  • Determine judgmental value on all files in pending within a reasonable time frame and make presentations to management as necessary.
  • Manage reserve adjustments and payments to avoid deficit payments.

What you will need to succeed

  • 1+ years of claims and/or litigation experience.
  • Financial experience preferred.
  • Ability to analyze policies of insurance and legal documents.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Strong computer skills (Microsoft Office).
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent required. JD highly preferred.

Ready to make a bigger impact? We look forward to reviewing your application.

About this job

Design and architect Workday Adaptive Planning solutions for enterprise financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and workforce planning. Lead technical implementation from discovery through production support, serving as design authority for the planning platform.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience and deep knowledge of financial planning, data modeling, and system integration.

Full job description

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Workday Adaptive Planning Architect to implement the strategy, roadmap, and architecture of our enterprise planning platform! Serving as both design authority and hands on technical lead, the Architect drives the technical solutioning for major FP&A initiatives from discovery through implementation and support across budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, scenario modeling, and reporting. Partnering closely with Finance, FP&A, and HR collaborators, this role also provides support for business-critical issues.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed!

What the day will look like

In this role, you will:

  • Implement the vision, roadmap, governance, and lifecycle management of the Workday Adaptive Planning platform, defining planning technology strategies that support budgeting, forecasting, long range planning, workforce planning, and scenario analysis.
  • Lead the design of complex, scalable Adaptive Planning solutions, ensuring data integrity and seamless information flow across the enterprise.
  • Lead the technical solutioning for all major Adaptive Planning initiatives, from initial discovery and design through implementation and postproduction support.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and model architecture, ensuring alignment with overall business strategy, and continuously find opportunities for process improvement and tool optimization for FP&A and other business teams.
  • Architect multidimensional planning models and structures, including dimensions, assumptions, versions, levels, and hierarchies that support:
  • Revenue, expense, and headcount planning. Workforce and long-range goal setting,
  • Driver based forecasting and scenario modeling
  • Own and provide hands on support for urgent and business critical production issues, ensuring swift resolution and minimal business disruption.
  • Serve as a domain authority for business collaborators, fixing process and technical issues in a timely manner, with a focus on upholding guidelines.
  • Configure and maintain Adaptive Planning models, sheets, formulas, assumptions, dimensions, attributes, and workflows, optimizing model performance, usability, and maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain executive reporting solutions and establish governance standards for OfficeConnect reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and key performance indicators.
  • Architect and oversee integrations between Workday Adaptive Planning and Workday Financials, Workday HCM, ERP, data warehouses, payroll, and BI platforms. Apply deep expertise in data modeling, system integration, and performance optimization.
  • Manage security architecture, user provisioning, access controls, and segregation of duties.
  • Own the evaluation and adoption of new Adaptive Planning capabilities, including bi-annual release adoption and AI/LLM enabled planning and forecasting features.
  • Serve as the enterprise design authority for planning architecture, defining standards, and governance for the Adaptive Planning platform.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Extensive hands-on Adaptive Planning experience designing, building, and maintaining models, with a proven portfolio of successfully architected and delivered large scale, high impact Adaptive Planning projects.

  • 7+ years of experience supporting FP&A, EPM, or enterprise planning platforms, including 5+ years of hands on Workday Adaptive Planning experience as an architect, lead administrator, or consultant.
  • Deep expertise in data modeling, system integration, and performance optimization within a sophisticated enterprise environment.
  • Deep functional knowledge across adaptive modeling, workforce planning, financial planning and forecasting, OfficeConnect, reporting and dashboards, security administration, and version management.
  • Solid understanding of financial statements, FP&A processes, budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, and scenario analysis.

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a leading global insurance organization. AIG member companies provide a wide range of property casualty insurance in approximately 70 countries and jurisdictions. These diverse offerings include products and services that help businesses and individuals protect their assets and manage risks.


We're also committed to making a positive difference for our colleagues and in the communities where we work and live. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs.


Get to know the business

At AIG, technology is at the heart of everything we do, from underwriting risks to processing claims. The Information Technology team equips our colleagues with the latest tools to complete their work efficiently and with the highest standards of excellence. The team is responsible for shielding the company's systems from security risks, while designing technology strategies that enable AIG's businesses to achieve their goals. AIG's Information Technology functions include enterprise architecture, software and systems engineering, cybersecurity, and technology risk and compliance.


About the Role

We are looking for a Network Automation Engineer to help build and scale automation across our enterprise network environment. You'll combine strong networking knowledge with software and automation skills to reduce manual work, improve network reliability, and enable API-driven operations. A key part of the role will be developing and operating our Network Source of Truth (SSoT/NSoT) using Nautobot, and integrating it with network infrastructure, automation, observability, and other enterprise platforms. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving real network problems with Python, APIs, Ansible, Git, and modern automation practices, not simply administering network devices.


What Success Looks Like

Requirements

  • Design and build network automation for provisioning, configuration, validation, migrations, and operational workflows.
  • Help lead the implementation and ongoing development of Nautobot as the Network Source of Truth.
  • Integrate Nautobot and other network platforms using REST APIs, GraphQL, and Python.
  • Develop reusable automation using Python, Ansible, Jinja2, Terraform, and related technologies.
  • Automate synchronization and validation of network inventory, IPAM, configuration, and operational data.
  • Build automated pre-change and post-change validation to make network changes safer and more reliable.
  • Apply Git, CI/CD, testing, and Infrastructure as Code practices to network automation.
  • Integrate automation with network management, observability, and enterprise platforms.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues spanning networks, automation, APIs, and data.
  • Partner with network architects, engineering and operations teams to identify opportunities for automation and improve how the network is operated.
  • Evaluate and prototype emerging network automation technologies and capabilities.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of network engineering, network automation, or related experience in large enterprise environments.
  • Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing and switching, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and IPAM.
  • Strong Python development or scripting skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible or similar automation platforms.
  • Experience building integrations using REST APIs and working with JSON/YAML.
  • Experience with a network Source of Truth, IPAM, DCIM, or inventory platform, ideally Nautobot or NetBox.
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience automating network technologies from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, F5, or similar.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, architecture, operations, and technology teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Hands-on experience developing Nautobot Jobs, Apps/plugins, APIs, GraphQL integrations, or data models.
  • Experience with NetBox, Nornir, Netmiko, NAPALM, pyATS, Jinja2, or similar automation technologies.
  • Familiarity with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and Linux environments.
  • Cloud networking experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of VXLAN/EVPN, controller-based networking, intent-based networking, or SDN.
  • Relevant Cisco, Juniper, DevNet, cloud, or automation certifications.

You'll help move network operations from manual, device-by-device processes toward automated, data-driven workflows, with Nautobot serving as a trusted source of network data and APIs, automation, validation, and CI/CD providing the foundation for scalable network operations.


Ready to step up to new challenges? We would love to hear from you.
