Job Description

Senior Risk Consultant - Real Estate

Work Style and Location

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of working from the office 2 to 3 days per week.

The preferred locations are Chicago, IL, or Denver, CO. Remote candidates may be considered on a case-by-case basis.

Regular travel, primarily within the United States, is required.

Role Overview

Join Aon in a highly consultative role supporting clients and prospects across our Real Estate & Hospitality practice. You will provide outsourced risk management and insurance advisory services, helping complex organizations understand their exposures, strengthen risk-management practices and make informed business and insurance decisions.

This is not a broking or account-management position. The role focuses on business risk consulting, risk analysis and risk assessments, translating complex insurance and operational risks into practical recommendations and solutions.

You will collaborate closely with the National Real Estate & Hospitality Leader and colleagues across Aon to support client engagements and practice-wide initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a trusted consultant to real estate and hospitality clients, providing strategic risk management and business risk consulting across insurance, operational risk, risk financing and related business challenges.
  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and risk analysis, using established auditing procedures to evaluate exposures, controls and insurance programs and recommend practical risk-mitigation strategies.
  • Review contracts, lender requirements, property-management agreements and insurance policies to identify risk-management and regulatory compliance considerations. Evaluate property risk-control practices, including physical access controls where relevant.
  • Advise clients on claims management, loss prevention, captive insurance and alternative risk solutions, including parametric insurance and structured risk solutions. Assess existing practices and support business process design improvements that strengthen efficiency and risk mitigation.
  • Translate complex findings into clear, executive-ready reports and actionable recommendations, maintaining accurate client records, risk assessments and deliverables through effective report writing and document management.
  • Lead multiple client engagements and practice initiatives using effective project management, balancing priorities, milestones and deliverables while working closely with the National Real Estate & Hospitality Leader and colleagues across Aon.
  • Build trusted client relationships through strong customer relationship management (CRM) and clienteling practices, understanding evolving business needs and connecting clients with the right capabilities across Aon, including AGRC.

Skills and Experience That Will Lead to Success

  • Extensive risk management and insurance experience supporting complex commercial real estate operations, with a strong understanding of industry risks, mitigation techniques and Property and Casualty insurance.
  • Experience developing risk-mitigation strategies across claims management, property risk control and loss prevention, with knowledge of captive insurance, parametric insurance and other alternative risk solutions.
  • Strong consulting and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate complex information, ask insightful questions and communicate practical recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience managing multiple client relationships, projects and priorities while building collaborative relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Strong written communication skills, including experience preparing client-facing or executive-level risk reports and interpreting contracts, lender requirements, property-management agreements and insurance policies.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree preferred; a professional qualification or designation in insurance or risk management is also desirable.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in commercial real estate risk management, insurance, brokerage, corporate risk management or a closely related environment.
  • Strong technical insurance background, including experience working within or closely with a corporate Risk Management function.

Job Description

Senior Scientist - Hurricane Model Developer, Impact Forecasting

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work virtually and from our Boston or Chicago office.

Aon is in the Business of Better Decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

United through trust as one inclusive team, we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the Role Looks Like

As a Senior Scientist - Hurricane Model Developer, you will contribute to the development of industry-leading catastrophe models used to assess and manage hurricane and tropical cyclone risk. You will apply scientific research, advanced analytics, and quantitative modeling techniques to enhance hazard representation, evaluate climate-related impacts, and support innovative solutions for clients around the world.

Working closely with scientists, engineers, data specialists, and product teams, you will help deliver high-quality modeling capabilities that improve risk insight, decision-making, and resilience planning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance hurricane and tropical cyclone catastrophe models, including stochastic event generation, wind field modeling, hazard characterization, and parameter estimation.
  • Build, maintain, and improve model components used to quantify catastrophe risk and estimate potential insurance losses.
  • Prepare, transform, integrate, and analyze large meteorological, geospatial, and insurance datasets to support model development and research initiatives.
  • Develop and optimize automated data processing and forecasting workflows that improve the efficiency, scalability, and accuracy of modeling solutions.
  • Manage and maintain modeling datasets, ensuring effective data organization, accessibility, documentation, and governance throughout the model development lifecycle.
  • Implement data quality controls, validation procedures, and performance testing to ensure reliable and accurate model outputs.
  • Incorporate emerging climate science research into catastrophe models to evaluate potential impacts on future hurricane-related losses.
  • Utilize Python, SQL, and related analytical tools to support data analysis, model development, and automation efforts.
  • Conduct quantitative analyses to identify risk drivers, evaluate uncertainty, and support catastrophe risk management decisions.
  • Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to deliver modeling enhancements and research initiatives aligned with business priorities and project timelines.
  • Document methodologies, validation results, and research findings through clear technical reports and model documentation.
  • Communicate complex scientific concepts and analytical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Stay informed of developments in atmospheric science, climate research, data science, and catastrophe modeling to advance product capabilities and innovation.

Skills and Experience That Will Lead to Success

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Meteorology, Climate Science, Oceanography, Earth Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Experience developing, analyzing, or enhancing catastrophe models, risk models, or related scientific modeling solutions.
  • Strong quantitative analysis and problem-solving skills with experience applying statistical or computational methods to complex datasets.
  • Experience programming in Python, MATLAB, R, or similar analytical languages, including developing tools, workflows, or automated analytical solutions.
  • Experience collecting, processing, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets to generate actionable insights.
  • Experience conducting scientific research and translating findings into practical modeling applications.
  • Ability to communicate technical information clearly through reports, documentation, presentations, and stakeholder discussions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams while managing priorities and delivering high-quality work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with hurricane, tropical cyclone, or weather-related catastrophe modeling.
  • Experience using SQL to query, manage, and analyze relational datasets.
  • Experience with ArcGIS, QGIS, or other geospatial analysis tools.
  • Knowledge of climate change impacts on natural catastrophe risk.
  • Experience supporting model validation, data quality, or model governance activities.

Full job description

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

Lenox Advisors is a premier MassMutual agency supporting a network of financial professionals who provide insurance, investment, and financial planning solutions to clients nationwide. As part of NFP, an Aon company, we offer the resources of a large organization while maintaining the culture and agility of a high-performing agency. Our team is dedicated to delivering exceptional advisor support, effective supervision, and operational excellence that drive business growth and client confidence.

Position Summary & Overall Purpose:

Reporting directly to the General Agent, the Lead Agency Supervisory Officer works in close partnership with Compliance, Risk, and other MassMutual Home Office departments. This position delivers strategic direction and oversight of the agency's supervisory framework. It leads supervisory staff and holds accountability for the efficiency of the Agency's Supervisory Program encompassing governance, policy administration, regulatory readiness, and enterprise risk coordination. The role centers primarily on tasks that extend past individual client-account reviews.

Job Accountabilities:

Supervisory Governance and Oversight:

  • Implement and maintain the agency's supervisory framework, policies, procedures, and control environment.
  • Review significant supervisory matters, exceptions, trends, and emerging risks that require senior-level judgment or coordination.
  • Conduct regular branch and agent audits, including review of client files, transaction suitability, and sales practices.
  • Monitor and review agent activities to identify and address potential compliance risks.
  • Ensure timely and accurate reporting of incidents, blocking issues, and regulatory filings.
  • Assist with the onboarding and supervision of new agents and staff, ensuring accurate licensing and registration.
  • Collaborate with management on office registration in accordance with state and federal regulations.

Team Leadership and Regulatory Partnership:

  • Lead, develop, and support supervisory personnel through clear expectations, mentoring, workload prioritization, and performance accountability.
  • Serve as the senior point of contact for complex supervisory, compliance, and conduct matters involving blocking issues.
  • Work closely with MassMutual Home Office teams responsible for Compliance, Risk, and Legal issues.
  • Provide senior management with clear reporting on supervisory performance, risk themes, resource needs, and remediation progress.

Enterprise Initiatives and Organizational Preparedness:

  • Coordinate regulatory change management, policy implementation, licensing and registration controls, and supervisory readiness.
  • Sponsor training, communications, and change-management efforts that reinforce supervisory expectations across the organization.
  • Lead initiatives involving supervisory technology, data, recordkeeping, workflow development, process improvement, and risk mitigation.

Job Summary

Farmers Insurance is seeking an experienced, results-driven IT Project Manager III to join our Data & Analytics organization.

In this role, you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex technology projects that support business objectives. You will work closely with the IA and EA Distribution Data teams, which are responsible for extracting, transforming, and loading data used for analytics, data science, and reporting across agencies and business units.

You will manage project timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables while coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring alignment between business and IT stakeholders.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management expertise, technical aptitude, leadership capabilities, and excellent communication skills to deliver technology solutions in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead end-to-end planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of medium- to large-scale IT projects, including complex data and analytics initiatives.
  • Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocations, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including IT, Data & Analytics, business stakeholders, and external vendors.
  • Apply SAFe Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methodologies based on project requirements.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to ensure successful delivery.
  • Monitor project performance and provide regular status updates, reports, and presentations to management and key stakeholders.
  • Manage project financials, including budget tracking, cost estimates, vendor expenditures, and invoice approvals.
  • Coordinate supplier activities, evaluate work requests, and oversee work orders and vendor deliverables, as applicable.
  • Facilitate stakeholder communication, issue resolution, and decision-making across business and technology teams.
  • Establish and manage project acceptance criteria, coordinate acceptance testing, and ensure deliverables meet business and technical requirements.
  • Oversee project change management activities and maintain accurate project documentation.
  • Review and approve project deliverables, ensuring quality and alignment with business objectives.
  • Lead project closure activities, including final documentation and post-implementation reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project management processes and delivery effectiveness.
  • Perform additional project management responsibilities as assigned.

Education Requirements

Experience & Education

  • 4–6 years of professional experience in IT project management or technology project delivery.
  • Experience managing complex, cross-functional IT projects, including schedules, budgets, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating technical teams, business partners, and third-party vendors.
  • Experience supporting data, analytics, business intelligence, or enterprise technology initiatives is preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Technology Management, or a related field.
  • Master's degree or MBA preferred.
  • Background in Management Information Systems (MIS) or Computer Information Systems (CIS) is an advantage.
  • Fluent English is required.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of SAFe Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid project delivery methodologies.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for project tracking, reporting, and data analysis.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint for stakeholder presentations and management reporting.
  • Familiarity with Rally or similar Agile project management platforms.
  • Experience with Microsoft Project or comparable project scheduling tools.
  • Basic knowledge of Power BI for dashboards and performance reporting.
  • Foundational SQL knowledge and the ability to collaborate effectively with data-focused technical teams.
  • Understanding of project governance, risk management, financial tracking, and resource planning.

Core Competencies

  • Strong leadership and team coordination skills.
  • Excellent planning, organization, and prioritization abilities.
  • Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and complex project dependencies.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • High level of accountability, ownership, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively resolve challenges.
  • Adaptability and flexibility in a dynamic technology environment.
  • Business acumen and the ability to align technology initiatives with organizational objectives.

Job Summary

Agile Dev Team Member IV (Sr. QA Engineer) with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements. Defines and executes tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on experience. Based on business products, processes, and system knowledge, provides broad and deep thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems.

This role is responsible for establishing and executing comprehensive testing strategies, driving test planning and execution activities, and ensuring solutions meet business, functional, non-functional, and regulatory requirements. As a senior member you will lead quality engineering efforts across enterprise applications, APIs, integration and data platforms. Ensure complete traceability between business requirements, test cases, and test results. Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Owners, Business Systems Analysts, Vendor partners and Engineering teams to review and analyze business and functional requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, implement, and maintain enterprise quality assurance and testing strategies aligned to business objectives and delivery methodologies.
  • Drive testing strategy, planning, and execution activities throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop risk-based testing approaches that prioritize critical business functionality and system stability.
  • Lead quality planning activities across multiple initiatives and releases.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated testing solutions.
  • Execute API, functional, integration, regression, end-to-end (E2E), and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Ensure comprehensive test coverage based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.
  • Support release validation, defect analysis, and continuous testing practices.
  • Identify testing risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
  • Provide regular status reporting, defect analysis, and quality metrics to stakeholders.
  • Participate in PI planning, sprint planning and other agile ceremonies.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience developing and executing comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases to ensure coverage of business, functional, non-functional, and regulatory requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium and Playwright, including the design and maintenance of automated test suites.
  • Experience with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices using tools such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, or similar frameworks.
  • Strong background in API testing and automation using tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Swagger, with experience testing integrations. Exposure to MuleSoft-based integrations is preferred.
  • Experience performing a wide range of testing activities, including functional, integration, system, regression, end-to-end (E2E), and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Knowledge of test strategy development, risk-based testing methodologies, test planning, estimation, execution management, and defect lifecycle management.
  • Experience working with cloud-based applications and environments, preferably AWS, as well as source code repositories such as GitHub.
  • Familiarity with project lifecycle and test management tools (e.g., Jira, Rally, or similar) used to manage test plans, test cases, and testing activities.
  • Ability to perform SQL queries, database testing, and data validation activities.
  • Experience with root cause analysis, defect trend analysis, and quality metrics reporting.
  • Familiarity with test environment management, release validation processes, and continuous testing practices, including Shift-Left Testing approaches.
  • Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace and CloudWatch.
  • Ability to review business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications to develop comprehensive test coverage.
  • Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years of IT/Software Engineering experience.
  • 7+ years of Quality Engineering experience.
  • Experience in insurance or financial services environments.
  • AWS certifications.

Job Summary

Agile Dev Team Member IV (The Sr. Integration Engineer) is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise integration solutions for FNWL's integration platform, connecting multiple vendors, applications, and business systems.

This role partners with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Solution Architects, Vendor partners and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable integration solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in API development, MuleSoft, AWS, and cloud-based integration architectures. While this role is not responsible for defining enterprise architecture standards, it plays a critical role in ensuring solutions are designed and implemented in alignment with established architecture principles, security requirements, and integration governance standards. As Sr. Integration Engineer you will provide technical leadership, mentor other engineering team members, reviews solution designs, and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-performing integration capabilities that support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, deploy, and maintain enterprise integration solutions.
  • Build and support APIs, web services, and system integrations using MuleSoft and CloudHub.
  • Design, develop, and support event-driven integration solutions leveraging AWS Lambda, SNS, and SQS, utilizing Python to build scalable automation, orchestration, and data processing services, while implementing secure file exchange capabilities through AWS Transfer Family and related managed file transfer technologies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable integration architectures.
  • Develop secure and performant API solutions following best practices and standards.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and stakeholders throughout the SDLC.
  • Review and validate technical designs to ensure quality, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot and support production integration solutions.
  • Mentor junior developers and provide technical leadership.
  • Support DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in PI planning, sprint planning and other agile ceremonies.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of overall IT/Software Engineering experience.
  • 4+ years of Integration Engineering experience.
  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise integration solutions.
  • Strong API design and development experience, including RAML based design and governance.
  • Experience with MuleSoft and CloudHub.
  • Experience with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SNS, SQS and AWS file transfer.
  • Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace and CloudWatch with ability to use them to debug errors and for monitoring applications.
  • Hands-on experience utilizing Git for source control management, branching strategies, code promotion, and release management, with the ability to design, implement, and support CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, and related DevOps tools to automate build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
  • Experience working in Agile/SAFe environments.
  • Fluent English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years of IT/Software Engineering experience.
  • 7+ years of Integration Engineering experience.
  • Experience in insurance or financial services environments.
  • AWS and MuleSoft certifications.

Critical Technical Skills

4-6 Years of Experience

  • MuleSoft & CloudHub
  • AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, AWS File Transfer, API Gateway)
  • Spring Boot
  • Python

7+ Years of Experience

  • API Design

Advanced Skills

  • Secure API Design
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication
  • Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to support and enhance enterprise access management platforms that secure critical applications and digital services across the organization. This role will serve as a lead responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and supporting commercial IAM solutions while partnering with business and technology teams to deliver secure, scalable access management capabilities.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with web access management and identity platforms such as IBM Verify Identity Access, IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar enterprise IAM technologies. This individual will play a key role in product strategy, solution design, vendor management, application integrations, troubleshooting, testing, issue resolution, and mentoring team members.

The Allstate job title for this is role is Vended Application Lead Consultant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and guide the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of enterprise Identity and Access Management solutions, with a focus on vended access management platforms.

  • Develop technical and functional designs that address complex business requirements, application access needs, and security objectives.

  • Configure, develop within, and maintain IAM platforms that support authentication, authorization, single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access control capabilities.

  • Partner with business stakeholders, security teams, infrastructure teams, application owners, and vendor support teams to deliver secure access management solutions.

  • Contribute to product planning by creating, refining, and guiding user stories for complex features, including coaching team members who may be learning the platform or process.

  • Facilitate feature review sessions for complex business issues and requirements, document key decisions, and ensure alignment across business and technical teams.

  • Create functional designs using moderate technical skills to address complex business processes, product features, and application integration needs.

  • Support the planning, execution, and review of module, integration, and system testing for assigned features and product stories.

  • Manage issues, blockers, defects, and implementation risks through resolution for assigned features and product stories.

  • Review and validate new vendor release features, assess impact, and identify opportunities to improve platform capability and reliability.

  • Use vendor defect resolution processes, support tools, product documentation, and developer groups to troubleshoot issues and influence future product direction.

  • Evaluate proposed vendor software products and enhancements in alignment with strategic corporate direction, platform standards, and vendor roadmaps.

  • Provide knowledge and support for resolving technology issues across multiple business areas and application processes.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for access management processes, vended IAM platforms, and related application integrations.

  • Provide training, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to strengthen team capability and bench strength.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, process documentation, support procedures, and implementation guidance.

Essential Qualifications

  • 5 years or more of experience implementing, configuring, administering, or supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. (Or Equivalent)

  • Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise web access management or IAM platforms, such as IBM Verify Identity Access (IVIA), IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), IBM Verify Access Appliance or related earlier versions, Okta, ForgeRock, PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar vended access management tools. (Or Equivalent)

  • Experience configuring or developing within vendor software to support access management, application authentication, authorization, and secure application access.

  • Experience implementing and supporting single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access management solutions for enterprise applications.

  • Experience writing automation scripts to complete the integration mapping automation using scripting languages, such as JavaScript, Python, Groovy, YAML or PowerShell. (Or Equivalent)

  • Knowledge of common identity and access standards and protocols, including SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and federation concepts.

  • Experience gathering complex business requirements and translating them into functional and technical designs.

  • Experience supporting module testing, integration testing, issue resolution, and production troubleshooting for enterprise applications or platforms.

  • Ability to lead technical discussions, organize requirements or feature review sessions, and document resulting decisions.

  • Experience working with vendor support processes, product documentation, defect resolution procedures, or developer support groups.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify blockers, drive issue resolution, and support delivery of assigned product features.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder partnership skills.

  • Ability to mentor, coach, or train team members and share knowledge across technical and business teams.

  • Equivalent combinations of technical training, certifications, and relevant work experience will be considered.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large enterprise IAM or access management environments.

  • Experience with cloud-based identity platforms, SaaS application integrations, or hybrid identity environments.

  • Knowledge of directory services such as Active Directory, LDAP, or related identity stores.

  • Experience with API security, access gateways, reverse proxies, policy configuration, or application onboarding for access management platforms.

  • Familiarity with Identity Governance Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), adaptive authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), or related security technologies.

  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Product Engineering, or similar delivery environments.

  • Experience evaluating vendor roadmaps, testing new release features, and recommending platform enhancements.

  • Relevant identity, security, cloud, or vendor certifications.

  • Experience in creating technical documentation, operational procedures, training materials, or platform standards.

About this job

Lead Java engineer designing and building backend services for Allstate's next-generation operational claims platform. Role includes architecture decisions, microservices development, production ownership, and technical leadership on a strategic modernization initiative.

Good fit if you have 4+ years Java experience with Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, databases, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and Agile team experience.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. Job Description

In this role, you will help design, build, and deliver the next generation of operational claims systems supporting Allstate Dealer Services. This platform is a strategic investment in the future of the business, enabling more efficient operations, faster service delivery, improved customer experiences, and long-term cost optimization.

As a technical leader on the team, you will contribute to the architecture, development, and delivery of modern backend services and applications that support key business capabilities. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate complex operational needs into scalable, reliable, and maintainable technology solutions.

This role includes ownership of applications in production, driving engineering best practices, and helping shape the technical direction of a platform that will modernize how Dealer Services manages claims operations. Your work will directly contribute to reducing operational complexity, accelerating delivery of new capabilities, and improving outcomes for customers and the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting enterprise payment solutions.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including iteration planning, standups, and retrospectives, helping drive continuous improvement across the team.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions.
  • Contribute to the architecture, development, and operation of scalable microservices and distributed systems.
  • Apply engineering best practices including clean code principles, test-driven development, code reviews, and automated testing.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes that support reliable software delivery.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications in production environments.
  • Contribute to the codebase while ensuring adherence to coding standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices.

Essential Skills

  • 4+ years of software development experience using Java and J2EE technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring IoC, Spring Security, Spring AOP, and related Spring frameworks.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, including API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI), versioning, service discovery, testing, and microservice architectures.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles, software design patterns, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience with relational databases, including schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, and SQL development.
  • Experience with automated testing and Test Driven Development (TDD) using frameworks such as JUnit, Selenium, JBehave, or similar tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices using tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, SonarQube, Gradle, Maven, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized applications using Kubernetes, Docker, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing and supporting production services with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog or equivalent.
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or XP environments.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience building and operating high-volume, distributed systems with a focus on reliability, performance, and scalability.
  • Experience with messaging and event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar technologies.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, PCF, Azure, or equivalent cloud environments.
  • Experience with application security and quality tooling such as SonarQube, Fortify, Contrast, or similar products.
  • Exposure to modern front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, or Angular. While this role is primarily focused on backend engineering, the ability to collaborate across the full stack is a plus.

Experience

  • 5 or more years of experience (preferred)

The Strategy Manager will be responsible for assisting the Marketing Strategy team in the development and dissemination of our business strategies and operational priorities. This will require the individual to frame complex business challenges, apply rigorous analysis to evaluate alternatives, and communicate insights through clear, structured messaging. This role is ideal for an analytically minded strategist who is eager to grow into a trusted advisor by demonstrating the ability to break down complex problems, synthesize data into actionable insights, and build structured approaches that drive clarity and impact across the organization.

Monitor competitor actions, market trends, and industry benchmarks to provide an outside-in perspective that sharpens internal strategy

Develop a deep understanding of departmental and enterprise-level strategies to ensure all deliverables align with broader organizational goals

Identify emerging topics that anticipate leadership needs and spark forward-looking dialogue

Job.JobTitle: Florida Bodily Injury Litigation Claims Adjuster - Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Litigation Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

As a Litigation Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


The Customer Service Expert you will live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator you will use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator you will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver you will utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder you will protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+years of Florida Represented 3rd partyBodily Injury claim handling experience.
  • Experience managing severe, complex, and litigated Bodily Injury claims.
  • Knowledge of Florida tort reform.
  • Florida 6-20 All Lines Adjuster License (Property & Casualty).
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Remote Home-Based Work:

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.

  • Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm EST.

When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • A home office a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-on Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriter / Account Executive Officer - Inland Marine
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Underwriter, Underwriting, Insurance Account Executive
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$112,000.00 - $184,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Inland Marine provides protection for business properties that are mobile in nature or require unique valuation. Coverages extend to properties that are owned or in a business's care related to construction, transportation, fine art, and renewable energy. The Account Executive Officer (AEO), Inland Marine will partner with agents and brokers to provide coverage for new and renewal business based on customers' needs. This role is seen as a technical resource. As an AEO, you are decisive, detail-oriented, and know how to build relationships internally and externally to drive results. Your ability to independently assess complex risk and sell our products in challenging markets will contribute to the profitability and success of Travelers.

What Will You Do?

  • Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business.
  • Underwrite and skillfully negotiate complex customer accounts to minimize risk and maximize profitability.
  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to create sales plans and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Foster and maintain relationships with external partners by regularly meeting in person with agents and brokers to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to such meetings.
  • Identify and capture new business opportunities using consultative marketing and sales skills.
  • Independently develop and execute agency sales plans and frequently partner with your Managing Director (MD) to develop region/group sales plans.
  • May assist in the training and mentoring of less experienced Account Executives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Six to eight years of relevant underwriting experience with experience in inland marine.
  • Deep knowledge of inland marine products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
  • Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to proactively identify underwriting, marketing, or financial challenges and analyze available information to make timely decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to successfully negotiate in difficult situations with agents and brokers.
  • CPCU designation.

What is a Must Have?

  • Four years of underwriting, claim, operations, risk assessment, actuarial, sales, product, or finance experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

$112,000.00 - $184,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to handle a caseload of predominantly low to moderate complexity and deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a caseload of predominantly low to moderate complexity, your responsibilities will include:
  • Develop and apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide advice and training to Claim partners and clients.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 3+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Experience independently handling cases from inception through trial/hearing & appeal.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to present information on litigated matters to diverse audiences
  • Skilled in fostering collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service
  • Demonstrates persuasive legal writing skills and oral advocacy skills.
  • Strong legal research skills & ability to utilize technology.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency & responsiveness.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses strong negotiation skills.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 2 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job.JobTitle: Sr. Executive Assistant I - Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY

About this job

Senior Executive Assistant role supporting executives at Liberty Mutual Investments in New York. Manages calendars, coordinates travel, prepares meeting materials, and handles communications to maximize executive productivity.

Good fit if you have 6 to 8 years of progressive administrative experience, strong Microsoft Office skills, and can handle confidential information with tact and discretion.

Full job description


Description

The Company

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) andis responsible forpowering Libertys strategy amid profoundchangein global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies,LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises.Weoffer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future.#LMI #LI-LMI

Job Summary:

Provides administrative support for executives while exercising confidentiality, tact, and diplomacy. Manages executive calendars, prepares materials for meetings, triages communications, coordinates and optimizes executive travel plans, and helps to keep executives focused and on schedule. Essence of the role is to enable executives supported to be more productive with their time and to work as efficiently and effectively as possible. This level makes decisions with minimal direction, recommendations are typically accepted by executives, and is able to quickly adapt to changing priorities. In addition, there is a high degree of usage for executive assistant specific support. #LMI #LI-LMI

Responsibilities:

  • Identifies the preferred method of support for assigned executives and appropriately accommodates working style. Partners with executives to help them be more efficient and effective with their time, consistently maintaining strong communication.
  • Manages executive calendars. Acts as a gatekeeper to include prioritization of meetings and resolving scheduling conflicts. Keeps executives informed of changes and helps to keep them on schedule.
  • Triages and responds to various forms of communications based on executive needs and preferences. Coordinates responses to requests for information, surveys, etc.
  • Assists executives with preparing for meetings, to include preparing materials, setting up agendas, obtaining materials in advance, and distributing materials. May attend meetings on the executives behalf and liaise with external partners.
  • Prepares, updates, and organizes information (using PowerPoint, Excel, Word, etc.) for inclusion in huddle boards, reports, correspondence, presentations, budgets, etc. Edits documents for accuracy, format, and arrangement of material.
  • Optimizes travel arrangements (transportation, accommodations, agenda) based on executive travel needs and preferences. Manages complex itineraries, to include any changes. Processes related expenses.
  • Coordinates/assists with managing team meetings (staff meetings, town halls, quarterly on-sites/off-sites, team gatherings, etc.) whether virtual or in-person. Assists with event planning.
  • Assists in keeping executives and their teams well organized, to include online retrieval and archiving on collaboration platforms such as MS Teams and SharePoint, as well as supporting the Companys records retention schedule.
  • Learns and keeps informed of new tools and technologies to further executive productivity. Identifies and communicates useful functionality and assists with troubleshooting.
  • Assists with process and/or program management such as maintaining distribution lists, coordinating nominations, distributing updates, administering surveys, conducting research, obtaining resources, preparing documents, etc.
Qualifications
  • Solid knowledge of administrative procedures, software applications (such as Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Adobe Acrobat, etc.) records management systems, and other business procedures and terminology.
  • Excellent organizational skills, time management skills and attention to detail, to include anticipating needs, being resourceful and proactive.
  • Displays high degree of professionalism in order to maintain confidential information with discretion, deal with people tactfully, and help establish strong relationships and positive communication.
  • Strong ability to read complex settings and respond to challenging people and/or circumstances with diplomacy and tact.
  • Competencies typically acquired through an associate`s degree (or equivalent) and 6 to 8 years of relevant and progressively more responsible administrative experience, to include prior experience providing support at the management level.

Employees may apply for a new role after completing 12 months of employment in their current position.

About this job

Associate Attorney position handling moderately complex civil litigation and workers' compensation matters for Liberty Mutual and policyholders. Role is primarily remote in Texas with required in-person appearances, includes 20 days flexible time off annually and 401(k) matching.

Good fit if you have a Texas bar license, 5+ years insurance law experience, and strong litigation and legal writing skills.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of Texas except for required appearances.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Texasand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • Minimum 5 years experience in insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

Job.JobTitle: Director, Engineering - Property & Specialty (P&S) Delivery - USRM Tech
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Boston, MA
  • Experience: 10+ years

About this job

Director leading a ~150-person engineering team delivering Property & Specialty insurance products at Liberty Mutual in Boston. Role combines strategic technology leadership with hands-on involvement in AI-driven product delivery transformation and speed-to-market improvements.

Good fit if you have 10+ years software engineering experience, 5+ years in leadership, and preferably Property & Casualty insurance background.

Full job description


Description

USRM Technology is seeking a passionate, transformational Director, Engineering to lead the Property & Specialty (P&S) Delivery portfolio. This organization directly drives the design and build of product capabilities to deliver on aggressive P&S Profit and Growth targets. As Director, you will lead a group of ~150 FTE and contractors, and will bring partners together across domains to launch, roll out, and enhance our products.

You will partner closely with business stakeholders to further accelerate our ambition to grow Property & Specialty while maintaining target profitability. Central to that ambition is to pair lead lines with strong Specialty lines. Your teams will build and deliver the capabilities that make that strategy real for our customers and agents.

You will also play a key role transforming how we deliver. We are re-imagining our product delivery model to materially increase our speed to market for product launches and rollouts. You will be a driving force for AI in our delivery, from spec-driven development to agentic coding, and will build the delivery engine of the future.

The successful candidate will combine strategic business leadership with engineering excellence, influence investment decisions, and deliver lasting business value.

About the role:

  • Lead: Serve as a strategic technology leader, coach, and mentor for a high-performing engineering team. Attract and build talent and create an environment where teams can deliver with clarity, accountability, and urgency.
  • Strategize: Define and advance the technology strategy, build cross-functional partnerships across domains, and drive operational excellence by optimizing processes and delivery practices to accelerate speed-to-market while maintaining the high quality. Translate business priorities, user expectations, and industry trends into technology strategies that enable growth, profitability, both in the short and in the long term.
  • Analyze, Decide, and Execute: Use data-driven insights, business cases, engineering metrics, operational health, and risk indicators to make informed portfolio decisions, prioritization, and drive execution. Ensure teams deliver measurable outcomes, modernize critical platforms, improve resiliency and speed to market.
  • Collaborate: Build trusted partnerships across USRM Technology, Personal Lines Product, Service, Claims, Billing, Operations, Architecture, and peer portfolio teams to align priorities, remove barriers, manage dependencies, and deliver end-to-end solutions. Balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while ensuring technology decisions remain aligned to business strategy and long-term architectural direction.
  • Transform: Support the core Frontier team in shaping and advancing USRMs multiyear transformational journey to simplify and modernize our product offering, policy capabilities, technology landscape, and ways of working.
  • External support: Develop and maintain a network of industry contacts and vendor relationships. Uses insights and contacts to strategically augment our teams to deliver on outcomes with flexibility.
  • Present and Influence: Communicate frequently with senior leaders, executives, peers, and cross-functional stakeholders to build alignment around portfolio vision, strategy, investment decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes. Bring clarity to complex topics and influence decisions across a broad and senior stakeholder group.
  • AI Fluency: Actively uses AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and scale of work; can point to concrete workflows where AI adds value; critically evaluates and validates AI-generated output; and applies AI responsibly, protecting confidential and customer data.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in technical or business discipline or related experience; Master's Degree preferred.
  • Generally, more than 10 years related experience with 5 years in leadership role.
  • Proven experience leading and running a large-scale software engineering delivery engine of equivalent scale across distributed, multi-domain teams.
  • Property & Casualty (P&C) or Specialty insurance experience highly preferred.
  • In-depth knowledge of IT concepts, strategies and methodologies and their application to business opportunities. In-depth knowledge of business operations, objectives and strategies.
  • In-depth knowledge of project planning methodologies and tools and IT standards and guidelines.
  • Advanced knowledge of management concepts, practices and techniques. Ability to promote a team environment consisting of several teams.
  • Highly developed negotiation, facilitation and consensus building skills.
  • Highly developed oral and written communication skills; strong presentation skills.

Description

USRM Technology is seeking a passionate, transformational Director, Engineering to lead the Property & Specialty (P&S) Delivery portfolio. This organization directly drives the design and build of product capabilities to deliver on aggressive P&S Profit and Growth targets. As Director, you will lead a group of ~150 FTE and contractors, and will bring partners together across domains to launch, roll out, and enhance our products.

The successful candidate will combine strategic business leadership with engineering excellence, influence investment decisions, and deliver lasting business value.

  • Lead: Serve as a strategic technology leader, coach, and mentor for a high-performing engineering team. Attract and build talent and create an environment where teams can deliver with clarity, accountability, and urgency.

Translate business priorities, user expectations, and industry trends into technology strategies that enable growth, profitability, both in the short and in the long term.

About this job

Provide financial reporting, planning, and analysis for Energy, Public Entity, and Inland Marine underwriting teams at Liberty Mutual in Boston. Role involves variance analysis, data stewardship, and strategic recommendations to leadership.

Full job description


Description

As a Finance & Accounting Analyst at Liberty Mutual, you will be a key strategic partner to our innovative and growing Energy, Public Entity and Inland Marine underwriting teams. This role is central to driving business performance through robust financial reporting, planning, and analytics.

You will be responsible for the full scope of financial and operational reporting, planning, and forecasting. In this position, you will manage complex financial analysis reports and projects, leveraging strong data stewardship and analytics to provide strategic recommendations to the leadership of these market-facing teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and enhance critical financial and operational reports, analyses, plans, and forecasts in accordance with prescribed procedures.
  • Act as a data steward for the teams, obtaining required data for analyses from appropriate internal (e.g., general ledger, loss warehouse) or external sources in a timely, accurate, and efficient manner.
  • Perform in-depth variance analyses (e.g., plan vs. actual, prior year, multi-year trends) and identify significant items requiring further investigation to support our underwriting partners.
  • Ensure the timeliness, accuracy, and completeness of all reports and analyses by maintaining full documentation of recurring job duties, data sources, and assumptions.
  • Partner with market-facing Energy, Public Entity and Inland Marine underwriting teams, providing financial insights that directly support their strategy and goals.
  • Identify opportunities for efficiencies and improvements to processes, controls, and technology systems related to the functions being performed.
  • Perform follow-up investigations on financial or operational variances and suggestresolutions.

This position can be filled as either a Senior Financial Analyst or a Lead Financial Analyst, depending on experience. The posted description and salary range are for the Lead Financial Analyst.

The selected candidate should live within 50 miles of the Boston office and be able to come into the office two times/week. This policy is subject to change.
