Position Summary

The Defined Contribution Leader is responsible for guiding Wealthspire's National Defined Contribution administration practice. This role offers strategic direction, operational management, talent growth, exceptional service delivery, and financial responsibility for all DC plan administration activities throughout the organization.

The leader will drive the integration of Defined Contribution administration teams into a consistent national service delivery model, in partnership with Platform Operations and other TPA leaders. The individual will lead teams coordinating retirement plans ranging from solo and safe harbor plans to highly customized and complex employer-sponsored retirement programs. The position also serves as a key member on the TPA leadership team who are responsible for accomplishing the organization's growth, technology, and operational excellence strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Direct the national Defined Contribution practice and develop a consistent operating model across all offices.
  • Develop and implement critical initiatives that boost service quality, scalability, profitability, and client happiness within the Defined Contribution practice.
  • Partner with executive leadership to align departmental objectives with overall TPA business goals.
  • Drive adoption of organizational values, accountability standards, and performance expectations.
  • Support growth initiatives through operational preparedness, client retention, and business development partnership within the Defined Contribution practice.

Operational Excellence

  • Establish and maintain standardized service delivery processes across all DC administration teams.
  • Drive adoption and continuous improvement of DC administration workflows in partnership with Platform Operations, bringing to bear Stax.AI and other enterprise technology platforms.
  • Ensure uniform management of all DC plan types and service offerings.
  • Monitor service quality, turnaround times, compliance standards, and client experience metrics.

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop a geographically dispersed team of managers, administrators, and specialists.
  • Build clear career paths, succession plans, and professional development opportunities.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, trust, continuous learning, and transparency.
  • Mentor leaders to effectively manage performance, employee engagement, and career growth.

Financial & Business Management

  • Maintain responsibility for departmental efficiency, resource utilization, and profitability.
  • Find opportunities to improve operating leverage and service efficiency.
  • Partner with Platform Operations and Finance to apply enterprise important metrics, dashboards, forecasting, and capacity models to manage the DC practice.
  • Contribute to annual budgeting and long-term planning activities.

Enterprise & Client Partnership

  • Build positive relationships across Platform Operations, Defined Benefit, Advisory, Special Projects, Finance, and other functions to deliver a coordinated and consistent client experience.
  • Support complex client needs and central initiatives by bringing together the appropriate expertise, resources, and operational capabilities across the organization.
  • Partner with Business Development and key external relationships to strengthen client retention, support growth opportunities, and improve Wealthspire's position in the retirement-plan marketplace.

Qualifications

Required

  • Over 10 years of experience in managing retirement plans.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing managers and professional service teams.
  • Deep expertise in qualified defined contribution plans, including 401(k), profit sharing, safe harbor, and cash balance/defined contribution combinations.
  • Strong understanding of ERISA, IRC qualification requirements, compliance testing, plan operations, and fiduciary responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success leading operational transformation, process improvement, and organizational change.
  • Experience managing workforce planning, service delivery, and operational performance metrics.

Preferred

  • ASPPA credentials (QKA, QPA, QKC, CPC, QKA, TGPC, etc.).
  • Experience managing retirement plan administration operations across multiple offices or on a national scale.
  • Experience with workflow platforms such as Stax.ai, PensionPro, ASC, or similar technologies.

Posting Description

Who We Are:

Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services—empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence.

With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first—our clients, our colleagues, and our communities.

For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Plan Administrator with the technical expertise to support a variety of complex retirement plan administration projects. While this individual will have the knowledge and experience to provide full plan administration, their expertise will be leveraged by the Special Projects team to provide technical research, analysis, and guidance to internal and external stakeholders.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping clients and prospective clients navigate complex compliance challenges, resolve difficult plan issues, and protect the long-term health of their retirement plans.

The ideal candidate combines deep ERISA and plan administration expertise with the relationship-building skills needed to guide clients confidently through an increasingly complex regulatory landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Plan Administration & Compliance

  • Provide various technical compliance tasks for a multitude of clients including projects such as DB/DC/H&W 5500 preparation and corrective calculations
  • Perform non-discrimination and compliance testing, including ADP/ACP, 410(b) coverage, top-heavy, 415 annual addition limit, 401(a)(4) cross-testing and other necessary measurements
  • Calculate and allocate employer contributions
  • Assist clients with corrections through the various governmental programs
  • Reconcile payroll contributions and employee census to determine if prior activity aligns with prior instructions and determine current year plan eligibility
  • Reconcile trust assets and contributions, interpreting trust financial statements to resolve discrepancies
  • Interpret plan document provisions to ensure accurate, compliant administration
  • Ensure clients adhere to government filing and regulatory requirements

Government Filings & Regulatory Support

  • Complete, review, and provide audit support for Forms 5500, 5330, 8955-SSA, 1099-R, and related schedules
  • Review and validate work completed by other plan administrators and support staff to ensure accuracy prior to delivery
  • Maintain and expand ERISA compliance and software knowledge in step with evolving regulations and our evolving technology platform capabilities

Client & Relationship Management

  • Develop effective working relationships with clients, internal teams, external advisors, recordkeepers, and auditors supporting shared client relationships
  • Identify and present opportunities for new business development

Analysis & Communication

  • Review, analyze, and summarize plan data in clear, succinct written communication to support advisors, Consultants, and fellow Plan Administrators
  • Serve as a technical resource for research and plan analysis projects for internal and external clients

Professional Development

  • Comply with continuing education requirements and pursue ongoing credentialing
  • Participate in professional organizations and independent study to stay current on ERISA and industry developments
  • Integrate new knowledge and skills into daily work, sharing insights with colleagues as appropriate

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in business administration, business analytics, mathematical economics, finance, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

High school diploma required.

Experience

1-3 years of directly related experience in retirement plan administration and consulting.

Credentialing (one or more preferred)

  • ASPPA: Qualified 401(k) Administrator (QKA), Qualified Plan Specialist (QKS), Qualified 401(k) Consultant (QKC), and/or Qualified Pension Administrator (QPA)
  • NIPA: Accredited 401(k) Specialist (AKS), Accredited Pension Administrator (APA), and/or Accredited Pension Representative (APR)
  • IRS Enrolled Retirement Plan Agent (ERPA)
  • NAPA: Certified Plan Fiduciary Advisor (CPFA) and/or Qualified Plan Financial Consultant (QPFC)

Technical Skills

Experience with Stax.ai, FT William, and PensionPro strongly preferred; familiarity with ASC a plus. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams. High degree of technical and legal knowledge, including familiarity with the Internal Revenue Code and ERISA as they apply to qualified plans.

Core Competencies

  • Communication – effective oral, written, and interpersonal skills; communicates clearly and interactively with team members and support staff
  • Judgment & problem-solving – proven organizational and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on plan design and compliance matters
  • Client service – demonstrated ability to deliver quality customer service while managing multiple tasks with a high degree of accuracy
  • Ownership – a sense of urgency and commitment to timely, high-quality project completion, balanced with attention to detail and confidentiality
  • Collaboration – ability to work independently and within a team, bringing a positive, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset

What We Offer:

Wealthspire Advisors is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others.

The base salary range for this position is $72,000 – $88,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

About this job

Business Analyst for Berkley Medical Management Solutions, a workers' compensation managed care company. Acts as liaison between business, operations, and IT to document requirements, analyze solutions, and support process improvements for medical bill review and case management systems.

Good fit if you have 2-4 years of business analyst experience and background in workers' compensation, medical billing, or managed care.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley Medical Management Solutions (BMMS) provides a different kind of managed-care service for W.R. Berkley Corporation. We believe focusing on an injured worker's successful and speedy return to work is good for people and good for Berkley's insurance operating units. BMMS was first started in 2014 by reimagining the relationship between medical need and technology to deliver the best outcome for injured workers and Berkley's operating units. Our goal was clear: combine solid clinical practices, proven return-to-work strategies and robust software into one system for seamless management of workers' compensation cases.

To get it right, we started with a flexible technology platform that allowed for impressive customization without sacrificing the ability for expansion and continued innovation. We deploy integrated systems to give W.R. Berkley Companies recommendations and professional services for managing each individual case in an efficient and appropriate manner. The power of our technology takes medical bill-review services and clinical advisory services to a new level. Our unique marriage of technology, software platforms, data analytics and professional services ensures we provide Berkley's operating units with reliable results, and reduced time and expenses associated with case management.

Responsibilities

As a Business Analyst, you'll play a critical role in helping BMMS reach its goals by carrying-out the Business Analyst “Key Functions” outlined below. The Business Analyst is multi-faceted and acts as a liaison between business, operations, other business analysts, and IT resources internal to BMMS and external with BMMS' vendors and Berkley sister companies. The Business Analyst's objective is to perform the business analysis function to help BMMS achieve strategic, project based, and department level success wherever a business analysis resource is deemed appropriate and is deployed, and help educate fellow team members on Active Listening, Balanced Approach, Boldness, Critical Thinking, Integrity, and Quality Decision Making.

  • Determine business analysis work that will be required during the planning phase of projects and process improvement efforts.
  • Elicit and document business requirements for projects, including core product build & enhancements and implementations; business process workflows, service management issues; &/or identified opportunities for improvement. Requirements may include but are not limited to those that result in business and IT-based solutions including coding, configuration, EDI, reporting, process workflow, etc. These may impact BMMS only or BMMS' vendors &/or Berkley sister company systems/programs. Elicitation activities include leading large groups of diverse people within all levels of the organizations through detailed requirements gathering sessions.
  • Analyze business requirements to verify clarity and completeness with business owners; validate every requirement gathered belongs within the scope of project or assignment by comparing it to the stated business need & objective; confirm & document assumptions and constraints.
  • Analyze proposed solutions with the business owner and impacted IT &/or operational areas for clarity and completeness. Solutions may include changes or enhancements to systems/programs &/or operational workflows and may have impacts only internal to BMMS, to BMMS' vendors, &/or to Berkley sister companies.
  • Document high-level business requirements and/or detailed IT specifications using department-approved templates/formats (where applicable) to produce requirements artifacts that may include: Business Requirements Documents (“BRDs”), Policy & Procedure documents (“P&Ps”), IT Functional Specifications/User Stories, Report Specifications, Workflow Documents (Visios).
  • Contribute to test design, planning, scenario-building, and validation.
  • For service management issues: Identify root cause(s); lead resolution for specific issues; document issue, progress, and resolution clearly/completely in accordance with department standards; follow-up on root cause and lead root cause resolution with necessary business owner escalations & approvals.
  • Assist department in fulfilling goals and objectives by carrying-out other duties as assigned.
  • Mentor Associate Business Analysts.
  • Identify areas for improvement in department processes and raise recommendations to management.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2-4 years of experience in a business analyst role with similar functions demonstrating increasing level of responsibility over time required.
  • Workers' compensation, medical billing, or managed care service industry experience strongly desired.
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple complex assignments at one time employing multiple of the position's essential functions independently.
  • Experience managing requirements within the scope of a project required.
  • Experience with writing detailed IT specifications strongly desired.
  • Ability to operate computers including working knowledge of major Microsoft Office applications including MS Word; Excel; Power Point; Visio.

Education Requirement

  • Bachelor's Degree preferred, Certificate in Business Analysis a plus.

Backed by the strength of a Fortune 500 company, we operate with the agility of a forward-thinking team and the stability of an established enterprise. We believe in empowering individuals to share ideas, challenge norms, and help shape the future of insurance. If you're eager to gain hands-on experience in a company that values fresh perspectives and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

www.berkleyheathcare.com

Responsibilities

The Senior Underwriter is responsible for submission generation, underwriting and policy issuance of Directors and Officers Liability, Employment Practices Liability, Fiduciary Liability, Fidelity/Crime for large and complex private commercial and not-for-profit healthcare organizations. The underwriting position will be part of the Berkley Healthcare Financial Lines division of Berkley Healthcare. While our main offices are in West Hartford, CT, Chicago, IL and Chesterfield, MO we will consider candidates nationwide. The senior underwriter will be responsible for handling new and renewal, primary and excess business throughout the placement process from underwriting submission receipt to policy issuance.

Responsibilities

The Senior Information Security Engineer is responsible for leading the engineering and enhancement of the Microsoft Sentinel SIEM platform, designing and supporting security data ingestion and automation, implementing Azure and cloud security controls, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to strengthen the organization's security posture.

This role will:

  • Lead the engineering, deployment, administration, and continuous enhancement of Microsoft Sentinel as the organization's enterprise SIEM platform, including workspace architecture, RBAC, retention management, and ingestion cost optimization.

    • Design, implement, and maintain Azure security controls and security architecture standards, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, Entra ID, Conditional Access, Key Vault, network security controls, and secure landing zone architectures.

    • Lead and mentor junior security engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and career development support.
    • Provide Person in Charge (PIC) coverage on a rotational basis, serving as the senior escalation point for complex security incidents and operational decisions.
    • Collaborate closely with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, DevOps, and IT teams to design, implement, and continuously improve security controls, monitoring capabilities, automation solutions, and data protection measures across the enterprise.

Job Description

Early Careers Launch - Broking

Commercial Risk - NPG Trucking

Launch Your Career in Broking

Aon is looking for soon-to-be graduates and recent graduates to join our Early Careers Launch Development Program as Brokers, with opportunities across Commercial Risk and Reinsurance. You do not need to be an insurance expert on day one. Through our Launch Program and on-the-job learning, you will learn how brokers help clients understand risk, navigate insurance and reinsurance markets, and make better decisions, that support resilience and growth.

Location: Little Rock, Arkansas

As a Broker, you will build the skills, confidence and market knowledge needed to translate complex risk exposures into structured insurance programs and serve as a credible intermediary between clients and insurers.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What is Commercial Risk

Commercial Risk Aon's Commercial Risk team helps organizations around the world identify, understand, and manage the risks that could impact their people, assets, and performance. We partner with clients across industries to design and deliver innovative risk and insurance solutions - from property and casualty to cyber and specialty risks - using data, analytics, and deep market insight to help them make better decisions and protect their business.

What You Will Do

As a Broker, you will build hands-on broking experience while developing an understanding of how risk, markets, clients and strategy come together to create value for clients. Technology, including AI, Aon's risk analyzers and global delivery teams increasingly support routine execution, allowing Brokers to focus earlier on commercial judgment, market strategy and client value.

Analyze Risk and Build Market Insight

  • Assess risk exposures using data, analytics and market intelligence while learning to validate results across coverage lines.
  • Conduct market analysis to benchmark pricing, identify coverage gaps and support effective program recommendations.

Support Market Strategy and Placements

  • Help prepare market submissions, renewal materials, placement documentation and client deliverables.
  • Engage insurers and underwriters to secure competitive pricing and terms, applying market knowledge where AI-suggested terms need tailoring.
  • Build experience coordinating renewals, reviewing contracts and maintaining accurate documentation for smaller placements and account activity.

Build Client Relationships and Advisory Skills

  • Participate in client meetings, presentations and follow-up materials with growing confidence.
  • Leverage technology, data analytics, and market insights to translate complex risk information into clear, actionable recommendations that help clients make informed business decisions.
  • Build trust as a credible point of contact while developing client and market relationships.

Coordinate Projects and Improve How Work Gets Done

  • Support placement workflows across broking, account management, analytics, operations, specialist teams and global delivery partners.
  • Review documents and client materials for accuracy, consistency and quality before they are used with markets or clients.
  • Identify opportunities to improve broking processes and support efficient client delivery.

Qualifications 

  • College Seniors graduating between Spring 2026 to Spring 2027 with a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0
  • Please Note: For this role you must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

The Launch Development Program

Launch is a structured 10-month Early Career development program that combines meaningful work, business learning, professional development and relationship-building across Aon. The program helps you build a strong foundation for a long-term broking and advisory career through:

  • On-the-job learning with brokers, client teams, account managers and solution line specialists.
  • Business and professional development in Commercial Risk, Reinsurance, client service, communication, collaboration, problem solving and commercial awareness.
  • Exposure to data, analytics and technology that support risk assessment, market analysis, workflow coordination and client-ready recommendations.
  • Networking, mentorship and coaching opportunities to build relationships across Aon and develop your career path.

What Will Help You Succeed and Grow

We are looking for candidates who are curious, motivated and excited to learn. Through the Launch Program, you will continue developing the same skills and capabilities that support a successful broking and advisory career, including:

  • An interest in business, risk, insurance, reinsurance, analytics, finance, economics, client service or global markets.
  • A desire to pursue a career in Commercial Risk and/or Reinsurance - Broking.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with a range of stakeholders.
  • Analytical and critical thinking, problem-solving ability and attention to detail.
  • A collaborative mindset, alongside initiative, adaptability and a willingness to contribute as part of a team.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Confidence using technology and a willingness to learn new tools, internal AI platforms and technology-enabled ways of working.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues, clients and external partners.
  • Initiative and a commitment to continuous learning, growth and professional development.

Berkley Southeast Insurance Group (BSIG) is a member company of W. R. Berkley Corporation, a Fortune 500 Company, whose insurance company subsidiaries are rated A+(Superior) by A. M. Best Company. BSIG provides local underwriting, risk services, claim, marketing and audit services for agents and policyholders in Alabama, Georgia, Mississippi, South Carolina, North Carolina and Tennessee. We take a broad approach to underwriting for ‘best in class' businesses, primarily in: construction, light manufacturing, wholesale, distribution and business service industries.

Responsibilities

The Senior Claims Specialist is responsible for the quality handling, investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of commercial general liability claims, ranging from fast-track to litigated matters. This position manages claims involving coverage issues, minor to severe injuries and property damage, contractual liability exposures, and other moderately complex to complex matters requiring specialized claim handling. The role is expected to provide exceptional customer service while achieving timely resolution and maintaining effective expense management.

Key functions include but are not limited to the following:

  • Review new losses and appropriately manage claims through coverage analysis, investigation, damages evaluation, reserving and resolution on non-litigated casualty claims.
  • Manage bodily injury claims, auto material damage claims and total loss claims process. Includes vehicle appraisal procedures, diminished value, vendor networks, subrogation demands, salvage procedures and heavy equipment appraisals.
  • Establish timely and accurate claim and expense reserves.
  • Negotiate and convey claim settlements within authority limits.
  • Participate in regional round table meetings as needed.
  • Write Reservation of Rights and Coverage Denial letters and other complex correspondence.
  • Maintain an effective dairy system and document claim file activities in accordance with established procedures.
  • Manage file inventory to ensure timely resolution of cases.
  • Handle files in compliance with state regulations.
  • Provide excellent customer service to meet the needs of the insured, agent and all other internal and external customers.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Remote work may be considered for highly qualified candidates who do not reside within commuting distance of a Berkley Southeast office in Lawrenceville, GA, Charlotte NC, Nashville, TN, Birmingham, AL or Meridian, MS.

In addition, remote consideration will also be given to candidates who reside in Louisiana, Florida, Virgina, Arkansas and Kentucky

Qualifications

  • Min of 5 years of casualty claim experience preferred
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational and presentation skills
  • Computer proficiency, working knowledge of Microsoft Office products
  • Knowledge of tort and contract law and experience in auditing/reviewing casualty claim files
  • Independent adjusters' licenses for states of: AL, GA, MS, NC, SC & TN and/or ability to obtain licenses within 90 days of hire
  • The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Education

  • BA/BS degree preferred or equivalent work experience

Job Description

The Financial Operations & Integration Leader serves as the strategic finance and operations lead for Aon's Marketing & Communications (MarComm) and People Organization, acting as the primary liaison to Finance. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, this role leads a team responsible for financial planning, workforce investment governance, and oversight of events, project, and program expenditures.

The role combines people leadership, financial stewardship, and cross-functional partnership to drive operational excellence, align investments with business priorities, and ensure adherence to enterprise standards. The successful candidate develops talent, fosters accountability, and collaborates with senior leaders to deliver strategic initiatives and organizational objectives.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly manage a team of two colleagues, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, growth, and high performance.
  • Establish annual team goals and individual performance objectives aligned to MarComm, People Organization, and enterprise priorities.
  • Lead performance management activities, including goal setting, performance reviews, ongoing feedback, talent assessment, and recognition of colleague contributions.
  • Hold regular 1:1 meetings and quarterly 4x4 development conversations to support colleague growth, engagement, career progression, and development planning.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and stretch opportunities that build financial acumen, business partnership skills, operational discipline, and future leadership readiness.
  • Monitor workload distribution, clarify priorities, remove barriers, and ensure successful delivery of key planning, reporting, governance, and operational objectives.
  • Support succession planning and building capability by identifying development opportunities, strengthening team knowledge, and encouraging continuous learning.

Enterprise Integration & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a key integration point across enterprise stakeholders to ensure alignment on financial targets, strategic priorities, investments, operational activities, governance requirements, and execution plans.
  • Coordinate planning, workforce investments, vendor engagements, organizational changes, and new initiatives across a broad stakeholder network.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration to support organizational effectiveness, resource optimization, financial transparency, and successful execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Lead integration efforts for new programs, projects, technologies, and business processes, ensuring effective implementation, operational readiness, and clear ownership.
  • Partner with business leaders and enterprise stakeholders to identify process improvements, governance enhancements, and operational efficiencies.
  • Facilitate decision-making by aligning diverse stakeholder groups around common objectives, priorities, investment trade-offs, and execution timelines.
  • Support enterprise-wide initiatives, organizational transformations, and operating model changes by ensuring appropriate financial, operational, and governance structures are in place.

Strategic Financial Planning & Workforce Investment Governance

  • Lead the annual planning, budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes for the MarComm and People Organization functions.
  • Oversee governance and review of Salary, incentive and Benefits (SIB) talent investments and hire requests, ensuring alignment with business cases, organizational priorities, and approved plans.
  • Partner with functional leaders to evaluate workforce needs, investment impacts, financial trade-offs, and prioritization decisions.
  • Develop financial models, planning inputs, and operating reviews that support informed decision-making and resource allocation.

P&L Oversight, Variance Management & Financial Structures

  • Key liaison between MarComm and the People Org with the Finance function.
  • Partner with functional leaders to ensure visibility into P&L performance, including SIB and non-salary, incentive, and benefits variances (NSIB).
  • Provide analysis of actuals, forecasts, risks, opportunities, and year-end outlooks to strengthen transparency and accountability.
  • Own the governance and maintenance of cost-center structures, financial hierarchies, and organizational reporting frameworks.
  • Ensuring financial structures align with evolving functional structures, operating models, organizational redesigns, and new initiatives.
  • Oversee financial governance for projects, programs, vendor engagements, and operational expenditures, including budget management and investment prioritization.

How this opportunity is different

The ideal candidate is a strategic and collaborative people leader who combines strong coaching and talent development capabilities with financial and operational expertise in Marketing and HR costs. They create clarity, build trust, and develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, quarterly 4x4 development conversations, thoughtful coaching, and clear expectations.

This leader excels at connecting people, processes, financial structures, and business objectives. They are comfortable navigating complex, matrixed environments, influencing senior stakeholders, and aligning diverse groups around shared priorities. They bring discipline to planning, governance, financial transparency, and operational execution while enabling successful delivery of organizational priorities and strategic investments.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Significant experience in financial operations, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), workforce planning, business operations, or related finance leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated experience managing and developing colleagues, including performance reviews, goal setting, coaching, mentoring, and development planning.
  • Proven ability to partner with senior leaders in a complex, matrixed organization and translate financial insights into business actions.
  • Strong understanding of annual planning, forecasting, P&L management, variance analysis, cost-center governance, and organizational financial structures.
  • Experience supporting projects, programs, vendor engagements, organizational changes, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, influence, problem-solving, and operational execution skills.

Shape High-Dollar Stop Loss Claim Decisions That Matter

Are you an experienced Stop Loss Claims professional who thrives on analyzing complex medical claims, interpreting contract language, and making informed reimbursement decisions?

As a Stop Loss Claims Auditor (a.k.a. "Claims Analyst"), you'll join a highly respected team where your contribution will directly impact claim outcomes, customer experience, and business results. This role develops and manages agency partnerships and serves as the primary relationship between the agency and the company.
  • The position develops and successfully promotes and supports the available suite of Foremost products and services, including a portfolio of moderately complex accounts, within an assigned territory. This role is at the forefront of building premium growth through relationships with agents to ensure market share is built successfully.
  • This position is an individual contributor who receives moderate guidance and direction from management and field distribution partners while performing work with business unit and enterprise impacts.
  • The position is remote with required weekly field travel in Northern California (Bay Area, Stockton, Sacramento, San Jose, San Francisco) - candidate must within territory.

Essential Job Functions

  • Owns and manages assigned territory driving profitable growth to achieve financial and operational targets.
  • With moderate guidance from management and field distribution partners, assists in leading, developing, and executing territory tactical plan and agency management processes (example business planning, training, compensation) to support financial and operational targets, measure results, and pivot as necessary.
  • With coaching, builds and cultivates mutually beneficial agency partnerships in person with agency ownership, management, and frontline staff using a consultative sales framework.
  • Establishes position as a trusted advisor while delivering product, underwriting philosophy, appetite, and system training, to support retention and new business development to increase depth and maximize agency revenue.
  • With moderate guidance, creates, maintains, and executes high quality agency strategies and plans, including holding agents accountable, to achieve written premium, profit, and new business goals.
  • Coordinates plans with field distribution partners, including strategic and tactical components, to align with business strategies such as carrier consolidation (agency book consolidation), agency storefront expansion, and new product or program rollout support.
  • With coaching, drives and ensures quality of new business flow, appropriate mix of business, and overall risk management of both ind ividual agency books and overall assigned territory.
  • Provides appetite and target market clarity, identifies and addresses profit or quality of business concerns to ensure profitability across territory.
  • Strategically utilizes internal reporting and tools designed to support the Independent Agent channel including all Marketing and Development programs, business development tools and internal production/profitability data and analysis.

About this job

Manage non-complex medical-only workers' compensation claims, handling coverage verification, claim validity assessment, reserve establishment, and payment authorization. Remote position with CorVel, a national risk management solutions provider.

Good fit if you have 1+ year workers' compensation claim handling experience, hold an AZ Adjuster license, and possess strong communication skills.

Full job description

The Workers' Compensation Medical Only Claims Specialist manages non-complex and non-problematic, medical only claims under close supervision, supporting the goals of the Claims Department and of CorVel.

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Receives Workers' Compensation claims, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgement of the claim
  • Determines the validity and compensability of the claim
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within established reserving authority limits
  • Communicates claim status with the customer, claimant and client
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Assists other claims professionals with more complex or problematic claims as necessary
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Fast learner; develops knowledge and understanding of claims practice, relevant statutes, and medical terminology
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 1 year industry experience and claim handling
  • Workers' Compensation experience required
  • AZ Adjuster license required

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position for KY, preferably in the Georgetown/ Lexington, KY area.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluates patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney's visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker's injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Preferred to have national certification – CCM, COHN, CRRN, CDMS
  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of an Inside Property Adjuster, and what it take to do the job!

As an Inside Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve virtually inspecting damages, investigating coverage, preparing estimates, and settling claims promptly and accurately. You will be interacting with customers, contractors, and vendors through various software platforms such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. This role places a particular focus on water losses, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule:

During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:30pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm with rotational Saturday duty

  • Mondays and Fridays (remote)

  • Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays (in-office)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of previous customer service experience.

  • Excellent organization skills.

  • Ability to multi-task.

  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.

  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in an office and virtual work environment.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality and efficient claim resolutions.

  • Previous industry experience is highly desired.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign-on Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Representative, Insurance Sales, Insurance Agent
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $18.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time, includes weekends
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), tuition assistance

About this job

Sell Allstate insurance products to inbound leads via phone, chat, and SMS from home. Work involves consultative sales with warm leads, no cold calling, and compensation includes base pay plus uncapped performance incentives.

Good fit if you have at least one year of sales or customer service experience and can obtain a Property and Casualty Producer license

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance

  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $18.00 an hour
  • Schedule: Full-time, includes weekends
  • Location: Oklahoma City, OK
  • Education: High school diploma or GED
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), tuition assistance

About this job

Full-time remote insurance sales representative selling Allstate products via phone, chat, and SMS to warm leads. Base pay $18/hour plus uncapped performance incentives; total compensation averages $52,730-$76,480/year.

Good fit if you have at least one year of sales or customer service experience and can obtain a Personal Lines or Property and Casualty Producer license.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.
  • Eligible licensed external candidates who complete licensing prior to hire or bring an active Property & Casualty or Personal Lines license before start date may be eligible for a bonus.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.

Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Gardendale, AL
  • Experience: 2+ years

About this job

Sell auto, home, and specialty insurance to local customers in person and by phone for National General/Allstate. Generate new business, cross-sell existing customers, and build community relationships to drive growth.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of experience and can obtain P&C licensing within 90 days, or already hold it.

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Day 1 Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 0 2 years of experience
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company.

Active Learning, Adaptability, Business Integrity, Customer Service, Persuasion, Sales, Social Orientation, Time Management

Job Description

The Cybersecurity Strategic Planning Expert helps Allstate Cybersecurity & Controls (ACC) leaders turn complex cybersecurity risks, strategies, performance information, and technical initiatives into clear decisions, aligned action, and measurable outcomes. As part of the ACC Strategy team, this role develops compelling narratives and executive-ready communications for the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), ACC leadership, senior executives, the Board, and the Audit Committee. Operating as a trusted advisor in an evolving and often ambiguous environment, the role brings structure to complex questions, synthesizes technical and business perspectives, and frames priorities, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations in concise, non-technical language. Success is reflected in stronger executive decision-making, consistent strategic narratives, greater visibility into cybersecurity posture and outcomes, clear accountability, and coordinated progress on the highest-priority risks.

Key Responsibilities


  • Develop clear, compelling cybersecurity narratives for the CISO, senior executives, Board, and Audit Committee.
  • Translate complex cybersecurity risks, strategies, metrics, and technical initiatives into concise, non-technical, decision-ready communications.
  • Create executive-level presentations and communications, including briefings, talking points, strategic reports, leadership updates, and Board materials.
  • Support the development and governance of the Allstate Cybersecurity & Controls (ACC) strategy, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities, business strategy, and the evolving cybersecurity risk environment.
  • Monitor cybersecurity threats, regulatory developments, technology trends, and business changes to identify strategic implications and emerging priorities.
  • Coordinate cross-functional strategic governance, including key commitments, portfolio outcomes, dependencies, risks, metrics, and leadership decisions.
  • Measure and communicate strategic progress and cybersecurity outcomes through meaningful metrics, trends, gaps, and indicators of risk reduction.
  • Analyze complex and ambiguous business and cybersecurity challenges, combining quantitative and qualitative information to develop practical recommendations.
  • Frame strategic options, trade-offs, and recommendations and facilitate leadership discussions around prioritization, sequencing, and risk-informed decision-making.
  • Build alignment across cybersecurity and enterprise partners, including Technology, Enterprise Risk, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Communications, while strengthening governance practices and team standards.

Required Education and Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in strategy, executive communications, strategic planning, management consulting, business analysis, portfolio governance, risk, technology, financial services, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated experience developing executive presentations, strategic narratives, briefing materials, or Board-facing content and synthesizing complex technical and business information into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Experience supporting strategy development, governance, metrics, portfolio reporting, facilitation, cross-functional decision-making, or senior executive communications.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, technology, risk, consulting, financial services, insurance, or another complex regulated environment preferred.
  • Must be willing and able to travel into our Chicago, Illinois office on an as needed basis.

About this job

Design, build, and own scalable data pipelines and products using Microsoft Fabric and modern data engineering practices. Partner with product managers, engineers, and analysts to deliver data solutions that power digital products and business insights.

Good fit if you have strong proficiency with PySpark, Python, SQL, and experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, or similar tools

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Design, build, and own scalable data products and pipelines using Microsoft Fabric and modern data engineering practices, ensuring reliability, performance, governance, and effective delivery of trusted data for digital products and analytics.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and support high-quality data solutions and pipelines using modern engineering practices and tools. In this role, you will partner closely with product managers, software engineers, and data analysts to deliver scalable, reliable data capabilities that power digital products and business insights. You will be accountable for the endtoend lifecycle of your data products, from design and implementation through production support, data quality, and performance against key metrics.

Key Responsibilities:


Design, Build & Manage Data Solutions

  • Design, develop, and enhance scalable data pipelines and data processing systems.
  • Build reusable ingestion, transformation, and storage patterns to support product and analytical needs.
  • Integrate data from diverse sources including APIs, databases, event streams, and thirdparty systems.
  • Implement data models and schemas that create unified, consistent views of business operations.

Engineering Excellence

  • Apply modern engineering practices, including version control, testing, CI/CD, and automated deployments.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and reliability through validation, monitoring, and observability tools.
  • Optimize data workflows for performance, cost efficiency, and operational resilience.
  • Document data flows, lineage, and technical components in support of transparency and maintainability.

Product Collaboration & Delivery

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and analysts to understand data requirements.
  • Participate in iteration planning, ensuring shared understanding of backlog items and technical needs.
  • Engage in daily standups, retrospectives, and product ceremonies as an active member of the team.

Governance, Standards & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to data governance practices such as metadata management and data lineage.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and patterns to improve data infrastructure and engineering capabilities.
  • Share knowledge and mentor less experienced engineers, contributing to team growth and best practices.

Core Skills

  • Strong proficiency in developing scalable data pipelines using PySpark and Python.
  • Hands-on experience with modern data engineering frameworks and tools, including Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, dbt, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databases, data modeling, and data architecture principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to optimize SQL queries, data pipelines, and storage for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Experience designing and developing batch and/or real-time streaming data solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric Notebooks for developing, debugging, testing, and operationalizing data engineering workflows.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions, with Datadog experience preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative, iterative, and product-centric engineering environments.
  • Strong communication, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with cloud data services (Azure, AWS).
  • Handson experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Performance tuning for data pipelines, databases, and queries.
  • Familiarity with generative and agentic AI tools to improve engineering productivity.
