Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Senior technical leadership role designing and delivering enterprise-scale data solutions across cloud, lakehouse, warehouse, streaming, and analytical platforms. Leads architecture modernization, establishes engineering standards, and drives data governance across multiple teams and business domains.

Good fit if you have expertise in data architecture, distributed processing technologies like Spark and Kafka, Microsoft Fabric, and cloud platforms.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Data Expert provides technical leadership in designing and delivering scalable, reliable, and well-governed enterprise data solutions. This role defines data architecture and engineering standards, solves complex data challenges, and drives modernization and engineering excellence across teams.

As a Data Expert, you will provide technical leadership in the design, engineering, governance, and evolution of enterprise data solutions. This role serves as a senior technical authority for complex data initiatives, translating business and analytical needs into scalable, secure, reliable, and well-governed data products.


You will lead the design of modern data architectures and engineering patterns, establish technical standards and best practices, and solve highly complex data problems spanning multiple systems and business domains. You will partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analytics teams, and business stakeholders to modernize data platforms and create trusted, reusable data capabilities.


You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence technical direction across teams, mentor engineers, and drive continuous improvement in data architecture, engineering, governance, quality, observability, and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities:


Data Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Lead the architecture and design of complex, enterprise-scale data solutions across cloud, lakehouse, warehouse, streaming, and analytical platforms.
  • Define scalable architectural patterns for data ingestion, transformation, storage, integration, consumption, and lifecycle management.
  • Provide technical direction for complex initiatives involving multiple applications, data domains, platforms, and engineering teams.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, interoperability, metadata, lineage, security, performance, and platform integration.
  • Lead technical design reviews and evaluate architectural trade-offs involving scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex data architecture, engineering, integration, and production challenges.
  • Guide modernization of legacy data platforms and workloads using modern cloud and distributed data technologies.

Advanced Data Engineering

  • Design and lead implementation of highly scalable batch, streaming, and event-driven data processing solutions.
  • Develop complex data solutions using Python, PySpark, Scala, SQL, or comparable engineering languages.
  • Apply distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, dbt, or equivalent modern data frameworks.
  • Design reusable engineering frameworks and patterns that accelerate delivery across multiple data products and teams.
  • Design dimensional, relational, lakehouse, and domain-oriented data models appropriate for operational and analytical use cases.
  • Optimize distributed workloads, SQL queries, storage organization, partitioning strategies, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and cost.
  • Establish advanced practices for automated testing, dependency management, orchestration, failure recovery, replay, and operational resilience.

Microsoft Fabric & Cloud Data Platforms

  • Provide technical leadership for modern data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
  • Design scalable processing solutions using Fabric Notebooks, Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, and Delta Lake.
  • Define patterns for data organization, ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and consumption within Microsoft Fabric.
  • Apply appropriate Azure and/or AWS cloud services to enterprise data architectures.
  • Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and determine where they can improve engineering productivity, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

Engineering Excellence & DevOps

  • Define and promote software engineering standards for data development, including Git-based version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and automated deployment.
  • Establish reusable development patterns, coding standards, testing strategies, and deployment practices.
  • Design observability strategies covering pipeline execution, data quality, dependencies, application health, performance, and failures.
  • Drive proactive monitoring and operational excellence using platforms such as Datadog or equivalent observability technologies.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for complex production issues and drive solutions that prevent recurrence.
  • Establish measurable engineering practices that improve reliability, maintainability, performance, and supportability.

Data Quality, Governance & Security

  • Define and implement enterprise-level practices for data quality, metadata management, lineage, retention, classification, and lifecycle management.
  • Establish automated data validation, profiling, reconciliation, and quality monitoring practices.
  • Partner with business owners, data custodians, governance teams, security teams, and architects to establish trusted and governed data products.
  • Ensure solutions align with applicable privacy, security, regulatory, retention, and enterprise data governance requirements.
  • Establish clear ownership and accountability for critical data elements and governed data products.
  • Design and communicate standards for documenting data sources, transformations, lineage, business rules, and downstream dependencies.

Technical Strategy & Innovation

  • Evaluate new data technologies, architectural patterns, and frameworks and recommend adoption where they provide measurable value.
  • Provide technical leadership for modernization initiatives and migration from legacy data ecosystems to modern cloud and lakehouse platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, improve development velocity, and increase reuse.
  • Apply generative AI and agentic AI tools and patterns where appropriate to improve data engineering productivity, metadata management, data quality, and operational processes.
  • Develop prototypes and reference implementations to validate emerging technologies and architecture patterns.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence

  • Partner with senior business and technology leaders to translate complex business needs into long-term data capabilities.
  • Communicate complex technical topics, architectural decisions, risks, and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Facilitate architectural and technical discussions across engineering, product, analytics, governance, and business teams.
  • Influence technical direction across multiple teams without direct supervisory authority.
  • Mentor engineers and help develop advanced engineering and architecture capabilities across the organization.
  • Create technical documentation, reference architectures, standards, and reusable implementation guidance.

Core Skills

  • Expert-level knowledge of data architecture, data engineering, distributed processing, data integration, and data modeling.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, PySpark, Scala, SQL, or comparable languages used for large-scale data processing.
  • Advanced understanding of Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Notebooks, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
  • Strong knowledge of Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, distributed computing, batch processing, and streaming architectures.
  • Advanced SQL expertise, including query optimization and performance tuning.
  • Strong understanding of relational, dimensional, NoSQL, and distributed data modeling techniques.
  • Experience designing reusable frameworks and enterprise-scale data processing patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud architecture and data services within Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
  • Advanced understanding of engineering practices including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure/deployment automation, and release management.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog and designing operational monitoring for enterprise data solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, security, privacy, and retention principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex distributed data and production problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and influence engineering standards across multiple teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate architecture and technical strategy to engineering teams, business partners, and senior leadership.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience designing large-scale solutions on Microsoft Fabric and Azure.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data warehouse, ETL, or enterprise data processing environments into cloud/lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience developing metadata-driven data processing and orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience with event-driven and real-time data architectures.
  • Experience establishing enterprise data engineering standards, reusable frameworks, or reference architectures.
  • Experience with data cataloging, lineage, governance, and observability capabilities.
  • Experience applying generative AI and agentic AI technologies to data engineering and operational use cases.
  • Experience leading architecture reviews, proof-of-concepts, technology evaluations, and complex platform modernization efforts.

Experience

  • 10 or more years of relevant technology, data engineering, data architecture, or data platform experience (Preferred).
  • Significant experience designing and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership across large or cross-functional initiatives.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL

About this job

Lead complex data and analytics initiatives at enterprise scale, combining technical expertise with business strategy to advance data governance, modernization, and analytics across Allstate. Responsibilities include designing scalable solutions, establishing data quality standards, and fostering cross-functional collaboration on initiatives aligned with business goals.

Good fit if you have deep experience with data strategy, governance, and modern data technologies like Azure, Spark, and SQL, plus demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Leads complex data and analytics initiatives that deliver trusted, secure, and scalable enterprise data capabilities. This role combines technical expertise, business knowledge, and cross-functional leadership to advance data strategy, governance, quality, modernization, and analytics across the enterprise.

The Data & Analytics Lead Consultant provides strategic and technical leadership to deliver enterprise data and analytics capabilities that support business goals and enable trusted, data-driven decision making. This role combines strong data and analytics expertise with business knowledge to lead complex initiatives, establish scalable solutions and standards, and foster collaboration across business, technology, analytics, and data governance teams.


The Lead Consultant will contribute to enterprise data strategy across Data Governance & Quality, Analytics Ecosystem, Master Data Management, and Data Information & Security, while helping modernize data platforms and engineering practices.


Key Responsibilities:


Data & Analytics Strategy

  • Lead complex, cross-functional data and analytics initiatives aligned with business and enterprise data strategies.
  • Translate business objectives and requirements into actionable data, analytics, and technology solutions.
  • Contribute to functional strategy and define measurable success criteria for enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • Develop frameworks, roadmaps, and implementation plans for strategic data initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve how enterprise data is collected, integrated, managed, governed, and consumed.
  • Evaluate technical approaches and communicate recommendations, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs to stakeholders.

Data Solutions & Modernization

  • Lead the design and delivery of scalable data solutions supporting analytical and business needs.
  • Provide technical guidance for data ingestion, transformation, integration, storage, modeling, and consumption.
  • Apply modern data technologies and frameworks such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Spark, Python/PySpark, SQL, Kafka, dbt, or equivalent technologies.
  • Support modernization of legacy data platforms and processes through cloud, lakehouse, and modern data engineering patterns.
  • Promote reusable patterns and standards that improve consistency, scalability, maintainability, and delivery efficiency.
  • Ensure data solutions meet expectations for performance, reliability, security, and operational support.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Establish and promote practices that improve the reliability, consistency, accessibility, and quality of enterprise data.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to define data ownership, stewardship, metadata, lineage, and quality expectations.
  • Define and monitor data quality controls, validation rules, reconciliation processes, and key data quality metrics.
  • Help establish trusted and governed data sources that can be consistently reused across business and analytical applications.
  • Ensure appropriate data lifecycle, retention, privacy, and governance requirements are incorporated into data solutions.

Analytics Ecosystem

  • Enable the appropriate data, platforms, and capabilities needed to conduct analysis, inform decisions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with analytics, data engineering, product, and business teams to develop integrated analytical capabilities.
  • Promote consistent and reusable approaches to data modeling, data access, semantic definition, and analytics consumption.
  • Identify gaps in the analytics ecosystem and recommend improvements to platforms, processes, and capabilities.

Master Data Management

  • Support the development and adoption of trusted enterprise sources for key business data.
  • Establish processes and standards that improve the consistency, quality, and usability of shared data across business domains.
  • Partner with data owners, data custodians, technology teams, and business stakeholders to establish authoritative data definitions and ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce duplication and inconsistencies across enterprise data assets.

Data Information & Security

  • Partner with security, governance, and technology teams to protect enterprise data through appropriate security and access controls.
  • Ensure data solutions align with applicable privacy, security, regulatory, and enterprise requirements.
  • Incorporate security considerations into data architecture, integration, storage, and consumption designs.
  • Promote appropriate data classification and access practices throughout the data lifecycle.

Program Leadership & Enterprise Collaboration

  • Lead integrated, multi-track projects and initiatives, ensuring high-quality deliverables, effective risk management, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Develop project plans, establish controls, track performance, manage dependencies, and communicate risks and status.
  • Collaborate across business units and technology teams to resolve complex data and delivery challenges.
  • Foster enterprise-wide collaboration and alignment across data engineering, analytics, architecture, governance, security, and business teams.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business implications, capabilities, risks, and recommendations.
  • Communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • Mentor team members and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of data and analytics best practices.

Core Skills

  • Strong knowledge of data and analytics strategy, data governance, data quality, data engineering, and analytics.
  • Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including lakehouse, data warehouse, batch and streaming processing, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Hands-on knowledge of technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Spark, Python/PySpark, SQL, or equivalent modern data technologies.
  • Experience with data modeling, data integration, metadata, lineage, master data management, and data quality practices.
  • Understanding of Microsoft Fabric capabilities including Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Notebooks, Data Pipelines, and Semantic Models.
  • Experience with modern software and data engineering practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through complex technical and business problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business capabilities and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration, facilitation, consulting, and written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Azure data services.
  • Experience modernizing legacy data platforms and processes into cloud or lakehouse architectures.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data governance, data catalogs, metadata management, lineage, and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience with Master Data Management and enterprise data standardization.
  • Experience with data security, privacy, classification, and access-control practices.
  • Familiarity with generative and agentic AI capabilities and their application to data, analytics, and engineering productivity.

Experience

  • 7 or more years of relevant experience in data, analytics, technology, consulting, or related disciplines (Preferred).
  • Experience leading complex or cross-functional data and analytics initiatives (Preferred).

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Phoenix, AZ
  • Experience: 2+ years

About this job

Investigate automobile accidents involving bodily injury, assess coverage and liability, and negotiate settlements with customers and third parties. Remote role based in MST or PST time zones, working Monday through Friday with potential Saturday rotation.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of casualty bodily injury claims experience and strong phone communication and problem-solving skills.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

As a Claims Resolution Adjuster, your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving bodily injury. In this role, you will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service. You will communicate with customers through voice calls, email, and text messages, and use innovative platforms and tools to negotiate fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Pacific or Mountain time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.


At Allstate, responsibilities may vary from day to day. We are looking for adaptable professionals who thrive in a dynamic environment, bring care and sound judgment to each claim, and are excited to make an impact.


  • The Customer Service Expert Youll support customers by caring, empowering, and restoring throughout the claims process. You will do this by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator Youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator Youll use phone, email, and sometimes video chat to help customers through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also tailor your approach to claim handling by honoring the customers communication preferences and keeping them updated on claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claim settlements with customers, vendors, third-party carriers, and claimants in accordance with legal and business standards. You will incorporate tactics for handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver Youll use multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimating tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, while applying strong critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Youll help protect the company financially by following applicable policies and keeping a clear record of your work in the claims system. Youll ensure timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of claims experience, specifically with casualty bodily injury claims.
  • Claims investigation and negotiation experience preferred.
  • Experience with liability investigations, coverage investigations, property damage coverage, method of inspection, rental, and liability resolution preferred.
  • Strong phone communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

Work Location


This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States within one of the listed time zones above.


When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.


What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Work Schedule

  • 8-hour shift Mon-Fri | 8:00am - 4:30pm with potential Saturday duty rotation.

Licensing Requirements

  • You may be required to obtain an adjuster and/or appraiser license as a condition of employment.
  • If required, licensing may include an additional Department of Insurance background check and must be completed within 60 days of hire.
  • If you currently hold an active insurance license, you must terminate all existing appointments before onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments during employment.
  • If you are seeking an adjuster role and hold a resident producer license, you must formally surrender that license when instructed by the licensing team.
  • The Hiring Manager and Centralized Licensing team will provide support if licensing is required. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and agree to comply with these licensing requirements.

Sign-On Bonus Information

  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus.
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits

  • Day 1 benefits, including time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.
  • Competitive pay, plus support for ongoing development and career advancement.
  • Time off programs and resources that support work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to help you succeed in the role.
  • Additional benefits may include 401(k)/pension, education reimbursement, and programs that support life outside of work. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Please Note:

  • In our virtual environment, employees are expected to be on camera and actively participate during online meetings and training sessions.
  • This job description is not intended to include a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. Employees may be asked to perform other related duties as assigned.
  • Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this role.

About this job

Investigate automobile accident claims involving property damage and bodily injury, assessing coverage, liability, and damages. Work remotely from the Pacific or Mountain time zones, handling customer communications via phone, email, and text while negotiating settlements.

Good fit if you have 2+ years of claims adjusting experience with liability determination skills and strong phone communication abilities.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

As a Claims Resolution Adjuster II, your focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles that result in property damage and/or bodily injury. In this role, you will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service. You will communicate with customers through voice calls, email, and text messages, and use innovative platforms and tools to negotiate fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

Candidates for this role must reside in the Pacific or Mountain time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.


At Allstate, responsibilities may vary from day to day. We are looking for adaptable professionals who thrive in a dynamic environment, bring care and sound judgment to each claim, and are excited to make an impact.


  • The Customer Service Expert Youll support customers by caring, empowering, and restoring throughout the claims process. You will do this by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator Youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator Youll use phone, email, and sometimes video chat to help customers through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also tailor your approach to claim handling by honoring the customers communication preferences and keeping them updated on claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claim settlements with customers, vendors, third-party carriers, and claimants in accordance with legal and business standards. You will incorporate tactics for handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver Youll use multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimating tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, while applying strong critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder Youll help protect the company financially by following applicable policies and keeping a clear record of your work in the claims system. Youll ensure timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Work Location


This position is a remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States within one of the listed time zones above.


When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.


What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Work Schedule

  • 8-hour shift Mon-Fri | 8:00am - 4:30pm with potential Saturday duty rotation.

Licensing Requirements

  • You may be required to obtain an adjuster and/or appraiser license as a condition of employment.
  • If required, licensing may include an additional Department of Insurance background check and must be completed within 60 days of hire.
  • If you currently hold an active insurance license, you must terminate all existing appointments before onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments during employment.
  • If you are seeking an adjuster role and hold a resident producer license, you must formally surrender that license when instructed by the licensing team.
  • The Hiring Manager and Centralized Licensing team will provide support if licensing is required. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and agree to comply with these licensing requirements.

Sign-On Bonus Information

  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus.
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of claims adjusting experience determining liability.
  • Claims investigation and negotiation experience preferred.
  • Experience with liability investigations, coverage investigations, property damage coverage, method of inspection, rental, and liability resolution preferred.
  • Strong phone communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

Allstate Benefits

  • Day 1 benefits, including time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.
  • Competitive pay, plus support for ongoing development and career advancement.
  • Time off programs and resources that support work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to help you succeed in the role.
  • Additional benefits may include 401(k)/pension, education reimbursement, and programs that support life outside of work. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Please Note

  • In our virtual environment, employees are expected to be on camera and actively participate during online meetings and training sessions.
  • This job description is not intended to include a complete list of all duties and responsibilities. Employees may be asked to perform other related duties as assigned.
  • Regular, predictable attendance is an essential function of this role.

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

As a Field Property Claims Adjuster with National General, youll play an important role in helping customers navigate the claims process following a loss. Youll manage claims from initial investigation through resolution, conducting field inspections, evaluating damages, reviewing applicable coverage, developing repair estimates, and working with customers and other involved parties to reach timely and accurate claim outcomes. This role combines independent field work, critical thinking, technical expertise, and strong customer service. Youll manage an assigned territory and workload while documenting claim activity, communicating throughout the claims process, and making sound decisions in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

This role combines field inspections with virtual claim handling, requiring flexibility to assess losses in person and through virtual inspection technology. Using tools such as Xactimate, you'll evaluate damages related to weather, water, wind, and other property losses while providing a seamless customer experience.


You'll work independently while collaborating closely with your leadership team, peers, contractors, vendors, and customers. A company vehicle is provided for this designated field territory. The role offers significant autonomy, allowing you to manage your own schedule and daily routing while maintaining customer commitments and business expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Possesses a deep understanding of the content of all policy types written by the company
  • Possesses strong estimating fundamentals in order to create or audit estimates of damages on first party homeowner losses with complexity
  • Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers across multiple lines
  • Evaluates settlement alternatives by reviewing regulatory compliance and fair claims practices and makes decisions on best option
  • Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files across multiple lines

Job.JobTitle: Auto Property Damage Litigation Adjuster /Senior Consultant I -Remote
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $83,000 to $107,500 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Dallas, TX

About this job

Investigate auto accidents involving property damage and litigation. Assess coverage and liability, negotiate settlements with attorneys and parties, and manage claim files remotely from anywhere in the US.

Good fit if you have 3+ years of claims adjustment experience and can work independently from a home office with reliable internet.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

As an Auto Property Damage Litigation adjuster, you will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage with attorney representation/litigation involved. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair settlements with all parties involved.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluates, negotiates and settles complex unrepresented, represented and/or litigation claims in accordance with business unit best practices
  • Collaborates with defense counsel to establish negotiation and litigation strategies
  • Establishes and adjusts reserves, documents rationale and claim summary notes
  • Manages, researches, and resolves communications, concerns, conflicts or issues
  • Documents a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process

Experience

  • 3 or more years of experience (Preferred)

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Remote Home-Based Work:

  • This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States. This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington residents.

When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • A home office a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Allstate Benefits:

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Skills

Complex Claims, Critical Thinking, Litigation, Negotiation, Time Management

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is:

Casualty Claims Adjuster Sr Cons I: $83,000 - $107,500

Total compensation for this role is comprised of several factors, including the base compensation outlined above, plus incentive pay (i.e. commission, bonus, etc.) if applicable for the role.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

About this job

Direct Sales Agent Specialist sells home, auto, and specialty insurance products to local customers in person and by phone for National General, part of Allstate Corporation. The role includes generating new business, cross-selling, community relationship building, and local lead generation.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of sales experience and can obtain P&C licensing within 90 days

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Day 1 Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 0 2 years of experience
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company.

Skills

Active Learning, Adaptability, Business Integrity, Customer Service, Persuasion, Sales, Social Orientation, Time Management

Compensation

Base compensation: $20.00 per hour

Total Compensation:
In addition to the base hourly rate, total compensation for this role may include incentive pay, such as commissions and bonuses, based on individual and team performance.

Quick facts

  • Pay: $123,400 to $203,600 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Baltimore, MD
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • License: Valid driver's license
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Associate Senior Counsel at Travelers Insurance handling insurance defense litigation matters from inception through trial and appeal in Baltimore, Maryland. Role involves managing moderate to high complexity cases, mentoring junior attorneys, and serving as trusted advisor to insured clients and internal partners.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of insurance defense litigation experience, proven jury trial success, and an active law license to practice in Maryland.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$123,400.00 - $203,600.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As an Associate Senior Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to independently handle a caseload of predominatly moderate to higher complexity matters, which may include Major Case matters depending on line of business. You will deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers, and will mentor less experienced attorneys.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a caseload of predominantly moderate and higher exposure cases, including Major Case litigation matters depending on line of business, your responsibilities will include:
  • Leverage pre-trial and trial experience to apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct proficient to advanced legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft substantive pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other legal documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide in-depth, substantive case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and Claim partners on file handling strategies.
  • Collaborates with expert witnesses and consultants to develop case strategies, evaluate technical matters, and prepare compelling testimony for litigation.
  • Build and maintain strong internal and external client and business partner relationships, including accountability for managing client and business partner relationships.
  • Provide internal and external training, seminars and legal updates to insured clients and Claim partners.
  • Provide leadership through mentoring other attorneys and legal support staff.
  • Contributes to special projects and identifies other opportunities to support office goals/business needs.
  • Fully and effectively utilize available technology, case management system and automation.
  • Travel as required to meet business needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5+ years of insurance defense litigation experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Demonstrates an aptitude for trying cases to a jury; proven track record of preparing and/or litigating jury trials, with a history of successful courtroom outcomes.
  • Demonstrates strong technical knowledge in the practice area(s) and the ability to effectively communicate complex information on litigated matters to diverse audiences.
  • Proficient oral and written advocacy skills, with a demonstrated track record of summary judgment and/or appellate successs.
  • Possesses in-depth knowledge of the bench, bar, local jurisdictional practices, adversaries.
  • Capably fosters collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners to deliver exceptional customer service.
  • Demonstrates leadership through mentoring and influencing skills.
  • Exercises sound decision making and possesses advanced negotiation skills.
  • Effectively manages multiple priorities with an attention to detail, sense of urgency and responsiveness.
  • Possesses a flexible and agile mindset with a willingness to take on new challenges as needs evolve.

What is a Must Have?

  • Juris Doctorate or equivalent International legal degree; graduate of an accredited law school.
  • 4 years experience as a practicing attorney.
  • Active license in good standing to practice law in the state(s) in which representation is required.
  • Regularly handles hearings, trials, dispositive motion arguments, depositions, or other court proceedings and has the ability to transport to those meetings. Valid driver's license required depending on the location.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job Description:

Job Summary
The Business Analyst serves as a liaison between business stakeholders and Information Technology to support system enhancements, business initiatives, and process improvements within Commercial Insurance operations. This role combines business analysis, ticket administration, requirements documentation, testing, and defect management throughout the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate has strong Commercial Insurance knowledge and experience participating in projects, system implementations, testing efforts, or process improvement initiatives.

Commercial Insurance experience is a core requirement for this position. This role supports multiple concurrent initiatives and requires the ability to effectively manage competing priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and maintain progress in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, highly organized, a quick learner, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with business and technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

· Gather, analyze, and document business requirements.

· Partner with business stakeholders and IT teams to support solution design and implementation.

· Manage requests, enhancements, and defects through the development lifecycle.

· Create and maintain requirements, project documentation, and process flows.

· Develop and execute test scenarios and test cases to validate system functionality.

· Perform manual testing of enhancements, defect fixes, and system changes.

· Assist with regression testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

· Research reported issues, document findings, and coordinate defect resolution.

· Apply Commercial Insurance knowledge to evaluate business requirements and system functionality.

· Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

· Commercial Insurance experience.

· Experience supporting business projects, system implementations, process improvements, testing efforts, or technology initiatives.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

· Demonstrated ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

· Self-motivated with strong time management and organizational skills.

· Ability to work independently, take ownership of assignments, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight.

· Ability to quickly learn new systems, processes, and business concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

· Business Analyst experience.

· Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.

· Experience with software testing, quality assurance, or User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

· Experience working with policy administration systems.

· Experience with Diamond, Cover-All, or comparable insurance systems.

· Experience working directly with business and IT teams.

Education & Experience

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience preferred.

· Commercial Insurance experience required.

Job Description:

The Producer Contracting & Appointment Manager supervises Agency Administrative Support personnel and personally performs agency contracting, appointments, onboarding, and ongoing agency maintenance for Hallmark's Personal and Commercial Lines business units. The manager develops and maintains procedures to support efficient departmental workflows and achievement of short- and long-term objectives, and partners with business unit leaders to resolve agency appointment and contracting issues.


Job Duties

  • Supervises Agency Admin staff and personally performs agency contracting, appointments, merger and buyout processing, and ongoing agency partner support.
  • Responsible for coaching, developing, and leading team to meet timely service and processing goals
  • Oversees and/or personally processes producer onboarding applications, including required background checks and license verification, and enters producer information into agency systems, policy systems, and producer portals.
  • Oversees and personally handles renewals and updates to agency errors and omissions (E&O) insurance information; processes agency terminations and suspensions as needed.
  • Works directly with business unit leaders to address agency appointment issues.
  • Collaborates with Sales leadership to coordinate agency onboarding priorities, communicate contracting and appointment requirements, and resolve processing barriers to support timely agency appointments.
  • Performs quality audits
  • Identifies systems or processing enhancements to increase accuracy and efficiency
  • May prepare and submit periodic compliance reports for internal licensed staff
  • Assists the department head with projects as needed.

Independence

  • Decisions of moderate to high complexity should be made independently and within company guidelines. The individual performing this job should be confident in his/her decision-making abilities and have a general understanding of when issues should be brought to Leadership or Human Resources.

Supervision

  • Supervises 2-4 direct reports, including Agency Administrative Support personnel

Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring and training employees; planning, assigning and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Education, Experience, Knowledge and Skills:

  • Prior supervisory or management experience required
  • P&C Insurance industry experience preferred
  • Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Must be dedicated to quality, highly organized, and efficient
  • Ability to collaborate with others and establish strong working relationships throughout the organization

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Representative
Job.JobDescription:
Claims Representative II - Property

Our preference is for this role to be HYBRID, working inoffice Tuesday–Thursday at our Merrill, WI location.

We will also consider fully remote candidates who are not within commuting distance to one of our offices in Milwaukee or Madison, WI.

What You'll Be Doing

In accordance with application of state and federal laws and company best practices, handle low-to-moderate value commercial property claims short in duration with lower indemnity which may include property damage, business personal property, and building damage. Gather and review claim information, determine coverage, and conduct thorough investigations. Initiate and maintain customer contact to provide updates and resolve any issues with the claim. Update information in the claim system to document claim handling activities. Determine/set reserves and make payments within level of authority. Investigate and refer identified claims to Loss Recovery Services, as applicable.

On Any Given Day, You'll

  • Perform claim tasks timely and document claim files appropriately. Proactively manage claim activities to ensure fair claim resolution. Handle all claims in accordance with state and federal laws.

  • Verify coverage by gathering adequate information necessary to make an informed decision in a fair, equitable, and ethical manner. Deny losses under limited supervision, providing detailed explanation, citing facts, and policy language.

  • Perform a thorough investigation based upon the type, complexity, and severity of the claim. Upon completion of the investigation, analyze and evaluate the potential exposure and damages, including potential full or partial liability and compensability denials. Formulate and document an action plan based on the covered damages and injuries.

  • Determine and set reserves based on the most probable outcome of the claim, within authority level. Evaluate and negotiate directly with insured or insured representative on all cases within authority level. Review claim facts and exposure with claims management, as appropriate, to guide claim strategy. Make complete, accurate, and timely payments within authority for covered losses. Refer claims above authority to management for review and potential reassignment.

  • Maintain a professional, courteous, and helpful approach when communicating in-person, on the phone, or through email and other correspondence with internal and external customers and business partners.

  • Recognize when vendor partners are required on a claim, including experts, independent adjustors, or other. Assign and direct vendors, as needed, to aid in the investigation and evaluation of the claim. Manage claim expenses by concluding vendor assignment when vendor is no longer adding value to the claim.

  • Investigate and refer identified claims to Loss Recovery Services, as applicable.

  • Completes all other assigned duties, as requested.

Here's What We Expect

  • Two to four years of claim handling and/or insurance-related experience is preferred.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree preferred. A combination of equivalent education and/or experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

  • Additional training in insurance, construction, restoration, and/or building terminology knowledge is desirable.

  • Completion of courses in any one or more of the following designations, INS, AIC, or CPCU, is preferred.

Necessary Knowledge and Abilities

  • Ability to obtain and maintain state adjusting license requirements and complete continuing education requirements.

  • Evidence of ability to think independently, be detail oriented, and organized.

  • Strong listening, verbal, and written communication skills.

  • Knowledge of policy terminology and legal principles involving at least one or more of the following: insurance, automobile, medical, and property claims.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote

About this job

Lead business user acceptance testing for Guidewire PolicyCenter implementation supporting commercial property and casualty insurance operations. Coordinate between business and technology teams to ensure system functionality meets requirements, manage testing execution across policy lifecycle functions, and drive readiness for production deployment.

Good fit if you have five or more years in commercial P&C insurance, experience leading UAT for complex system implementations, and strong knowledge of policy administration and insurance operations.

Full job description

***This role can be FULLY REMOTE or HYBRID (in office days Tuesday-Thursday) if in close proximity to one of our office locations below***

  • Merrill, WI 
  • Milwaukee, WI
  • Mechanicsburg, PA
  • Madison, WI

ROLE:

Lead business user acceptance testing (UAT) activities supporting the implementation of Guidewire PolicyCenter and related systems for commercial property and casualty insurance operations. This role serves as the primary coordinator between business and technology teams to ensure system functionality aligns with approved business requirements and operational needs.

The Guidewire UAT Lead is responsible for establishing the structure, governance, processes, and reporting necessary to successfully execute UAT activities across multiple products and business functions. This position works closely with underwriting, insurance product, technology product, quality assurance, and implementation teams to define requirements, develop testing strategies, manage testing execution, facilitate issue resolution, and ensure business readiness prior to production deployment. The role provides leadership and influence across cross-functional teams without direct supervisory authority.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead UAT strategy, planning, preparation, execution, and completion for Guidewire PolicyCenter and related integrations supporting commercial property and casualty insurance products.
  • Partner with underwriting, insurance product, technology product, business analysis, quality assurance, development, and implementation teams to establish UAT scope, schedules, resource requirements, entry and exit criteria, and business sign-off expectations.
  • Facilitate working sessions with underwriting and product subject matter experts to define and refine business requirements, workflows, referrals, product rules, and expected system behavior.
  • Translate approved business requirements into acceptance criteria, end-to-end business scenarios, test cases, test scripts, expected outcomes, and reusable regression testing assets.
  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive UAT framework, including test inventories, traceability documentation, readiness assessments, tester assignments, schedules, execution tracking, and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate and lead business subject matter experts and UAT participants by assigning work, clarifying expectations, monitoring progress, and addressing resource constraints, dependencies, and testing gaps.
  • Coordinate test environments, system access, test data, integrations, documentation, and other prerequisites required to support successful testing execution.
  • Lead testing activities across policy lifecycle functions including submission, quote, underwriting, referral, rating, bind, issue, endorsement, renewal, cancellation, reinstatement, and associated integrated systems.
  • Validate configured workflows, screens, rating logic, product rules, documents, integrations, and migrated data to ensure compliance with approved business and operational requirements.
  • Document, assess, prioritize, track, and communicate defects, requirement gaps, and testing issues while coordinating appropriate resolution activities with business and technology teams.
  • Coordinate corrective actions, retesting, regression testing, and issue closure to ensure successful implementation outcomes.
  • Develop and communicate testing status, defect trends, risk assessments, readiness evaluations, dependencies, and recommendations to project stakeholders and leadership.
  • Facilitate business review and acceptance activities and support final business sign-off decisions based on testing outcomes, acceptance criteria, and residual risk evaluation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of UAT methodologies, testing standards, documentation practices, and governance processes to support future technology implementations.
  • Support organizational readiness by identifying operational impacts, process changes, and training considerations associated with new system functionality.
  • Build collaborative relationships across business and technology teams and provide leadership through influence, coordination, and effective communication.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; degree emphasis in insurance, risk management, information technology, business, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Five or more years of commercial property and casualty insurance experience in policy administration, business analysis, quality assurance, user acceptance testing, or a related discipline. Experience spanning underwriting, insurance product management, and technology product functions is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading business user acceptance testing efforts for complex enterprise system implementations, modernizations, or migrations.
  • Experience defining and documenting business requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, business scenarios, test scripts, expected results, and regression testing materials.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial property and casualty insurance operations and policy lifecycle processes.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into structured testing methodologies and repeatable test conditions.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and project coordination skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all organizational levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and lead work across cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and competing business needs in a fast-paced transformation environment.
  • Guidewire PolicyCenter experience strongly preferred. Experience with policy administration platforms, testing tools, defect management systems, agile delivery methodologies, and related insurance industry designations is preferred.
  • Advanced computer skills and the ability to learn and apply new technologies and tools.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Professional office environment.
  • Hybrid work arrangement with in-office days Tuesday through Thursday in Merrill, Madison, or Milwaukee.
  • Fully remote work may be considered for candidates outside commuting distance.
  • Occasional travel may be required to support project planning, testing activities, training, or implementation efforts.

NOTE: This job description does not state or imply that these are the only duties performed by this role.  This role may be requested to perform job related tasks other than those specifically presented in this job description.  The employer reserves the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

About this job

Provides advanced underwriting support for renewal accounts, endorsements, and policy servicing while evaluating risk information and applying underwriting guidelines. Serves as a technical resource and mentor for underwriting support operations at Church Mutual Insurance in Merrill, Wisconsin.

Good fit if you have underwriting or insurance support experience and can mentor team members while managing complex accounts.

Full job description

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Underwriting Support Specialist is responsible for providing advanced underwriting support underwriting activities, and servicing activities while serving as a technical resource for underwriting support operations. This role supports underwriters through risk review, renewal preparation, endorsement evaluation, account servicing, and the underwriting of designated accounts of increasing size, premium volume, and complexity within established authority through risk evaluation, coverage review, and application of underwriting guidelines while promoting operational quality and customer satisfaction

The Senior Underwriting Support Specialist provides leadership through technical expertise, mentoring, training, and process improvement initiatives. The primary accountability of this role is delivering advanced underwriting support while enhancing team capability, supporting underwriting operations, and developing expertise necessary for increasingly complex underwriting responsibilities. This role serves as an advanced underwriting support position that provides opportunities to develop underwriting knowledge, technical expertise, and advanced technical, leadership, and underwriting career opportunities.


Primary Job Responsibilities

Underwriting Support & Risk Review

  • Underwrite designated renewal accounts and routine underwriting transactions of increasing size and complexity within delegated authority by evaluating risk information and applying underwriting guidelines and standards.
  • Review risk information, account characteristics, and supporting documentation to assess exposures and determine appropriate underwriting actions or recommendations.
  • Apply underwriting guidelines, coverage analysis, and rating considerations when evaluating and processing assigned underwriting responsibilities.
  • Perform designated underwriting activities for assigned accounts and other risks within established authority and guidelines, including evaluating risk information, applying underwriting guidelines, analyzing coverage considerations, and completing underwriting actions within delegated authority and established procedures.
  • Provide advanced underwriting support for renewals, endorsements, and policy servicing activities.
  • Prepare and review renewal files and supporting documentation to facilitate underwriting evaluation and decision-making.
  • Conduct review of endorsements and policy transactions within established authority and procedures, evaluating risk characteristics, coverage considerations, and appropriate underwriting actions
  • Evaluate supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and underwriting readiness.
  • Support underwriters with increasingly complex underwriting support activities and account servicing needs.
  • Document underwriting actions, communications, and supporting information in accordance with departmental standards.

Customer Service & Collaboration

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with producers, customers, underwriters, and internal business partners.
  • Provide timely, accurate, and professional service in support of retention, customer satisfaction, and business objectives.
  • Assist in resolving complex service issues and underwriting support concerns.
  • Collaborate with underwriters and business partners to support underwriting workflows, account servicing, and renewal processes.
  • Serve as a resource for underwriting support staff and assist with escalated questions or issues.
  • Communicate underwriting decisions, requirements, coverage considerations, and risk-related recommendations to producers, customers, underwriters, and internal business partners as appropriate.

Leadership, Mentoring & Training

  • Serve as a technical resource and experienced team member for underwriting support operations.
  • Mentor and support less experienced underwriting support staff through coaching, knowledge sharing, and guidance.
  • Assist with onboarding and training activities for new and existing team members.
  • Support development and maintenance of procedures, workflow documentation, and job aids.
  • Contribute to a positive culture of learning, development, and operational excellence.
  • Serve as a resource to team members regarding underwriting guidelines, risk evaluation, coverage analysis, and underwriting best practices

Compliance, Documentation & Quality

  • Ensure underwriting support activities comply with established guidelines, procedures, and company standards.
  • Support quality, audit, and process consistency initiatives across underwriting support operations.
  • Identify recurring issues, trends, and opportunities for quality improvement.
  • Maintain accurate and complete underwriting documentation and records.
  • Protect the confidentiality of customer and company information

Knowledge Development & Contribution

  • Maintain advanced knowledge of insurance products, policy forms, underwriting support processes, and underwriting workflows.
  • Apply and continue developing advanced underwriting knowledge, including risk evaluation, coverage analysis, underwriting guidelines, complex account review, and underwriting support operations.
  • Participate in projects, initiatives, and process improvement efforts designed to enhance service, quality, and operational effectiveness.
  • Provide recommendations to improve workflows, procedures, and underwriting support effectiveness.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Operational Excellence & Adaptability

  • Meet established service, productivity, quality, and timeliness expectations.
  • Effectively manage competing priorities and support departmental workload needs.
  • Promote consistency, professionalism, and accountability across underwriting support activities.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in response to changing business needs, priorities, and processes.
  • Support process improvements and change initiatives that strengthen underwriting support operations.

..

 

SCOPE & DECISION-MAKING AUTHORITY

  • Account Scope: Advanced underwriting support activities, renewal preparation, endorsement review, policy servicing, and designated small-account underwriting activities.
  • Complexity: Advanced underwriting support responsibilities combined with underwriting responsibility for designated accounts and transactions of increasing size and complexity within delegated authority.
  • Authority: Expanded authority for designated underwriting support activities and underwriting responsibility for designated accounts and transactions of increasing size and complexity within delegated authority.
  • Decision-Making: Exercises judgment on assigned accounts, endorsements, and transactions within established guidelines and delegated authority while providing guidance to others and escalating higher-risk, more complex, or out-of-authority situations appropriately.
  • Supervision: Functions independently and provides mentoring, training, and technical support to team members without formal supervisory responsibility.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Post-secondary education preferred.
  • Recognized insurance education or coursework is desirable.
  • Typically 3-5 years of insurance experience with demonstrated progression in underwriting support, policy administration, policy processing, underwriting operations, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, train, and support the development of others.

Technical Knowledge

  • Advanced knowledge of insurance products, underwriting concepts, policy forms, underwriting support processes, and underwriting workflows.
  • Understanding of risk review, coverage considerations, and underwriting support activities.
  • Ability to review documentation, identify issues, and support underwriting decisions within established authority.
  • Proficiency with company systems, applications, and technology supporting underwriting operations

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to train, mentor, and support others.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and complex assignments.
  • Demonstrated leadership through influence and expertise.
  • Commitment to continuous learning, professionalism, and operational excellence.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & TRAVEL

  • Work is performed in a professional office or remote/hybrid environment, consistent with organizational policy.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be allinclusive. Employees may be asked to perform other duties as assigned. Duties and scope may vary by product line or Center of Excellence while maintaining core underwriting responsibilities.
