  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Carmel, IN
  • License: Valid driver's license

About this job

Sell auto, home, life, and commercial insurance to individuals and families through outside sales in the Carmel area. Base salary plus uncapped commissions, backed by Fortune 100 company with training and support. No prior insurance experience required.

Good fit if you are self-motivated, relationship-focused, reliable with strong communication skills, and comfortable learning sales technology.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS. Must reside in the state of Indiana.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Qualifications

Day One Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

Licensing:

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired (P&C and Life).

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Description

We are looking for a Sales Agent to join our team in the Texas areas. Success in this role will require a strong local network and in-person relationship building in the community. This is a field sales position.

To be considered, applicants must live in Texas, specifically in one of the following cities or surrounding area: San Antonio, El Paso, Midland, McAllen, Edinburg, Mission, Kerrville, Laredo, Fredericksburg, Odessa, Seguin, Brownsville, Harlingen, Eagle Pass, or Del Rio*

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.

We are looking for a Sales Agent to join our team in the Texas areas. Success in this role will require a strong local network and in-person relationship building in the community. This is a field sales position.

To be considered, applicants must live in Texas, specifically in one of the following cities or surrounding area: San Antonio, El Paso, Midland, McAllen, Edinburg, Mission, Kerrville, Laredo, Fredericksburg, Odessa, Seguin, Brownsville, Harlingen, Eagle Pass, or Del Rio*

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

Insurance Sales Associate supporting a sales agent in new business and customer retention at a Comparion Insurance Agency office in Chandler. Full job description


Description

We are looking for an Insurance Sales Associate to join our team in our Chandler office. This is not a remote position.

Were Hiring Immediately!

As an Insurance Sales Associate, you will work alongside with and support a Comparion Insurance Sales Agent in profitable growth through new business sales and customer retention. Your ability to listen and empathize are key in being the initial contact for our customers. Success in this role will require building a strong local network and in-person relationship in the community.

Working for Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company, means working for a company thats committed to advancing an inclusive environment. We do that through leadership development programs aimed at advancing, engaging, and retaining under-represented talent and our Employee Resource Groups, which strengthen our inclusive workplace, enhance personal development, and provide ways for employees to connect, learn and engage.

Ready to find out what it means to work for an agency that is backed by Liberty Mutuala Fortune 100 company thats committed to putting people first, acting responsibly and making things better?

Responsibilities:

  • Utilize consultative sales techniques to prospect and initiate new business sales.
  • Assists in the processing of new business, including contacting customers to finalize sales and service transactions.
  • Identifies cross selling opportunities for Sales Agent.
  • Contributes to and executes a marketing plan with the Sales Agent.
  • Identifies mass marketing prospects through existing book of business and community prospecting opportunities.
  • Meet monthly goals for new business sales.
  • Completes follow-ups on new policies in order to keep retention level high and capitalize cross-selling opportunities.
  • Coordinates activities with other departments to ensure quality customer service
  • Acts as initial contact in addressing customer concerns regarding establishment of policies and new account status.
  • Unlicensed candidates will be enrolled in a new hire training class once they begin working for Comparion. The training includes a licensing training program in which Comparion covers the cost of training materials and exam fees.
Qualifications
  • High School Degree
  • 1-2 years of relevant sales experience preferred
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to handle common objections and educate customers in a consultative manner
  • Demonstrated self-starter, motivated to learn and grow in a professional sales organization
  • Professional business acumen, strong presence and confidence
  • Resourceful team player that can contribute and accept new ideas
  • A state insurance licenseor willingness to earn one with training and supportin Property & Casualty, and Life

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Build a career for yourself, not by yourself. Launch a rewarding insurance sales career today.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Lake Oswego, OR
  • Experience: 5 to 7 years

About this job

Investigate and resolve complex workers compensation claims of high exposure and severity. Requires Oregon Workers Compensation Adjuster License and 5-7 years of claims experience, with 1-2 years in complex claims.

Good fit if you have an Oregon Workers Compensation Adjuster License and 5-7 years of claims experience with complex claims background

Full job description


Description

Under limited supervision and established practices, responsible for the investigation, evaluation, and disposition of Complex Workers Compensation cases of high exposure and severity. Applies established medical management strategies on high dollar complex claims. Has developed high level of knowledge of Workers Compensation claims handling techniques, a full knowledge of LMG claims procedures and is cognizant of new industry trends and claim handling techniques Uses available data to track claims trends and other claim related metrics.

Candidates should be based in Oregon with Oregon Workers Compensation Adjuster License.

The salary range posted reflects the range for the varying pay scale that encompasses each of the Liberty Mutual regions and the overall cost of living for that region.


Responsibilities

  • Investigates claims to determine whether coverage is provided, establish compensability and verify exposure.
  • Resolves claims within authority and makes recommendations regarding case value and resolution strategy to Branch Office Management and HO Examining on cases which exceed authority.
  • Participates in pricing, reserving and strategy discussions with HO Examining and Examining Management.
  • Works closely with staff and outside defense counsel in managing litigated files according to established litigation management protocols.
  • Identifies and appropriately handles suspicious claims and claims with the potential to develop adversely.
  • Identifies and appropriately handles claims with third party subrogation potential, SIF (Self-Insured Fund) and MSA (Medicare Set Aside) exposure.
  • Establishes and maintains accurate reserves on all assigned files.
  • Makes timely reserve recommendations to Branch Office Management and HO Examining on cases which exceed authority.
  • Prepares for and attends mediation sessions and/or settlement conferences and negotiates on behalf of LMG and LMG Insureds.
  • Demonstrates the ability to understand new and unique exposures and coverages.
  • Demonstrates the ability to understand key data elements and claims related data analysis.
  • Confers directly with policyholders on coverage and resolution strategy issues.
  • Coordinates and participates in training sessions for less experienced staff, including both Complex Non-Complex staff.
Qualifications
  • A bachelors degree or equivalent business experience is required
  • In addition, the candidate will generally possess 5-7 years of related claims experience with 1-2 years of experience in complex claims
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint as well as excellent written and verbal communication skills required

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Operations Manager, Operations & Policy Administration
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Risk Financing sits at the center of how Liberty Mutual transfers risk to the reinsurance market, and its effectiveness depends on a large number of functions moving in step. This role exists to make that happen. As Reinsurance Operations Manager, you will be the connective tissue between Risk Financing and its key partner functions Enterprise Risk Management, RI Operations, RI Accounting, Legal, Tax, LM Re and the broker community ensuring that priorities are clearly set, actively managed and consistently executed across all of them.

This is a role for someone who is energized by turning recurring friction into durable process. You will own the definition of the treaty lifecycle and its implementation across the team, contribute to the standard operating procedures that allow placement teams to act with confidence, and take a leading role in renewal preparation and management including the treaty handover to downstream teams within agreed service levels. You will work across the full lifecycle, from market approval and reinsurer governance through binding, post-placement data delivery and in-force management.

Much of the work involves shaping the agenda of teams you do not manage, so the ability to build credibility, communicate with clarity in writing and in person, and hold a position under senior scrutiny is central to success.

What you'll do

  • Serve as a key operational point of contact between Risk Financing and its partner functions, establishing and maintaining a governed cadence with each
  • Own the treaty lifecycle definition end to end and drive its adoption across the Risk Financing team
  • Author, secure approval for and implement standard operating procedures and standardized templates that remove ambiguity and reduce duplication of work
  • Own operational renewal preparation and management for reinsurance cycles, including new process implementation, training, and monitoring of operational handovers to Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and RI Operations withing tight SLAs
  • Partner with ERM on reinsurer governance, collateral requirements, approved market lists and concentration frameworks, and implement approved changes as business as usual
  • Support regulatory and control processes including SSAP62 risk transfer reviews, transfer pricing documentation and internal audit requests
  • Drive data quality and standardization initiatives with internal teams and external delivery partners
  • Identify and champion opportunities to simplify how the team delivers, including responsible adoption of GenAI tooling

At least 75% of time is spent on a combination of the following responsibilities:

  1. Operational excellence and SOP ownership: Own, maintain and continuously improve Risk Financing standard operating procedures across the treaty lifecycle, ensuring processes are clearly documented, scalable, audit ready and consistently applied globally.
  2. Process optimization and waste reduction: Identify inefficiencies, duplication and bottlenecks across Risk Financing operations, applying continuous improvement methods to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, minimize rework and shorten cycle times.
  3. Automation and simplification: Lead workflow simplification initiatives in partnership with Technology, Data and operational teams, translating strategic priorities into practical improvements.
  4. Data, reporting and insight: Improve data quality, lineage and usability across reinsurance systems and reporting outputs, using descriptive analytics, visualization tools, KPIs and operational metrics to support decision making and executive reporting.
  5. Stakeholder and partner connectivity: Act as a central coordinator between Risk Financing and partner functions including Finance, Claims, Actuarial, Legal, Tax, brokers and reinsurers, ensuring smooth handoffs, clear ownership and aligned timelines.
  6. Governance, controls and risk management: Support operational risk identification and remediation, ensuring controls, documentation and governance are in place to meet internal, audit and regulatory expectations.
  7. Operational performance management: Develop, update and analyze complex metrics used to assess operational performance, productivity, staffing needs, service levels and other measures valuable to Risk Financing leadership.
  8. Audit, review and senior forum support: Prepare materials, insights and recommendations for audits, reviews, governance meetings and senior forums
  9. Innovation and continuous improvement: Champion new tools, ways of working and data-driven practices across Risk Financing Operations, embedding continuous improvement into daily management.
  10. Mentoring and capability building: Provide guidance, coaching and mentoring to less experienced staff, helping embed consistent operational practices across the Risk Financing team.
Qualifications
  • Competencies typically acquired through a Bachelor`s degree or equivalent experience in addition to 8+ years of relevant experience to includereinsurance operations, process improvement, accounting or audit
  • Substantial experience in reinsurance operations, treaty administration or a closely related insurance operations discipline
  • Advanced degree preferred
  • Displays strong research, problem solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills
  • Advanced business operations knowledge to include understanding the function`s value chain and market conditions
  • Advanced influencing, relationship management & presentation skills
  • Highly skilled at supporting change and imparting value within an organization
  • Strong project management skills as part of implementing business process changes
  • Advanced knowledge of available data sources, strengths and shortcomings
  • May also be relevant based on the particular needs of the position: Advanced knowledge of Excel and strong knowledge of database software
  • Solid knowledge of business intelligence tools
  • A demonstrated record of cross-functional coordination in a complex organization, including influencing teams outside your reporting line
  • Strong process design and documentation capability the ability to take an undefined process, map it, and produce guidance others can follow without you present
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the judgement to adapt the same material for operational, financial and risk-and-controls audiences
  • Sound working knowledge of treaty structures, reinsurer governance and regulatory requirements affecting reinsurance transactions
  • Comfort operating with autonomy and precision on long-horizon initiatives alongside a high volume of ad hoc requests
  • A collaborative, service-oriented approach and the credibility to become the person stakeholders bring problems to for quick resolution

The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer II to join our organization as we grow and transform our Enterprise Technology Solutions organization.

The Infrastructure Engineers II focuses on administering and improving enterprise Microsoft 365 messaging and collaboration services. The position combines Exchange, Teams, automation, troubleshooting, security, compliance, and project delivery responsibilities.

What Will You Do?

  • Exchange platform ownership: The role manages Exchange Online and on-premises Exchange Server in a hybrid environment, including Azure AD Connect, mail flow, mailboxes, distribution groups, routing policies, server health, queues, retention, and archiving.
  • Teams and collaboration administration: Responsibilities include enterprise Teams policies, meetings, client updates, and Teams Phone System capabilities such as Direct Routing, dial plans, call queues, normalization rules, and E911 services. The role also maintains integrations with Exchange, SharePoint, and OneDrive.
  • Automation and operational support: PowerShell automation is used for onboarding and offboarding, license and mailbox setup, Teams configuration, batch changes, health reporting, usage analysis, monitoring, configuration management, patching, and backups. The engineer provides Tier 3 troubleshooting, performs root cause analysis, and manages escalations to Microsoft Support.
  • Upgrades and cross-team delivery: The position plans and executes Exchange updates, mailbox migrations, new Microsoft 365 feature deployments, and possible tenant-to-tenant migrations through testing and change-management processes. It also requires detailed documentation, runbooks, training, and collaboration with Network, Security, and Help Desk teams.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

Core Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or its equivalent in work experience.
  • 5 years of relevant Infrastructure or Systems Engineering experience.
  • Substantial Exchange hybrid and Teams expertise, and experience with SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business.
  • Required technical knowledge spans Exchange architecture, Teams policies and voice, Azure AD identity and security, Conditional Access, MFA, PowerShell, Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, networking, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft certifications, advanced Microsoft 365 services, third-party administration tools, enterprise or regulated-industry experience, and leadership of migrations or upgrade projects are advantageous.

Work Environment & Availability:

  • This position offers a flexible hybrid work model.
  • Occasional off-hours maintenance or critical-incident response may be required. 

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in work experience plus 4 years of infrastructure engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

50

What Is the Opportunity?

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in early September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible

Innovative thinking, creative problem-solving, and a determination to challenge the status-quo, these are some of the defining qualities for participants of our Engineering Development Program (EDP). The EDP is a one-year program where you will be placed in one of the four designated Engineering tracks: Software, Data, Cybersecurity or Infrastructure & Cloud. Each track is designed to grow and develop your technical and self-leadership skills. Within your assigned track, you will receive a combination of hands-on opportunities, an immersive learning journey, and a mentoring program to prepare you for a dynamic career. You will have the opportunity to explore multiple technologies while learning from different engineers within Travelers.

Our five-week long technical learning accelerator consists of a mix of classroom, independent, and hands-on learning that is designed to fine-tune your skills and introduce you to Travelers technology. The accelerator focuses on providing you valuable training on multiple tools and technologies, but from a Travelers perspective. You will also learn about our software development lifecycle, enterprise engineering environments, artificial intelligence-enhanced practices, and working with Agile methodologies.

As an EDP participant, you will model the way for others and set a personal example of what is expected. You will positively challenge processes, embrace change, actively listen to and support diverse points of view, and celebrate the success of others. Travelers offers a hybrid work location model designed to support flexibility.

You are a self-starter who goes beyond required job or educational commitments to explore new technologies, applications, and environments. You take strong ownership of your actions, performance, and outcomes, proactively managing your time while juggling multiple projects simultaneously. You collaborate effectively and maintain a positive attitude whether working independently or as part of a team. You also demonstrate strong analytical aptitude-identifying current or future problems and opportunities, synthesizing and comparing data, recognizing cause-and-effect relationships, and exploring alternative solutions to support sound decision-making.

At Travelers, our vision is to advance our ability to fuel analytic-driven business decisions by accelerating cross-enterprise collaboration and capabilities. The Business Insights & Analytics Leadership Development Program (BI&ALDP) internship is built for analytically driven students who are serious about launching a career in data and analytics. This is not a passive, observational internship - you will do real work, solve real business problems, and be evaluated like a professional from day one.

Over 10 weeks, you and your cohort of peers will be embedded in Travelers' data and analytics community, gaining hands-on experience in one or more of our core analytics disciplines while building the technical and professional skills that define a successful career.

Technical training is delivered to you by current full-time BI&ALDP participants - those who were recently in your position - giving you an authentic, peer-informed perspective on what it takes to grow here.

Housing: The internship program is based in Hartford, CT and St. Paul, MN. Positions are available in our business units and corporate departments. Subsidized apartments are available for students who live beyond a commutable distance from Hartford, CT or St. Paul, MN.

Positions are available from June through early August.

What Will You Do?

  • Real project work aligned to active business needs across Travelers' analytics functions.
  • Technical training taught by full-time BI&ALDP participants.
  • Formal performance reviews that give you honest, structured feedback on your growth.
  • Leadership exposure through company-wide events including the Intern Symposium and community outreach initiatives, where you will interact with leaders and a cohort across the enterprise.
  • A collaborative capstone presentation where you and your fellow interns develop and present solutions to relevant business and analytics challenges.
  • Leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • At the close of the internship, high performing interns are eligible to interview for a full-time offer to join the BI&ALDP - making these 10 weeks one of the most important career opportunities of your academic journey.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or greater preferred.
  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a STEM related discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math).
  • Data warehouse and ETL understanding with Python, SQL, and/or Snowflake.
  • Knowledge of data lakes and/or experience with Databricks.
  • Exposure to dashboarding, scorecards or other descriptive reporting tools.
  • Knowledge of multidimensional data and open-source cloud-enabled analytical programming languages.
  • Familiarity with agile concepts & workflows.

The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.


The Underwriting Intern will support the Underwriting team by assisting with risk analysis, portfolio management, reporting, and underwriting processes that help drive informed business decisions and profitable growth. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in insurance underwriting, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration while developing foundational skills for a career in underwriting and risk management.


Underwriting Analysis & Development (80%)

  • Assist the Underwriting team with data collection, analysis, and reporting of key underwriting and portfolio performance metrics.
  • Support the review and evaluation of underwriting results, trends, risk characteristics, and financial performance.
  • Assist in the preparation of underwriting reports, presentations, and business insights for internal stakeholders.
  • Conduct research and analysis to support underwriting strategies, pricing initiatives, and risk management decisions.
  • Help identify opportunities for process improvements and support the development of more efficient underwriting practices.
  • Utilize reporting and analytical tools to manage and interpret underwriting data in support of various projects.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, finance, product, and operations teams to support business objectives.

Project Management & Continuous Improvement (20%)

  • Participate in team meetings and brainstorming sessions to support underwriting initiatives and business solutions.
  • Assist in documenting underwriting processes, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
  • Support special projects related to portfolio management, risk assessment, business analytics, and operational improvements.
  • Contribute to process mapping and workflow optimization efforts.

Learning & Development Opportunities

In this role, the intern will have the opportunity to gain experience, enhance skills, and develop competencies that prepare them for future underwriting and risk management roles, including:

  • Exposure to a corporate insurance and underwriting environment
  • Understanding of underwriting principles and risk evaluation
  • Critical thinking and analytical problem-solving skills
  • Advanced use of data analysis and reporting tools
  • Experience working with business performance metrics and portfolio analysis
  • Ability to develop business recommendations supported by data and research
  • Experience presenting findings and insights to stakeholders
  • Exposure to cross-functional collaboration and business decision-making

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years completed and currently enrolled in a 3rd or 4th year undergraduate program in Risk Management, Finance, Business Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Master's degree candidates will also be considered.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and basic modeling.
  • Interest in insurance, underwriting, risk assessment, and business analytics.

Other Skills

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Professional demeanor and positive attitude.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to learn new systems and applications quickly.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and making sound recommendations based on available information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Experience using data visualization or analytical tools (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar) is a plus.
  • Coursework in insurance, risk management, finance, statistics, or related disciplines preferred.

Remote Opportunity

Paid Internship: $22/hour

Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/7/2027


Note: You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full time basis.

About this job

Conduct on-site and virtual risk assessments for high-value homes in New York City, identifying vulnerabilities and developing customized loss prevention strategies. Serve as trusted advisor to affluent homeowners while supporting underwriting decisions on property characteristics and coverage adequacy.

Good fit if you have 3+ years in risk management, loss control, underwriting, or related property discipline, know residential construction and valuation, and can communicate complex risks clearly.

Full job description

Company Details

Berkley One is a modern insurance provider for a modern generation of affluence. We serve clients who live dynamic, adventurous lives and expect their insurance experience to match. Our mission is to deliver highly personalized risk and claims management through a blend of expert independent agents, cutting-edge digital tools, and the strength of the W.R. Berkley brand.

Why Join Us?
At Berkley One, you'll be part of a forward-thinking team that's reimagining personal insurance. We're building solutions that are as sophisticated and agile as the clients we serve—individuals and families who value innovation, simplicity, and exceptional service. You'll collaborate with passionate professionals, leverage modern technology, and help shape the future of our industry.

What We Value

  • A client-first mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences
  • Curiosity, creativity, and a drive to challenge the status quo
  • Collaboration across disciplines to build smarter, more intuitive solutions
  • Integrity, expertise, and a commitment to excellence

Join us in creating a new standard in personal insurance—where protection meets possibility.

#LI-AV1 #LI-REMOTE

The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.

Responsibilities

As a High Value Home Risk Consultant, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to affluent homeowners, helping them protect their homes, families, and valuable assets from preventable loss. Through on-site and virtual risk assessments, the consultant identifies vulnerabilities and exposures, educates clients on emerging and common risks, and develops practical, customized loss prevention strategies.

By combining technical expertise with a consultative approach, the Risk Consultant helps clients understand their risks, evaluate mitigation options, and make informed decisions that enhance safety, resilience, and long-term asset protection. The role is focused not only on identifying exposures, but also on influencing action and supporting clients throughout their loss prevention journey.

You'll be an essential partner to Underwriting by validating property characteristics, assessing overall risk quality, establishing accurate replacement cost estimates, and escalating material underwriting concerns that may impact eligibility, pricing, or coverage decisions.

This is a fully remote/work-from-home position supporting accounts throughout New York City with heavy concentration in Manhattan, and serving the Brooklyn/Kings county area.

What you can expect:

  • Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
  • Internal mobility opportunities
  • Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
  • Opportunity to impact change
  • Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

We'll count on you to:

  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments for high-value homes to identify exposures that could lead to property damage, personal liability, or threats to client safety and security.

  • Evaluate risks associated with water damage, fire, electrical systems, severe weather, natural catastrophes, homes under construction, personal security, and other exposures common to affluent homeowners.

  • Deliver tailored loss prevention recommendations designed to reduce the likelihood and severity of loss while improving the resilience of the home and lifestyle.

  • Act as a trusted advisor by educating clients on risks, explaining mitigation options, and supporting informed decision-making.

  • Encourage and influence adoption of loss prevention measures through effective consultation, clear communication, and ongoing engagement with clients and brokers.

  • Maintain knowledge of emerging loss trends, technologies, and best practices to provide relevant and actionable risk management guidance.

  • Collaborate with brokers, clients, contractors, and service providers to facilitate the implementation of recommended risk mitigation solutions.

  • Validate and document property characteristics, construction features, protective systems, and occupancy information to support sound underwriting decisions.

  • Develop, validate, and maintain accurate replacement cost estimates to help ensure adequate insurance-to-value.

  • Identify, evaluate, and escalate material underwriting concerns, changes in risk profile, or coverage adequacy issues discovered during the assessment process.

  • Prepare clear and concise risk assessment reports that communicate exposures, recommendations, and underwriting considerations.

  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

What you'll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  • 3+ years of experience in risk management, loss control, underwriting, claims, construction, appraising, or a related property risk discipline.

  • Strong ability to identify property loss exposures and provide effective loss prevention and risk mitigation recommendations.

  • Knowledge of residential construction, building systems, property valuation, and replacement cost methodologies.

  • Experience working with affluent clients and a solid understanding of personal insurance products and risk management principles.

  • Proficiency with e2Value or similar valuation platforms.

  • Exceptional communication, consulting, and relationship-management skills.

  • Customer-focused with the ability to influence action, build trust, and advocate for client needs.

  • Highly organized, accountable, and collaborative, with strong judgment and problem-solving skills.

What makes you stand out:

  • Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement and innovation.

  • Ability to travel throughout the assigned territory, including occasional overnight travel and flexible scheduling

Additional Company Details

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from external recruiting agencies or firms.

The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees which for this role include:
• Base Salary Range: $110,000 - $135,000
• Eligible to participate in annual discretionary bonus.
• Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit-Sharing plans.

The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Hybrid ( #LI-Hybrid ), Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technical solutions that support complex to highly complex business initiatives. The role acts as a subject matter expert to provide systems-level views of technology and devise technical solutions aligned with business objectives. It focuses on enhancing solution design, optimizing development processes, and effectively implementing CI/CD pipelines to deliver impactful solutions that meet business needs. The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving guidance or direction for only the most complex scenarios. Mentors, trains, and coaches team members at all levels.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Partners with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams to understand and address complex to highly complex initiatives within a business unit or at the enterprise level. Leads discussions to gather requirements, develop solutions, validate technology assumptions, and evaluate implementation alternatives. Influences solution strategies by leveraging comprehensive business knowledge and depth of expertise in solution engineering.
  • Acts as a servant leader for the solution by ensuring Agile Release Trains operate effectively. Anticipates and removes constraints across the development and delivery process while collaborating with Release Train Engineers to coordinate delivery. Provides a systems view of the development lifecycle to lead technology delivery and align architecture with business objectives. Serves solutions with multiple Agile Release Trains or business units. Primarily serves solutions at the enterprise level but may support solutions at all levels as needed.
  • Leads multiple technical projects simultaneously by prioritizing and coordinating solution engineering efforts across teams and initiatives. Establishes performance metrics to measure effectiveness and continuously optimize performance. Manages non-functional requirements and ensures compliance with industry standards throughout the solution development and delivery process.
  • Develops and refines robust technical designs to meet business requirements for complex to highly complex solutions while ensuring scalability and performance. Collaborates with developers and Agile Release Trains to align solutions with enterprise architecture. Works with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployment and integrate new features. Engages with quality assurance teams to validate that technical solutions meet performance and reliability standards.
  • Leads development and delivery of complex to highly complex solutions by ensuring technical implementation s align with product roadmaps and overarching business strategies. Monitors progress, resolves issues affecting delivery timelines, and leads technical problem-solving efforts during development and deployment phases. Partners with business stakeholders and technical teams to address challenges and optimize solutions.
  • Oversees the maintenance of technical documentation for solutions to ensure effective knowledge sharing. Engages in continuous learning to stay current with trends and technologies in solution engineering. Applies learning to enhance own skills and impact the achievement of team and project objectives. Acts as a subject matter expert to consult and advise on solution engineering across business units and the enterprise. Leads pioneering of design and development practices to promote innovation and improvements across solutions. Performs other duties as assigned.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish credibility as a trusted AI partner and primary AI contact for both IT and Business organizations.
  • Translate business opportunities into a sequenced portfolio of AI initiatives, clearly defining target outcomes, required capabilities, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Partner across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, and governance teams to identify and remove barriers to execution, accelerate delivery from concept through production, and ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and reusable across the enterprise.
  • Drive adoption of the enterprise Spec-Driven Development (SDD) framework and AI-assisted engineering practices, achieving 90% adoption across targeted teams.
  • Drive measurable business and technology outcomes through faster delivery cycles, improved software quality, increased automation adoption, and successful deployment of AI capabilities that deliver enterprise value.
  • Lead multiple AI initiatives from concept through production readiness, partnering with engineering ensuring successful delivery while proactively removing obstacles and managing risks.
  • Establish reusable AI delivery assets, including implementation playbooks, patterns, templates, evaluation frameworks, governance controls, CI/CD standards, and production-readiness checklists.
  • Build a portfolio of AI success stories and reusable solutions that accelerate adoption across the enterprise.
  • Champion AI adoption across IT through hackathons, innovation challenges, monthly technology summits, workshops, and enablement programs.
  • Coach and enable engineers, architects, product owners, and technical teams on AI technologies, SDD, and modern engineering practices.
  • Ensure all AI solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and AI-driven transformation across the IT organization.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • Bachelors degree required in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 9 years of experience required in solution engineering, software development, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams required.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.
  • Lead Solution Engineer is in support of AI COE / Forward Deployed Engineer in the AI and Automation Team.
  • This role is targeting the IT / Systems AI FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer) in support of Farmers IT Core SDLC Functions.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated written communication skills.
  • Excellent collaboration and team building skills.
  • Demonstrated problem solving skills. Able to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues of varying complexity.
  • Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion.
  • Demonstrated project management skills.
  • Possesses strong technical aptitude. Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite. Deep knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns. Strong proficiency in one or more phases of the software development lifecycle. In-depth knowledge of multiple systems and their key components. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, etc.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

About this job

Senior Claims Specialist at CorVel handles complex Workers' Compensation claims in Las Vegas, managing investigations, reserves, settlements, and subrogation. Works with case managers and attorneys to resolve claims while meeting customer service standards.

Good fit if you have at least 3 years of claims handling experience, a bachelor's degree, current Workers' Compensation certification, and strong written communication skills.

Full job description

The Senior Claims Specialist handles complex and high-profile Workers' Compensation claims following company standards. This role works closely with case managers and attorneys, manages subrogation, and negotiates settlements. The Senior Claims Specialist ensures the best possible outcome for the claim, meeting customer service expectations, and supporting the goals of the Claims Department and CorVel.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Receives Workers' Compensation claim, confirms policy coverage and acknowledgement of the claim
  • Determines validity and compensability of the claim by investigating and gathering information regarding the claim and files necessary documentation with state agencies
  • Establishes reserves and authorizes payments within reserving authority limits
  • Develops and manages well documented action plans with the case manager and outcomes manager to reduce overall cost of the claim
  • Coordinates early return-to-work efforts with the appropriate parties
  • Manages subrogation and litigation of claim as it applies
  • Manages potential claim recoveries of all types
  • Reports claims to the excess carrier when applicable
  • Communicates claim status with the customer and claimant
  • Adheres to client and carrier guidelines and participates in claims review as needed
  • Develops and maintains professional customer relationships
  • Complies with rules and regulations of applicable state
  • Additional duties as assigned

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to assist team members to develop knowledge and understanding of claims practice
  • Ability to identify, analyze and solve problems
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office including Excel spreadsheets
  • Strong interpersonal, time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
  • Knowledge of the entire claims administration, case management and cost containment solution as applicable to Workers' Compensation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree or a combination of education and related experience
  • Minimum of 3 years' industry experience and claim handling
  • Self-Insured Certificate preferred
  • State Certification or license as an experienced claims adjuster
  • Current license or certification in Workers' Compensation must be maintained throughout employment with CorVel

PAY RANGE:

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $61,053 – $98,334

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

ABOUT CORVEL:

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers' compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Take your complex claims expertise to the next level in a highly specialized role focused on some of the most challenging exposures in the casualty space.

As a Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental, you will independently manage sophisticated legacy and long-latency claims involving asbestos, environmental contamination, talc, PFAS, and other mass tort exposures. You will apply advanced coverage analysis, strategic claims handling, negotiation, and litigation management skills to claims arising from historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.

This is an opportunity to join a specialized team where your judgment, technical expertise, and ability to navigate complex coverage issues will have a direct impact. The role supports claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and Canada and offers significant autonomy in managing complex matters from evaluation through resolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Complex Claims & Coverage Analysis

  • Independently manage complex, high-exposure casualty claims involving historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.
  • Analyze historical policy language, underlying facts, applicable law, and long-latency exposures to determine coverage positions and claims strategy.
  • Manage legacy runoff claims arising primarily from policies issued during the 1970s through the mid-1980s.
  • Develop thoughtful, well-supported strategies for resolving complex coverage and liability issues.

Mass Tort & Environmental Claims

  • Handle complex asbestos bodily injury, talc, PFAS, environmental contamination, and other mass tort claims.
  • Evaluate environmental exposures involving soil and groundwater contamination and remediation.
  • Manage claims involving large commercial and industrial insureds with significant liability exposure.
  • Navigate complex, multi-jurisdictional claims across the U.S. and Canada.

Litigation, Negotiation & Resolution

  • Manage litigated claims and coverage actions involving Allstate.
  • Partner with internal and external counsel to develop effective litigation and resolution strategies.
  • Participate in mediations, arbitrations, settlement negotiations, and other dispute-resolution activities.
  • Serve as a witness when required.

Financial & Strategic Management

  • Establish, document, and adjust case reserves and financial projections based on evolving claim exposure.
  • Develop and execute strategic action plans designed to move complex claims toward resolution.
  • Provide clear, well-supported analysis and recommendations to key stakeholders.

Caseload & Operational Excellence

  • Independently manage a diverse portfolio of complex claims while maintaining accurate and thorough documentation.
  • Ensure claim files comply with applicable internal guidelines and standards.
  • Work effectively across multiple claims systems and adapt to evolving technology and AI-supported workflows.
  • Communicate complex coverage and claim issues clearly and effectively in both written and verbal settings.

What You Bring:


Preferred Experience

  • 3+ years of experience handling mass tort, asbestos, environmental, or other long-latency claims.
  • Casualty claims experience involving complex coverage analysis, excess liability policies, or legacy runoff portfolios strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and/or Canada.
  • Experience with litigation, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, or complex claim resolution.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong knowledge of complex casualty claims and coverage analysis.
  • Ability to interpret and apply historical insurance policy language.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven negotiation and settlement capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex, high-exposure matters and competing priorities.
  • Comfort working across multiple systems and adapting to new technology and AI-supported processes.
  • High level of ownership, sound judgment, and accountability in a remote environment.

Why This Role

This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned claims professional who enjoys digging into complex coverage questions, sophisticated litigation, historical policies, and high-exposure claims. You will have the autonomy to own challenging matters while collaborating with experienced claims professionals and legal partners on issues that require both technical expertise and strategic thinking.


Work Environment

  • Remote-friendly opportunity within a highly specialized claims team.
  • Independent role suited for a self-starter who is comfortable taking ownership of complex matters.
  • Collaborative environment with exposure to legal partners and sophisticated casualty claims.

Skills

Claims Administration, Claims Resolution, Complex Claims, Mass Torts, Settlement Negotiations

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 65,600.00 - 110,075.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

About this job

Moderate Inside Property Adjuster role at Allstate in Long Island City, NY, handling virtual damage inspections, claim investigations, and settlements. Hybrid schedule with in-office work Tuesday-Thursday and remote work Monday-Friday.

Good fit if you have 1+ years of customer service experience and can work independently with strong communication and negotiation skills.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This is an IN-OFFICE Hybrid Trainee role in the Allstate Long Island City, NY office

THIS IS AN IN OFFICE ROLE

8:00 5:00 EST

Tuesday,Wednesday, Thursday - In Office

Monday, Friday - Remote

28-07 Jackson Ave

Long Island City, NY 11101

A day in the life of an inside Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Moderate Inside Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. The work schedule is in-office at our Long Island City location on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with remote work on Monday and Friday. Your primary responsibility will involve virtually inspecting damages, investigating coverage, preparing estimates, and settling claims promptly and accurately. You will be interacting with customers, contractors, and vendors through various software platforms such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. This role places a particular focus on water losses, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always. This role involves taking care of customers in their times of need

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule:

8:00 5:00 EST

Tuesday,Wednesday, Thursday - In Office

Monday, Friday - Remote

Preferred Qualifications:

1+ years of previous customer service experience required.

Previous industry experience is highly desired.

Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for virtual assessments is preferred.

Ability to assess property damages and accurately determine claim coverage.

Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.

Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in a virtual work environment.

Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality and efficient claim resolutions.

This role is Hybrid at the Allstate Long Island City Office.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designation

People who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit: www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

This job does not have supervisory duties.
