Good fit if you have 10+ years in executive search or talent acquisition, 7+ years leading executive searches, and experience partnering directly with C-suite executives.

Full job description

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

Senior Director, Executive Recruitment, Talent Intelligence & Advisory

Job Family Grouping:

Human Resources


Job Family:

Talent Acquisition / Executive Recruitment


How does this role contribute to our collective success?

The Senior Director, Executive Recruitment, Talent Intelligence & Advisory serves as AXIS' lead advisor on executive talent acquisition, external succession intelligence, and strategic leadership hiring. Reporting to the Global Head of Talent Acquisition, this individual partners directly with the CEO, Executive Committee (EXCO), senior business leaders, and Human Resources leadership to identify, assess, attract, and advise on executive talent decisions that support the organization's long-term business strategy and leadership objectives.

This role combines the disciplines of executive search, talent intelligence, market mapping, competitive talent research, leadership assessment, and executive advisory. The successful candidate will lead highly visible executive and mission-critical searches while building and maintaining external succession pipelines for critical leadership positions across the enterprise.

The Senior Director will provide an external market perspective to senior leadership, helping inform executive hiring decisions, succession planning discussions, organizational design considerations, and future leadership capability needs. The role requires exceptional judgment, executive presence, intellectual curiosity, discretion, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders through data, insight, and market intelligence.


What will you do in this role?

  • Lead end-to-end executive and senior leadership searches globally across all business functions.
  • Partner with the CEO, EXCO, Board-facing executives, and senior Group/P&L leaders to define leadership requirements and develop search strategies.
  • Design and execute search plans including market mapping, target company identification, candidate engagement, assessment methodology, stakeholder alignment, and offer strategy.
  • Personally identify, engage, assess, and recruit senior executive talent, including highly passive candidates.
  • Develop and present executive candidate slates supported by market intelligence and candidate assessment insights.
  • Facilitate executive interview processes, stakeholder calibration discussions, and finalist evaluations.
  • Partner with Total Rewards, Legal, HR, and business leaders on executive offer development, negotiation, and closing strategies.
  • Deliver a differentiated executive candidate experience reflective of AXIS's leadership brand and culture.
  • Develop and maintain executive talent maps and external succession pipelines for enterprise-critical leadership roles.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership regarding executive talent strategy, market intelligence, organizational capability, and succession planning.
  • Manage executive assessment processes, external search firms, and strategic talent intelligence partnerships.
  • Drive operational excellence, governance, compliance, reporting, and continuous improvement across executive recruitment activities.

You may also be required to take on additional duties, responsibilities, and activities appropriate to the nature of this role.


About You

We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and helping us achieve our goals.


What you need to have:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in executive search, executive recruitment, talent intelligence, talent advisory, or related talent acquisition disciplines.
  • Minimum of 7 years leading executive or senior leadership searches with direct responsibility for search strategy, market mapping, executive assessment, candidate engagement, stakeholder management, and offer completion.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering directly with C-suite executives, Executive Committee members, or equivalent senior business leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting executive market mapping, talent intelligence, competitive talent analysis, or succession-related research initiatives.
  • Experience developing executive candidate assessments, market intelligence reports, leadership profiles, and executive presentations.
  • Experience identifying and recruiting passive executive talent.
  • Experience managing retained executive search firms and external talent partners.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent executive searches and confidential talent initiatives.
  • Experience advising senior business leaders on executive talent decisions.
  • Working knowledge of executive recruiting technologies, applicant tracking systems, talent intelligence platforms, CRM systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, and executive research tools.
  • Ability to travel globally as business needs require.

What we prefer you to have:

  • Experience working within insurance, reinsurance, financial services, professional services, consulting, or similarly complex global organizations.
  • Experience supporting CEO, Board, Executive Committee, or enterprise-critical recruitment initiatives.
  • Experience conducting external succession planning and executive talent benchmarking projects.
  • Experience advising senior executives regarding organizational design, leadership capability, and executive talent strategy.
  • Experience recruiting leaders with significant P&L responsibility and enterprise-wide accountability.
  • Experience conducting executive recruiting and talent intelligence activities across multiple geographies and international markets.
  • Experience managing highly confidential leadership, succession, or organizational-change initiatives.
  • Experience utilizing AI-enabled recruiting, talent intelligence, or market research tools.
  • Advanced degree or professional certification related to executive search, leadership assessment, human resources, talent acquisition, or organizational effectiveness.

Role Factors

In this role, you will typically be required to:

  • Travel globally as business needs require.
  • Work with highly confidential executive, succession, and organizational information.
  • Engage regularly with senior executives, external leadership candidates, and search partners.
  • Utilize talent intelligence, market research, and executive recruitment technologies.
  • Participate in a hybrid work environment consistent with organizational requirements.

What We Offer

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $200,000 - $250,000 (NY). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.


Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes

Job Description – North American Cyber Insurance Pricing Lead

Title: North American Cyber Insurance Pricing Lead
Reports to: Global Head of Cyber Pricing
Department: Insurance Actuarial
Location: New York

Job Summary:

The Pricing team has responsibility for developing consistent pricing practices across the AXIS Insurance segment and is primarily responsible for pricing, product and portfolio monitoring and construction, profitability studies, new business / product development, price adequacy metric development and monitoring, and business planning. It is expected that the Pricing team will interact extensively with other functions including Underwriting, Reserving, Risk and Group Underwriting Analytics (GUA).

The Cyber Practice is responsible for providing pricing support to all cyber insurance business written by US, Canada and London offices.

This role has overall responsibility for providing pricing support on US and Canadian business, and may be asked to assist with London-based business as well.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop/maintain pricing models and train underwriters to ensure a consistent approach across the US and Canada
• Deliver quarterly product monitoring (profitability) analyses for to identify any potential issues and / or business opportunities, and assist underwriters in developing subsequent action plans & strategy
• Assist underwriters as needed in the evaluation of large account or facilities pricing
• Derive expected loss ratios for financial planning taking into account business strategy, market conditions, mix of business, trends and reinsurance structure
• Work with Cyber Portfolio Management Lead to ensure risk / accumulation potential is evaluated appropriately for and allowed for in pricing metrics
• Work with Ceded Reinsurance to produce information for reinsurance submissions and present information as needed to reinsurers / brokers
• Report accurate and up to date rate monitoring data and advise on the impact of emerging rating trends on underwriting strategy
• Recommend and assist with the implementation of more comprehensive data capture as needed to support monitoring
• Lead team of analyst(s), rotational graduates and interns

Required Qualifications, Skills & Experience

• At least 10 years' insurance industry experience – pricing experience preferable
• Fellow or Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society or equivalent
• Knowledge of cyber as a product and / or a peril preferred
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to establish credibility with both internal and external stakeholders
• Thoroughness, attention to detail and diligence
• Self-starter, proactive and with the ability to develop, recommend and implement new approaches
• Competent user of Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SQL, VBA


For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $185,000-$225 (NY). Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location. 

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.

About this job

Outside Auto Appraiser at Travelers Insurance in Barnstable, Massachusetts. Inspect damaged vehicles, estimate repair costs, determine total loss values, and settle claims. Remote-based role with work at customer and repair facility locations.

Good fit if you have two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience, an active adjuster license, valid driver's license, and proficiency with claims management software.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$65,400.00 - $108,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

$25.00 - $26.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role. Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) Underwriting Internship Program provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand experience, receive valuable on-the-job training and learn more about the property & casualty insurance industry. What exactly is an Underwriter? Insurance is the contractual transfer of financial risk from one party to another. Underwriters (Account Executives) are the heart of the insurance process, gathering and researching pertinent information and then using finely tuned analytical skills to evaluate the acceptability of business and institutional risk. However, underwriters are more than just analysts - they are the core relationship builders with our agents and clients. They are responsible for managing a profitable portfolio of business through our distributing agents and brokers. An underwriting career includes a dynamic blend of analytical and marketing skills - it's challenging, stimulating and a superb career choice. BSI provides management liability, professional liability and surety to businesses of all sizes. It also provides traditional property casualty coverages to financial institutions, and is organized into six separate and distinct business units which include: Commercial Surety (protects a third party from the failure of an insured to perform or fulfill an obligation); Construction Services (insuring the bond between contractors and clients); Financial Institutions (insurance for community banks, credit unions, insurance companies, investment advisors and large depository & non-depository institutions); Private/Non Profit Liability (insurance products for private companies and non-profit institutions); Professional Liability (coverage protects against liability claims for negligence, errors and omissions in the performance of professional services; and Public Company Liability (insurance products crafted to address the diverse management liability exposures faced by today's public companies.) Positions last approximately 10-12 weeks beginning in late May/early June and ending in mid-August. Housing assistance is not provided.

What Will You Do?

  • Each intern will be expected to complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program. In addition, there are core assignments and a designated coach to further develop interns' knowledge of insurance underwriting, sales and marketing.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Participate in the Enterprise Internship experience which includes Executive Speaker Series, Networking events, and Rising Senior Intern Symposium.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Management, Marketing, Risk Management and Insurance.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing or obtained a Bachelor's degree.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Underwriters perform the critical function of evaluating the acceptability of risk and determining appropriate pricing for insurance products. The Business Insurance (BI) Underwriting Professional Development Internship Program provides students with an amazing opportunity to gain exposure to this critical function at Travelers. The 10-week program (running from early June to mid-August) provides qualified interns with an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand commercial insurance underwriting experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn more about the property and casualty insurance industry from industry professionals. Given that, we are seeking interns that are serious about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making underwriting their future career choice. This role is a potential pathway to our full-time Underwriting Professional Development Program (UPDP). Housing assistance is not provided.

  • Participate and complete self-paced professional development courses in time management, presentation skills, and other key areas.
  • Complete challenging and meaningful project work over the course of this program at the discretion of your manager. You may work independently or with other interns and will be asked to present your findings to local leadership. Sample projects include a territorial risk assessment to determine profitability and underwriting opportunities as well as a business process analysis to determine underwriting gaps.
  • Learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • Learn about other areas at Travelers such as Risk Control, Claims, and related corporate functions. Interns may also engage in agency visits with Account Executives.

As an Associate Claim Rep, Workers Compensation, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.

  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Communicate and apprise all parties regarding claim status which may include our business customers, injured employees, medical providers, and legal counsel.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Achieve a positive result by returning an injured party to work when appropriate. This may include coordinating medical treatment in collaboration with internal or external resources.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.

What Is the Opportunity?

At Travelers, we're building the future of insurance - and Team Breeze is at the center of that work. This role puts you at the intersection of large language models (LLMs), cloud-native infrastructure, and real business impact. If you've shipped AI agent systems to production and want to do it again at scale, we'd like to talk.

What Will You Do?

  • Lead the design, configuration and development of complex, high-visibility AI applications on Team Breeze with a focus on LLM agents, retrieval pipelines and production reliability.
  • Design and implement agent orchestration flows using AWS Bedrock AgentCore and/or frameworks such as LangGraph, including tool calling, routing and prompt strategies for Claude models on Bedrock.
  • Own the retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline end to end - from document ingestion (SharePoint/LivePublish to S3), processing and embedding in Databricks, and serving from a vector store via Python retrieval APIs (FastAPI/Haystack) - including evaluation steps that measure retrieval and answer quality before each release.
  • Architect and build services on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront/Lambda@Edge, Route 53, Secrets Manager/Vault and Bedrock application inference profiles to track and manage cost.
  • Develop and operate containerized retrieval and evaluation services on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), deployed with Helm and ArgoCD, including OpenTelemetry collector integration exporting traces to Dynatrace, S3 and Braintrust.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code and CI/CD using Terraform (Terraform Enterprise), GitHub Actions and TEP pipelines to deliver reliable, repeatable deployments.
  • Build and maintain the application layer across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 (Lambda xAPIs) and React 19/Vite for front-end UI experiences.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical, high-impact production issues, including debugging across AWS services, Kubernetes workloads, data pipelines and observability tooling.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to teammates, fostering strong engineering practices around design documentation, testing, evaluations, code reviews and operational readiness.
  • Continuously apply knowledge of current AI/LLM, cloud and observability trends to improve system design, developer productivity and business outcomes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • LLM and Agent Systems
    • Demonstrated experience shipping LLM/agent systems to production - not just demos or prototypes.
    • Hands-on knowledge of tool calling, prompt and routing design, RAG retrieval quality tuning, and defining evaluations to measure LLM and retrieval performance.
    • Experience with Strands, LangGraph or Bedrock AgentCore is a plus.
  • Cloud, Infrastructure and Operations
    • Strong AWS serverless and EKS experience; able to design and debug systems spanning Lambda, API Gateway and Kubernetes-based containers in production.
    • Practical experience authoring and maintaining Terraform, Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, TEP).
    • Observability fluency: tracing with OpenTelemetry or Dynatrace, structured logging with correlation IDs, cost tracking and incident handling.
  • Full-Stack and Data Pipeline Ownership
    • Comfortable working across Python and TypeScript/Node 24 in the service layer and React 19/Vite on the front end.
    • Familiar with data and retrieval pipelines from ingestion through embedding to vector-store-backed APIs.
    • Consistent habit of writing tests, evaluations and data-quality checks.
  • Delivery
    • Advanced delivery skills, including the ability to determine software design strategy and methodology, use automated tests and informed feedback loops to ensure quality and production readiness, and monitor the health of work efforts and adjacent systems.
  • Domain Expertise
    • Demonstrated track record of developing business partnerships and influencing priorities by identifying solutions aligned with current business objectives; closely follows industry trends relevant to the domain and shares knowledge with coworkers.

  • Leadership
    • Takes action even when there is no clear owner; inspires and motivates others and is effective at influencing team members.

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers Insurance is seeking a highly motivated and knowledgeable Associate Claim Counsel to join our Bond & Specialty Insurance team. Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) provides management and professional liability, cyber, crime insurance, and surety bonds to or on behalf of businesses and/or nonprofits of all sizes. The BSI Claim Counsel team conducts thorough investigation, analysis, evaluation, and disposition of claims and claim litigation to achieve superior customer service and to optimize claim results. As an Associate Claim Counsel, you will effectively manage all assigned BSI claims, typically of lower severity and complexity within our organization, and with close supervision from management. You will manage outside counsel relationships, negotiate settlements, and ensure stakeholders are supported throughout the claims process. In addition to comprehensive claim and risk management, you also will provide legal advice and/or insight to our underwriting colleagues and non-attorney claim colleagues and participate in BSI claim strategic initiatives.

What Will You Do?

  • Analyze, investigate, and resolve Bond & Specialty Claims of lower severity and complexity with close supervision, following operational policies.
  • With close management supervision, retain, monitor, and manage outside counsel (and other vendors, as applicable) by actively utilizing incident response and/or litigation management plans and budgets, and negotiate settlements when appropriate to ensure effective legal and/or claim outcomes, involving litigation matters of lower severity and complexity.
  • Prepare management reports on loss development, financial exposure, and resolution strategies with a high degree of guidance from management.
  • Develop and coordinate recovery efforts with the Recovery Management Unit to optimize loss mitigation opportunities, as needed.
  • Attend mediations, settlement conferences, trials, depositions to support claim resolution, and may attend other internal/external business meetings with supervision as needed.
  • With significant supervision, provide a variety of legal and business support to underwriting colleagues which varies by business unit and may include negotiating indemnity documentation, drafting product forms and endorsements, reviewing contracts and bond forms, all involving matters of lower complexity, and supporting marketing and/or risk management efforts through broker visits and seminars.
  • Ensure stakeholders/customers feel 'secure, respected, and cared for' throughout the duration of the claims process.
  • Ensure compliance with BSI Claims processes, procedures, and best practices.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of claim activities, decisions, and communications, adhering to record-keeping standards and confidentiality protocols.
  • To perform the essential functions of this job, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance Adjuster License(s) is required to comply with state and Travelers' requirements. Generally, license(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the job and must obtain ongoing continuing education credits as mandated. Additionally, the maintenance of an active legal license in the state of your principal office location and remaining current with all Continuing Legal Education (CLE) is required to perform this role.
  • All Surety
  • With significant oversight, provide legal review and advice to underwriters on bond obligations and project contract documents. Review, draft and/or modify bond forms and contract documents, all involving matters of lower complexity.
  • Engage in account workout risk mitigation analysis, advise on mitigation strategies, and assist in execution of such strategies with assistance from management.
  • With oversight from management, monitor account bankruptcy proceedings and document post-bankruptcy indemnity. Draft and file proofs of claim and advise as to potential recovery and retain outside counsel as necessary.
  • Determine whether bond exposure has expired, including for the purpose of releasing collateral, by reviewing bond terms, applicable law, and court dockets (when applicable).
  • Review documents pertaining to mergers, equity sales and asset sales to determine the legal status and ownership of indemnitors undergoing a change of control. With assistance from management, assist with drafting and negotiating appropriate agreements to document indemnity changes related to such transactions.
  • Construction Surety
  • With significant oversight, assist with the drafting and modifying of takeover agreements, completion agreements, subcontractor ratification agreements, and any other documents necessary to mitigate risk and discharge the Company's bond obligations concerning the takeover and completion of construction projects.
  • Commercial Surety
  • Review, draft, and modify a variety of bond forms, contract documents, and other agreements (including but not limited to indemnity and collateral) for various industry sectors including healthcare, financial institutions, power and utilities, oil and gas, court requirements, and self-insurance obligations
  • Participate in underwriting focus groups for particular industries and draft internal white papers.
  • Under close supervision, analyze commercial contract provisions and advise the business with respect to contract risk mitigation.
  • Management Liability
  • Prepare timely and thorough coverage evaluations and correspondence to Insureds.
  • Maintain and note claim files pursuant to company best practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • One to five years of relevant legal or claim handling work experience.
  • Ability to effectively work through conflict and resolve issues with a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and negotiate terms and conditions within designated authority limit.
  • Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate coverage determinations.
  • Solid time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities with an attention to detail, data and analytics.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective and collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Juris Doctor Degree.
  • Properly licensed, registered or authorized, and in good standing, to practice law in the jurisdiction in which you will be working.
  • Valid driver's license or access to alternative means of transportation to travel to mediations, conferences, field offices, trials, and/or depositions.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

About this job

Develop and scale automotive business solutions at Assurant by translating dealer and partner needs into practical requirements. The role combines deep automotive industry expertise with cross-functional leadership to drive solution adoption and business growth.

Good fit if you have 8+ years of hands-on automotive experience as a dealer GM, F&I director, or OEM leader, with strong commercial judgment and ability to travel occasionally.

Full job description

The Automotive Business Solutions Lead brings deep automotive industry and operating knowledge to the development, adoption and scaling of business solutions. The role translates dealer, partner and segment needs into practical business requirements, supports consistent solution positioning, and coordinates adoption and vendor follow-through for assigned initiatives. It strengthens continuity of business expertise within Executive Strategy & Innovation and helps build a repeatable approach to scaling solutions across business lines.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Serve as the business expert on client economics, F&I operations, workflows, and partner decision-making.
  • Translate market needs into clear business requirements and fit assessments.
  • Validate use cases, challenge assumptions, and help prioritize product roadmap initiatives.
  • Lead onboarding, workflow testing, access readiness, and adoption support for new launches.
  • Gather feedback, identify adoption barriers, and coordinate issue resolution during launch periods.
  • Create guidance materials and transition ongoing ownership to business stakeholders.
  • Enable account teams with solution details, FAQs, messaging, and sales/discussion resources.
  • Partner with Marketing, business leaders, and vendors to support execution and communications.
  • Consolidate workflow feedback, address business objections, and assess release readiness.
  • Evaluate scope, timelines, costs, and business impacts, recommending next steps for leaders.
  • Apply market, competitor, and industry insights to identify growth and expansion opportunities.
  • Provide reporting, risk assessments, and recommendations while continuously improving future launches and business-fit evaluations.


What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • 8+ years of hands-on industry operating experience as a dealer general manager, F&I director, OEM or commercial-equipment field leader, or in F&I administrator operations.
  • Deep automotive industry and business knowledge is essential and the first selection priority, including credibility in client economics, operating workflows and dealer or partner decision-making.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent operating experience.
  • Strong commercial judgment and ability to translate industry insight into practical business requirements and recommendations.
  • Skilled in constructive challenge, cross-functional influence and clear communication without formal authority.
  • Able to assess workflow fit, understand adoption barriers and coordinate vendor follow-through.
  • Business fluency in AI-enabled solutions is required; technical development expertise is not.
  • Ability to undertake regular client and dealer travel.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • A proven record of solution adoption and scaling is preferred, secondary to deep industry knowledge; solution-specific practices can be developed through training.
  • An established industry network, multi-channel operating experience, familiarity with competitor approaches, and experience supporting launches with innovation teams and solution partners are also preferred.

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

General office demands

How much should I expect to travel?

Occasional travel required for team meetings, leadership summits, or business reviews.

The Order Management Coordinator will serve as a liaison between Operations/Fulfilment/Planning/Customer Experience areas and Order Management Specialist under the guidance and supervision of Order Management Manager to support customer priorities based on changes in supply, product availability, or changing customer requirements.

Offer Guidance and execution plans with troubleshooting on all insurance claims and other order types to identify and execute various enhancements to all order management processes.

Follow standard procedures and policies with Order Management Specialists and other organization stakeholders using judgment and on-the-job knowledge in responding to internal customers.

The OM Coordinator should demonstrate expertise in problem solving, bringing new ideas and creative solutions to existing processes and issues.

This individual will act as a trainer to Order Management specialists by sharing knowledge and expertise within the department.


This is an onsite role in our Irving, TX facility with a schedule of Monday - Friday, 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?


  • This is a highly technical job, where understanding of order flow, process flow and above average knowledge of the Operating system is crucial for successful performance
  • Manage all communication with Materials, Operations and Fulfilment centers and in order to satisfy and process all insurance orders and timely shipment of devices within SLA.
  • Using current warehouse management system (Oracle) to modify, migrate and push orders using technical knowledge in order to facilitate order flow until shipment.
  • Verify all order lines and prepare reports on everyday basis and manage all shipment and respond to all inquiries for all status order and resolve all order issues
  • Monitor and evaluate all order issues and resolve using tools available
  • Work in tandem with Purchasing department in order to resolve escalations for claims which can't be satisfied based on current stock availability
  • Using tools available, this position is responsible to generate multiple reports in order to send priority and urgency to other departments. For example: Priorities needed to satisfy backorders. Receiving daily priorities, Kitting Priorities
  • Technical research for current claims needing migration of existing models and execute those migrations in order to satisfy claims within SLA.
  • Communicate with the Planning Department on devices that need to be prioritized from Production lines for all programs.
  • Ensure FIFO is followed to satisfy older claims
  • Depending on program and customer additional research will be needed in order to move orders from Entered status into Booked status, allowing the orders to be cascaded within the system
  • Create different feedback reports to monitor overall SLA attainment on a daily/monthly basis and publish this data to stakeholders
  • Create reports of status, pending shipment, and overall status of claims at a model level for all programs and the action items needed to fulfil and troubleshoot orders
  • Other duties as assigned

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of distribution and logistics background.
  • MS Excel proficiency in order to manage large amount of data
  • MS Word proficiency in order to create basic documents and reports
  • Good communication skills in order to interact and influence others

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • BS/BA on a technical field preferred
  • Oracle experience a plus.
  • Experience in inventory control, material management/movement of more than 2 years desired

What are the working conditions and physical requirements of this job?

  • Occasional: bending, squatting, kneeling, reaching, twisting, exposure to changes in temperature, being near moving machinery, and office machinery
  • This position requires incumbents to regularly sit at a desk and operate standard office equipment such as a computer and phone
  • Employee is occasionally required to stand and walk, lift, carry and/or move up to 40 pounds
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus
  • Ability to talk and hear
  • Required to use hands and fingers, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

Job.JobDescription:
Help Shape the Future of Claims Learning


We're seeking an experienced property claims professional to help build and deliver technical learning programs that strengthen claim handling quality, compliance, customer outcomes, and associate development.

In this role, you'll combine deep claims expertise with training, coaching, and quality analysis to identify performance opportunities, develop learning solutions, and influence claims excellence across the organization.


What You'll Do


Build Learning Solutions

  • Design and develop technical training, job aids, claim scenarios, assessments, and learning resources.
  • Translate audit findings, regulatory changes, and business initiatives into practical learning solutions.
  • Support onboarding, continuing education, and performance improvement programs.

Deliver Training & Develop Talent

  • Facilitate engaging instructor-led and virtual learning experiences.
  • Lead technical claims, compliance, quality, and operational training initiatives.
  • Serve as a trusted resource supporting associate growth and capability development.

  • Reliable, follows through on commitments.

  • Ability to work through questions and concerns collaboratively
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with CRM, portfolio management and financial planning software is a plus.

Job.JobDescription:
CorVel Corporation is hiring a caring, self-motivated, energetic and independent registered nurse to fill a Medical Case Manager position in California.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager, you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

This is a remote position

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides in-person and telephonic Medical Case Management to individuals, involving the patient, physician, other health care providers, the employer, and the referral source
  • Utilizes their medical and nursing knowledge to discuss the current treatment plan with the physician and discuss alternate treatment plans
  • Provides assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation of patient's progress
  • Evaluates patient's treatment plan for appropriateness, medical necessity, and cost effectiveness
  • Attends doctors, other providers, home and in some cases, attorney's visits
  • Attends hospital and/or long-term facility discharge planning conferences, etc. for the purpose of determining appropriateness of care and developing an effective long-term care strategy
  • Conducts home visit for initial evaluation
  • Implements care such as negotiating the delivery of durable medical equipment and nursing services
  • This role requires regular travel, dependent on the injured worker's injuries and needs. The employee must be available for local travel up to approximately 60% of the work week/month
  • This role may require overnight travel
  • Complies with all safety rules and regulations during working hours in conjunction with the Injury and Illness Prevention Program (“IIPP”)
  • Additional duties as required

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Effective communication and multi-tasking skills in a high-volume, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers
  • A cost containment background, such as utilization review or managed care is helpful
  • Strong interpersonal, time management, and organizational skills
  • Computer proficiency and technical aptitude with the ability to utilize Microsoft Office, including Excel spreadsheets
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience as an RN Medical Case Manager is ideal, or a clinical background in orthopedics, neurology, or rehabilitation is preferred
  • Graduate of accredited school of nursing
  • Current RN Licensure in state of operation
  • Certification as a CCM, CIRS, or other Case Management certifications preferred
  • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to assigned locations is required

PAY RANGE

CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.

For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.

Pay Range: $30.64 - $45.80 per hour

A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers | Opportunities in Risk Management

In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry-leading risk management solutions for the workers' compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE-IT!).

A comprehensive benefits package is available for full-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off. About this job

Vice President leading sales enablement for CorVel's national sales organization, responsible for strengthening execution consistency, leadership effectiveness, and adoption of sales methodology. Remote position focused on improving pipeline quality, coaching practices, and overall sales performance through cross-functional partnerships.

Good fit if you have 12+ years in enterprise sales leadership or enablement, strong B2B execution experience, and background in insurance or healthcare.

Full job description

The Vice President, Sales Enablement plays a critical leadership role in strengthening execution, leadership effectiveness, and consistency across CorVel's national sales organization. This role reinforces and advances the consistent application of CorVel's Sales Performance System, ensuring that strategy, methodology, and expectations are effectively applied in how the organization sells. Through close partnership with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams, this role improves how the organization executes, supporting stronger pipeline quality, more consistent selling practices, and overall sales performance.

This is a remote position.

Core Purpose:

Strengthen execution, leadership effectiveness, and consistency in how the organization sells.

This role enables leaders and sellers to operate with clarity, discipline, and alignment, supporting improved sales performance across the organization.

Role within the Sales Performance System:

The Vice President, Sales Enablement leads the Enablement and Field Leadership (ENABLE and LEAD) pillars of CorVel's Sales Performance System, with direct responsibility for strengthening sales capability, leadership effectiveness, and execution consistency across the organization.

In this role, the Vice President partners with pillar owners to reinforce consistent execution across the broader system:

  • Positioning (POSITION) – in partnership with Marketing to support consistent use of messaging in the field
  • Sales Process Execution (SELL) – in partnership with Sales to reinforce consistent use of the sales process
  • Commercial Execution (WIN) – in partnership with Sales and Marketing to support clear and consistent value articulation
  • Performance Optimization (OPTIMIZE) – in partnership with Finance and Sales to share field insight and support alignment

The role supports alignment of the overall sales strategy (ALIGN) and ensures the system is consistently applied across the organization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Performance & Capability Development:

  • Delivering training that builds core selling skills and improves confidence and effectiveness across the sales team

And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.

  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of an Inside Property Adjuster, and what it take to do the job!

As an Inside Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve virtually inspecting damages, investigating coverage, preparing estimates, and settling claims promptly and accurately. You will be interacting with customers, contractors, and vendors through various software platforms such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. This role places a particular focus on water losses, ensuring that our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule:

During Training: IN OFFICE

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-4:30pm

After Training: HYBRID (IN OFFICE & REMOTE)

  • Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm with rotational Saturday duty

  • Mondays and Fridays (remote)

  • Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays (in-office)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of previous customer service experience.

  • Excellent organization skills.

  • Ability to multi-task.

  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills to interact with customers and stakeholders remotely.

  • Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently in an office and virtual work environment.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality and efficient claim resolutions.

  • Previous industry experience is highly desired.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing anadditionalbackground check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you willbe requiredto secure license(s) within60 daysof hire.

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license mustterminateall existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license wheninstructed toby the licensing team. Byproceedingwith the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree tocomply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/orapplicableAppraiser License.

  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as anAllstater,youllenjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit:www.allstategoodlife.comto learn more.

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Experience: 5+ years

About this job

Lead consultant role defining and ensuring high-quality measurement practices across Allstate's Claims organization. Combines analytics expertise with consulting and stakeholder management through short-term consulting engagements, long-term embedded partnerships, and educational initiatives.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in analytics, data science, or statistics with demonstrated experience designing experiments and causal inference analyses.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Measurement Science Lead Consultant combines deep analytical expertise with strong consulting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. This role is responsible for defining and ensuring high-quality measurement practices across Claims. This role serves as a strategic leader and subject matter expert, partnering with business and analytics teams to ensure initiatives are measured accurately, enabling confident, data-driven decision making. Reducing the risk of misinformed decisions is critical to the future success of Allstate.
The role is guided by 3 core pillars.
Consult: We have short term consulting engagements with teams across claims. These engagements are used to provide feedback and course correct measurement on specific projects.
Embed: We have long-term engagements. This role periodically serves as a dedicated resource within business and product teams, providing hands-on analytical support, domain expertise, and partnership to help achieve strategic objectives.
Educate: We help educate claims leaders and employees on how to think about and execute with measurement science.

Communication & Stakeholder Influence

  • Translate complex analytical concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Present findings, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Build strong partnerships across Claims, Analytics, Technology and Finance.
  • Lead complex measurement engagements involving multiple stakeholders.

Measurement Strategy & Consulting

  • Partner with business leaders to define business objectives, success metrics, assumptions, and measurement approaches.
  • Provide consultative expertise on measurement design and business outcomes. Ensure analyses are accurate, defensible, and aligned to business objectives.
  • Identify measurement risks and opportunities that could impact decision quality.
  • Promote consistent measurement standards, frameworks, and best practices.

Experimental Design & Evaluation

  • Design and execute experiments, quasi-experiments, and observational studies.
  • Apply statistical and causal inference methods to evaluate business initiatives.
  • Establish baselines, control groups, and success criteria to support valid attribution.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, measurement science, economics, statistics, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience designing experiments, causal inference analyses, or program evaluations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience influencing decisions through analytics and business consulting.
  • Experience working in matrixed organizations and partnering with senior business stakeholders.
  • Claims experience preferred but not required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in statistical analysis, experimentation, and causal inference.
  • Experience with advanced analytics tools and programming languages (Python, R, SQL).
  • Strong business acumen and ability to connect analytics to business outcomes.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-paced environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking capabilities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Measurement practices are consistently applied across high-impact Claims initiatives
  • Claims leaders trust measurement outputs and use them to drive decisions
  • Initiatives have clear, defensible impact assessments
  • Measurement risks are identified early and mitigated proactively

Skills

Analytics, Business Analysis, Business Case Analyses, Business Model Development, Data Analytics, Data Science, Problem Solving, Statistical Analysis

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 98,100.00 - 167,850.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Vended Application Senior Consultant II (Zscaler) serves as an experienced contributor for enterprise security platforms, with a primary focus on Zscaler technologies. This role is responsible for supporting, configuring, optimizing, and enhancing cloud-delivered security services that enable secure access to applications, data, and internet resources across the enterprise. The role contributes to platform improvements, operational excellence, and technical solution design while serving as a trusted resource within their area of expertise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, configure, and support Zscaler platforms including ZIA, ZPA, and related security services.
  • Support secure internet access, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SSL inspection, web security, DNS security, and cloud-delivered security controls.
  • Partner with network, security, cloud, identity, and application teams to implement solutions that meet business and security requirements.
  • Evaluate business and technical requirements and recommend appropriate platform capabilities, policies, and configurations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user access, application connectivity, traffic forwarding, authentication, policy enforcement, and performance issues.
  • Configure and manage security policies, access controls, application segments, forwarding profiles, and authentication integrations.
  • Lead or support moderately complex platform enhancements, deployments, and operational initiatives.
  • Review, test, and validate vendor software releases, new features, and service enhancements.
  • Participate in functional, integration, user acceptance, and post-implementation testing.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, APIs, scripting, and process improvements.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, vendor support engagements, and problem investigations.

Experience (preferred)

  • 5 or more years of experience supporting enterprise security technologies.
  • Experience administering or supporting Zscaler solutions within a large enterprise environment.
  • Experience supporting cloud-delivered security platforms, secure web gateways, Zero Trust solutions, or related technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting network connectivity, authentication, DNS, proxy, SSL/TLS, and application access issues.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, or other SSE/SASE platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust architecture and modern enterprise security principles.
  • Experience with REST APIs, automation, and scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Git-based workflows, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise cloud environments including AWS and Azure.

Job Description

The Vended Application Senior Consultant I (Zscaler) serves as a subject matter resource for enterprise security platforms, with a primary focus on Zscaler technologies. This role partners with business, security, network, cloud, and infrastructure teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable solutions using cloud-delivered security services. The role is responsible for configuring, supporting, optimizing, and enhancing enterprise deployments while aligning platform capabilities with business and security requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, configure, and support Zscaler platforms including ZIA, ZPA, and related security services.
  • Support secure internet access, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SSL inspection, web security, DNS security, and cloud-delivered security controls.
  • Partner with network, security, cloud, identity, and application teams to implement solutions that meet business and security requirements.
  • Evaluate business and technical requirements and recommend appropriate platform capabilities, policies, and configurations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user access, application connectivity, traffic forwarding, authentication, policy enforcement, and performance issues.
  • Configure and manage security policies, access controls, application segments, forwarding profiles, and authentication integrations.
  • Review, test, and validate vendor software releases, new features, and service enhancements.
  • Participate in functional, integration, user acceptance, and post-implementation testing.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, APIs, scripting, and process improvements.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, vendor support engagements, and problem investigations.

Experience (preferred)

  • 3 or more years of experience supporting enterprise security technologies.
  • Experience administering or supporting Zscaler solutions within a large enterprise environment.
  • Experience supporting cloud-delivered security platforms, secure web gateways, Zero Trust solutions, or related technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting network connectivity, authentication, DNS, proxy, SSL/TLS, and application access issues.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, or other SSE/SASE platforms.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust architecture and modern enterprise security principles.
  • Experience with REST APIs, automation, and scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Git-based workflows, and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience supporting enterprise cloud environments including AWS and Azure.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Sales Manager, Insurance Sales, Insurance Sales Representative
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues

Develops and maintains the assigned markets new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level & coach new TSMs

Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software

Collaborates with Independent Agents to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results

Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on Specialty Vehicle & Household package coverages (based on state availability)

Delivers on the business units annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on SV & HH package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director

Consults with IAs by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position NGAAC products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity

Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies

Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan

Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and UW trends filed and implemented in the market


Candidates must reside in the greater Bay Area (San Jose, San Francisco, Vallejo, Salinas)


Experience

3 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.


Skills

Consultative Selling, Insurance Products, Relationship Building, Strategic Collaboration, Territory Sales Management

Compensation

Base Salary: $85,000 - $90,000 plus incentives based on performance
