Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Louisville, KY
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Property Claims Adjuster, Claims, Claims Adjuster
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $72,000 to $115,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Louisville, KY
  • Experience: 4 to 5 years
  • License: Valid driver's license

About this job

Large Loss Property Adjuster conducting on-site inspections, investigating coverage, and settling claims for Allstate in Louisville. Role involves traveling to customer homes and handling virtual claims countrywide, with focus on water losses using Xactimate and other software.

Good fit if you have 4-5 years of outside property adjuster experience, proficiency with Xactimate, and can physically access roofs and carry equipment.

Full job description

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Large Loss Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • 4-5 years previous experience as an outside property adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • Reside within 40 miles of Louisville, KY

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:


  • Must be able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access roofs with up to a 6/12 pitch.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:


  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

** Please note, you will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:


  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:


Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

About this job

Direct Sales Agent Specialist for National General Insurance selling home, auto, and accident and health insurance to local customers in person and by phone. Role involves generating new business, cross-selling, and building community relationships to drive growth.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of experience and can obtain P&C licensing within 90 days, or already hold it

Full job description

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making a difference, then apply to join our team today!

As a Direct Sales Agent Specialist, you will:

  • Achieve sales goals through new business, cross-sell, and retention
  • Build and maintain a consistent pipeline, including local lead generation and referrals
  • Develop relationships within the community (e.g., dealerships, events, local partners) to support business growth
  • Conduct outbound prospecting and follow-ups to convert opportunities into sales
  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

What makes Direct Auto Insurance unique?

  • Day 1 Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Tuition Reimbursement, Pension & so much more
  • 20 PTO Days per year & 6 Paid Holidays
  • Ability to sell a multitude of industry-leading products through retail stores and phone
  • Entrepreneurial, performance-based, and results-focused culture
  • Multi-tiered and comprehensive paid training program
  • Base hourly rate plus uncapped monthly incentive

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 0 2 years of experience
  • P&C licensing (Preferred) or must attain required licensure within 90 days of joining the company.

Skills

Active Learning, Active Listening, Business Rules, Communication, Cooperation, Customer Service, High Reliability, Professional Integrity, Sales, Time Management

Compensation

Total Compensation:
In addition to the base hourly rate, total compensation for this role may include incentive pay, such as commissions and bonuses, based on individual and team performance.

  • Pay: $142,900 to $235,800 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Hartford, CT
  • Education: Bachelor's degree
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off

About this job

Director of Data Engineering leading teams that build data pipelines and machine learning solutions for Travelers' underwriting analytics. The role involves designing end-to-end data architecture, managing a data engineering team, and collaborating across the enterprise.

Good fit if you have 6+ years data engineering experience, 3+ years management experience, and hands-on expertise with AWS, Python, Databricks, SQL, and CI/CD pipelines.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$142,900.00 - $235,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers Data Engineering team constructs pipelines that contextualize and provide easy access to data by the entire enterprise. As a Data Engineering Director you will accelerate growth and transformation of our analytics landscape. In this role, you will lead teams designing and building data solutions that capture, explore, transform and utilize data to support Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and business intelligence/insights. In addition to ingesting data from multiple sources and relaying information to relevant partners, you will also mentor and develop a team of data engineers.

This role is part of the BI Data & Analytics Organization. You will lead data engineering efforts encompassing solution design, building and optimizing data pipelines, and overseeing engineering and integration work in support of Underwriting Models and Analytics. The role requires cross-functional collaboration with Data Scientists, BI Tech Data Engineering, Data & Analytics Value Streams, and Architecture to prioritize, implement data and ML pipelines, build roadmaps, streamline processes, and standardize implementation patterns across these domains.

What Will You Do?

  • Lead, guide, and coach the Underwriting Data Engineering team, establishing processes, fostering a culture of technical excellence, and supporting career development across the team.
  • Design, develop, and implement robust end-to-end data solutions and ML pipelines covering feature engineering, data preparation, training, testing, and deployment, while enforcing strong data validation, versioning, and governance practices.
  • Govern the end-to-end productionization of models, coordinating with stakeholder and application teams to ensure seamless integration with production systems and APIs, including monitoring, alerting, and error handling frameworks.
  • Lead the development of analytic data products, pilots, and proof of concepts in alignment with enterprise architecture and data strategies, while maintaining scalable, secure, and automated solutions.
  • Develop and maintain the Underwriting Analytics Portfolio roadmap, present analysis and recommendations to inform management decisions, and maintain cross-functional relationships to ensure partner needs are met and work is prioritized accordingly.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree in STEM related field or equivalent.
  • Five or more years of related experience.
  • 3 or more years of management experience, ideally with at least 2 years in the insurance industry.
  • 3 or more years of hands-on experience with AWS Cloud Services, Python, and Databricks, along with 2 or more years working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and pipeline development, with experience in data governance frameworks and advanced knowledge of cloud platforms and data tooling.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and leadership levels.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 6 additional years of data engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

What Is the Opportunity?

Behavioral science is becoming a critical function for many businesses today and Travelers is no exception. Travelers Claim Behavioral Science group uses scientific methods to understand the changing needs of our customers, claimants and employees. As a Director, Behavioral Scientist, you will apply behavioral science frameworks and academic insights to practical business challenges in the Property and Casualty Insurance industry. You will serve as a researcher, interviewer, design thinking facilitator, and data analyst for the application of behavioral science to Travelers Claim strategies and projects.

What Will You Do?

  • In close collaboration with key stakeholders across Claim, conduct pilots, apply behavioral science frameworks, and implement interventions to influence choices customers or claimants make before or throughout the lifecycle of a claim.
  • Conduct research and test behavioral interventions to enhance claim practices, product design, business strategies, as well as customer and employee experiences.
  • Collect and analyze quantitative data, conduct semi-structured interviews, facilitate group design thinking sessions, and conduct test and learns with follow up measurements.
  • Apply behavioral science frameworks to test interventions that inform product design and experiences, and that impact financial results.
  • Collaborate with product designers, data scientists, project managers and marketing and communications to design, develop, conduct and evaluate projects and proofs of concept.
  • Help to develop and document research to support multiple recommendations to improve Claim business line results.
  • Implement agreed upon interventions in partnership with various sponsors.
  • Apply insights internally to influence how employees within the organization react to and manage transformational change.
  • Provide insights, best practices, tools, and training to help develop organizational capabilities in the application of behavioral science.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5+ years of applied industry experience in a business setting.
  • Proven ability to design, conduct, analyze and communicate research results and recommendations as business cases.
  • Ph.D., with certification and/or applied experience in Data Science.
  • Proficiency with Excel, and R, SAS, or Python.
  • Experience in natural language processing and/or statistically based text analysis methods.
  • Experience in designing and conducting semi-structured interviews or user research for Behavioral Science interventions.
  • Group-led facilitation using design thinking collaboration software across multi-disciplinary groups.
  • Natural curiosity is key - demonstrated ability to understand problems and ask the right questions.
  • Strong research and analytical skills including an ability to observe and record behaviors.
  • Experience advocating for and influencing business partners to adopt behavioral science research, experimentation, and interventions.
  • Strong Project Management Skills and the ability to bring projects from idea to testing, and implementation; ability to balance priorities while working on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate across business areas.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience

What is a Must Have?

  • Master's in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Economics, HCI, UX, People Analytics or related field.
  • Some experience applying behavioral science frameworks, insights, and experimental research in a business setting.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

About this job

Senior Director applying behavioral science to insurance claims challenges at Travelers. Design and conduct research, test interventions, and analyze impact on customer and employee decision-making across the claim lifecycle.

Good fit if you have a Master's degree in Behavioral Science or related field, 2+ years applying behavioral science in business, and proficiency with data analysis tools.

Full job description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$129,600.00 - $213,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Within the Claim Behavioral Science function, apply behavioral science frameworks, the scientific method, and design thinking to practical business challenges across the Property and Casualty Insurance industry. Acting as an internal consultant, researcher, and data analyst, conduct pilots and implement evidence-based interventions that influence customer, claimant, and employee decision-making throughout the claim lifecycle - spanning initiatives such as digital adoption, change management, and product development. Work collaboratively with fellow behavioral scientists and key stakeholders, contributing independent project management and research expertise to design, execute, and analyze experiments with rigor and creativity to achieve measurable business outcomes.

What Will You Do?

  • Collect and analyze quantitative data, conduct semi-structured interviews, facilitate group design thinking sessions, and conduct test-and-learns with follow up measurements to calculate financial impact.
  • Apply behavioral science frameworks to test interventions that inform product design and experiences, and that impact financial results.
  • Collaborate with product designers, data scientists, project managers and marketing and communications to design, develop, conduct and evaluate projects and proofs of concept.
  • Help to develop and document research to support multiple recommendations to improve Claim business line results.
  • Implement agreed upon interventions in partnership with various sponsors.
  • Apply insights internally to influence how employees within the organization react to and manage transformational changes.
  • Provide insights, best practices, tools, and training to help develop organizational capabilities in the application of behavioral science.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5+ years of applied industry experience in a business setting.
  • Ph.D., with certification and/or applied experience in Data Science.
  • Proven ability to design, conduct, analyze and communicate research results and recommendations as business cases.
  • Proficiency with Excel, R, SAS, and/or Python.
  • Experience in natural language processing and/or statistically based text analysis methods.
  • Experience in designing and conducting semi-structured interviews or user research for Behavioral Science interventions.
  • Group-led facilitation using design thinking collaboration software across multi-disciplinary groups.
  • Natural curiosity is key - demonstrated ability to understand problems and ask the right questions.
  • Strong research and analytical skills including an ability to observe and record behaviors.
  • Experience advocating for and influencing business partners to adopt behavioral science research, experimentation, and interventions.
  • Strong Project Management Skills and the ability to bring projects from idea to testing, and implementation; ability to balance priorities while working on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate across business areas.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.

What is a Must Have?

  • Master's Degree in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Economics, HCI, UX, People Analytics or a related field.
  • 2 years of experience applying behavioral science frameworks, insights, and experimental research in a business setting.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking an experienced Director of Customer Experience to lead and scale Customer Experience capabilities across Workplace Solutions. This leader will bring deep, hands-on CX expertise and a demonstrated track record of building mature, repeatable practices that embed customer-centered decision-making across an organization. In this role, you will set the CX strategy and operating model, strengthen governance and measurement, and create the tools, standards, and ways of working that enable teams across Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Marketing, and Distribution to consistently improve the experience. You will champion the voice of the customer while connecting customer insights and experience improvements to measurable business outcomes, including growth, retention, efficiency, and differentiation.

This is not a role focused solely on journey mapping or Voice of Customer programs. We are looking for a proven CX leader who has helped an organization move from individual projects to an integrated, enterprise-scale CX capability. You will influence senior leaders, develop talent, build cross-functional commitment, and translate customer needs into clear priorities, investment decisions, and sustained change.

What you'll be doing

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Experience professionals, setting clear expectations and building the strategic, analytical, and influencing capabilities needed to deliver meaningful impact.
• Define and execute a scalable CX strategy and operating model, including governance, standards, roles, decision rights, prioritization, and cross-functional ways of working.
• Build and mature the organization's CX capabilities by establishing repeatable methods, tools, training, and frameworks that enable teams to apply customer-centered practices consistently and independently.
• Partner with senior leaders across Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Marketing, and Distribution to embed customer needs into business strategy, transformation roadmaps, investment decisions, and solution design.
• Establish an enterprise approach to journey management that identifies priority journeys, clarifies ownership, connects insights across touchpoints, and drives coordinated improvement over time.
• Integrate Voice of Customer, research, behavioral and operational data, market intelligence, and employee insights to identify root causes, size opportunities, and inform strategic recommendations.
• Translate complex customer and business challenges into actionable strategies, business cases, executive-level recommendations, and sequenced roadmaps.
• Define and monitor a CX measurement framework that connects experience outcomes to business results such as growth, retention, utilization, digital adoption, cost, and operational performance.
• Drive adoption and accountability through change leadership, stakeholder engagement, communication, and capability-building across the organization.
• Champion the thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies to improve customer outcomes, increase efficiency, and create competitive advantage.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:
• 5+ years of progressive CX experience, including CX strategy, journey management, customer insights, experience measurement, service design, or related disciplines
• Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or maturing a CX practice across a complex organization, including establishing operating models, governance, standards, tools, measurement, and cross-functional adoption
• 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of developing high-performing teams and leading through influence in a matrixed environment
• Experience translating customer insights and journey opportunities into enterprise priorities, funded roadmaps, measurable improvements, and business outcomes
• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and gain alignment across functions with competing priorities
• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect CX investments to growth, retention, efficiency, risk reduction, and market differentiation
• Demonstrated change leadership experience, including building organizational commitment, establishing accountability, and driving sustained adoption of new CX practices
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of a Bachelor's degree)

Nice-to-haves:
• Recognized Customer Experience certification, such as CCXP, or comparable certification in human-centered design, service design, design thinking, or change management
• Experience leading CX in financial services, insurance, employee benefits, retirement, or another regulated and complex service environment
• Working knowledge of Group Benefits and/or Retirement Plans
• Experience applying AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve customer experiences and operational outcomes

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through November 20th, 2026 subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

Full job description

Alliant Insurance Services is one of the nation's largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms. We operate through a network of specialized national platforms and local offices to offer our clients a comprehensive portfolio of solutions built on innovative thinking and personal service. Alliant is changing the way our clients approach risk management and benefits, so they can capitalize on new opportunities to grow and protect their organizations.

More information is available on the company's website at: >.


SUMMARY


Responsible for providing analytical support to operating group leadership and team. Key responsibilities include management reporting and analysis, financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and process improvement.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Provides broad analytical support to assigned departments and acts as a liaison between departments.


Analyzes and interprets financial results, comparing actual performance to prior periods, budgets, and forecasts; then clearly articulates to management the narrative behind the numbers.


Designs and prepares ad hoc and standard management reporting.


Proactively seeks opportunities to provide increasingly insightful reports to management.

Independently constructs moderate to complex financial models to analyze the impact of current and proposed company initiatives.


Leads the forecasting and budgeting processes.


Creates and maintains planning templates and reports, helps to construct revenue and expense plans, identifies and analyzes variances, challenges and redirects business assumptions as needed.


Organizes and analyzes large quantities of data and performs data reconciliations to ensure accuracy of work products.


Identifies and interprets patterns and outliers in the data set and provides insight into the meaning of the data.


Partners with IT to develop and maintain integrity of financial systems used for analysis.


Proactively identifies areas for process improvement and implements methods to reduce error rates and maximize productivity and efficiency.


Performs all duties in accordance with all company policies and procedures, and all federal, state and local laws, wherein the Company operates.


Performs other duties as assigned.



QUALIFICATIONS
EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE


Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Mathematics or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience


Five (5) or more years related work experience; specifically in a FP&A role


Strong understanding of financial computer systems and data systems


Graduate degree or professional certification


Certified Corporate FP&A Professional


Certified Public Accountant (CPA)


Certified Financial Planner-CFP Board



SKILLS


Excellent verbal and written communication skills, polished presentation skills


Proficient in Microsoft Office products, with advanced Excel skills and familiarity with Access


Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills


Strong ability to interpret and analyze financial statements


Strong mathematical ability


Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent assignments and complete work by required due dates


Ability to interact professionally with employees across all levels of organization


Technical understanding of data structure, data mining and reporting processes


Highly proactive; actively seeks opportunities for process improvement


Works independently with minimal supervision and as a member of a team

The Role at a Glance

We are seeking a Lead Actuary to join our Variable Annuity (VA) and Registered Index-Linked Annuity (RILA) Valuation team. In this role, you will produce monthly and quarterly valuations for Lincoln's VA and RILA blocks while partnering with internal stakeholders to analyze results and gain insights. You will also provide support to various actuarial modernization and automation projects.

What you'll be doing

•Produce VA and RILA financial reporting results, including statutory reserve and capital under VM-21 and market risk benefits (MRBs) under GAAP LDTI.
•Develop expertise in modeling, automation, and visualization tools used in valuation processes.
•Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and regulatory standards.
•Build new tools and processes that provide deeper insight into VA and RILA valuations.
•Support existing automation efforts to increase efficiency, reduce the potential for error, and improve presentation of results.
•Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across Lincoln, including Accounting, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Market Risk Management (MRM), Model Development, Pricing, Audit, ERM, Investments, Capital Management, and the Qualified Actuary team.

What we're looking for

•4-year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum required)
•5-7+ years of actuarial experience with actuarial credentials (FSA or ASA with additional years of experience)
•Substantial knowledge of annuity products
•Experience with actuarial modeling software (e.g., GGY-AXIS) and data automation and visualization tools (e.g., Dataiku, Tableau)
•Strong execution and time management skills, with a record of producing high-quality work and meeting deadlines
•Self-starter with ability to work independently and demonstrated accountability

Good fit if you have 10+ years of actuarial experience, FSA designation, annuity product knowledge, and experience with modeling platforms like AXIS, Python, or SQL.

This role drives insights that directly inform investments, risk management, capital and liquidity decisions while partnering across the organization with business units and functions supporting these decisions.


You will lead a high-performing team responsible for building the process, running the analysis and providing the recommendation supporting the growth of our Annuity business. This role partners closely with Finance, Investments, Product, Risk Management and Treasury teams to translate complex Annuity modeling and financial analysis into actionable business insights and decisions.

What you'll be doing

•Lead analysis on, and monitoring of, Lincoln's emerging pricing risks.
•Provide thought leadership and pricing insights in the development investment strategies, ALM and emerging risk across Lincoln's Annuity business.
•Work in partnership with the Finance, Investments and In-force modeling teams to connect Annuity pricing model output to its impact on the company's strategic goals, ensuring results are understood in both regulatory and earnings contexts.
•Collaborate with internal stakeholders across the organization to educate on techniques used in Annuity New Business modeling and socialize insights derived through team's work.
•Collaborate with teammates to share knowledge, institute best practices, and develop shared insights.
•Lead a team of professionals in the execution of the team's responsibilities.

What we're looking for

•10+ years of actuarial experience, with demonstrated competency in the specific responsibilities for this position
•Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) designation or Associate (ASA) with additional years of actuarial experience
•Annuity product knowledge and general insurance/business knowledge
•Demonstrated success in providing strategic and holistic thought leadership
•Demonstrated success in balancing and pivoting across projects with shifting priorities
•Strong relationship management skills across functional areas, including senior management and peers, including ability to influence effectively
•Experience building and mentoring actuarial talent
•Curiosity, comfort asking questions and challenging the status quo, and critical thinking with an eye for innovation
•Experience with actuarial modeling platforms and programming/analytics tools (e.g. AXIS, Python, SQL)

The Role at a Glance

As the COLI BOLI Insurance Consultant for Lincoln's Executive Benefit's Underwriting Team, you will analyze and deliver on COLI BOLI ICOLI cases. The Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) Underwriter is responsible for evaluating mortality, financial, and insurable risk associated with corporate-sponsored life insurance programs. The role supports the issuance and management of COLI and BOLI cases by assessing underwriting evidence, applying carrier guidelines, and making risk-based decisions that support profitable growth while maintaining regulatory compliance. Responsibilities often include collaboration with sales, actuarial, legal, case management, and corporate clients

This is a developmental opportunity designed for someone who brings relevant experience and knowledge of the COLI, BOLI, or broader institutional life insurance marketplace and is interested in building deeper underwriting expertise. A traditional underwriting background is not required. Candidates may bring transferable experience from areas such as operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or other roles that provide meaningful exposure to COLI and BOLI programs.

What you'll be doing

  • Underwrite Corporate-Owned Life Insurance (COLI) applications, including corporate and institutionally sponsored programs.
  • Underwrite Guaranteed Issue (GI) and Simplified Issue (SI) COLI cases in accordance with approved program designs, eligibility criteria, and carrier guidelines.
  • Evaluate and assess complex financial, and corporate risks for executives, key employees, and eligible participant populations.
  • Analyze corporate financial statements, program structures, and plan designs to ensure alignment with underwriting standards, regulatory requirements, and risk tolerance.
  • Apply knowledge of Qualified Purchaser and Accredited Investor definitions in support of program eligibility, structure, and regulatory compliance.
  • Determine face amounts, and policy terms using sound underwriting judgment
  • Review and approve pre-issue and post-issue underwriting transactions, including policy changes, face amount adjustments, and other in-force underwriting requests.
  • Collaborate with Sales, New Business, Legal, Compliance, Actuarial, and Operations to support case design and execution.
  • Identify underwriting trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Maintain current knowledge of COLI regulations, underwriting philosophies, and market practices.

What we're looking for

Must-Have's

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to influence management/critical stakeholders
  • Analytical skills and close attention to detail is necessary
  • Ability to adapt quickly in a changing work environment

Nice-to Have's

  • Experience working with corporate owned life insurance (COLI) and/or bank owned life insurance (BOLI) programs
  • Strong understanding of the institutional life insurance marketplace
  • Experience in underwriting, operations, product management, client service, implementation, relationship management, or a related area

We are excited to bring on an AVP, Product Development – Registered Indexed Linked Annuities (RILA) to support the Annuity business in a hybrid work environment. Preferred key cities include Hartford, Greensboro, Fort Wayne, Radnor.

Background Details

As the AVP, Product Development for RILA products, you will play a leadership role focused on shaping and executing the future of Lincoln's RILA product portfolio. This position is responsible for driving product opportunities and growth by identifying market opportunities, and developing differentiated solutions, for a rapidly evolving segment of the annuity marketplace.

Working across the organization and with external partners, you will leverage industry expertise, market insights, and strong relationships to influence product direction and enhance Lincoln's competitive position. Success in this role requires a deep understanding of RILA products, the broader annuity landscape, and emerging trends that impact customers, advisors, and the industry.

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of developing and advancing RILA or similar insurance and investment products, along with the strategic vision to anticipate market needs and translate them into meaningful product solutions. This role is well-suited for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of market strategy, product innovation, and business growth. If this role is for you, please read on!

Please note: This is a product leadership role focused on product strategy and development, not a project management position.

What you'll be doing

  • You will lead the discovery, design, development, and delivery of RILA solutions that support business growth, market differentiation, and long-term product strategy.
  • You will identify emerging market opportunities, consumer needs, and industry trends to develop strategies that expand into new markets and diversify the product portfolio.
  • You will assist business leaders by influencing product priorities and future growth opportunities.
  • You will work alongside business partners to assess the annuity and adjacent markets to identify product concepts and evaluate their viability, competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.
  • You will collaborate with Pricing, Distribution, Marketing, Legal, State Filings, Operations, and Implementation teams to develop and bring product solutions from concept to market.
  • You will build and leverage relationships with external partners, industry organizations, and third-party providers to gather market insights, identify opportunities, and inform product innovation efforts.
  • You will play a key role in evaluating product performance, in-force management strategies, and market competitiveness to support portfolio optimization and business growth.
  • You will contribute to risk management and product governance processes by assessing potential impacts to product design, pricing strategies, business mix, and overall portfolio performance.
  • You will help define and execute short- and long-term product strategies by maintaining a deep understanding of market dynamics, competitor offerings, regulatory developments, and emerging industry trends.

What we're looking for

  • 4 Year Bachelor's degree or 4+ years of experience of equivalent work experience

  • Strong presentation skills with demonstrated ability to influence at all levels of management through clear, informed and logical discussions/presentations.

  • Demonstrated strong relationship management skills with internal clients (e.g. senior management, peers and colleagues); proven ability to develop creative and collaborative approaches.

About this job

Build shared cloud platforms and engineering foundations on AWS that enable AI agents and agentic applications at Lincoln Financial. Focus on runtime, tooling, guardrails, model access, orchestration, observability, and DevSecOps.

Good fit if you have 5+ years in platform engineering or DevOps, strong AWS and Python skills, and hands-on experience with LLM frameworks like LangChain and agent tools.

Full job description

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Requisition #: 76592

The Role at a Glance

The Agentic Platform Engineer builds the shared cloud platform and engineering foundations that enable AIDA teams to deliver secure, scalable AI agents and agentic applications. This role focuses on the runtime, tooling, and guardrails that agents depend on: model access, tool and context integration, orchestration frameworks, evaluation, observability, and DevSecOps on AWS.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain shared platform services that support agent runtimes, LLM gateways, model routing, prompt/context management, and tool integration.
  • Standardize agentic delivery patterns including tool/function calling, MCP-style tool servers, retrieval pipelines, memory and state management, and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Implement guardrails for agent safety: input/output filtering, prompt injection defenses, human-in-the-loop approval paths, sandboxed execution, and least-privilege agent identities.
  • Improve developer productivity through CI/CD, environment templates, agent scaffolding, SDKs, and platform automation.
  • Build observability and evaluation for agentic systems: tracing, token and cost telemetry, latency, quality/eval harnesses, and regression testing of prompts and agent behavior.
  • Manage cost-aware model consumption, rate limits, caching, and secure secrets/access patterns across environments.
  • Partner with architecture, security, risk, and engineering leaders to apply AI controls, interoperability standards, and governance guardrails.
  • Document platform standards and help delivery teams adopt agentic patterns consistently.

What we're looking for

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE, with hands-on work building or operating AI/LLM-based applications.
  • Strong experience with AWS, including services supporting AI workloads (Bedrock, SageMaker, containers, serverless).
  • Practical experience with agent frameworks and LLM tooling such as LangChain/LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
  • Strong coding ability in Python; Java or NodeJS is a plus.
  • Experience enabling engineering teams through CI/CD, GitLab, observability, reusable services, and platform standards.
  • Experience with API infrastructure, containers, deployment pipelines, and operational tooling.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with agent evaluation and LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, LangFuse, Arize, or similar).
  • Experience supporting production systems, data platforms, and AI/ML workloads.
  • Exposure to regulated enterprise environments, identity/access controls, AI risk frameworks, and audit logging.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $119,749 to $201,948 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: San Diego, CA
  • Experience: 4+ years
  • Benefits: Health insurance, 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays

About this job

Privacy & Compliance Program Manager role at ICW Group, a 50+ year old insurance carrier headquartered in San Diego. Manages the company's privacy program, oversees data incident response, and supports corporate compliance functions across the organization.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree, 4+ years of privacy or corporate compliance experience, and strong legal research and writing skills.

Full job description

Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this role is to provide analysis, guidance, and direction for the management and resolution of corporate compliance and privacy-related matters. Reporting to the Director of Corporate Compliance, this position works closely with leaders in Law and Corporate Compliance and serves as a key resource for leaders and team members throughout the organization on privacy program requirements and corporate compliance functions.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manages the company's privacy program (under the direction of the department director), partnering with Information Security, insurance operations, finance, purchasing and vendor management, human resources, and other departments on privacy and cybersecurity compliance.
  • Oversees data events and incident response processes to support timely and appropriate resolution.
  • Maintains up to date knowledge of applicable privacy, AI, cybersecurity, data classification, data retention, and data protection laws and regulations across the U.S.
  • Supports general corporate compliance functions, including corporate policy management, conflict of interest administration, compliance risk assessments, data management, regulatory change management, compliance training, team member awareness, and enterprise-level compliance risk management.
  • Develops compliance workflows, key risk indicators, and metrics to support compliance risk management, regulatory readiness, and program maturity.
  • Participates in the development and drafting of corporate policies and policy-related materials, without use of AI.
  • Prepares departmental and executive-level reports on compliance risk management and assigned program activities.
  • Interprets corporate policies, frameworks, and process documents within assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Promotes responsible innovation, practical compliance risk management, and accountable data management across the organization.
  • Mentors and assists in supervising the work of less experienced members of the department.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have formal supervisory responsibilities but will assist with providing mentorship and oversight to others.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience) required. Juris Doctorate (JD) preferred. 4+ years' related experience required in privacy, corporate compliance or closely related area. Insurance industry experience is helpful. Leadership experience, including direct people-management experience, is preferred.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required. Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) a plus.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Substantial, direct experience interpreting legal requirements for privacy program management and providing practical management-level guidance on consumer privacy and cybersecurity laws and regulations.
  • Excellent computer skills, including familiarity with corporate cybersecurity practices and an interest in AI governance. GRC systems experience is helpful.
  • Familiarity with general corporate compliance functions, such as corporate policy management, conflict of interest principles, and compliance risk assessments.
  • Superior legal research and analytical skills, with careful attention to detail and the ability to provide guidance in complex, ambiguous situations.
  • Proven ability to translate complex statutory language into plain English reports, process guidance, policy statements, and training materials.
  • Demonstrated ability to work without relying on AI to produce high caliber analyses and written work product.
  • Excellent communication skills, including experience leading cross-functional meetings and presenting reports to leadership.
  • Strong problem-resolution skills, including experience with internal investigations and balancing compliance risk management needs with corporate priorities.
  • Client-oriented perspective, with a focus on timely, actionable guidance that responds to business needs.
  • Comfortable working in a growth-oriented environment with evolving regulatory requirements, uncertain legal interpretations, and organizational change.
  • Well-developed self-management skills, with the ability to work independently with minimal guidance, take direction from management, and collaborate effectively with individuals from diverse backgrounds.
  • Proven ability to oversee the work of others, provide guidance and feedback, and recognize when issues should be escalated to department leadership.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and demonstrated ability to handle sensitive matters respectfully, ethically, and with discretion.
  • Good interpersonal skills, with the ability to build cross-functional relationships, set direction, and develop consensus in support of organizational goals.
  • Experience in business management, insurance operations, contract interpretation, employment law, sanctions compliance, or corporate governance is helpful.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands. Employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Working at corporate headquarters in the San Diego area, this position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

Why Join Marshall+Sterling?

As a 100% employee-owned company with roots dating back to 1864, Marshall+Sterling offers the strength of a time-tested organization and the energy of an ownership-driven culture. Guided by our mission to empower clients to predict, prepare for, and preempt risk, we are relentlessly focused on helping people and businesses protect what matters most — so they can move forward with confidence. Innovation is not optional here — it's imperative. We constantly seek better, smarter ways to serve our clients and improve as a company. Collaboration is at our core, because we know we are stronger together — across teams, with our clients, and in the communities we serve. Our employee-owners are not only valued and empowered, but also directly invested in our collective success.

At Marshall+Sterling, you're not just joining a company — you're joining an inclusive culture built on integrity, impact, and people-first values. Your ideas matter, your growth is prioritized, and your work helps shape a more secure future for all.

This role will be based out of Marshall+Sterling's Poughkeepsie Office

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, responding promptly to inquiries and service requests.

  • Process claims and support clients through the claims process as needed.

  • Proficiency with AI tools, task management systems, and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Compensation: $47,500 - $52,500, based experience.

Employee Stock Ownership Program

As a 100% employee-owned company, Marshall+Sterling offers you the unique opportunity to build long-term wealth while growing your career. Here's what makes our ESOP so valuable:

  • Long-Term Rewards: The value of your ESOP account grows over time, rewarding your commitment and contributions to the company's success.

At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this job is to produce complex analyses and provide expert actuarial advice to the Actuarial team. This position exists to support and execute Company strategy as directed by the Chief Actuary, while establishing and upholding a department direction and vision. This position will also manage an entire line of business or other area similar in scope or complexity, including owning one or more domain areas of responsibility, as well as increased breadth of ownership managing enterprise actuarial requests and solutions across all lines of business.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Establishes and upholds a department direction and vision.

  • Contributes to discussions around establishing vision and direction for the actuarial department.
  • Represents the company in business settings and potentially with external parties.
  • Responsible for developing new business processes or comprehensive analytic efforts.
  • Ensures that the work product supports business growth and profitability.
  • Takes responsibility to extensively modify processes in order to improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Invokes critical thought process to solve complex problems and identify dependencies in processes to enable direction of staff.
  • Ensures soundness of actuarial analyses and consistency with Standards of Practice.

Partners with business leaders to provide expertise on business efforts.

  • Partners with business leaders in administering an entire line of business or other area of responsibility similar in scope and complexity.
  • Organizes and coordinates actuarial efforts with business leaders to develop and implement new products and expand into new markets.
  • Fosters positive, collaborative working relationships with higher level experts across the organization.
  • Acts as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for actuarial matters.
  • Prepares and communicates actuarial findings to business leaders.

Develops and manages a team of Credentialed Actuaries and Actuarial Analysts

  • Provides direction to team. Communicates Mission, Values and other organization operating principles to the team.
  • Establishes high standards for the delivery of services and products rendered, resulting in an excellent customer experience. Ensures that the entire team is engaged and that leadership practices encourage development, recognition and retention.
  • Establishes and adheres to hiring criteria, on-boarding and training requirements for incoming staff.
  • Oversees the performance management and development process for the team and performs performance management duties, development planning and coaching for direct reports.
  • Acts as a resource for team members to answer questions and solve complex problems.
  • Manages budget, technology and other resources, workload and customer requests for services. Ensures adherence to all Company policies and procedures and Compliance responsibilities.
  • Ensures data quality, adherence to IT security guidelines, profitability and other risk-related metrics for self and members of the team.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position directly supervises employees within the Actuarial department and carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. These responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; conducting performance and salary reviews; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems; coaching, mentoring, and developing team members to further their skills and knowledge; creating and monitoring development plans; setting performance expectations/goals; forecasting staffing needs and planning for peak times and absences; enforcing department policies and procedures.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or related field preferred. Minimum 7 years of related experience and/or training; or, equivalent combination of education and experience.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Associate of the Casualty Actuary Society (ACAS) or Fellow of the Casualty Actuary Society (FCAS) designation required.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Strong interpersonal skills and proven leadership ability. Thorough knowledge of actuarial models and ability to assess results. Experience managing complex projects, resources and staff. Broad company and industry experience and expertise, with the ability to work collaboratively with other business leaders to solve complex business problems. Ability to mentor and train actuarial staff. Ability to take actuarial ownership of significant segments of responsibility, including multiple lines of business. Ability to influence the strategic vision of the actuarial department.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

Full job description

The Claims Representative I is responsible for investigating, evaluating and disposing of assigned claims in a timely manner in order to achieve best practices type settlements within legal statutes, policy provisions and Company and/or client guidelines.

This is a hybrid role reporting to the Waukesha, WI office.

About this job

Design secure architectures and develop cybersecurity approaches to protect ICW Group's systems and infrastructure. Lead security incident response, vulnerability remediation, and compliance audits while serving as a technical security subject matter expert.

Good fit if you have experience with security architecture, incident response, SIEM tools, and can advise business units on security practices.

Full job description

Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Information Security Engineer IV is to design secure architectures and develop cybersecurity approaches and techniques for the security of all ICW related systems and infrastructure. This position will assist with strategic initiatives for short and long-term plans to identify and reduce the attack surface across applications and systems. The Information Security Engineer IV will drive the architecture to monitor and defend ICW Group's technology against potential threats that jeopardize the financial growth and security goals of the Company.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Monitors, defends and drives improvements for ICW Group IT Information Security.

  • Monitors networks and systems for security breaches, using software that detects intrusions and anomalous system behavior and develops strategies to respond to and recover from a security breach.
  • Identifies gaps in the technical tool/technology suite and makes recommendations
  • Leads security incident response, including preparation, detection, analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.
  • Researches and implements methods to remediate network and application security vulnerabilities.
  • Leads and participates in security architecture controls reporting, compliance audits, monthly and ad-hoc statistics and trends, and risk-focused reports including internal and 3rd party Risk Assessments.
  • Utilizes automated tools to identify, assess, and report security concerns, with emphasis placed on effective communication to stakeholders. Takes an active lead to inform, advise, and partner with business units to help better secure operations.

Leads complex security endeavors.

  • Overseas complex security projects and issues.
  • Develops a set of security standards to respond to and recover from a security breach.
  • Provides support by proposing solutions, coordinating implementation, and enforcing information systems security policies, standards, and methodologies.
  • Uses advanced technologies including Intrusion Detection & Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Firewalls, SIEM, Antivirus, Network Packet Analyzers, Malware analysis and forensics tools to detect intrusions, breaches in compliance, etc.
  • Prepares and analyses system security reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends and makes recommendations to improve security.
  • Maintains operational security posture for an information system or program to ensure information system security policies, standards, and procedures are established and followed.
  • Creates and updates technical security standards for assets and software.

Serves as cyber security technical subject matter expert for the organization.

  • Provides information security expertise to system development teams throughout the life cycle process.
  • Partners with systems engineering teams to ensure system design and implementation are consistent with company policies, requirements, and directives.
  • Conducts risk assessments, penetration tests and diagnoses internet/extranet security, intrusion attempts, and cyber-crime response.
  • Leads and conducts information security risk assessments including documenting processes, service level agreements and best practices.
  • Develops the overall security design, development, testing and implementation of security solutions. Recommends compliance strategies that support customer requirements and alignment to company policy.
  • Ensures security quality, adherence to security guidelines, profitability, and information security related metrics for self and assigned projects.
  • Collaborates with key stakeholders on remediation strategies and follows remediation activities through closure.

Partners with project management and other internal teams in determining overall security solutions.

  • Prepares and presents comprehensive reports and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders on security-related matters.
  • Develops and implements comprehensive security architectures encompassing all areas of IT and business technology for ICW Group using standard and advanced security measures.
  • Works with peers, cross functional architecture leadership, and other internal groups to drive technical security risk down in targeted areas while ensuring adherence to ICW architecture standards.
  • Coaches and educates others to increase early detection rates and decrease IT risk and security.
  • Documents as is state of information security. Keeps current on industry trends, principles, and thought to define long range technology transitions.
  • Performs end to end full stack reviews of current or incoming technologies for ITSEC compliance.
  • Ensures that proposed and existing technology architectures are aligned with organizational security goals and objectives.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has no supervisory responsibility but may mentor and train junior engineers.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's Degree from four-year college or university required with major or emphasis Engineering, Cybersecurity, Networking, or Computer Science related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience working in a security engineering related role designing secure networks, systems and application architectures or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in AWS Cloud Security services preferred.
  • Direct experience using advanced technologies such as Intrusion Detection & Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Firewalls, SIEM, Antivirus software, Network Packet Analyzers, content filtering, Malware analysis and forensics tools to detect intrusions.
  • Experience in cyber security role requiring knowledge of data analysis, risk assessment, risk mitigation, investigation methods, incident management concepts and practices, and policy and procedure development.
  • Experience with AWS Services such as AWS Identity & Access Management, AWS Organizations, AWS Security HuB, Guard Duty, CloudTrail, AWS CloudTrail.
  • Experience with LLM-based applications, document intelligence, automated data extraction, or AI systems processing structured or unstructured enterprise data preferred.
  • Understanding of LLM applications, AI-enabled workflows, data pipelines, data handling, and human-review practices preferred.
  • Experience with AI/ML platforms, generative AI, LLM applications, data pipelines, AI-enabled automation, or analytics environments preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Certification in GSEC, CISSP, and/or Security+ preferred. AWS Certified Security – Specialty, preferred.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong knowledge of risk assessment tools, technologies, and methodologies.
  • Knowledge of disaster recovery, computer forensic tools, technologies, and methods.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security platforms.
  • Ability to communicate network security issues to peers and management.
  • Ability to read and use the results of mobile code, malicious code, and anti-virus software.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint security solutions to include File Integrity Monitoring and Data Loss Prevention.
  • Demonstrated experience as a lead engineer in the design, implementation and support in an enterprise IT environment.
  • Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
  • Ability to hypothesize on root cause of inefficiencies and then test out probable solutions against those hypotheses.
  • Must be able to read, write and speak English effectively.
  • Ability to effectively communicate/present technical information to a non-technical audience.
  • Ability to cross train and share information with team members.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear. Employees are required to reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Employees must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Employees are required to have visual acuity and be capable of operating and viewing computers and other electronic devices for extended periods of time.


WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

Job.JobDescription:
***Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to Brevard, Osceola, and Indian River Counties***

Position Summary:

Position is responsible for prompt and thorough investigation of routine to moderately complex residential property claims. This is a field-based position involving on-site inspection of insured properties. Regular travel within assigned territory is required.

Essential Functions:

  • Prompt and courteous servicing of property claims, including insured and agency contact and follow through.
  • Communicate and interact with a variety of individuals to foster the timely resolution of claims, including, but not limited to, policyholders, public adjusters, attorneys, vendors, and experts.
  • Timely identification, analysis and resolution of coverage issues arising in claims investigation.
  • Factual investigation of cause of loss.
  • Coverage determination based on a variety of policy and endorsements.
  • Maintain proper file documentation reflecting progressive claim handling.
  • Coverage and Payment Letters necessary to settle and conclude the claim.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience:

  • Must maintain a Florida All-Lines adjuster (620) license.
  • 3+ years of homeowner's claims field adjusting experience required handling all perils.
  • Must be proficient with Xactimate and sketching, including mobile applications (iPad etc.)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Exceptional customer service skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Knowledge of property insurance policy and coverage analysis.
  • Must be able to work under deadlines.
  • Proficient in MS Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Strong skills and experience with Xactimate estimating program.
