Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager -Internal Audit Business Intelligence & Analytics
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Internal Auditor, Accounting / Finance, Data Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Pay: $118,000 to $148,000 a year
  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: New York, NY
  • Experience: 8+ years

About this job

Lead the design and delivery of enterprise analytics, reporting, and dashboards for Internal Audit at AIG. The role combines technical expertise in Power BI, SQL, and data modeling with business acumen to transform operational and risk data into actionable insights for senior leadership.

Good fit if you have 8+ years in business intelligence, advanced Power BI and SQL skills, and experience supporting regulated business functions or internal audit operations.

Full job description

Role Summary


The Senior Manager– Business Intelligence & Analytics is responsible for leading the development and delivery of enterprise analytics, reporting, and data-driven insights for Internal Audit Department within AIG.
This role partners with senior leaders and internal auditors to transform complex operational, risk, and performance data into clear, actionable insights. The position combines strong technical expertise in business intelligence and data modeling with business acumen, stakeholder management, data governance, and analytical storytelling.
The role will lead the design of scalable reporting solutions, executive dashboards, KPI frameworks, thematic and root-cause analysis, and analytics capabilities that help leadership identify emerging risks, understand performance drivers, prioritize remediation, and make informed business decisions.


Key Responsibilities


Business Intelligence & Analytics Ownership


  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise BI and analytics solutions supporting Internal Audit Operations, and senior management.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable reporting, analytics, and data solutions.
  • Establish reporting strategies, KPI frameworks, scorecards, and analytical approaches aligned with business and regulatory objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve decision-making through advanced analytics, automation, and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Provide technical and analytical leadership to other team members.


Executive Reporting & Data Storytelling


  • Develop executive-level dashboards and management reporting that communicate key trends, risks, performance indicators, and areas requiring management attention.
  • Translate complex datasets into concise, actionable narratives for senior leadership and governance committees.
  • Present analytical findings, emerging trends, and business implications to senior management.

Power BI & Data Visualization


  • Design and develop enterprise Power BI dashboards, scorecards, and analytical applications.
  • Build scalable semantic models using dimensional/star-schema modeling principles.
  • Develop advanced DAX measures and reporting logic to support complex business requirements.
  • Create intuitive visualizations that enable both executive-level monitoring and detailed analytical investigation.

Data Engineering & Integration


  • Use SQL Server and other enterprise data sources to extract, transform, integrate, and analyze data.
  • Integrate information from platforms such as ServiceNow IRM and other data sources such as SharePoint and Snowflake databases.

Data Quality & Governance

  • Identify source-system data quality issues and assess their impact on downstream analytics and reporting.
  • Develop data-quality reports.
  • Partner with Auditors and technology teams to drive remediation of recurring data issues.

Advanced Analytics & AI


  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and advanced analytics to improve analytical efficiency and insight generation.

Stakeholder & Team Leadership


  • Lead requirements-gathering sessions and translate business questions into analytical solutions.
  • Manage competing reporting priorities and establish delivery roadmaps.
  • Mentor other team members and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, data modeling, and data storytelling.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert to business and senior leadership.

Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience in Business Intelligence Reporting, Data Management, or related disciplines.
  • Significant experience delivering analytics and reporting solutions within complex enterprise environments.
  • Advanced experience with Power BI, SQL Server, DAX, and dimensional data modeling.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, KPI development, and enterprise reporting.
  • Experience supporting Internal Audit Operations, or regulated business functions.
    Strong experience developing executive dashboards and presenting insights to senior leadership.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and analytical findings into clear business narratives and recommendations.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in Internal Audit domain.
  • Experience with ServiceNow IRM or similar Governance, Risk, and Compliance platforms.
  • Experience establishing reporting standards, and enterprise analytics operating models.


Core Competencies


Business Intelligence | Power BI | SQL | Data Modeling | Executive Reporting | Data Storytelling | Internal Audit Analytics | KPI & Scorecard Development | Data Quality | Data Governance | ServiceNow IRM | Automation | Stakeholder Management

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Parsippany, NJ
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Lead data engineer role designing, building, and operating production PySpark pipelines on AWS for AIG's Data Office. Hands-on position emphasizing end-to-end delivery, team leadership, and active use of GenAI tools like Claude Code and Snowflake Cortex.

Good fit if you have 7+ years data engineering experience with PySpark, Python, SQL, AWS services, and demonstrated use of GenAI tooling.

Full job description

Data Engineer Lead

AIG | Data Office · Data Engineering


About The Role

The Data Engineer Lead is a hands-on engineering role within AIG's Data Engineering organization. You will design, build, and operate production-grade data pipelines and platforms — and bring sound engineering judgment to every solution you deliver.

We actively leverage GenAI tooling — including Claude Code and Snowflake Cortex — as a genuine productivity multiplier across the development lifecycle. We want someone who is motivated to learn, keeps up with a fast-moving space, and continuously finds new ways to put these tools to work.

You will collaborate closely with the product owner, business stakeholders, and fellow engineers. Strong communication and analytical skills matter here as much as technical depth — the ability to ask the right questions, think through trade-offs clearly, and explain your reasoning is part of the job.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate production-grade PySpark and Python pipelines on AWS EMR, Glue, and S3 with integrated data quality checks and observability.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of data products from requirements through production, working within an Agile/Scrum framework — including sprint planning, CI/CD, release management, and production readiness
  • Translate business and product requirements into concrete technical designs, defining pipeline structure, data models, and SLAs.
  • Demonstrate a sound understanding of architecture and design patterns, evaluate trade-offs of design decisions, and articulate clear rationale to peers and stakeholders.
  • Set and enforce engineering standards — coding conventions, data quality frameworks, reusable pipeline patterns, and observability hooks — across the team.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and pair with engineers on hard problems, raising the technical quality of the whole team.
  • Leverage GenAI tooling — such as Claude Code CLI, Snowflake Cortex — throughout the development lifecycle to write better code faster and improve solution quality.
  • Collaborate with product owners to refine requirements, surface trade-offs, and push back constructively when scope is technically unworkable.
  • Communicate design decisions and delivery updates clearly to both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Mentor junior engineers through review, pairing, and knowledge sharing, building team capability alongside product delivery.
  • Produce clear technical documentation — Architecture Decision Record (ADR), runbooks, data dictionaries, and pipeline lineage notes — as a standard part of delivery, not an afterthought.
  • Evaluate and drive adoption of productivity tooling and best practices, setting team norms for safe and effective use.

Experience/Skills

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 7+ years of hands-on data engineering experience with a consistent track record delivering production data pipelines end-to-end.
  • Strong command of PySpark, Python, and SQL — including Spark optimization, partition management, and query performance tuning in Snowflake.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services: S3, Glue, EMR, Aurora, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch.
  • Working knowledge of architecture and design principles — Lakehouse patterns, data modeling, fault-tolerant ingestion — with demonstrated ability to apply them in practice.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: able to decompose complex requirements, reason through design trade-offs, and arrive at practical, well-justified solutions.
  • Clear communicator — able to explain technical decisions and design rationale in plain language to both engineering peers and business stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated learner with a genuine interest in staying current with evolving tools, frameworks, and engineering best practices.
  • Demonstrated use of GenAI tooling (e.g. Claude Code CLI or Snowflake Cortex) to improve productivity or solution quality.

Preferred/Nice To Have


  • AWS certification — Solutions Architect Associate or equivalent.
  • Domain familiarity with insurance or financial services data — claims, policy, risk, or actuarial structures.
  • Experience writing ADRs, design notes, or technical documentation in a collaborative engineering team.

Our Culture

AIG's Data Office is a team of builders, thinkers, and pragmatic problem-solvers. We move with the urgency of a technology company and the accountability of a global insurer.

Great data engineering is a team sport here. We write documentation as carefully as we write code, review designs together, mentor across every level, and keep business stakeholders close to the work. We lean into GenAI not as a novelty but as a genuine force multiplier — and we want people who share that mindset.

AIG is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and encourages candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and hybrid flexibility.

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as an Underwriter II, Energy to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Underwriter II, Energy

This Underwriter role will be an ideal next step in your career if you already have some relevant experience in insurance – or this could be your entry into underwriting if you have transferable skills.


Make your mark in Underwriting

AIG underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, Multinational Clients, and High Net Worth individuals. You will also aim to generate new business by expanding your broker network, attending broker events, and building new relationships across the market – in line with a sales plan established with your manager.

  • The ability to analyze financial statements.
  • Strong communication, networking and relationship building skills.
  • Good organizational and time management skills.
  • Customer and Sales orientated behaviors: motivated, tenacious, focused, technically skilled, proactive, and accountable.

Full job description

We are Farmers – where ambition meets opportunity.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. Job.JobTitle: Head of Lexington Middle Market Property
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Atlanta, GA
  • Experience: 15+ years

About this job

Lead AIG's Lexington Midmarket Property underwriting business, managing the GWP, P&L, and risk strategy for the excess and surplus property portfolio. Drive business vision, develop market-leading products for a producer network, and establish underwriting standards across a zonal framework.

Good fit if you have 15+ years of property insurance leadership experience, strong broker relationships, and expertise in portfolio management and first-party insurance underwriting.

Full job description

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as the Head of Midmarket Property Underwriting to play your part in that transformation. It's an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.


Make your mark in Lexington Midmarket Property


AIG underwriting teams help to find insurance solutions in areas including Financial Lines, Property, Casualty, Specialty Lines, Cyber, Multinational Clients, and High Net Worth individuals. We are reimagining how we help customers to manage risk, transforming our operating model, and reshaping our role responsibilities and career pathways. The goal is to unlock the full potential in each colleague – empowering our people to grow as insurance professionals and add more value to our customers and AIG.


How you will create an impact


  • Drive Lexington's Excess and Surplus Property Midmarket vision and value proposition that recognize changing business and competitive environment dynamics, key business drivers, and financial elements and demonstrate the value we bring to the different segments of our producer delivery network.
  • Responsible for the GWP and P&L of the Midmarket Property book of business; assessing line of business ROE and allocation of capital as necessary
  • Monitor Catastrophe modeling results within the portfolio to ensure we are in line with corporate mandates for risk aggregation in aggregate and by zone
  • Strategically review use of reinsurance to reduce volatility and as an alternative form of capital within the book and supports our risk appetite for per risk and aggregation across all product lines
  • Develop, position, market, and deliver innovative, market-leading products and services through a zonal framework to a network of producers in a manner that effectively leverages our strengths as a competitive differential in the marketplace.
  • Established business strategies to deliver a profitable shift of business mix, and support efforts to become our Clients' most Valued Insurer, all while maximizing synergy with other AIG business partners
  • Lead the Midmarket platform for Property business, working closely with Head of Wholesale Property to enhance and integrate all complimentary product offerings
  • Establish and implement a long-term business strategy for Midmarket Property focusing on risk appetite that effectively manages risk
  • Drive consistent distribution and underwriting best practices and guidelines to ensure rating and pricing adequacy of the business
  • Develop sustainable relationships with key wholesale brokers throughout the zonal framework.
  • Develop and ensure effective utilization of detailed monitoring standards including quality reviews to assess underwriting results and loss ratios down to the account level
  • Understanding of regulatory and compliance processes
  • Establish strong relationships with Lexington leadership; create mutual understanding of overall parameters and goals to drive effective execution of business model.
  • Develop tools and strategies, in collaboration with HR, to attract and retain top industry talent and develop high performing teams.
  • Drive a culture that promotes collaboration, diversity and inclusion.
  • Ensure a reputation of Claims excellence in the marketplace.

What you'll need to succeed


  • At least 15 years insurance leadership experience in Property Insurance.
  • Knowledge of market segmentation, portfolio management, acquisition and distribution
  • Proven Strategic Leadership skills in developing vision and purpose, driving for results and leading effective teams
  • Established strong relationships with brokers
  • Skilled leader of change; versatile, client focused, results oriented
  • Demonstrated business savvy, analytical and quantitative skills
  • Expert technical underwriting background with advanced knowledge of first party insurance for all industries
  • Strong problem solving and conflict resolution

In this role, you will bridge the gap between sales strategy and technical execution, ensuring that sales commissions, bonuses, and performance metrics are calculated accurately, audit-ready, and delivered on time.

Job Summary

This role owns the technical administration, governance, and lifecycle tooling for AI agents and assistants across the enterprise's three AI ecosystems: Microsoft Power Platform/Copilot Studio, the broader Microsoft 365 Copilot suite, and Anthropic Claude. The engineer builds and maintains the guardrails — data loss prevention (DLP) policies, environment strategy, identity and access controls, usage governance, and agent inventory — that let business teams build and use AI safely, and partners with security, identity, and compliance teams where governance crosses platform boundaries.

Essential Job Functions

  • Power Platform & Copilot Studio
    • Administer PPAC: environment strategy, managed environments, tenant inventory, capacity/licensing, and usage monitoring in the Power Platform Admin Center.
    • Manage DLP policies: design, implement, and maintain data loss prevention policies for Power Platform and Copilot Studio agents, including connector classification and action-level control.
    • Govern Agent 365 registrations: register and govern agents in Microsoft Agent 365, maintaining the agent registry, assigning ownership, and triaging agents flagged with security risk via Defender, Entra, and Purview signals.
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot Ecosystem
    • Administer Microsoft 365 Copilot: manage deployment across Word, Excel, Teams, Outlook, and other apps, including enterprise data protection settings.
    • Govern Copilot Chat and Agent Builder: manage the no-code declarative agent experience, including knowledge sources and consumption billing available to makers.
    • Enable and govern Copilot Cowork: administer Microsoft's agentic execution layer for long-running, multi-step tasks, including Copilot Credit billing and its use of Anthropic Claude models as a subprocessor.
    • Administer GitHub Copilot: manage organization-level policy configuration, seat management, and content-exclusion policies for engineering teams.
    • Evaluate and govern Microsoft Scout: assess Microsoft's always-on “Autopilot” personal agent, including its policy-conformance and approval controls, as it becomes available tenant-wide.
  • Anthropic Claude
    • Administer Claude Console and Claude for Enterprise: manage workspace(s), seat management, workspace/role structure, and org-wide feature settings.
    • Manage API governance: oversee API key issuance, rate limits, and spend controls; monitor usage and cost analytics across teams and use cases.
    • Configure identity management: set up SSO, SCIM provisioning, and JIT access in partnership with the identity team.
    • Own security and compliance settings: manage data retention configuration, audit log review, and (where applicable) zero data retention, CMEK, or HIPAA-ready configurations.
    • Manage Connectors and MCP integrations: support enterprise rollout and governance of Claude Code and Claude Cowork.
  • Cross-Platform Responsibilities
    • Maintain a consolidated view of agent/assistant inventory, ownership, and risk across Power Platform, M365 Copilot, and Claude for leadership reporting.
    • Feed data from all three ecosystems into the organization's Agent SDLC framework (POC, UAT, Pilot, Production) so every platform is governed under one lifecycle model.
    • Produce documentation, runbooks, and stakeholder communications on policy changes, incidents, and platform updates.

Physical Actions

Physical Environment

Education Requirements

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent, relevant experience.

Experience Requirements

  • 3+ years administering Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) in an enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and/or Microsoft 365 Copilot administration, including DLP/data policy configuration.
  • Experience administering a SaaS AI platform (Claude, OpenAI Enterprise, or similar) — workspace/org setup, SSO/SCIM, usage and spend governance.
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell and REST APIs for admin automation.
  • Understanding of identity concepts (conditional access, SSO, service/agent identities) across Microsoft Entra and third-party identity providers.

Special Skill Requirement

Additional Qualification

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Agent 365 and the newer Microsoft Scout Autopilot agent model.
  • Experience governing Copilot Cowork, including its usage-based billing and multi-model (Claude subprocessor) architecture.
  • Direct experience with Claude Console, Claude API, and enterprise data controls.
  • Experience administering GitHub Copilot for engineering organizations.
  • Background in AI governance frameworks or SDLC-style lifecycle models spanning multiple AI vendors.
  • Microsoft certifications (PL-600, SC-300) and/or Anthropic partner/enterprise training.

The Learning Experience Coordinator is a key operational partner supporting University of Farmers learning, training, and leadership development programs. This role ensures that the logistics and administrative activities behind learning programs are organized, accurate, and delivered on time.

You will coordinate training schedules, learning cohorts, facilitators, learner registrations, leadership development events, workshops, credentialing programs, and stakeholder meetings. As a central point of contact for learners, facilitators, vendors, and business partners, you will help create a seamless learning experience while ensuring program details, communications, calendars, materials, and records are properly managed.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong organization, attention to detail, communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced learning environment.

Essential Job Functions

  • Coordinate the day-to-day logistics and administrative activities for learning, training, leadership development, credentialing, and special learning programs

  • Serve as a central point of contact for learners, facilitators, business partners, vendors, and other stakeholders

  • Partner with learning, leadership development, training, and business teams to understand operational needs and coordinate effective solutions
  • Support vendor coordination and administrative activities related to external learning providers and facilitators
  • Use learning management systems, scheduling tools, Microsoft Office, and other administrative platforms to manage program information and workflows
  • Conduct quality and accuracy checks on schedules, learner records, communications, and program materials
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, operational issues, or missing information and proactively coordinate solutions
  • Maintain organized documentation and records in accordance with organizational policies and program requirements
  • Support reporting and tracking of program participation, attendance, completion, and other operational metrics
  • Contribute to process improvements that make learning program coordination more efficient and improve the learner experience
  • Ensure program administration and learner information are handled accurately and in accordance with applicable policies, confidentiality requirements, and data privacy standards

Experience Requirements

  • Experience in program coordination, learning operations, training coordination, administrative coordination, project coordination, or a related field

Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver technical solutions that support complex business initiatives. The role acts as a knowledgeable resource to provide systems-level views of technology and devise technical solutions aligned with business objectives. It focuses on enhancing solution design, optimizing development processes, and effectively implementing CI/CD pipelines to deliver impactful solutions that meet business needs. The position ensures technology delivery is successful within lines of business and across the enterprise. It performs work independently while receiving limited guidance or direction.

Essential Tasks & Leadership Philosophy

  • Engages with cross-functional business stakeholders and technical teams to understand and address complex initiatives within a business unit or at the enterprise level. Participates in discussions to gather requirements, develop solutions, validate technology assumptions, and evaluate implementation alternatives. Influences solution strategies by leveraging in-depth business knowledge and practical experience in solution engineering.
  • Leads multiple technical projects simultaneously by prioritizing and coordinating solution engineering efforts across teams and initiatives. Uses established performance metrics to measure effectiveness and make necessary adjustments. Manages non-functional requirements and ensures compliance with industry standards throughout the solution development and delivery process.
  • Acts as a servant leader for the solution by ensuring Agile Release Trains operate effectively. Identifies and resolves constraints across the development and delivery process while collaborating with Release Train Engineers to coordinate delivery. Provides a systems view of the development lifecycle to guide technology delivery and align architecture with business objectives. Serves solutions with one or more Agile Release Trains or business units.
  • Develops and refines technical designs to meet business requirements for complex solutions while ensuring scalability and performance. Collaborates with developers and Agile Release Trains to align solutions with enterprise architecture. Works with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that streamline deployment and integrate new features. Engages with quality assurance teams to validate that technical solutions meet performance and reliability standards.
  • Supports development and delivery of complex solutions by ensuring technical implementations align with product roadmaps and overarching business strategies. Monitors progress, resolves issues affecting delivery timelines, and contributes to technical problem-solving efforts during development and deployment phases. Collaborates with business stakeholders and technical teams to address challenges and optimize solutions.
  • Maintains technical documentation for solutions to facilitate knowledge sharing and makes updates as architecture or functionality changes. Engages in continuous learning to stay current with trends and technologies in solution engineering. Applies learning to enhance own skills and impact the quality of work produced. Shares best practices in solution engineering across business units and the enterprise to promote peer learning. Supports pioneering of design and development practices to promote innovation and improvement across solutions.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education & Career Experience Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required. Bachelors degree preferred in computer science, engineering, or similar field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience required in solution engineering, software development, systems architecture, or related.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and working in Agile teams preferred.
  • Experience in the insurance industry preferred.

First Year Success Factors

  • Establish credibility as the trusted advisor and primary point of accountability for AI strategy and business value realization across IT and business organizations.
  • Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of AI opportunities aligned to enterprise objectives, ensuring clear business outcomes, investment rationale, value realization targets, and executive sponsorship.
  • Partner with senior business and technology leaders to identify strategic opportunities where AI can improve customer experience, operational efficiency, employee productivity, risk management, and revenue growth.
  • Drive enterprise alignment across business units, technology teams, governance bodies, and executive stakeholders to accelerate AI adoption and remove organizational barriers to execution.
  • Define and track meaningful business KPIs for AI investments, ensuring measurable outcomes through productivity gains, cost reduction, process optimization, improved decision-making, and customer impact.
  • Lead the governance and prioritization process for AI initiatives, ensuring investments are aligned with enterprise strategy, regulatory requirements, risk appetite, and organizational capacity.
  • Build and institutionalize repeatable frameworks for AI opportunity assessment, business case development, prioritization, value tracking, and executive reporting.
  • Create a portfolio of enterprise AI success stories that demonstrate business impact and serve as catalysts for broader adoption across the organization.
  • Champion a culture of innovation and responsible AI by leading executive engagement, business workshops, innovation forums, strategic planning sessions, and change management initiatives.
  • Influence and enable leaders, product owners, and business teams to identify, evaluate, and adopt AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with architecture, data, security, legal, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise standards while balancing speed, innovation, and risk management.
  • Establish executive-level visibility into AI strategy, investments, risks, adoption metrics, and business outcomes through regular reporting, scorecards, and portfolio reviews.
  • Build strategic partnerships across internal teams and external vendors to accelerate innovation, leverage emerging capabilities, and maximize enterprise value.
  • Foster an organization-wide mindset focused on continuous improvement, experimentation, business transformation, and value-driven adoption of AI technologies.

Additional Qualification

  • Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.

Strong proficiency in one or more phases of the software development lifecycle. In-depth knowledge of multiple systems and their key components. Job Summary

This position handles Tier 3 California mid-loss auto policy claims requiring in-depth claim investigation, coverage confirmation, damage assessment, liability determination, and settlement negotiation. The role owns the entire claim process and serves as the primary point of contact to facilitate claim resolution. This position uses in-depth expertise to manage claim scenarios such as multi-vehicle auto losses with comparative negligence and bodily injury losses pertaining to soft tissue injury, fracture, dislocation, ligament injury, herniated disc and nerve injuries. In addition to claim issues handled at lower tier levels, this position investigates coverage issues requiring in-depth investigation, policy interpretation, and knowledge of state statutes and case law such as those with applicable exclusions or endorsements. Works within prescribed authority to proactively and accurately resolve claims. Escalates claims with exposures exceeding financial authority or Tier 3 complexity to supervisor.

*Candidate must reside in PST, CST, or MST. Will consider EST, however candidate must be willing to work until 3 PM PST.

Essential Job Functions

  • Evaluates bodily injury claims promptly including assessment of medical and general damages and wage loss. Analyzes injury causation for all alleged injuries.
  • Evaluates, sets, and updates case reserve amount for injury exposures throughout the life of the claim.
  • Negotiates settlement of bodily injury claims with unrepresented claimants and with represented claimants attorneys.
  • Recognizes and investigates all potential claim exposures, including injury exposures.
  • Conducts investigations by obtaining recorded statements of involved parties.
  • Collects police reports, vehicle photos, scene inspections, signed medical authorizations, medical bills and medical records, and other supporting evidence.
  • May conduct in-person or virtual meetings with customers based on claim needs.
  • Analyzes duties owed and breached by all potential responsible parties and determines liability percentage for each party.
  • Communicates liability decisions to stakeholders including customers, claimants, claim specialists, and Underwriting. Recognizes subrogation potential and makes referrals to Subrogation department when appropriate.
  • Communicates policy risk issues to Underwriting to facilitate evaluation of policy risk and exposure.
  • Conducts material misrepresentation investigations and submits findings to Underwriting; maintains active diary and resolution plan on open claim files.
  • Handles and documents claim files in compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Authorizes and issues claim payments to customers, repair facilities, rental vendors, and others.
  • Obtains signed release of claims and issues payment upon final settlement.
  • Provides professional verbal and written communication to customers including claim status updates, coverage explanations and decisions, and correspondence, including Reservation of Rights and Disclaimer letters, within prescribed authority limits.
  • Communicates with insured throughout the claim process to keep them informed; comprehensively assesses policy details to confirm coverage.
  • Makes same-day contact with customers to explain the claim process and verify facts of loss.
  • Explains coverage details to policyholders; determines vehicle location and condition.
  • Secures timely auto physical damage estimates via proper inspection method and repair channel.
  • Explains repair process and estimates to customers and offers repair and rental service options.
  • Proactively manages and mitigates storage costs and arranges release of vehicles accruing storage fees.
  • Coordinates with auto physical damage and total loss specialists to facilitate claim resolution.
  • Mentors Tier 3 Claim Owner I level.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
  • Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance.

Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Remote

About this job

Handle General Liability and Commercial Auto claims including investigations, coverage determinations, reserve setting, and payment authorization. Remote position requiring seven years of claims experience and state adjusting license.

Good fit if you have seven plus years handling GL or Commercial Auto claims and can obtain a state adjusting license

Full job description

What you'll be doing:
In accordance with application of state and federal laws and company best practices, gather and review claim information, determine coverage, determine duty, and conduct liability investigations. Initiate and maintain contact with claim parties to provide updates and resolve issues timely. Update the claim system to document claim handling activities throughout the life of the claim. Determine, set, and maintain reserves and issue payments in line with a level of authority.  Review contracts and thoroughly investigate risk transfer possibilities.  Investigate and refer identified claims to Loss Recovery Services, as applicable.  Direct vendors and review reports to evaluate exposure.  Manage and direct counsel when litigation is involved.

On any given day, you'll:

  • Perform claim tasks timely and document claim files appropriately. Proactively manage claim activities to ensure fair claim resolution. Handle all claims in accordance with state and federal laws.
  • Make complex coverage decisions by gathering information necessary to make an informed decision in a fair, equitable, and ethical manner. Deny losses within authority level, providing detailed explanation, citing facts, and policy language.
  • Perform a thorough investigation based upon the type, complexity, and severity of the claim. Upon completion of the investigation, analyze and evaluate the potential exposure and damages, including potential full or partial liability and compensability denials. Formulate and document an action plan based on the covered damages and injuries.
  • Determine and set reserves based on the most probable outcome of the claim, within authority level. Evaluate and negotiate directly with insured, claimant, or claimant's attorney on all cases within authority level. Review claim facts and exposure with claims management, as appropriate, to guide claim strategy. Make complete, accurate, and timely payments within authority for covered losses. Refer claims above authority to appropriate team member for review and potential reassignment.
  • Maintain a professional, courteous, and helpful approach when communicating in-person, on the phone, or through email and other correspondence with internal and external customers, business partners and brokers.
  • Recognize when vendor partners are required on a claim, including experts, independent adjustors, nurses, defense attorneys, etc. Assign and direct vendors, as needed, to aid in the investigation and evaluation of the claim. Manage claim expense by concluding vendor assignment when vendor is no longer adding value to the claim.
  • Investigate and refer identified claims to Loss Recovery Services, as applicable.
  • Act as a resource to share knowledge and experience with other claim handlers. Assist and support their development with mentoring and auditing functions.
  • Negotiate settlements, attend mediations, attend settlement conferences, engage in various ADR opportunities.

Here's what we expect:

  • Minimum of seven years handling General Liability and/or Commercial Auto claims is required.
  • Three years of litigation management experience is preferred.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree preferred. A combination of equivalent education and/or experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Additional training in insurance, medical, and/or building terminology knowledge is desirable.
  • Completion of INS, AIC, or CPCU is preferred.

Necessary Knowledge and Abilities:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain state adjusting license requirements and complete continuing education requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and manage workload timely.
  • Strong listening, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Proficient knowledge of policy terminology and legal principles involving at least one or more of the following: insurance, automobile, medical and property claims.


Church Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.


Exact compensation will vary based on consideration of a variety of factors including education, skills, experience, and location.

Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Philadelphia, PA
  • Education: Bachelor's degree
  • License: Valid driver's license

About this job

Associate Environmental Underwriter in a structured development program starting June 2027. You'll learn environmental insurance underwriting, risk assessment, and coverage analysis while working alongside experienced underwriters on real-world cases.

Good fit if you have 0-2 years of professional experience, a bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Insurance, or Environmental Studies, and valid US work authorization.

Full job description


Description

Are you curious, analytical, and energized by solving complex business challenges? Do you enjoy evaluating risk, building relationships, and making informed decisions? Are you interested in helping businesses navigate environmental exposures and emerging risks?

If so, Liberty Mutual'sEnvironmental Division may be the perfect place to launch your career.

The Details

As an Associate Environmental Underwriter, you'll participate in a structured development program designed to build the technical, analytical, and business skills needed for a successful underwriting career. Working alongside experienced environmental underwriters, you'll learn how businesses identify, manage, and mitigate complex environmental risks through specialized insurance solutions.

Environmental liability is one of the most dynamic and evolving areas of risk. From site pollution and contractor environmental liabilities to emergency cleanup exposures and emerging environmental concerns, organizations face challenges that require specialized expertise and innovative risk management solutions. Our Environmental team helps businesses manage both the risks they can see and the risks they can't.

About Global Risk Solutions Environmental

Liberty Mutual's Environmental team provides a comprehensive suite of environmental insurance products backed by expert underwriting, proactive claims support, and specialized services such as crisis management and incident response. We partner with businesses, brokers, and industry professionals to help organizations navigate environmental liabilities while supporting responsible business growth.

Throughout the program, you'll gain exposure to environmental insurance products, underwriting principles, risk assessment, coverage analysis, and customer relationship management. You'll learn how environmental risks impact businesses across a variety of industries and how underwriting decisions balance customer needs, risk selection, and profitable growth objectives.

Training & Development

The Underwriting Development Program combines formal training, mentorship, structured learning, and hands-on underwriting experience starting in June 2027. Through real-world assignments and collaboration with experienced professionals, you'll develop skills in risk evaluation, coverage analysis, financial review, negotiation, and relationship management.

You will learn alongside a cohort of peers, build connections across the business, and receive ongoing coaching to support your growth as an underwriting professional.

Please note that this position does not offer relocation assistance.

We encourage interested candidates to apply early, as applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Interviews and offers are extended throughout the recruiting season as qualified candidates are identified.

Qualifications

What youve got

  • You have 0-2 years of related professional experience.
  • You hold, or will be completing, a Bachelors degree in Risk Management & Insurance, Environmental Studiesor a related discipline.
  • A strong academic record with a cumulative 3.0 GPA preferred.
  • You possess strong analytical, decision-making, and negotiating skills.
  • You have solid interpersonal skills and demonstrate a passion for customer service.
  • You must be willing to complete professional designation(s) and continued insurance education.
  • You must have permanent work authorization in the United States.
  • You must possess and maintain a valid driver's license for regular travel to customer locations.

Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual Investments manages Liberty Mutual Insurance Groups global financial assets across public and private domains, to create capital and generate income. With over $100 billion in AUM and staffed with 300+ investment, finance and operations professionals located in Boston, MA., Liberty Mutual Investments offers the best of both worlds; the look and feel of a boutique investment firm, and the reputation and financial strength of a Fortune 100 company.

Note: This role has a preferred hybrid work arrangement (3 days per week in our Boston office).

The Principal Full Stack Software Engineer for the Public Markets Agile Squad will:

- Provide hands-on technical leadership designing and building real-time, highthroughput trading and market data platforms for Global Liquid Markets.

- Partner closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and Solution Engineers to cocreate solution designs that balance speed, resilience, security, and enterprise quality.

- Serve as the technical authority on the squad, guiding architecture decisions, setting engineering standards, and ensuring alignment with Public Markets and enterprise technology strategy.

- Design clean, evolvable architectures for lowlatency, eventdriven, and APIfirst systems supporting institutional trading workflows.

- Embed modern software engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and responsible use of AI across the SDLC to improve developer productivity and system quality.

- Lead design reviews, produce clear architectural artifacts, and articulate technical tradeoffs to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

- Collaborate across squads and enterprise architecture to deliver integrated solutions while avoiding local optimization.

- Mentor and develop engineers through code reviews, pairing, and coaching, setting a high bar for engineering excellence.

Qualifications

Experience

- 8+ years of software engineering experience in an agile environment

- Prior experience building realtime trading, execution, order management, or market data systems for institutional investors strongly preferred.

- Deep understanding of distributed systems, lowlatency architectures, and resilient, faulttolerant design.

- Proven experience working in fastpaced, regulated financial services environments.

Skills

- Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend development; experience with cloudnative architectures on AWS (e.g., Lambda, Fargate, Step Functions).

- Experience designing and consuming REST and eventdriven APIs; familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake and ingestion pipelines.

- Practical experience applying AIassisted tools in the SDLC (e.g., code generation, test creation, observability, or productivity tooling).

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and influence skills.

Knowledge

- Deep knowledge of software architecture patterns, security and privacy controls, and enterprise engineering practices.

- Strong grasp of agile delivery, backlog management, and incremental value delivery.

Education

A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Highly Desirable: CFA or Progress towards CFA

Full job description


Description

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a claims team with a fast-growing company that has consistently outpaced the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual has an excellent claims opportunity available. As a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative, you will review, and process simple and straightforward Commercial claims within assigned authority limits consistent with policy and legal requirements. In addition to a wide range of benefits, as a direct employee, your insurance education and training are paid by Liberty Mutual.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices:Boston, MA; Westborough, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL;Weatogue, CT; Indianapolis, IN; Plano, TX;Suwanee, GA; orLake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ. (Please note this policy is subject to change.)

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates claim using internal and external resources including speaking with the insured or other involved parties, analysis of reports, researching past claim activity, utilizing evaluation tools to make damage and loss assessments.
  • Extensive and timely direct interaction with Insured's, Claimants, Agent's and Internal Customers.
  • Determines policy coverage through analysis of investigation data and policy terms. Notifies agent and insured of coverage or any issues.
  • Establishes claim reserve requirements and makes adjustments, as necessary, during the processing of the claims.
  • Determines and negotiates settlement amount for damages claimed within assigned authority limits.
  • Write simple to moderately complex property damage estimates or review auto damage estimates.
  • Takes statements when necessary and works with the Field Appraisal, Subrogation, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) as appropriate.
  • Maintains accurate and current claim file/damage documentation and diaries throughout the life cycle of claim cases to ensure proper tracking and handling consistently with established guidelines and expectations.
  • Alerts Unit Leader to the possibility of fraud or subrogation potential for claims being processed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors Degree preferred. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1-2 years of experience. Claims handling skills preferred.
  • Strong customer service and technology skills.
  • Able to navigate multiple systems, strong organizational and communication skills.

This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a claims team with a fast-growing company that has consistently outpaced the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual has an excellent claims opportunity available. As a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative, you will review, and process simple and straightforward Commercial claims within assigned authority limits consistent with policy and legal requirements. In addition to a wide range of benefits, as a direct employee, your insurance education and training are paid by Liberty Mutual.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices:Boston, MA; Westborough, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL;Weatogue, CT; Indianapolis, IN; Plano, TX;Suwanee, GA; orLake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ. (Please note this policy is subject to change.)

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates claim using internal and external resources including speaking with the insured or other involved parties, analysis of reports, researching past claim activity, utilizing evaluation tools to make damage and loss assessments.
  • Extensive and timely direct interaction with Insured's, Claimants, Agent's and Internal Customers.
  • Determines policy coverage through analysis of investigation data and policy terms. Notifies agent and insured of coverage or any issues.
  • Establishes claim reserve requirements and makes adjustments, as necessary, during the processing of the claims.
  • Determines and negotiates settlement amount for damages claimed within assigned authority limits.
  • Write simple to moderately complex property damage estimates or review auto damage estimates.
  • Takes statements when necessary and works with the Field Appraisal, Subrogation, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) as appropriate.
  • Maintains accurate and current claim file/damage documentation and diaries throughout the life cycle of claim cases to ensure proper tracking and handling consistently with established guidelines and expectations.
  • Alerts Unit Leader to the possibility of fraud or subrogation potential for claims being processed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors Degree preferred. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1-2 years of experience. Claims handling skills preferred.
  • Strong customer service and technology skills.
  • Able to navigate multiple systems, strong organizational and communication skills.
  • License may be required in multiple states by state law.

About this job

Liberty Mutual seeks a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative to review and process commercial claims within assigned authority limits. The role involves investigating claims, determining coverage, negotiating settlements, and writing damage estimates, with hybrid work requiring office presence twice monthly if within 50 miles of specified locations.

Good fit if you have 1-2 years of claims handling experience, strong customer service and technology skills, and a high school diploma or bachelor's degree.

Full job description


Description

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a claims team with a fast-growing company that has consistently outpaced the industry in year-over-year growth? Liberty Mutual has an excellent claims opportunity available. As a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative, you will review, and process simple and straightforward Commercial claims within assigned authority limits consistent with policy and legal requirements. In addition to a wide range of benefits, as a direct employee, your insurance education and training are paid by Liberty Mutual.

You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices:Boston, MA; Westborough, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL;Weatogue, CT; Indianapolis, IN; Plano, TX;Suwanee, GA; orLake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Chandler, AZ. (Please note this policy is subject to change.)

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates claim using internal and external resources including speaking with the insured or other involved parties, analysis of reports, researching past claim activity, utilizing evaluation tools to make damage and loss assessments.
  • Extensive and timely direct interaction with Insured's, Claimants, Agent's and Internal Customers.
  • Determines policy coverage through analysis of investigation data and policy terms. Notifies agent and insured of coverage or any issues.

  • Write simple to moderately complex property damage estimates or review auto damage estimates.
  • Takes statements when necessary and works with the Field Appraisal, Subrogation, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) as appropriate.
  • Maintains accurate and current claim file/damage documentation and diaries throughout the life cycle of claim cases to ensure proper tracking and handling consistently with established guidelines and expectations.
  • Alerts Unit Leader to the possibility of fraud or subrogation potential for claims being processed.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Specialist, Miscellaneous Medical Facilities & Long-Term Care Professional Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for an experienced claims professional with focus on Miscellaneous Medical Facilities (MMF) and Long-Term Care (LTC) Professional Liability.As a Senior Claims Specialist, you will handle a book of specialty lines MMF/LTC Professional Liability claims throughout the life of the claim. In this role, you will be responsible for conducting investigations, recommending adequate reserves, monitoring, documenting, and settling/closing claims in an expeditious and economical manner within prescribed authority limits for the line of business.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzes, investigates, and evaluates MMF/LTC Professional Liability claims from first notice of loss through resolution he loss to determine coverage and claim disposition.
  • Within prescribed settlement authority for the line of business, establishes appropriate reserves for both indemnity and expense and reviews on a regular basis to ensure adequacy.
  • Makes recommendations to set reserves at appropriate level for claims outside of authority level.
  • Prepares comprehensive reports as required. Identifies and communicates specific claim trends and account and/or policy issues to management and underwriting.
  • Manages the litigation process through the retention of counsel.
  • Adheres to the line of business litigation guidelines to include budget, bill review and payment.
  • Monitors the case resolution process. Actively participates in mediations and arbitrations, within limit of settlement authority.
  • Participates in meetings with brokers, risk managers, and reinsurers.
  • As required, maintains insurance adjuster licenses.

*This position may have in-office requirements and other travel needs depending on candidate location. You will be required to go into an office twice a month if you reside within 50-miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; or Westborough, MA. We will consider a remote candidate if you do not live within 50-miles of one of these offices. This policy is subject to change.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors' and/or advanced degree. JD is a plus, especially with experience litigating Professional Liability claims (MMF or LTC).
  • 5+ years claims/legal experience, with substantive, hands-on, medical Professional Liability claims (providers and/or facilities).
  • Functional knowledge of claims handling Professional Liability concepts, practices and techniques, to include but not limited to coverage issues, and product line knowledge.
  • Functional knowledge of law and insurance regulations in various jurisdictions common to Miscellaneous Medical Facilities and/or Long-Term Care Professional Liability.
  • Proven analytical, negotiation and written/verbal communication skills; able to present complex clinical and coverage positions to Counsel, Underwriters, Senior Management, and other applicable parties.

About this job

Claims Specialist at Liberty Mutual manages routine to moderately complex insurance claims from investigation through resolution, including liability assessments, damage evaluation, and settlement negotiations. Hybrid role based in Hoffman Estates, Illinois with in-office attendance twice monthly.

Good fit if you have 2+ years claims adjustment experience, a BS/BA degree, and knowledge of bodily injury and commercial claims.

Full job description


Description

The Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to manage an assigned caseload of routine to moderately complex claims from the investigation of the claim through resolution. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, and negotiating settlements. The role interacts with claimants, policyholders, appraisers, attorneys, and other third parties throughout the claims management process. The position offers training developed with an emphasis on enhancing skills needed to help provide exceptional service to our customers.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates within 50 miles of select offices are expected in-office twice a Month.

Responsibilities:

  • Manages an inventory of claims to evaluate compensability/liability.
  • Establishes action plan based on case facts, best practices, protocols, regulatory issues and available resources.
  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims to confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability and damages.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim, refers claims to the subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Experience with bodily injury and commercial claims required.
Qualifications
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience in claims adjustment, general insurance or formal claims training.
  • Required to obtain and maintain all applicable licenses.
  • Continuing education courses leading to industry certifications preferred (e.g., AEI, IIA, CPCU).
  • Knowledge of claims investigation techniques, medical terminology and legal aspects of claims.

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit.

Description

The Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team, using the latest technology to manage an assigned caseload of routine to moderately complex claims from the investigation of the claim through resolution. This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, and negotiating settlements. The role interacts with claimants, policyholders, appraisers, attorneys, and other third parties throughout the claims management process. The position offers training developed with an emphasis on enhancing skills needed to help provide exceptional service to our customers.

This is a hybrid position. Candidates within 50 miles of select offices are expected in-office twice a Month.

Responsibilities:

  • Manages an inventory of claims to evaluate compensability/liability.
  • Establishes action plan based on case facts, best practices, protocols, regulatory issues and available resources.
  • Plans and conducts investigations of claims to confirm coverage and to determine liability, compensability and damages.
  • Assesses policy coverage for submitted claims and notifies the insured of any issues; determines and establishes reserve requirements, adjusting reserves, as necessary, during the processing of the claim, refers claims to the subrogation group or Special Investigations Unit as appropriate.
  • Assesses actual damages associated with claims and conducts negotiations, within assigned authority limits, to settle claims.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Experience with bodily injury and commercial claims required.
Qualifications
  • BS/BA degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years experience in claims adjustment, general insurance or formal claims training.
  • Required to obtain and maintain all applicable licenses.
  • Continuing education courses leading to industry certifications preferred (e.g., AEI, IIA, CPCU).
  • Knowledge of claims investigation techniques, medical terminology and legal aspects of claims.

As part of the application process, you'll complete an assessment related to the skills needed for this role please allow approximately 35 minutes, although there is no time limit.

Job.JobTitle: Complex Claims Specialist, Miscellaneous Medical Facilities Professional Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Weatogue, CT

About this job

Manage medical professional liability claims from investigation through resolution for specialty facilities like surgery centers and urgent care. Lead high-exposure matters with autonomy, coordinating clinical experts and outside counsel while applying advanced coverage analysis and litigation strategy.

Good fit if you have 7+ years claims or legal experience with medical malpractice expertise and strong analytical and negotiation skills.

Full job description


Description

Liberty Mutual has an immediate opening for a Complex Claims Specialist to join our Miscellaneous Medical Facilities Claims Team. This is a high-visibility, hands-on role for an experienced Professional Liability claims handler with deep medical malpractice expertise. With minimal supervision, the Complex Claims Specialist will manage a book of specialty MMF Professional Liability Claims through the entire lifecycle, applying advanced coverage interpretation, clinical issue spotting, complex litigation management and prudent reserving to resolve high-exposure matters economically and defensibly.

Why this role matters

  • Lead ownership of complex medical professional liability claims (e.g., ambulatory surgery centers, urgent care, behavioral health, home health, correctional medicine, clinical staffing).
  • Opportunity to shape claim strategy on high-severity matters, coordinate clinical/expert resources, and act as an internal subject-matter resource for underwriting, reinsurance, and senior leadership.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with autonomy to influence outcomes and policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage Professional Liability Claims from first notice through resolution: investigate, analyze coverage, evaluate liability and damages, establish and adjust reserves, negotiate settlements and close files within authority.
  • Perform advanced coverage analysis (duty to defend vs. indemnify, occurrence vs. claims-made, allocation, additional insured issues, contractual liability, tail exposures, endorsements) and prepare clear coverage opinions and reservation of rights/declination communications.
  • Document claims thoroughly using Claims Management System and proactively diary follow-up actions and deadlines.
  • Set indemnity and expense reserves within authority; escalate and recommend reserves for matters outside authority; review reserves regularly and justify reserve positions to management and auditors.
  • Manage litigation: retain and oversee outside defense counsel with LTC expertise, control budgets and billing, direct discovery strategy, and evaluate mediation/arbitration/trial risk to optimize resolution.
  • Coordinate clinical resources and expert consultants (nursing, pharmacy, infection control, medical specialists) for chart review, causation analysis and expert testimony.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, reinsurance and subrogation on allocation, ceded reporting and recovery opportunities.
  • Identify and report claim trends, coverage exposures, and policy issues to management and underwriting; contribute to playbooks, training and process improvements.
  • Participate in mediations and arbitrations within settlement authority and support major loss response efforts.
  • Maintain required adjuster licenses and adhere to company litigation and billing guidelines.

*This position may have in-office requirements and other travel needs depending on candidate location. You will be required to go into an office twice a month if you reside within 50-miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; or Westborough, MA. We will consider a remote candidate if you do not live within 50-miles of one of these offices. This policy is subject to change.

We are open to fill this position depending on related professional skills and experience. The salary range reflects the varying pay scale that encompasses each of the Liberty Mutual regions, the salary for both levels, and the overall cost of labor for that region. Please note your salary range may not fall at the top of the posted range, depending on your location.

Qualifications
  • Bachelors' and/or advanced degree.J.D. is a plus!
  • 7 + years claims/legal experience, with at least 2 years within a technical specialty preferred.
  • Medical Malpractice claims experience strongly desired.
  • Advanced knowledge of claims handling concepts, practices and techniques, to include but not limited to coverage issues and product line knowledge.
  • Functional knowledge of law and insurance regulations in various jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated advanced verbal and written communications skills.
  • Demonstrated advanced analytical, decision making, and negotiation skills.
  • Obtain and maintain Adjuster's license.

With minimal supervision, the Complex Claims Specialist will manage a book of specialty MMF Professional Liability Claims through the entire lifecycle, applying advanced coverage interpretation, clinical issue spotting, complex litigation management and prudent reserving to resolve high-exposure matters economically and defensibly.

Why this role matters

  • Lead ownership of complex medical professional liability claims (e.g., ambulatory surgery centers, urgent care, behavioral health, home health, correctional medicine, clinical staffing).
  • Opportunity to shape claim strategy on high-severity matters, coordinate clinical/expert resources, and act as an internal subject-matter resource for underwriting, reinsurance, and senior leadership.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with autonomy to influence outcomes and policy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage Professional Liability Claims from first notice through resolution: investigate, analyze coverage, evaluate liability and damages, establish and adjust reserves, negotiate settlements and close files within authority.
  • Perform advanced coverage analysis (duty to defend vs. indemnify, occurrence vs. claims-made, allocation, additional insured issues, contractual liability, tail exposures, endorsements) and prepare clear coverage opinions and reservation of rights/declination communications.
  • Document claims thoroughly using Claims Management System and proactively diary follow-up actions and deadlines.
  • Set indemnity and expense reserves within authority; escalate and recommend reserves for matters outside authority; review reserves regularly and justify reserve positions to management and auditors.
  • Manage litigation: retain and oversee outside defense counsel with LTC expertise, control budgets and billing, direct discovery strategy, and evaluate mediation/arbitration/trial risk to optimize resolution.
  • Coordinate clinical resources and expert consultants (nursing, pharmacy, infection control, medical specialists) for chart review, causation analysis and expert testimony.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, reinsurance and subrogation on allocation, ceded reporting and recovery opportunities.
  • Identify and report claim trends, coverage exposures, and policy issues to management and underwriting; contribute to playbooks, training and process improvements.
  • Participate in mediations and arbitrations within settlement authority and support major loss response efforts.
  • Maintain required adjuster licenses and adhere to company litigation and billing guidelines.

*This position may have in-office requirements and other travel needs depending on candidate location. You will be required to go into an office twice a month if you reside within 50-miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Hoffman Estates, IL; Indianapolis, IN; Lake Oswego, OR; Las Vegas, NV; Plano, TX; Suwanee, GA; Chandler, AZ; or Westborough, MA.   • Functional knowledge of law and insurance regulations in various jurisdictions.
