Job.JobTitle: Product Owner III, Insurance Investment Accounting, Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Accountant, Accounting / Finance, Insurance Product Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Description

The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI

The Position:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is seeking aProduct Owner III to support its Accounting Product, with responsibility for investment accounting and regulatory and financial reporting capabilities across multiple reporting frameworks, including statutory (National Association of Insurance Commissioners, NAIC), GAAP, and TAX. The role will focus on enhancing and maintaining accounting and reporting capabilities within LMI's investment accounting platform, SimCorp Dimension, and its related data and reporting processes, with an emphasis on the end-to-end processes and upstream data that produce reported figures, including quarterly and annual statutory investment schedules. This position reports to the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner within Financial Products and Global Investment Solutions (GIS).

Operating at the intersection of Investment Accounting, Finance, Technology, Data, Investment Product, and the platform vendor, the Product Owner will translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable product priorities and drive the delivery of technology solutions that enable accurate, timely, and reliable financial and regulatory reporting. The role will own the Accounting Product backlog and proactively partner with Agile delivery teams, other Product Owners, and SimCorp Dimension's Regulatory Center of Excellence (REGCOE) to deliver solutions aligned with business priorities and regulatory commitments.

This role requires strong business acumen, technical fluency, sound judgment, and a proactive approach: anticipating regulatory and accounting changes, setting and communicating timelines, and aligning dependencies early. The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners and senior leadership to strengthen data quality and controls, improve reporting processes, reduce operational risk, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Responsibilities:

Product Strategy, Prioritization & Delivery

  • Partner with the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner and stakeholders to shape and execute the Accounting Product roadmap across reporting frameworks (statutory/NAIC, GAAP, and TAX), ensuring alignment with broader product strategy and regulatory requirements.
  • Own and prioritize the Accounting Product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory deadlines, strategic enhancements, technical improvements, and production support, and serve as the point of coordination for all accounting- and reporting-related changes across product backlogs.
  • Translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Proactively collaborate with other Product Owners, SimCorp Dimension's REGCOE, and technology and data teams to anticipate dependencies, remove impediments before they affect delivery, and drive outcomes.
  • Set clear deadlines and handoff dates for each deliverable and maintain visibility of partner teams' commitments and deadlines so that dependencies, sequencing, and critical-path risks are managed in advance.
  • Lead Agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and coordination of development, testing, business validation, and production implementation.
  • Evaluate business value, feasibility, and regulatory risk to make informed prioritization decisions and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Regulatory & Accounting Change Management

  • Proactively monitor regulatory, statutory accounting, and reporting framework changes (e.g., NAIC updates), as well as SimCorp REGCOE releases and roadmap items, and assess their impact on systems, data flows, and downstream processes ahead of effective dates.
  • Translate upcoming changes into backlog items with defined timelines, owners, and testing and validation plans, and communicate impacts, priorities, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership early.
  • Assess the impact of new investment types and reporting requirements across statutory, GAAP, and TAX bases, including basis differences (such as the statutory-to-GAAP "stat gap") and their effect on reporting content and downstream processes.
  • Apply working knowledge of investment accounting, investment operations, and the upstream data that feeds reporting (trade capture and settlement, security master and reference data, pricing and valuation sources, custodian and counterparty data, and corporate actions) to evaluate how upstream changes affect reporting accuracy and timing.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Internal (LMI): Partner with Investment Reporting, Operations, Investment Product, Data Product, Technology and other Financial Product teams to deliver accurate, complete, and timely financial and regulatory reporting.
  • Liberty Mutual Group (LMG): Coordinate with LMG Corporate Accounting, Finance, TAX, and other group functions that depend on LMI's accounting and reporting outputs, aligning on requirements, calendars, and priorities.
  • Vendors: Work with SimCorp, implementation partners, and other platform and data vendors to manage releases, defects, enhancements, and delivery commitments.
  • Regulators and external parties: Support engagement with regulators, auditors, and advisors as needed, and ensure reporting changes and regulatory requirements are understood and addressed ahead of deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Accounting Product stakeholders, building strong relationships, facilitating decisions, and communicating priorities, progress, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Proactively identify and resolve reporting issues, data quality concerns, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks as appropriate to protect critical reporting timelines.

Data Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Data Product and Investment Product, alongside Accounting, Finance, and Technology stakeholders, to define data requirements, ownership, and quality standards for the data that feeds accounting and reporting.
  • Strengthen data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance through effective data validation, reconciliation, and operational controls, identifying and addressing data quality gaps at the source.
  • Drive process improvements and leverage automation, including AI-enabled capabilities, to reduce manual effort, improve reporting efficiency, and mitigate operational risk.
  • Balance delivery of new capabilities with platform stability, ongoing production support, and evolving regulatory and data governance requirements.
  • Define and monitor product-level KPIs to measure reporting timeliness, data quality, operational efficiency, and delivery outcomes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in business, technology, financial services, or consulting, including 5+ years working with Agile teams in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • Working knowledge of investment accounting and financial and regulatory reporting frameworks, including statutory accounting principles (SAP) and NAIC investment reporting, GAAP, and TAX, including basis differences between them.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, translating complex business and technical requirements into actionable user stories, and delivering technology or data-driven solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate business processes, data dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to proactively plan and independently drive complex initiatives from requirements through implementation, set and meet deadlines, manage dependencies, and deliver business value in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstratesstrong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation whilemaintainingsound judgment and compliance with governance standards

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in insurance or asset management, with familiarity with investment instruments and accounting processes.
  • Experience with SimCorp Dimension or comparable investment accounting platforms such as Blackrock Aladdin, Eagle STAR, State Street Alpha, Charles River, Princeton Financial System, Clearwater, FIS, SS&C Advent Geneva
  • Data management and regulatory reporting capabilities, and multi-basis (statutory, GAAP, and TAX) accounting.
  • Experience working with data and investment product teams on data quality, reference data, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), reporting automation, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Fair Chance Notices

The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners and senior leadership to strengthen data quality and controls, improve reporting processes, reduce operational risk, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Responsibilities:

Product Strategy, Prioritization & Delivery

  • Partner with the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner and stakeholders to shape and execute the Accounting Product roadmap across reporting frameworks (statutory/NAIC, GAAP, and TAX), ensuring alignment with broader product strategy and regulatory requirements.
  • Own and prioritize the Accounting Product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory deadlines, strategic enhancements, technical improvements, and production support, and serve as the point of coordination for all accounting- and reporting-related changes across product backlogs.
  • Translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Proactively collaborate with other Product Owners, SimCorp Dimension's REGCOE, and technology and data teams to anticipate dependencies, remove impediments before they affect delivery, and drive outcomes.
  • Set clear deadlines and handoff dates for each deliverable and maintain visibility of partner teams' commitments and deadlines so that dependencies, sequencing, and critical-path risks are managed in advance.
  • Lead Agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and coordination of development, testing, business validation, and production implementation.
  • Evaluate business value, feasibility, and regulatory risk to make informed prioritization decisions and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Regulatory & Accounting Change Management

  • Proactively monitor regulatory, statutory accounting, and reporting framework changes (e.g., NAIC updates), as well as SimCorp REGCOE releases and roadmap items, and assess their impact on systems, data flows, and downstream processes ahead of effective dates.
  • Translate upcoming changes into backlog items with defined timelines, owners, and testing and validation plans, and communicate impacts, priorities, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership early.
  • Assess the impact of new investment types and reporting requirements across statutory, GAAP, and TAX bases, including basis differences (such as the statutory-to-GAAP "stat gap") and their effect on reporting content and downstream processes.
  • Apply working knowledge of investment accounting, investment operations, and the upstream data that feeds reporting (trade capture and settlement, security master and reference data, pricing and valuation sources, custodian and counterparty data, and corporate actions) to evaluate how upstream changes affect reporting accuracy and timing.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Internal (LMI): Partner with Investment Reporting, Operations, Investment Product, Data Product, Technology and other Financial Product teams to deliver accurate, complete, and timely financial and regulatory reporting.
  • Liberty Mutual Group (LMG): Coordinate with LMG Corporate Accounting, Finance, TAX, and other group functions that depend on LMI's accounting and reporting outputs, aligning on requirements, calendars, and priorities.
  • Vendors: Work with SimCorp, implementation partners, and other platform and data vendors to manage releases, defects, enhancements, and delivery commitments.
  • Regulators and external parties: Support engagement with regulators, auditors, and advisors as needed, and ensure reporting changes and regulatory requirements are understood and addressed ahead of deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Accounting Product stakeholders, building strong relationships, facilitating decisions, and communicating priorities, progress, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Proactively identify and resolve reporting issues, data quality concerns, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks as appropriate to protect critical reporting timelines.

Data Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Data Product and Investment Product, alongside Accounting, Finance, and Technology stakeholders, to define data requirements, ownership, and quality standards for the data that feeds accounting and reporting.
  • Strengthen data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance through effective data validation, reconciliation, and operational controls, identifying and addressing data quality gaps at the source.
  • Drive process improvements and leverage automation, including AI-enabled capabilities, to reduce manual effort, improve reporting efficiency, and mitigate operational risk.
  • Balance delivery of new capabilities with platform stability, ongoing production support, and evolving regulatory and data governance requirements.
  • Define and monitor product-level KPIs to measure reporting timeliness, data quality, operational efficiency, and delivery outcomes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in business, technology, financial services, or consulting, including 5+ years working with Agile teams in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • Working knowledge of investment accounting and financial and regulatory reporting frameworks, including statutory accounting principles (SAP) and NAIC investment reporting, GAAP, and TAX, including basis differences between them.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, translating complex business and technical requirements into actionable user stories, and delivering technology or data-driven solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate business processes, data dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to proactively plan and independently drive complex initiatives from requirements through implementation, set and meet deadlines, manage dependencies, and deliver business value in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstratesstrong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation whilemaintainingsound judgment and compliance with governance standards

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in insurance or asset management, with familiarity with investment instruments and accounting processes.
  • Experience with SimCorp Dimension or comparable investment accounting platforms such as Blackrock Aladdin, Eagle STAR, State Street Alpha, Charles River, Princeton Financial System, Clearwater, FIS, SS&C Advent Geneva
  • Data management and regulatory reporting capabilities, and multi-basis (statutory, GAAP, and TAX) accounting.
  • Experience working with data and investment product teams on data quality, reference data, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), reporting automation, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.

About this job

Manages investigations and resolutions of moderate to severe property loss claims with limited supervision at Liberty Mutual Insurance. This remote position requires strong claims handling knowledge, building construction understanding, and at least 5 years of related experience.

Good fit if you have a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, 5+ years in claims handling, advanced property training, and strong customer service skills.

Full job description


Description

Manages, investigates and resolves assigned moderate to severe property loss claims under limited supervision. Provides policyholders with exceptional customer service.

Training is a critical component to your success and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory

This position is listed as remote.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates, determines coverage of loss and adjusts all elements of Property Loss claims of moderate-high severity.
  • Handles moderate- severe complexity claims assigned under little supervision.
  • Works with a Field Appraiser or Liberty network contractor in the appraisal process of moderate- severe complexity claims.
  • Explains coverage of loss, assists policyholders with itemization of damages, emergency repairs and additional living arrangements.
  • Works with and may coordinate a number of vendor services such as contractors, emergency repair, cleaning services and various replacement services.
  • Identifies suspicious losses.
  • Recommends referral to SIU where appropriate and may assist the SIU in their investigation and settling of the claim.
  • May be called upon for catastrophe duty.
Qualifications
  • Demonstrated understanding of building construction principles.
  • Requires strong knowledge of claims handling procedures, and a full working knowledge of claims operations and procedures.
  • Proven ability to provide exceptional customer service experience.
  • Effective negotiation skills.
  • Ability to effectively and independently manage workload while exhibiting good judgment.
  • Strong written and communication skills; interpersonal skills; computer skills with the ability to work with multi-faceted systems; and analytical skills.
  • The capabilities, skills and knowledge required is normally acquired through bachelors Degree or equivalent experience and at least 5 years of directly related experience.
  • Completion of advanced property training.
  • Ability to obtain proper licensing as required.

About this job

Staff Attorney at Liberty Mutual managing moderately complex civil litigation involving personal injury and property damage claims up to approximately $50,000 exposure. Primarily remote in California with required in-person appearances, mentoring responsibilities, and focus on legal strategy, settlement negotiations, and client relationship management.

Good fit if you have 5+ years of trial attorney experience, California bar admission, insurance law knowledge, and e-discovery proficiency.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of California except for required appearances.

In addition to the base salary, an incentive bonus is a part of the compensation package and will be discussed during the interview process.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If youre looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual is seeking a skilled and proactive Attorney to independently manage moderately complex civil litigation matters. This role requires a deep understanding of legal principles and insurance law, strategic case management, advanced technology utilization, and strong clientrelationship skills. The Attorney will develop and execute sophisticated legal strategies, lead settlement negotiations, mentor junior attorneys, and contribute to organizational improvements while maintaining the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Management and Execution: Independently manage all phases of litigation involving claims of moderate to heavy value (up to approximately $50,000 exposure). Conduct comprehensive legal research, draft precise pleadings, motions, and other legal documents. Lead settlement negotiations and participate in hearings, trials, and mediations to achieve optimal case outcomes.
  • Litigation Support: Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Legal Strategy Development: Develop, implement, and continuously refine advanced legal strategies for discovery, investigation, and trial preparation.
  • Technology Utilization: Employ advanced e-discovery tools, case management systems, and data analysis software to streamline workflows and reduce costs.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear, well-reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to clients and Claims Representatives. Build and sustain trusted relationships by understanding client operations and legal challenges.
  • Risk Evaluation and Mitigation: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with cases in collaboration with clients and senior attorneys.
  • Training, Mentoring, and Leadership: Design and conduct training sessions and workshops for Legal, Claims, and related departments. Mentor junior attorneys and legal support staff, offering guidance and direction to elevate team performance.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with relevant laws, regulations, and company policies. Adhere strictly to ethical guidelines, licensing requirements, and the Model Rules of Professional Conduct (MRPC).
  • Organizational Improvement and Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities for process automation and workflow enhancements.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Californiaand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of successful trial attorney experience, preferably within insurance law and related litigation.
  • Proven experience managing moderately complex litigation with demonstrated success in achieving favorable outcomes.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Exceptional legal research, writing, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficient in advanced e-discovery tools, legal case management software, and remote collaboration technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and lead junior attorneys and legal staff.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Commitment to ethical legal practice and compliance with all regulatory and professional standards.

Full job description


Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of California except for required appearances.

In addition to the base salary, an incentive bonus is a part of the compensation package and will be discussed during the interview process.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligible performance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If youre looking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual is seeking a skilled and proactive Attorney to independently manage moderately complex civil litigation matters. This role requires a deep understanding of legal principles and insurance law, strategic case management, advanced technology utilization, and strong clientrelationship skills. The Attorney will develop and execute sophisticated legal strategies, lead settlement negotiations, mentor junior attorneys, and contribute to organizational improvements while maintaining the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Management and Execution: Independently manage all phases of litigation involving claims of moderate to heavy value (up to approximately $50,000 exposure). Conduct comprehensive legal research, draft precise pleadings, motions, and other legal documents. Lead settlement negotiations and participate in hearings, trials, and mediations to achieve optimal case outcomes.
  • Litigation Support: Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Legal Strategy Development: Develop, implement, and continuously refine advanced legal strategies for discovery, investigation, and trial preparation.
  • Technology Utilization: Employ advanced e-discovery tools, case management systems, and data analysis software to streamline workflows and reduce costs.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear, well-reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to clients and Claims Representatives. Build and sustain trusted relationships by understanding client operations and legal challenges.
  • Risk Evaluation and Mitigation: Identify, evaluate, and mitigate legal risks associated with cases in collaboration with clients and senior attorneys.
  • Training, Mentoring, and Leadership: Design and conduct training sessions and workshops for Legal, Claims, and related departments. Mentor junior attorneys and legal support staff, offering guidance and direction to elevate team performance.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with relevant laws, regulations, and company policies. Adhere strictly to ethical guidelines, licensing requirements, and the Model Rules of Professional Conduct (MRPC).
  • Organizational Improvement and Innovation: Identify and implement opportunities for process automation and workflow enhancements.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Californiaand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of successful trial attorney experience, preferably within insurance law and related litigation.
  • Proven experience managing moderately complex litigation with demonstrated success in achieving favorable outcomes.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Exceptional legal research, writing, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficient in advanced e-discovery tools, legal case management software, and remote collaboration technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and lead junior attorneys and legal staff.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and client relationship management skills.
  • Commitment to ethical legal practice and compliance with all regulatory and professional standards.

Description

This role is primarily remote in the state of California except for required appearances.

In addition to the base salary, an incentive bonus is part of the compensation package and will be discussed during the interview process.

At Liberty Mutual, were committed to delivering exceptional legal services to our customers around the world, working to uphold and protect our policyholders rights and positively impacting our business. As an Associate Attorney at Liberty Mutual, youll join a diverse team that values a healthy work/life balance and enjoy benefits that include eligibleperformance bonuses, 20 days of flexible time off each year, personal holidays, and a 401(k) plan with matching contributions. If yourelooking for a place to build a long-term career while making a positive difference, consider joining our legal team where youll represent Liberty Mutual and our policyholders in moderately complex civil litigation matters involving claims for monetary damages or compensation for personal injuries or property damage of moderate value.

Liberty Mutual Insurance offers an engaging opportunity for an Associate Attorney to represent the company and its policyholders in routine civil litigation and workers' compensation matters involving moderately complex legal issues and claims for monetary damages or compensation related to personal injury or property damage. Under moderate supervision, you will manage cases from inception through resolution, applying your legal knowledge, research skills, and client relationship capabilities in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Litigation Execution: Manage all phases of litigation, including discovery, hearings, trials, mediations, and drafting legal documents such as pleadings and motions. Support Senior Trial Counsel and Senior Litigation Counsel in all aspects of case handling through trial, including preparation, management, and assistance at every stage of the litigation process.
  • Client Advisory and Relationship Management: Provide clear and reasoned legal opinions and strategic advice to Claims Representatives and insured clients. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through transparent and effective communication.
  • Technology Utilization: Utilize e-discovery and case management technologies to streamline legal processes, improve efficiency, and reduce operational costs. Demonstrate effective coordination with remote team members and proficiency in remote work settings.
  • Risk Evaluation and Case Resolution Facilitation: Identify, evaluate, and collaborate on strategies to mitigate legal risks, working closely with clients and senior counsel to facilitate effective resolutions.
  • Documentation Accuracy and Compliance: Ensure all legal documents, pleadings, and motions are meticulously prepared, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Timely Client Communication: Provide clear, consistent, and timely updates and recommendations to insured clients and claims professionals to maintain alignment with case objectives.
  • Contribution to Organizational Improvement: Participate in initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and best practices within Staff Legal and Global Legal & Compliance organizations.
  • Ethical Compliance Adherence: Uphold the highest standards of legal ethics and compliance, following legal regulations and licensing requirements and promoting a culture of integrity within the legal team.
Qualifications
  • Juris Doctor (JD) or LLB degree from an accredited law school.
  • Admission to the bar in Californiaand in good standing; special licenses to practice before particular boards or federal courts may be required.
  • General knowledge of insurance law, and as necessary, workers compensation and/or No Fault law.
  • Proficient in e-discovery, case management systems, and basic legal analysis tools.
  • Strong analytical, research, and legal writing skills.
  • Basic knowledge of negotiation techniques including preparation, active listening, and problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage cases from start to finish under supervision.
  • Effective communication and persuasion skills, both written and oral.
  • Ability to collaborate with clients, claims professionals, and senior attorneys.
  • Organized, process-oriented with strong time management skills.

Description

Are you looking for an opportunity to join a claims team with a fast growing company that has consistently outpaced the industry in year over year growth? Liberty Mutual has an excellent claims opportunity available. As a Commercial Insurance Claims Representative, you will review and process simple and straightforward Commercial claims within assigned authority limits consistent with policy and legal requirements. In addition to a wide range of benefits, as a direct employee, your insurance education and training are paid by Liberty Mutual.

Responsibilities:

  • Investigates claim using internal and external resources including speaking with the insured or other involved parties, analysis of reports, researching past claim activity, utilizing evaluation tools to make damage and loss assessments.
  • Extensive and timely direct interaction with Insured's, Claimants, Agent's and Internal Customers.
  • Determines policy coverage through analysis of investigation data and policy terms. Notifies agent and insured of coverage or any issues.
  • Establishes claim reserve requirements and makes adjustments, as necessary, during the processing of the claims.
  • Determines and negotiates settlement amount for damages claimed within assigned authority limits.
  • Writes simple to moderately complex property damage estimates or review auto damage estimates.
  • Takes statements when necessary and works with the Field Appraisal, Subrogation, Special Investigative Unit (SIU) as appropriate.
  • Maintains accurate and current claim file/damage documentation and diaries throughout the life cycle of claim cases to ensure proper tracking and handling consistent with established guidelines and expectations.
  • Alerts Unit Leader to the possibility of fraud or subrogation potential for claims being processed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelors Degree preferred. High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1-2 years of experience. Claims handling skills preferred.
  • Strong customer service and technology skills.
  • Able to navigate multiple systems, strong organizational and communication skills.
  • License may be required in multiple states by state law.

Job.JobTitle: Product Owner II, Insurance Investment Accounting, Liberty Mutual Investments
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Insurance Accountant, Accounting / Finance, Insurance Product Manager
Job.JobDescription:
Quick facts

  • Schedule: Full-time
  • Location: Boston, MA
  • Experience: 5+ years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree

About this job

Product Owner II supporting Liberty Mutual Investments' accounting platform, responsible for investment accounting and regulatory reporting across statutory, GAAP, and tax frameworks. Role involves managing the accounting product backlog, translating business and regulatory requirements into technology solutions, and coordinating with delivery teams and the SimCorp platform vendor.

Good fit if you have experience with investment accounting, regulatory reporting frameworks, and working with Agile delivery teams in financial services.

Full job description


Description

The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI

The Position:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is seeking aProduct Owner II to support its Accounting Product, with responsibility for investment accounting and regulatory and financial reporting capabilities across multiple reporting frameworks, including statutory (National Association of Insurance Commissioners, NAIC), GAAP, and TAX. The role will focus on enhancing and maintaining accounting and reporting capabilities within LMI's investment accounting platform, SimCorp Dimension, and its related data and reporting processes, with an emphasis on the end-to-end processes and upstream data that produce reported figures, including quarterly and annual statutory investment schedules. This position reports to the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner within Financial Products and Global Investment Solutions (GIS).

Operating at the intersection of Investment Accounting, Finance, Technology, Data, Investment Product, and the platform vendor, the Product Owner will translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable product priorities and drive the delivery of technology solutions that enable accurate, timely, and reliable financial and regulatory reporting. The role will own the Accounting Product backlog and proactively partner with Agile delivery teams, other Product Owners, and SimCorp Dimension's Regulatory Center of Excellence (REGCOE) to deliver solutions aligned with business priorities and regulatory commitments.

This role requires strong business acumen, technical fluency, sound judgment, and a proactive approach: anticipating regulatory and accounting changes, setting and communicating timelines, and aligning dependencies early. The Product Owner will collaborate with business partners and senior leadership to strengthen data quality and controls, improve reporting processes, reduce operational risk, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The Responsibilities:

Product Strategy, Prioritization & Delivery

  • Partner with the Accounting Portfolio Product Owner and stakeholders to shape and execute the Accounting Product roadmap across reporting frameworks (statutory/NAIC, GAAP, and TAX), ensuring alignment with broader product strategy and regulatory requirements.
  • Own and prioritize the Accounting Product backlog, balancing business value, regulatory deadlines, strategic enhancements, technical improvements, and production support, and serve as the point of coordination for all accounting- and reporting-related changes across product backlogs.
  • Translate business, accounting, and regulatory requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Proactively collaborate with other Product Owners, SimCorp Dimension's REGCOE, and technology and data teams to anticipate dependencies, remove impediments before they affect delivery, and drive outcomes.
  • Set clear deadlines and handoff dates for each deliverable and maintain visibility of partner teams' commitments and deadlines so that dependencies, sequencing, and critical-path risks are managed in advance.
  • Lead Agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, and coordination of development, testing, business validation, and production implementation.
  • Evaluate business value, feasibility, and regulatory risk to make informed prioritization decisions and ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Regulatory & Accounting Change Management

  • Proactively monitor regulatory, statutory accounting, and reporting framework changes (e.g., NAIC updates), as well as SimCorp REGCOE releases and roadmap items, and assess their impact on systems, data flows, and downstream processes ahead of effective dates.
  • Translate upcoming changes into backlog items with defined timelines, owners, and testing and validation plans, and communicate impacts, priorities, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership early.
  • Assess the impact of new investment types and reporting requirements across statutory, GAAP, and TAX bases, including basis differences (such as the statutory-to-GAAP "stat gap") and their effect on reporting content and downstream processes.
  • Apply working knowledge of investment accounting, investment operations, and the upstream data that feeds reporting (trade capture and settlement, security master and reference data, pricing and valuation sources, custodian and counterparty data, and corporate actions) to evaluate how upstream changes affect reporting accuracy and timing.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Internal (LMI): Partner with Investment Reporting, Operations, Investment Product, Data Product, Technology and other Financial Product teams to deliver accurate, complete, and timely financial and regulatory reporting.
  • Liberty Mutual Group (LMG): Coordinate with LMG Corporate Accounting, Finance, TAX, and other group functions that depend on LMI's accounting and reporting outputs, aligning on requirements, calendars, and priorities.
  • Vendors: Work with SimCorp, implementation partners, and other platform and data vendors to manage releases, defects, enhancements, and delivery commitments.
  • Regulators and external parties: Support engagement with regulators, auditors, and advisors as needed, and ensure reporting changes and regulatory requirements are understood and addressed ahead of deadlines.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Accounting Product stakeholders, building strong relationships, facilitating decisions, and communicating priorities, progress, and risks to stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Proactively identify and resolve reporting issues, data quality concerns, and cross-team dependencies, escalating risks as appropriate to protect critical reporting timelines.

Data Quality, Risk & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with Data Product and Investment Product, alongside Accounting, Finance, and Technology stakeholders, to define data requirements, ownership, and quality standards for the data that feeds accounting and reporting.
  • Strengthen data integrity, reporting accuracy, and regulatory compliance through effective data validation, reconciliation, and operational controls, identifying and addressing data quality gaps at the source.
  • Drive process improvements and leverage automation, including AI-enabled capabilities, to reduce manual effort, improve reporting efficiency, and mitigate operational risk.
  • Balance delivery of new capabilities with platform stability, ongoing production support, and evolving regulatory and data governance requirements.
  • Define and monitor product-level KPIs to measure reporting timeliness, data quality, operational efficiency, and delivery outcomes.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in business, technology, financial services, or consulting, including 3+ years working with Agile teams in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • Working knowledge of investment accounting and financial and regulatory reporting frameworks, including statutory accounting principles (SAP) and NAIC investment reporting, GAAP, and TAX, including basis differences between them.
  • Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, translating complex business and technical requirements into actionable user stories, and delivering technology or data-driven solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate business processes, data dependencies, risks, and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to proactively plan and independently drive complex initiatives from requirements through implementation, set and meet deadlines, manage dependencies, and deliver business value in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstratesstrong AI literacy and uses AI-enabled tools to enhance speed, accuracy, and insight generation whilemaintainingsound judgment and compliance with governance standards

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in insurance or asset management, with familiarity with investment instruments and accounting processes.
  • Experience with SimCorp Dimension or comparable investment accounting platforms such as Blackrock Aladdin, Eagle STAR, State Street Alpha, Charles River, Princeton Financial System, Clearwater, FIS, SS&C Advent Geneva
  • Data management and regulatory reporting capabilities, and multi-basis (statutory, GAAP, and TAX) accounting.
  • Experience working with data and investment product teams on data quality, reference data, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), reporting automation, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.

The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Libertys strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion (as of 12/31/2025) of capital globally,taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Libertys strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technologywith the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI

Description

We are seeking a high-performing Construction Casualty Executive Underwriter to drive profitable growth and strategic portfolio development across the Midwest region. In this role, you will leverage deep construction industry expertise and advanced underwriting acumen to manage complex Middle Market, Large Account, and National Account casualty risks. As part of Liberty Mutual, you will have the authority to make impactful underwriting decisions, build strong broker and client relationships, and contribute to the continued success of our specialized construction practice. If you are a proven commercial insurance underwriting professional with a strong market presence, exceptional risk assessment skills, and a growth-oriented mindset, this is an outstanding opportunity to advance your career while shaping a profitable book of business.

This role could be filled at the Senior or Executive level depending upon experience.

Responsibilities:

This position would be located in the field near our agency/broker partners:

  • Risk Selection: Reviews, rates, underwrites, evaluates, or assesses the business applying for insurance by qualifying accounts, identifying, selecting and assessing risks, determining the premium, policy terms and conditions, obtaining approvals, creating/presenting the proposal to the agent/broker, and successfully negotiating deals.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Demonstrates a high level of responsiveness and focus on supporting Key Agents and Brokers objectives. Establishes, develops, and maintains successful relationships with Key Agents and Brokers to facilitate marketing of products, through responsive service, site visits, in person renewal meetings or enhanced knowledge of their customers businesses. Develops strong personal brand to build and maintain a long-term quality pipeline with Key Agents/Brokers.
  • Portfolio Management: Manages a sizable and complex book of business by analyzing the portfolio, identifying areas of opportunity for improved growth, profit and diversification, and executing marketing plans to increase market share by making marketing calls to preferred brokers to market and cross market. Provides input to the development of marketing plans, product analysis, services, geographic focus and broker intelligence.
  • Documenting the Deal: Documents files in a way that reflects a solid thought process and decision making through comprehensive account reviews, sign-offs and referrals that comply with state regulations, letter of authority, and underwriting guidelines.
  • Leadership: Formally guides, mentors, and coaches underwriters and account analysts in both technical and professional skills. Demonstrates multiple areas of expertise and provides regular updates to other underwriters.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participates in continuous improvement by generating suggestions, participating in problem solving activities and using continuous improvement tools to support the work of the team.
Qualifications
  • Intermediate-level knowledge of insurance products/coverage, underwriting, pricing, risk selection, market segments and marketplace; insurance finance and actuarial concepts; loss control/risk engineering; marketing techniques, regulatory environment and reinsurance; advanced-level knowledge of territory management.
  • Ability to apply underwriting/appetite, tools, systems, and resources to achieve goals, solve complex problems, establish and build healthy working relationships exceeds in mentoring relationships, and negotiate as normally acquired and a related bachelors degree, three to ten years of relevant experience preferred; CPCU or professional insurance designation strongly preferred.

Description

We are seeking a high-performing Construction Casualty Executive Underwriter to drive profitable growth and strategic portfolio development across the Midwest region. In this role, you will leverage deep construction industry expertise and advanced underwriting acumen to manage complex Middle Market, Large Account, and National Account casualty risks. As part of Liberty Mutual, you will have the authority to make impactful underwriting decisions, build strong broker and client relationships, and contribute to the continued success of our specialized construction practice. If you are a proven commercial insurance underwriting professional with a strong market presence, exceptional risk assessment skills, and a growth-oriented mindset, this is an outstanding opportunity to advance your career while shaping a profitable book of business.

This role could be filled at the Senior or Executive level depending upon experience.

Responsibilities:

This position would be located in the field near our agency/broker partners:

  • Risk Selection: Reviews, rates, underwrites, evaluates, or assesses the business applying for insurance by qualifying accounts, identifying, selecting and assessing risks, determining the premium, policy terms and conditions, obtaining approvals, creating/presenting the proposal to the agent/broker, and successfully negotiating deals.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Demonstrates a high level of responsiveness and focus on supporting Key Agents and Brokers objectives. Establishes, develops, and maintains successful relationships with Key Agents and Brokers to facilitate marketing of products, through responsive service, site visits, in person renewal meetings or enhanced knowledge of their customers businesses. Develops strong personal brand to build and maintain a long-term quality pipeline with Key Agents/Brokers.
  • Portfolio Management: Manages a sizable and complex book of business by analyzing the portfolio, identifying areas of opportunity for improved growth, profit and diversification, and executing marketing plans to increase market share by making marketing calls to preferred brokers to market and cross market. Provides input to the development of marketing plans, product analysis, services, geographic focus and broker intelligence.
  • Documenting the Deal: Documents files in a way that reflects a solid thought process and decision making through comprehensive account reviews, sign-offs and referrals that comply with state regulations, letter of authority, and underwriting guidelines.
  • Leadership: Formally guides, mentors, and coaches underwriters and account analysts in both technical and professional skills. Demonstrates multiple areas of expertise and provides regular updates to other underwriters.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively participates in continuous improvement by generating suggestions, participating in problem solving activities and using continuous improvement tools to support the work of the team.
Qualifications
  • Intermediate-level knowledge of insurance products/coverage, underwriting, pricing, risk selection, market segments and marketplace; insurance finance and actuarial concepts; loss control/risk engineering; marketing techniques, regulatory environment and reinsurance; advanced-level knowledge of territory management.
  • Ability to apply underwriting/appetite, tools, systems, and resources to achieve goals, solve complex problems, establish and build healthy working relationships exceeds in mentoring relationships, and negotiate as normally acquired and a related bachelors degree, three to ten years of relevant experience preferred; CPCU or professional insurance designation strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities

The Tax Underwriter role provides a rare opportunity to develop your career as part of a market-leading, dedicated team of underwriting professionals. We are looking for an intelligent and enthusiastic candidate to underwrite bespoke tax liability insurance policies covering potential tax liability as a result of M&A transactions, internal restructurings, tax incentives related to investments in renewable energy, and other transactions.

The Successful Candidate Will Attend To The Following Responsibilities

GTS is proud of its reputation for training and developing staff and as such, this role offers great potential for an individual with a strong tax and legal (and/or M&A background) interested in establishing or further developing expertise in this exciting and growing sector of the insurance market.

  • assisting the team to build the Liberty GTS brand through marketing and business development opportunities;
  • providing technical training and guidance to other junior members of the team;
  • continuing to seek improvement of the product and its practices and processes; and
  • contributing to an effective team environment by interacting professionally with all team members in line with GTS core values.

  • Legal experience specializing in tax (with a strong preference for M&A experience) or tax liability insurance (preferably 4+ years) from a well-regarded accounting or law firm

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Strong legal drafting skills and broad understanding of legal and contract concepts
  • Interpersonal and relationship-building skills; and business, financial, and risk awareness/understanding is a plus

About this job

Manager overseeing risk assessment and controls for Global Risk Solutions across 20+ countries. Role combines analytical process auditing with stakeholder influence, uses GenAI tools to streamline mechanical work, and leads audit remediation, controls quality, and program partner oversight.

Good fit if you have 7+ years auditing and accounting experience, 5+ in insurance, CPA or CIA, and prior people leadership experience.

Full job description


Description

Global Risk Solutions writes business in more than 20 countries, and the controls behind that business have to hold up everywhere. This role owns a meaningful piece of how we prove they do and how we keep proving it faster, using the AI tools now built into the way our team works.

This is a role for someone who genuinely likes both halves of controls work: the analytical half, where you dig into a process and find the gap nobody else noticed, and the influencing half, where you bring a business owner along without owning their process or their decision. You'll partner with underwriting, claims, compliance and finance leaders across North America, Latin America, Europe and Asia Pacific and with external program partners, where you'll often be the Liberty Mutual voice in the room.

The opportunity

You'll help lead how GRS assures and strengthens its control environment worldwide driving the resolution of audit findings, elevating the quality of account reconciliations, building attestation programs from the ground up, and leading controls audits of our program partners. Alongside all of it, you'll bring a builder's mindset to how the work itself gets done: using GenAI to take on the mechanical lift so more of your time and your team's goes toward judgment, not formatting.

Where you'll make an impact

  • Audit remediation & assurance
    • Serve as GRS's connective tissue with Global Internal Audit keeping findings, action plans and closure evidence moving toward resolution, and escalating where the risk warrants it.
    • Support the external audit process- Coordinating request, resolving open items with external auditor on a timely basis.
  • Controls & attestation quality
    • Raise the bar on the controls framework across GRS strengthening account reconciliations and attestation coverage across entities and extending that same rigor to every project and initiative the business takes on.
    • Turn documentation, process gaps and structural weaknesses into durable fixes.
  • Program partner oversight
    • Plan and lead controls audits of external program partners, testing what they report against what actually happens and following up until remediation is real.
  • AI-augmented analysis
    • Put GenAI to work on reshaping data, drafting first-pass analysis and getting up to speed on technical findings quickly then build repeatable AI workflows the rest of the team can use too.
  • People leadership
    • Coach and develop team members, including across significant time-zone gaps, building their judgment so they can make sound calls independently.

Built around AI, not bolted on

Liberty Mutual is investing heavily in AI across the enterprise, and GRS Financial Controls is one of the places that shift shows up first. This role sits right at that intersection: you'll use GenAI to compress the time spent on mechanical work reshaping files, comparing narratives across entities, drafting the first version of an observation and apply the time you get back to the calls that actually need a human. You'll also help set the pattern for the rest of the team, turning one-off prompts into repeatable processes others can pick up and trust.

What you'll bring

Preferred Qualifications

  • Property & casualty insurance experience programs, reinsurance or surety a plusCPA, CIA, CPCU or an advanced degree in accounting, finance or business
  • Prior people-leadership experience
Qualifications
  • Master's degree/MBA; CPA
  • Requires 7+ years of auditing and accounting experience, 5+ insurance industry experience
  • Knowledge of financial accounting systems, business processes and reporting tools
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills, Strong negotiation skills, Project management skills

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

We are looking for candidates living in: Newark, DE | Oxford, PA | Avondale, PA | West Grove, PA & Kennett Square, PA.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Qualifications

Day One Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

Licensing:

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired (P&C and Life).

Description

Description

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.

  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

THIS IS NOT A REMOTE ROLE

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Full job description


Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, youll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed no prior insurance experience required.

Description

What youll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

What We Offer:

  • Unlimited commission and renewal income potential for earnings growth over time.
  • Full-time employment with benefits from day one, including health insurance, generous 401(k) match, and paid time off.
  • Paid training, licensing support, and ongoing development.
  • Autonomy to embrace your entrepreneurial spirit and structure your time your way.
  • Flexible work structure (hybrid office, field, and remote based on what your day requires).
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and long-term career paths.
Qualifications

Who Were Looking For:

Day One Skills & Traits

  • Self-motivated and accountable you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive you follow through and do what you say youll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Outgoing youre comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Tech savvy youre able to learn and use technology and digital tools with ease.
  • Calm under pressure you stay composed in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.

You will be required to obtain relevant licenses upon being hired.

Candidates are welcome to apply even if you do not currently hold your Property & Casualty and Life insurance licenses; however, you must obtain both licenses before your scheduled start date.   • Competitive Compensation:
    • $55K$65K base training salary

    • Uncapped commissions and renewal income for sustained earning potential
  • Career Growth & Support:

    • Earn public recognition at company events and in team communications, spotlighting your success and setting you apart as a top performer.

  • Highly self-motivated individuals
  • Networkers and relationship-builders who love face-to-face interaction
  • Adaptable professionals who own their results and rise to challenges
  • Team players eager to learn, grow, and continuously improve
  • Charismatic communicators who enjoy helping others protect what matters most

Job.JobDescription:
Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME!

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work. Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING

We have assignments available to help our insurance carrier or MGU clients in Premium Auditor / Auditor Assistant positions. Responsibilities may include:

  • Conduct audits of insurance policies by evaluating the insured's business operation, including examining, verifying, and recording pertinent classification-related data from financial/business records.
  • Review and summarize submitted information from insureds to determine correct exposures for all classifications. 
  • Review dispute information received from agents or insureds who contest audit results, analyze the submitted information for relevance and appropriate documentation.
  • Communicate with all internal and external customers regarding exposures, classification changes, or general auditing procedure questions pertaining to premium audits.
  • Ensure the process complies with regulatory, statutory, and procedural requirements. Including evaluating system access and management control reports.
  • Proven experience with problem solving, analyzing data, and recommending corrective measures.
  • Currently - HIGH DEMAND for General Liability and/or Workers Compensation premium audit experience.

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most current years of premium audit experience with Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance carrier or MGU in an auditor role

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT

  • Health insurance based on eligibility.
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility.
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).
  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules.
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself!

HOW TO GET STARTED

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!
